title: 抗体修飾物複合体の製造方法、及び医薬の製造方法
abstract: 下記工程（ａ）及び（ｂ）を含む、抗体修飾物複合体の製造方法、及び医薬の製造方法。 工程（ａ）：抗体と還元剤とをＧａイオンの存在下で反応させ、上記抗体内の鎖間ジスルフィド結合を還元してチオール基を生成する工程。 工程（ｂ）：反応性基を有する修飾物と、上記工程（ａ）で生成した上記チオール基とを反応させて、抗体修飾物複合体を得る工程。

title: 組成物の検査方法、組成物の検査装置、及び組成物の製造方法
abstract: 非接触で組成物を検査でき、かつインラインで、しかも短時間での組成物の検査に適した組成物の検査方法、組成物の検査装置、及び組成物の製造方法を提供する。組成物の検査方法は、組成物をノズルのノズル口から連続して送液する工程と、ノズル口から連続して送液される組成物の動画又は画像を取得する工程とを有し、さらに、組成物の形状、組成物の流速、及び組成物の光学特性のうち、少なくとも１つを算出する工程Ａ、及び組成物の動画又は画像を入力データとする学習済の機械学習モデルを用いて組成物を検査する工程Ｂのうち、少なくとも１つの工程とを有する。

abstract: 1529838 Rear projection screen FUJI PHOTO FILM CO Ltd 23 Dec 1975 [26 Dec 1974] 52730/75 Heading G2X [Also in Division C5] A rear projection screen comprises a lightdiffusing layer of wax mixed with 0À1-80 wt. per cent (based on the wt. of wax) of a polymer which increases the mechanical strength of the wax. The wax layer is preferably 0À2-2À0mm thick and may be self-supporting or laminated to a transparent support (preferably coloured), e.g. using a transparent adhesive. The wax may be natural, petroleum or synthetic (e.g. animal, plant, paraffin, microcrystalline, polyolefine or polyalkylene oxide wax). The polymer may be rosin, a rosin derivative or a terpene, terpene phenol, phenolic, xylenic, petroleum, cumarone-indene or styrene resin, ethylenevinyl acetate copolymer, polyisobutylene, polybutene and atactic polypropylene; the wax may additionally contain an antioxidant, U.V. absorber and/or colourant. One or both surfaces of the wax layer may be mat or have an optical element surface structure (e.g. lenticular, Fresnel or fly-eye lens structure).

title: Activity measurement method of beta-galactosidase
abstract: PURPOSE:To measure the activity of beta-galactosidase photochemically, by subjecting a compound having a sensitivity reducing action on a photosensitive  silver halide to pyranoside bond at the 1-position of galactose, using it with a  sensitivity weakly reducing action as a substrate. CONSTITUTION:A compound (e.g., 4-,ethylthiazole) having a sensitivity reducing action on a photosensitive silver halide is subjected to pyranoside bond at the 1-position of galactose, to prepare a compound shown by the formula (Z forms 5-6-membered heterocyclic ring containing 1-4 atoms except carbon) having a sensitivity weakly reducing action. This compound is used as a substrate, reacted with beta-galactosidase, and decomposed into galactose and a compound having sensitivity reducing action. The reaction mixture of the compound having a sensitivity reducing action is brought into contact with a silver halide, and exposed. The exposed silver halide is developed, and the prepared optical concentration is determined, to measure the activity of beta-galactosidase.

title: Color chart for evaluation of color of tea water
abstract: PURPOSE:To evaluate the quality by a color of a water accurately without difference between individuals, by using a color chart obtained by mixing a coloring material having spectroscopic transmissivity similar to that in visual region of a color of tea water in a transparent sheetlike body or applying said coloring material on the surface of said body. CONSTITUTION:At the time of evaluating the quality by a color of water of tea such as black tea, green tea, the spectrosopic transmissivity of color of tea water after immersing a prescribed weight of tea in a fixed quantity of hot water of a constant temperature for a prescribed time, is measured and one or more of dystuffs or pigments are combined so that the spectrosocpic transmissity shows that close to said measured value. Above five sheets of color chart obtained by uniformly dissolving or dispersing a coloring material 2 on a transparent resin sheetlike body 1 such as polyester, ABS resin or applying the material 2 on the surface of the body 1, is made in five steps for every kind of tea. Tea water is taken in two teacups 3, 4 having the same white color and the one side teacup 3 is left as it is and the color chart is placed on the other teacup 4 and then, a grade is determined by comparing the color. In such a manner, a correct judgement is made always even under any light source 5.

title: Block copy original producing method
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the trace of sticking from coming up in printed matters at the time of photomechanical process, by sticking originals so that a bonding agent containing a white pigment comes out from the peripheral margin of the originals. CONSTITUTION:Sticking originals 2 which contain compositions, pictures, etc., and have various sizes are sticked to a white ground paper 1 of paper, plastic, etc., with the bonding agent 3 containing a white pigment of this invention in such a way that the bonding agent 3 comes out from the peripheral margin of the originals 2. Printed matters, graphs, plans, printing papers, etc., of various sizes can be used as the sticking originals. Although it is desirable to use natural bonding agents, such as gum arabic, starch, etc., as the bonding agent, synthetic bonding agents can also be used. Titanium dioxide, zinc oxide, magnesium oxide, lithopone, hydroxy zinc carbonate, etc., are used as the white pigment. Since the bonding agent comes out from the originals, lights are irregularly reflected by the white pigment contained in the agent and, therefore, printed matters free from any sticking traces can be obtained.

title: Lithography and lithographic plate
abstract: PURPOSE:To make possible lithography which does not cause a positional shift or a plate cut and is especially suited to light printing by printing with a lithographic plate fixed to the surface of a transparent plate cylinder using a photopeel-type adhesive. CONSTITUTION:Printing is performed by fixing a lithographic plate to a transparent plate cylinder using a photopeel-type adhesive. After printing, light is projected to the rear surface of the lithographic plate through the surface of the transparent plate cylinder, and the lithographic plate is removed from the plate cylinder by decreasing the adhesion of the photopeel-type adhesive. The photopeel-type adhesive is for instance, cured through polymerization by light projection, resulting in the decrease of adhesion. At the same time, a tension concentrates in the surface between the plate cylinder and a cured adhesive layer and the adhesive layer is easily peeled off the surface of the plate cylinder. The adhesive of the above nature is of the solvent-type and is roughly classified as the rubber-based one and the acryl-based one. The acryl-based adhesive is superior to the rubber-based adhesive in terms of oil-proofness and in addition, allows molecular designing which gives a variety of adhesive properties. For these reasons, it is advantageous to use the acryl-based adhesive.

title: Treatment of planographic printing material
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve printing performance such as resolution and printing durability by using two baths for development, preparing a first bath containing a developer which does not substantially cause diffusion transfer development, and preparing a second bath containing a silver halide solvent which is necessary to causes diffusion transfer development. CONSTITUTION:This planographic printing material is developed by using two baths. The first bath contains a developer which does not substantially cause diffusion transfer development, while the second bath contains a developer containing a silver halide solvent which is necessary to cause diffusion transfer development. Namely, the developer in the first bath is a developer for reversal development, in which dissolving property can be suppressed by controlling the kind and quantity of the silver halide solvent. This developer 18 substantially a developer which contains no silver solvent. On the other hand, the developer in the second bath is such a developer for dissolution transfer development with high dissolving property. Thus, the silver halide which is not developed is further transferred to physical developing nuclei and precipitated as a silver image. By using two-bath development, reversal development and dissolution physical development are separated so that enough resolution and printing durability are obtd.

title: Preparation of multi-specific f(ab')3
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide an F(ab')3 composite material not containing a reactant substance such as a crosslinking agent and having a structure similar to a natural antibody and its production method capable of readily producing the composite material according to a simple process. CONSTITUTION:An F(ab')3 composite material composed of plural Fab' mutually bonded through a disulfide bond and its production method is provided. The method for producing the F(ab')3 is described below; F(ab')2 is obtained from an antibody and disulfide bonds crosslinking between the double strands at hinge parts are cut to prepare Fab'. In this process, Fab' having a thiol group only at one hinge part and Fab' having a thiol group at two or more hinge parts are respectively prepared. Fab' having a thiol group only at one hinge part is reacted with Fab' having a thiol group at two or more hinge parts so as to form a disulfide bond, thus combining and bonding two Fab' to each other. This F(ab')3 composite material has three antigen bonding sites. Accordingly, even after one antigen bonding site is used and bonded to another substance, further two antigen bonding sites can be used. This composite material enables, therefore, effective fixation of substance. In addition, this composite material is free from fear of toxicity, etc., since a reactant substance such as a crosslinking agent is not contained.

abstract: 1341068 Imbitition process FUJI PHOTO FILM CO Ltd 9 Sept 1971 [9 Sept 1970] 42209/71 Heading G2C In making coloured images by an imbitition process the final image quality is improved by lowering the absorptive ability to dye of the silvercontaining gelatine relief image. This is achieved by (a) rehalogenating the silver relief image in gelatine, obtained by a tanning development, fixing and wash off process, using a bleaching bath of a halide and a bleaching agent, and (b) by a further tanning development step using pyrogaltol or catechol. CONSTITUTION:Three types of resolution targets used with the ratios W/P of the line width W and the pitch P of 0.15, 0.3 and 0.8. abstract: PURPOSE:To continuously and efficiently obtain metal nitrate by connecting plural processing chambers in loops and successively using each chamber for the process of supplying metal lumps, the main reaction process to effect the reaction with nitric acid, and the post-reaction process. CONSTITUTION:Plural processing chambers 11-1, 11-2, 11-3, etc., are connected in loops, and each chamber is provided with tube L1, L2, L3, etc., for transportation of the reaction product, with tube L5, L6, L7, etc., for supplying the source nitric acid 12, and tube L8, L9, L10, etc., for recovery of the byproduct nitrogen oxide, etc., and for recovery of the process product. title: Automatic light intensity control for x-ray film viewer
abstract: The intensity of light penetrating an X-ray film being viewed is automatically maintained at a preset, adjustable, eye comfort level. A photosensor detects the average light level on the observer side, and its output controls the charging time of a capacitor coupled to the emitter of a unijunction transistor. When the capacitor reaches a predetermined voltage it fires the transistor and dumps its charge through a pulse generator which in turn triggers a gated semiconductor connected in series with the viewer light source. The period between successive firing cycles is proportional to the penetrating light level. Thus, if the light level increases, as when a relatively transparent film negative is inserted in the viewer or when a negative is removed, the capacitor charging time increases, the firing period increases, and the light source intensity therefore decreases to restore the preset level of light penetration.

title: カラー撮影用カートリッジフィルム、現像処理済カートリッジフィルムおよび画像形成方法
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  空気中の不純物等による劣化を防止した熱現 像カートリッジフィルム、画像形成方法及び現像処理済 ＡＰＳカートリッジフィルムを提供すること。
【解決手段】  少なくとも平板状感光性ハロゲン化銀粒 子、発色現像主薬、カプラー及びバインダーを含み、感 光波長領域が互いに異なり、前記発色現像主薬の酸化体 とカプラーから形成される色素の吸収波長領域も互いに 異なる少なくとも３種の感光層を透明支持体上に設けた 撮影用感光材料をスプール軸に巻き付け、該感光材料の 巻きついたスプール軸をフィルム収容容器に装填したカ ラー撮影用カートリッジフィルムにおいて、スプール軸 内に吸着剤、除酸素剤または除湿剤を保持することを特 徴とするカラー撮影用カートリッジフィルム、画像形成 方法、及び該画像形成方法による現像処理済ＡＰＳカー トリッジフィルムである。

title: Question and answer data recorder
abstract: PURPOSE:To record a presentation material, and the content of a question and answer and the data of a questioner as information related with the presentation material. CONSTITUTION:This device is equipped with a data inputting means 10 which inputs the content of the question and answer, and the data of the questioner related with the presentation material, data processing means 20 which describes the relation between the presentation material and the inputted content of the question and answer, and data of the questioner, data storage means 30 which stores the question and answer data constituted of the presentation material, the content of the question and answer, and the data of the questioner, user interface 50 equipped with a display means 51, and control means 40. Thus, when the question to the presentation material is presented, the content of the question and answer can be immediately and exactly recorded in relation with the above mentioned material.

title: Utilizing method of module type circuit part
abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate waste on the use of a module type circuit section, and to increase the density of mounting by cutting off the module type circuit section, in which a plurality of elements are changed into a module, into arbitrary numbers. CONSTITUTION:Seven transistors Trs are turned into a module in a module transistor 1, and pins 2 for connection at a time when the transistor 1 is fitted to a board and circuits are formed are shaped on both sides. The module transistor 1 can be dismantled easily into a module transistor consisting of four transistors Trs and a module transistor composed of three transistors Trs by cutting off the module transistor 1 by a broken line A when only four transistors (Trs) may be used.

title: Atomizing head
abstract: A rotary atomizing head for an atomizer having a cup-shaped rotary atomizing head body mounted on the front end of a rotary shaft. The head body has a conical inner surface with a circular outer edge. A bell hub is provided in the atomizing head body and discharging passages are provided for guiding a liquid in the form of a film to the inner surface of said atomizing head body. The bell hub is a cylinder which has a liquid passage along the central axis thereof and conically recessed end faces.

title: Sheet illustrated with photograph and method of confirming truth or falsehood thereof
abstract: PURPOSE: To judge the imitation or real of the sheet immediately by containing a normal portrait and split images of the portrait in the sheet and reproducing the portrait from the split one to compare with the normal one. CONSTITUTION: A portrait 18 is captured in the TV camera 20 and the image signals are digitized and transmitted to the image composer 22 and computer 23. The computer 23 processes the signals to split plural sections and changes the order according to a specified rule. The changed signals are converted and outputted to the image composer 22. When the sheet is judged its reality, the normal portrait 1a on the sheet and reproduced image 1d from the computer 23 are displayed on the color monitor 28 simultaneously to compare whether they are matched or not.

title: Method and device for certificate issuance for game
abstract: PURPOSE: To effectively evaluate a level of game skillfulness by storing threshold value clear data representing a score which is calculated while a game is in progress and exceeds a threshold value in a game program storage medium when the score exceeds the threshold value and printing a certificate including an image on a printer. CONSTITUTION: When a floppy disk FD is loaded on a drive 15, a game program, a point threshold value and other data are read by a whole control circuit 10, and stored once in a memory 17. Image data stored once is read out under the control of an image display control circuit 12, and converted to an analog video signal by a digital/analog conversion circuit 13, and after that, it is supplied to and displayed visually on a display device 22. When the point scored in a game by a player exceeds the point of the point threshold value decided in advance, the whole control circuit 10 stores a threshold value clear flag in the software recording area for game of the floppy disk FD. In this way, the image data representing the image to be printed is supplied to the printer.

title: Image forming method
abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce deterioration of photographic performance, in manufacturing or storing of heat-developable photosensitive element, and to make a thickness of coatings thinner by using a coloring matter imparting material composed of a (co)polymer of a specific monomer coupler. CONSTITUTION:The coloring matter imparting material comprises the polymer coupler composed of the (co)polymer of the monomer coupler shown by formula I, preferably formula II, wherein Cp is a coupler residue, Q is a group capable of cleaving with a coupling reaction, R1 is H or 1-4C alkyl group, etc., R2-R4 are each 1-10C alkylene group, X and Y are each -CONR5, or -NR5CONR5, etc., (R5 is H or alkyl group), Z is a group capable of cleaving with a coupling reaction. And, the image is formed by heating the heat-developable photosensitive element contg. a polymer coupler in presence of water and a base and/or a base coupler, after image-wisely exposing or simultaneously exposing it followed by transferring the formed diffusive coloring matter to a fixed layer of the coloring matter.

title: ホログラム記録方法およびフィルタリング方法
abstract:
(57)【要約】        （修正有）
【課題】  フーリエスペクトルの各周波数成分が失われ ることなく、所望の空間周波数特性のフィルタリングを 行うことができ、ホログラムメモリとしてのデータ記録 再生機能と高速性及び大容量性を有する識別能力の高い マツチトフィルタリングを行える記録方法とフィルタリ ング方法を提供する。
【解決手段】  被検索画像の０°の偏光のフーリエ変換 された物体光２を、参照光５によってホログラム記録す る。参照光５は、スケールｍのドーターウェーブレット が９０°の偏光を持つような空間偏光分布とする。その ホログラムを、検索画像の０°の偏光のフーリエ変換さ れた物体光で読み出す。ホログラムからの回折光とし て、スケールｍに対応する空間周波数成分と、その他の 空間周波数成分とで、偏光が９０°異なるものが得られ る。偏光素子によって、そのうちのスケールｍに対応す る空間周波数成分のみを取り出す。

title: Brightness and contrast setting system for image photographic device
abstract: PURPOSE:To shorten workhours at the time of setting by providing a transfer means for transferring and storing brightness and contrast information stored in a 2nd storage means to a 1st storage means for respective channels in the case of initialization. CONSTITUTION:This system is provided with the 2nd storage means 2 in which the brightness/contrast information is previously stored for the respective channels, and the transfer means 3 for transferring and storing the brightness/ contrast information stored in the means 2 to the 1st storage means 1 for the respective channels in the case of initialization. Then, the brightness/contrast information previously stored in the means 2 is transferred to the means 1 by the means 3 in the case of initialization and stored in the means 1. thus, the brightness/contrast information previously set is stored in the means 1 at the time of setting, thereby shortening the workhours at the time of setting.

title: File apparatus
abstract: PURPOSE: To cut a wait time for a memory medium to be designated, eliminate a large capacity memory and reduce costs. CONSTITUTION: When data are input, a specific magnetooptical disc BF among a plurality of magnetooptical discs of an assembly type disc apparatus 6 is turned into an accessible state at all times, and image data read by an image data read device 2 are sequentially stored in the magnetooptical disc BF by a CPU 10. title: Camera with dating device
abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate the necessity of a battery for supplying electric power to a dating device so that the title camera can be made smaller in size and lighter in weight by feeding electric power to the dating device from a signal line connected to the reset terminal of a microcomputer. CONSTITUTION:A battery for power supply 3 is commonly used for the reset signal of a microcomputer 1 and dating device 2 in such a way that the battery 3 is used for signals to the microcomputer 1 and as a power source to the dating device 2. Namely, when the output voltage of a detector 5 drops, a switching transistor 7b is turned on, and as a result, no voltage is applied across the reset terminal 1a of the microcomputer 1 and dating device 2, respectively. When the output voltage V1 of the detector 5 again becomes higher than a prescribed threshold voltage thereafter, the microcomputer 1 and dating device 2 are reset. Therefore, no special power supplying battery is required for the dating device and the camera can be made smaller in size and lighter in weight.

title: Floppy-disk inspecting method
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the reliability of inspection and to make it possible to accomplish the high speed in inspection and the low cost of the inspection by performing the connectivity analysis for the image signal on the upper surface of a center hub, and judging the applied state of a bonding agent from the number of the obtained connectivity components. CONSTITUTION:Under the state wherein a bonding agent 8 is applied on the upper part of a flange part, the image of a center hub 6 is picked up by a TV camera 10. The output is inputted into the threshold processing part of an image processing part 12. Binary-coding is performed at an adequate slide level. When the image is regenerated in an a monitor 20, three concentric concen tric circles are displayed. When connectivity analysis is performed in an image processing part 12, the number 3 of the connectivity component is obtained. Therefore, the number of the connectivity components is counted in the image processing part 12. When the result is 3, a signal OK is outputted from an output terminal 22. When the result is 2, a signal NG is outputted from a termi nal 22. Thus the accurate judgment can be performed without decreasing the speed of inspection.

title: Image sensor with aberration compensating lens and its manufacture
abstract: PURPOSE:To compensate various aberrations and to obtain an excellent image by forming a dam at the outer peripheral part of a sensor on a picked-up image side, making melted transparent resin flow in it and rotating a turntable at a preset speed and curing the resin for unity. CONSTITUTION:The annular dam 8 is fixed on the surface of a CCD chip 2 so as to surround the image pickup surface 7 of the CCD chip 2, and the synthetic resin 9 in a melted state is made to flow in the dam 8. In this state, the turntable 4 is rotated at the preset speed to curve the liquid surface of the synthetic resin 9 in the melted state into a parabolic surface with centrifugal force, thereby curing the synthetic resin 9 completely. Thus, the aberration compensating lens made of the transparent resin is molded integrally with the image pickup surface of the image sensor to improve, specially, curvature of field and also easily form the aberration compensating lens which has the parabolic surface which is hardly machined. Consequently, the picture quality of an image formation optical system using the parabolic concave lens advantageous to aberration compensation is improved at low cost.

title: 蛍光方法、蛍光装置、表示装置、スイッチング装置、蛍光記録方法、蛍光記録媒体、蛍光記録読み出し方法、蛍光記録読み出し装置及び蛍光記録消去方法

title: Production of developer absorbing base material for photographic film and base material as well as self-processing photographic film
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve a void property, compression hardness and the ability to prevent the leakage of processing liquid to the outside by compression bonding a fiber aggregate contg. self-adhesive binder fibers under heating with rolls of different heating set temps. and subjecting this aggregate to a heating treatment at the temp. above the m.p. of the binder fibers, thereby forming the base material while adjusting the density difference between the front and rear surfaces. CONSTITUTION:A fiber web 5 formed by incorporating at least 10wt.% self-adhesive binder fibers therein by a web forming machine is previously subjected to needle punching by a needle punching machine 6 in order to fix the web and to make the web as a non-woven fabric as well as to provide many columnar holes in its sectional direction. The needle punched non-woven fabric 7 is compression bonded under heating by a pair of the calender rolls constituted of the upper roll 8 heated to the temp. above the m.p. of the binder fibers and the lower roll 9 set at the temp. below the b.p. of the binder fibers, by which the non-woven fabric sheet 10 having the coarse and dense two-layered structures varying in the density of the front and rear fiber layers is obtd. The void property, the compression hardness and the ability to prevent the leakage of the processing liquid to the outside are improved in this way.

【構成】  紙面編集システム５４から画像データ蓄積装 置５８に画像データが送信される際に、画像データ毎に ＩＤ番号が付され、ＰＣＳ７２には、このＩＤ番号と共 に製版条件が入力される。従って、メインコントローラ ７０からＩＤ番号を出力することにより、該当する製版 条件が検索され、メインコントローラ７０へ返送され る。また、ダイレクト刷版装置１０からＰＣＳ７２へ は、版曲げ終了、載荷終了、製版完了の各信号が送信さ れ、ＰＣＳ７２では、各ダイレクト刷版装置１０での処 理状況を一括して管理している。一方、ダイレクト刷版 装置１０とキャリア６４との間では、移載タイミング及 び配布先情報と、配布先要求及び載荷完了報告の各信号 が交信される。

title: Silver halide color photographic sensitive material
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a color photography causing no color change on a white ground, even preserved for a long period or displayed after color development and bleach-fix processings of the title material by incorporating a specified coupler in at least one layer of photographic constituting layers mounted on a supporting body. CONSTITUTION:At least one layer of the photographic constituting layer mounted on the supporting body contains the coupler which has a function of allowing it to chemically inactive by chemically binding with an aromatic amine type color developing main agent. Said coupler has a sec. reaction rate constant of a range of 1.0-1.0X10<-6>l/mol.sec in the reaction of said coupler with p-anisidine and chemically binds with a residual aromatic amine type color developing main agent in pH of <=8 after the color development processing. Thus, the color photography causing no color change on the white ground, even preserved for a long period and displayed after the color development and the bleach-fix processings of said material, is obtd.

abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  高感度の感光材料を用いて、高濃度の透過型 陰画像を形成する方法を提供する。
【構成】  支持体上に、ハロゲン化銀、還元剤、重合性 化合物および塩基プレカーサーを一緒に収容した感光性 マイクロカプセルを含む感光層を有する感光材料を像様 露光する第一工程；第一工程と同時に、または第一工程 後に、感光材料を加熱し、これにより、塩基プレカーサ ーから塩基を放出させ、ハロゲン化銀を現像し、重合性 化合物を像様に硬化させる第二工程；第二工程後に、感 光材料と、透明支持体上に、色素を含む層を有する着色 シートとを重ね合わせた状態で加圧し、これにより未硬 化の重合性化合物と共に塩基を感光材料から着色シート に転写して、転写された塩基により着色シートに含まれ る色素を消色する第三工程；そして第三工程後に、感光 材料を着色シートから剥離する第四工程からなり、これ らの工程により着色シートに透過型陰画像を形成する。

title: Probe for measuring transmission characteristics and apparatus for measuring transmission characteristics
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a probe for measuring transmission characteristics of an object conveniently, without selecting the measuring place. SOLUTION: A core 12 has a primary coil 14 and a shorted secondary coil 16 at opposite positions, a resistance element 22 is provided in series to the primary coil 14 and the center conductor 20 of a coaxial line 18 to make constant the impedance of the coaxial line 18 and the sending-end impedance, a capacitor element 24 is provided in parallel to the resistance element 22 to cancel the inductance of the secondary coil and the intrinsic inductance of the resistance element 22, thereby broadening the frequency band, and the secondary coil 16 is connected to the shield sheath 20 of the coaxial line 18 through a capacitance element 28 to stabilize the frequency impedance characteristic in a wide band.

title: Optical filter and measuring instrument using the same
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the optical change caused by temp. and humidity change at ordinary temp. by providing the 1st member coated with a vapor deposited film and the 2nd member which is brought into tight contact with the coating surface of the 1st member. CONSTITUTION:The 2nd glass member 14 is brought into tight contact with the coating surface of the 1st glass member 12 coated with the vapor deposited film 16 by using an adhesive agent, such as canada balsam. Transparent glass or colored glass is usable as the 1st glass member 12 and transparent glass, colored glass and prisms are usable as the 2nd glass member. The 2nd member 14 is, therefore, brought into tight contact with the surface coated with the vapor deposited film 16 to shut off the contact of the vapor deposited film 16 and the outdoor air. The generation of an optical change in the optical filter by the temp. change and the humidity change is prevented in this way.

title: Color center forming device using epitaxial growth single crystal structure of rare earth elements
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a high contrast by forming a color center on a substrate having the first and second main surfaces while being formed of an oxide of rare earth elements and consisting of a substance doped with ion impurities, responding to information of projection. CONSTITUTION:A color center forming layer 2 is desired to have transmissibility to light emitted from a light source 11, thereby, light is projected on a screen 18 through a layer 2 in the case there is no color center. A single crystal of an oxide of properly doped rare earth elements is used for the layer 2. The single crystal layer is desirable because the structure of the single crystal is denser than that of a multi-crystal layer and a non-crystal layer while having a denser lattice defect. When an electron beam 1 is scanned under control, a color center 6 is dispersed spatially inside the layer 2, thereby an absorbing characteristic of a selected part of the layer 2 changes in relation to a picture. This absorption of the picture is increased by impression of bias voltage.

title: Sample stand used for image information reader and manufacture thereof
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a sample stand being easily cleaned and enduring repetitive use by applying coating to a sample placing surface with a fluororesin. SOLUTION: The sample stand 10 uses an aluminum plate 10d as a base material, and is coated with a composite resin 10c of a PTFE (tetrafluoroethylene resin) using a black color as a base and a PFA (tetrafluoroethylene-perfluoroalkyl vinyl ether copolymer resin). Actually, the sample stand is coated with a platinous tone using a silky black as a black pigment. A flange 10b is raised upward in a peripheral edge part of the sample stand 10, and a marking 10a for showing plural readable ranges for arranging a sample such as gel is formed in a recessed shape or a projecting shape in a flat part except for the peripheral edge. The marking 10a is formed after coating. Thus, since a sample placing surface is coated with a fluororesin, even if a fluorescence pigment, a sample and the like stick to the placing surface, these can be easily cleaned.

title: 纤维素酯胶片的干燥方法
abstract: 一种纤维素酯胶片的干燥方法是在干燥箱(31)内边传送胶片(1)边经干燥风排气管(33)及干燥风供给管(34)循环干燥风干燥胶片(1)。这时，与干燥箱(31)内的干燥风接触部分的温度比在干燥风中所含低分子量物质的饱和温度高5℃以上。另外，在新鲜风导入口(36)导入新鲜风，同时在干燥风排气口(37)排出部分干燥风。该方法在溶液制膜法中传送胶片至干燥箱使之干燥时，能抑制低分子量物质气化物附着在干燥箱内壁面并能防止低分子量物质附着在胶片上。

abstract: 药片形状的催化剂放在防水外壳内侧的上部。催化剂由钯做成,它加速氢气和氧气结合的化学反应。催化剂一接触氢气就开始加速化学反应。在上述的防水外壳内侧的上部放置催化剂,就能有效地去除比空气轻的氢气。该化学反应产生水,因此最好在催化剂旁边放置吸水剂。

title: Metal surface treating agent
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a metal surface treating agent having excellent durability which is easily applied to operation such as coating for imparting water repellency and noncohesive properties, with which the film to be formed is extremely thin, and, moreover, the film is hard to be peeled and broken. SOLUTION: A compound expressed by formula (I) is used as a surface treating agent: (I) D(-L-R)m; wherein, Hb is a hydrophobic group selected from the groups consisting of a 1 to 40C fluorine-substituted alkyl group, a 6 to 40C fluorine-substituted aryl group, a 6 to 60C alkyl group and a 1 to 60C alkyl-substituted oligosiloxanoxy group; Bu is a group containing at least two ring structures and having excluded volume effect; L is an (m+n) valence connected group; and (m) and (n) are individually integers of 1 to 12.

title: Size measuring instrument for sheet-like sensitive material
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain a size measuring instrument for sheet-like sensitive materials which is capable of preventing the occurrence of fog in the sheet-like sensitive materials when measuring the sizes of the sheet-like sensitive materials by using CCD cameras. SOLUTION: A size measuring section 16 of the size measuring instrument 10 has one set of belt conveyors 32a and 32b which transport the sheet-like photosensitive materials 12 while holding the same from above and below, a stroboscopic light source 34 which is arranged on the lower side of the belt conveyors 32a and 32b and the inlet side CCD cameras 36a to 36c and output side CCD camera 38 arranged on the upper side of the belt conveyors 32a and 32b. The stroboscopic light source 34 is constituted to output IR light.

abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a device and a program for recognizing a bar code in an appropriate code system by discriminating which code system the bar code is written in when the whole of bar codes to be read can be decoded as multiple kinds of bar codes.  <P>SOLUTION: This code recognition device 3 comprises a decoding part 31A consisting of an array of multiple kinds of graphic elements and decoding codes expressed on media in a plurality of code systems using predetermined kinds of graphic elements respectively; a decoding content storage processing part 31B storing processed content data indicating at least a part of contents of decoding during decoding on each code system; a likelihood computing part 31C computing likelihood of description in each code system according to the processed content data; and an output part 31D outputting the decoding result in one of the code systems according to the likelihood.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title: Paper discharging apparatus of copying machine
abstract: PURPOSE:To make it possible to raise a main floating roller, which is for discharging a paper sheet which is in contact with a driving roller and on which copying and fixing thereof have been done, and an auxiliary floating roller simultaneously, by connecting the main and auxiliary floating rollers through a link mechanism. CONSTITUTION:The main floating roller 3 that is in contact with the driving roller 1 and a conveying belt 2 and the auxiliary floating roller 4 can be raised integrally through a main roller supporting link 9 and an auxiliary roller supporting link 11. When a solenoid 5 is energized to raise the forward part of the supporting link 9 to raise the roller 3, then the main roller shaft 10 is engaged with a bent part 11b of the supporting link 11 and the roller 4 is also raised. abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an inkjet picture-preparing method capable of forming an image which is excellent in color developability, color tones, and water resistance and light resistance after formed, and has a texture of a picture, and the picture which is prepared by the method and exhibits excellent preservation stability.  <P>SOLUTION: The inkjet picture-preparing method comprises forming a picture on a recording medium using an ink composition comprising at least one oil-soluble compound and a polymerizable group-bearing monomer. The picture is prepared using the method.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Storage device and manufacture thereof
abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce variations in recrystallization positions and to carry out write of data by forming a desired position of a plurality of amorphous layers formed in a semiconductor substrate thinner than other positions thereof. CONSTITUTION:An n<+>-diffusion layer 12 is formed in a p-type semiconductor substrate 11. An amorphous layer 14 is formed as a memory cell between the n<+>-diffusion layer 12 and an upper electrode 13. The amorphous layer 14 is approximately circular and formed thin in a central part and thick in an outer peripheral part. An upper electrode is regarded as a word line and the n<+>- diffusion layer 12 is regarded as a lead line. When a voltage for data write is applied, the central part is recrystallized and the outer peripheral part maintains a amorphous state. Thereby, it is possible to carry out write stably without dispersion in data write positions. To form the amorphous layer 14, ion implantation is carried out to an exposed plane of a semiconductor substrate and difference of thickness is produced in the amorphous layer 14 by controlling the angle of ion implantation.

title: Information processor
abstract: PURPOSE:To efficiently perform object management by subordinating an item relating to an object to the object in an information processor in which the object of a document, etc., is displayed in a form of icon. CONSTITUTION:When the icon 18a of (memo A) and the (tag paper information display) of a pop-up menu 19 are selected, the operation of tag paper information display request processing is started. Firstly, an object managing information file 11 is referred, and an object ID is retrieved from an object name and the (memo A). Thence, a tag paper information managing table 12 is referred based on the object ID, and a correspondent tag paper storage address is retrieved. Tag paper information in a user data file area 9 is read out based on the tag paper storage address, and a tag paper window 20 is displayed. When the edit command part 23 of the tag paper window 20 is selected, the input of the tag paper information to the tag paper window 20 can be performed. After the tag paper information is inputted, it is written on the user data file area 9 by selecting (preservation) in an edit command.

title: Driving system for heat-sensitive recording head
abstract: PURPOSE:To shorten a recording time, to reduce an electric energy, and to enable obtaining of a uniform recording concentration, by a method wherein a plural number of common drive terminals, allotted to a block whose picture is totally black, is simultaneously selected for recording. CONSTITUTION:A video signal 10, which is a picture information transmission side, is inputted to a sequence controller 12 togetherwith a synchronizing signal 11. The controller 12 decides whether or not each block is black. In case the decision results in finding that the block is not totally black but an ordinary pattern, a recording takes place according to a conventional method. In case, however, it is decided to be totally black, two common drive terminals, for example, B1-1, B1-2 are simultaneously driven by a common drive specified signal 17 outputted from the controller 12. A total black signal is further transmitted to a shift resistor 15 from the controller 12, and this causes one block of a heat-sensitive head 14 to be recorded by one-time operation.

title: Magnetic recording medium
abstract: Disclosed is a magnetic recording medium comprising a nonmagnetic support, a lower nonmagnetic layer and an upper magnetic layer. The lower non-magnetic layer is coated on the support, comprises an inorganic nonmagnetic powder dispersed in a binder, and is surface-coated with an inorganic oxide. The upper magnetic layer has a dry thickness of 1.0 micrometers or less and comprises a dispersion of a ferromagnetic powder in a binder. The upper magnetic layer is coated onto the lower nonmagnetic layer.

title: 画像処理方法
abstract: 【課題】コンポジット出力に対しても、簡単な構成でオーバープリントの再現を可能とする。 【解決手段】プリントサーバでは、パスの構築命令を検出したときに、トラップ幅が設定されていると、描画命令から図形情報を抽出して保存し、パスの構築を行うと、構築されたパスを特定可能とする情報を抽出して、合わせて保存する（ステップ１００、１０２、１０６〜１１０）。また、描画処理を行うときに、図形情報が保存されているパスに対しては、この図形情報に基づいてトラッピング処理を行う〈ステップ１２０、１２２、１２６〉。これにより、該当する図形をオーバープリントで描画することができるようにしている。 【選択図】        図３

title: Low moisture permeability film, optical film, polarizing plate, and liquid crystal display device, and method of producing low moisture permeability film
abstract: The invention provides a low moisture permeability film which can provide an optical film with low moisture permeability and good brittleness, the optical film that a hard coat layer is further disposed on the low moisture permeability film and has low moisture permeability and good brittleness, a polarizing plate using the optical film, a liquid crystal display device using the polarizing plate and excellent in plate image quality in the high-temperature and high-humidity environment after a lapse of time, and a method of producing the low moisture permeability film. A low moisture permeability film has a layer formed by curing a curable composition on a substrate film. The curable composition includes the following (A) of 50 mass%-99 mass% and the following (B) of 1 mass%-30 mass% relative to the total solid components of the curable composition of 100 mass%: (A) at least one of a compound having an aliphatic hydrocarbon group and the ethylenically unsaturated double bonds, and a compound having a fluorine ring and the ethylenically unsaturated double bonds. (B) polyester urethane.

title: Ｘ線管装置
abstract: 小型化した場合においても、ガード部を取り付けられるＸ線管装置を提供する。   Ｘ線管装置（１０）は、Ｘ線を発生する管球（１７）を内蔵する本体（１１）と、本体（１１）の表面である前面（１２）（第１表面）の一部において本体からＸ線の照射方向（Ｌ１）に突出して設けられ、照射範囲を整えたＸ線を照射する照射窓（２３）を有するコリメータ２１と、被検体との距離を保つためのガード部６１を接続するコネクタ（５１Ａ及び５１Ｂ）を、本体（１１）の前面（１２）（第１表面）と、コリメータ（２１）の照射窓（２３）を有する表面である前面（２２）（第２表面）と、の間に備える。

title: Production of base
abstract: PURPOSE:To keep a base precursor made of a specified compd. stable during storage and to quickly decompose the precursor when an image is formed, by heating the precursor in the presence of a nucleophilic agent. CONSTITUTION:A base precursor made of a compd. represented by formula I is heated in the presence of a nucleophilic agent. In the formula I, R<1> is H atom, alkyl group or the like, X is O or S atom and B is a univalent group corresponding to an atomic group obtd. by removing an H atom bonding to an N atom from an org. base such as prim. amine, sec. amine or an amidine deriv. Thus, a base can be quickly produced from the base precursor having superior shelf stability at the time when the base is required.

title: Toner supply apparatus, developing apparatus using same, and image forming apparatus
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To surely attain the guarantee of image quality associated with a cartridge replacing work, without complicated operation of detecting/controlling toner empty.  <P>SOLUTION: The apparatus is provided with the cartridge 4 which is detachably loaded to the cartridge receiving part 3 of the image forming apparatus body, for storing toner and also having a carrying member 4a for carrying the toner inside, a reserve tank 5 arranged between the cartridge 4 and the developing apparatus 1 so as to temporarily store the toner from the cartridge 4 and also having a carrying member 5a for carrying the toner inside, a cartridge detection means 6 for detecting whether or not the cartridge 4 is attached to the cartridge receiving part 3, and a drive control means 7 for controlling the cartridge 4 and the reserve tank 5 so as to normally operate on the condition that the presence of the cartridge is detected by the cartridge detecting means 6, on the other hand, on the condition that the absence of the cartridge is detected, for stopping the drive of the cartridge 4 and controlling the reserve tank 5 so as to normally operate.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

title: Silica composite particles and method for producing silica composite particles
abstract: To provide silica composite particles capable of forming films with excellent transparency.SOLUTION: Silica composite particles are provided which comprise an atomic group of -Si-O-Al-O-Si-R (R is an organic group having 3 to 18 carbon atoms) on their surfaces with the number of OH groups on the surfaces being not more than 0.012 mmol/m.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Picture information reader
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the photodetection efficiency of reflected light or the like from a storage medium by allowing a light waveguide element arranged between a photodetector and the recording medium to make a read light incident on the recording medium to bring the photodetector sufficiently close to the recording medium. CONSTITUTION:The photodetector 20 is provided in face with a rotary drum 10 storing a storage fluorescent sheet 13 on which radiation picture information is stored and recorded and the light waveguide element 25 is fixed to a photodetection face 20a of the detector 20. The element 25 is arranged in a way that a light incident grating coupler 28 is unlocked from the detector 20, receives stimulated light 24 and a light radiation light condensing grating coupler 29 is opposed to the circumferential surface of the drum 10. Then the element 25 is made very thin as 1mm or below including the thickness of a disc 26 and the distance between the photodetection face 20a of the detector 20 and the sheet 13 is set sufficiently smaller even taking the optical path length for focusing the light 24 into consideration. Thus, the detector 20 is brought very close to the sheet 13 and the photodetection efficiency of the reflected light or the like from the sheet 13 is improved.

title: 機器状態表示装置付医療用機器及びその制御プログラム並びに記憶媒体
abstract: 【課題】  医療用機器の機器状態を離れていても容易に視認できる様にする。 【解決手段】  機器１の外部に外部表示灯４が設けられると共にカラーディスプレイ２を備える機器状態表示装置付医療用機器において、機器状態に応じた警告を外部表示灯４に色別表示すると同時に該色別表示と同じ表示色でカラーディスプレイ２に警告表示を行う。これにより、機器状態を離れた箇所からでも外部表示灯４で視認でき、カラーディスプレイ２の表示によっても視認可能となる。 【選択図】  図１

title: Method and device for processing picture
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To efficiently emphasize only a specific picture part in question without emphasizing a component such as a noise component unnecessary for picture reading by suppressing the undershoot and overshoot of a picture. SOLUTION: A high frequency component Ssp in an original picture signal Sorg is obtained by a low pass filter 11 and a computing element 14a, a morphology operation is applied to the component Ssp to obtain a morphology signal Smor indicating a large value on a required picture part and a small value on the other picture part, an emphasis coefficient β (Smor) corresponding to the signal Smor is found out from a conversion table 13, and a processed picture signal Sproc emphasizing only a required picture part is obtained by applying emphasis processing depending on morphology.

title: 多层配线基板
abstract: 本发明提供一种能够实现优异的导通可靠性的多层配线基板。本发明的多层配线基板层叠有各向异性导电部件与具有基板及形成于基板上的一个以上的电极的配线基板，所述各向异性导电部件具备：包含无机材料的绝缘性基材；包含导电性部件的多个导通路，以在绝缘性基材的厚度方向上贯穿并相互绝缘的状态而设置；以及粘合层，设于绝缘性基材的表面，各导通路具有从绝缘性基材的表面突出的突出部分，所述多层配线基板中，多个导通路中，与电极接触的导通路变形，而相邻的导通路彼此接触。

title: Direct positive silver halide color photographic sensitive material, color image forming method and forming method for color proof
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a picture which is high in max. picture density, high in contrast in highlight part and low in min. density. CONSTITUTION:The direct positive layer silver halide color photographic sensitive material contains the internal latent image type silver halide emulsion layer which is not fogged previously and the compd. which does not contribute to dye image forming and is expressed by the general formula A-B in at least one layer of a nonphotosentive layer. (In the formula, A is the group which releases B by reacting with the oxide of a developing agent but forms the compd. which does not contribute to dye image forming substantially, B is the diffusion resistant group which is capable of releasing by the coupling reaction with the oxide of the developing agent).

title: Image forming apparatus
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To prevent or suppress breakage of residual toner by a cleaning brush and to maintain cleaning property of the surface of a latent image holder.  <P>SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus is equipped with a cleaning brush having a plurality of columnar linear materials planted on a base material and removing a developer remaining on a latent image holder by friction with the top part of the linear material, wherein each top part of the linear material is obliquely cut with respect to the planting direction, and the latent image holder opposes to the cut face of the linear material or to the counter part opposite to the cut face.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title: 写真処理剤セット製品収納化粧箱及びその製造方法
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  現像液、定着液、漂白液等の各々写真処理剤 が充填された各々の容器をセットで自動現像機に装填す るための写真処理剤セット製品を製造する方法を提供す る。
【解決手段】  複数の異なる写真処理剤をそれぞれ空容 器に充填し、これらの写真処理剤を充填した容器をセッ トで収納する化粧箱４２であって、化粧箱４２内に収納 され、写真処理剤が充填された容器が各々識別可能な個 別の態様を有し、化粧箱４２に容器の個別態様を検知す るための孔４２Ａを設けた。容器の識別可能な個別の態 様は、各々の容器に付されたマーキングや各々の容器に 充填された写真処理剤の色相に起因する容器の外面色相 等からなる。この化粧箱４２の孔４２Ａを介して容器の セット状態が正常か否かを検知し、正常なセット状態の 化粧箱が出荷される。

title: Inkjet recorder
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an inkjet recorder in which adhesion of ink mist to a sensor can be prevented when printing is waited.  <P>SOLUTION: The inkjet recorder 10 comprises an inkjet recording head 22 for forming an image on a recording medium 80 by ejecting ink drops 84 from nozzles 24, a carriage 12 mounting the inkjet recording head 22 and reciprocating in the direction perpendicular to the carrying direction of the recording medium 80, a sensor 38 provided on the carriage 12 and detecting various kinds of information of the recording medium 80, a sensor cover 40 for covering the sensor 38, and a means 44 for moving the sensor cover 40 to cover or expose the sensor 38.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

title: 磁気テープカートリッジ収納体
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  収納された磁気テープカートリッジのテープ リールのガタつきを抑えることができる良好な磁気テー プカートリッジ収納体を提供する。
【解決手段】  磁気テープカートリッジ収納体１の底壁 部３１に環状歯部３８を設ける。該環状歯部３８は、カ ートリッジケース１０１の底面に形成された開口部１０ ３ａを介して該カートリッジケース１０１内に回動自在 に配設されたテープリール１０４の底面に形成された駆 動用係合歯部１０４ａに噛合する。テープリール１０４ は収納ケース本体３の底壁部３１に対する移動を阻止さ れ、ガタつきを抑えられる。

title: Page printer image output device
abstract: PURPOSE:To enable an optional area on an image memory to be outputted by a method wherein an input controller which perform control for expanding a data in the optional area on the image memory, and an output controller which performs control for outputting the data in the optional area on the image memory, are established. CONSTITUTION:When an input controller 7 receives a command from a CPU 6, it sends out various signals to a data memory 10 or the like,and controls input to an image memory 5. An output controller 8 controls the image memory 5. When a video data is outputted from the image memory 5 to a laser printer or the like, the output controller 8 follows addresses of an output original point and an output final point which are indicated from the CPU 6, and outputs a data in an area to be determined thereby. A multiplexer 9 receives inputs from the input controller 7 and the output controller 8, and selects either one to be outputted. Those inputs are a signal which determines which area of the image memory 5 the data is to be inputted into or which area the data is to be outputted from.

title: 帯電装置、画像形成装置及び電位制御板
abstract: 【課題】グリッドを感光体へ近接化できるようにすると共に感光体の軸方向における帯電ムラを抑制する。 【解決手段】２本の細線１３０を連結する梁１４０を、感光体６２の軸方向（図中の矢印Ｄ方向）へ分散して設けると共に、感光体６２の周方向（図中の矢印Ｓ方向）へ分散して設ける。これにより、梁１４０を有させず細線１３０のみの構成に比べ、グリッド１１０の強度が向上し、グリッド１１０を感光体へ近接化できる。また、梁１４０が分散されているので、放電ワイヤ１０６・１０８から感光体６２への電荷を梁１４０が遮ることによって生じる感光体６２の軸方向における帯電ムラが抑制される。 【選択図】図７

title: Method for manufacturing multicolor picture sheet, multicolor picture sheet and color filter
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for manufacturing a multicolor picture sheet provided with a black matrix having a light shielding property of high optical density and further having a spacer function and a color filter manufactured by the method. SOLUTION: In the method for manufacturing the multicolor picture sheet provided with the black matrix 12a constructed by laminating a photosensitive black resin layer 12 on a light transmitting substrate 10, the photosensitive black resin layer 12 contains at least an alkali soluble binder, a photochemical acid generator, a cross-linking agent cross-linking by the action of the photochemical acid generator and a colorant. The method for manufacturing the multicolor picture sheet contains at least a step to cure at least the light transmitting substrate side part of the photosensitive black resin layer with irradiation from the light transmitting substrate side and a step to cure the photosensitive black resin layer with irradiation from the photosensitive black resin layer side. The multicolor picture sheet and the color filter is manufactured by the method.

title: Recording material
abstract:
PURPOSE: To obtain the recording material with excellent light resistance and printing ink setting properties which jointly uses a developer and an inorganic pigment of specified physical properties of specified quantities respectively.  
     CONSTITUTION: A) 0.2W1g a developer in the metallic salt of aromatic carboxylic acid or fatty acid and 1.8W10g an inorganic pigment, which oil absorbing quantity is 45W200 and which volume mean grain size is 0.1W8μ, are applied per 1m 2  on a support body with a binder in a water-soluble, natural or synthetic high molecular compound. A fixed quantity of oil that the inorganic pigment absorbs can be obtained by applying chemical treatment, such as, acid treatment, alkali treatment, etc. and physical treatment, such as, heating, pulverization, etc. to the inorganic pigment.

title: フィルム状記録ヘッドおよび近接場記録装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  安価で容易に構成でき、同じ情報を複数箇所 に同時に記録できるフィルム状記録ヘッドを設けた近接 場記録装置を提供する。
【解決手段】  近接場記録装置は、記録材料１と、ナノ メートルサイズの凸部又は凹部等による屈折率変化部を 複数設けたフィルム状記録ヘッド２と、光源３とを備え て構成される。この近接場記録装置は、記録材料上に同 じ画像や文字などの情報を複数箇所に記録する場合、光 源からの光を情報に応じて変調し、そしてフィルム状記 録ヘッドの凸部又は凹部から記録材料１側へ漏れ出した 光により、これらの凸部又は凹部の位置に同じ情報を同 時に記録することができる。

title: Transfer device of color copying machine
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve a copying speed and productivity by arranging the transfer device so that the angle between the common normal of a photosensitive drum and a transfer drum and a perpendicular running on the center of the photosensitive drum is <=45 deg. and the center of the transfer drum is below the horizontal line running on the center of the photosensitive drum. CONSTITUTION:When multiple transfer for color copying is performed, a form 25 is passed through a variable shoot 19 shown by a broken line and gripped to the transfer drum 16 at the position where a gripper 17 comes to the registration position of the image front end part on the photosensitive drum 8. Then, toner is transferred by a transfer corotron 24 to the form through the mesh of the transfer drum 16 in a screen shape from its reverse side. Further, when a monochromatic copy is taken, the variable shoot 19 comes to a position shown by a solid line and the form is passed through a shoot 18, registered to the front end part of the image on the drum, and sent out through a registration roll 18.

title: Radiographic apparatus and radiographic system
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a radiographic apparatus, which does not require electric connection to a radiation generator, is not influenced by size of an irradiation field of radiation, and easily controls operation synchronized with irradiation timing of radiation.SOLUTION: An irradiation switch 15 of an X-ray generator 11 is provided with a sensor unit 29 for detecting operation force (pressurizing force) given to an operation button 57. The sensor unit 29 is connected to a photography controller 23 of an X-ray photographing apparatus 12, and when the operation button 57 is pressed and operated, a pressure detection signal is output to the photography controller 23. The photography controller 23 controls operation of an FPD (flat panel detector) incorporated in an electric cassette 21 on the basis of the pressure detection signal and synchronizes the irradiation timing of the X-ray source 13 with accumulation timing of the FPD.

title: Magnetic card with heat sensitive recording layer
abstract: PURPOSE:To correctly confirm service environments with the eye by laminating a magnetic recording layer, a heat sensitive recording layer and protective layer cured with ultraviolet rays on a supporter in that order. CONSTITUTION:This magnetic card is so constituted that a magnetic recording layer is placed on one surface of a supporter, a heat sensitive recording layer is placed thereon and a protective layer set by ultraviolet rays is placed thereon. The magnetic recording layer can be appropriately formed by a known method. Known substances can be employed as the color developing agent of the heat sensitive recording layer and the other materials. However, it is preferable that a specific application liquid is prepared so that the adhesion of the other materials to the magnetic recording layer is excellent and the cohesiveness of the heat sensitive recording material becomes powerful. As a binder, water soluble polyester is preferable. It is preferred that the ultraviolet curing protective layer be formed with solventless ultraviolet set resin.

title: 発光素子、光源ヘッド、及び画像形成装置
abstract: 【課題】本構成を有しない場合と比較して、駆動電圧が抑えられた発光素子、光源ヘッド、及び画像形成装置を提供する。 【解決手段】発光素子１００では、発光層１２６のバンドギャップが、アノード層１２２、ｎ型ゲート層１２４、ｐ型ゲート層１２８、及びカソード層１３０のバンドギャップよりも小さく、キャリアが再結合するための再結合層として機能する。また、結合ダイオード１０６は、ｐ型ゲート層１２８とｎ型ゲート層１２４との間で形成されている。従って、結合ダイオード１０６の拡散電位が小さく、発光素子１００の駆動電圧を抑えられる。 【選択図】図７

title: Va (vertical alignment) mode liquid crystal display device
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a VA mode liquid crystal display device which hardly causes irregularity in a moisture-heat environment and has excellent front contrast and viewing angle performance.SOLUTION: The VA mode liquid crystal display device comprises a pair of polarizing plates with absorption axes orthogonal to each other with a liquid crystal cell being interposed therebetween. The polarizing plate in a viewing side includes, successively from the liquid crystal cell side, an optical compensation layer, a polarizer and a polarizing plate protective film; and the optical compensation layer has a thickness of 10 μm or less and has Rth(550) of 35 nm to 220 nm. The polarizing plate in a backlight side includes, successively from the liquid crystal cell side, an optical compensate layer, a polarizer and a polarizing plate protective film; and the optical compensation layer has a thickness of 10 μm to 60 μm and satisfies expressions (1):30 nm≤Re(550)≤200 nm and (2):50 nm≤Rth(550)≤400 nm.

title: Photographing method in microfilm camera
abstract:
PURPOSE: To obtain the hard copy of good appearance based on the microfilm by exposing recording portion on one frame of the microfilm, shielding light only the recording portion and uniformly exposing one frame of the microfilm.  
     CONSTITUTION: The document 1 to be photographed is placed on a support table 4 and the document is lighted by a lighting means 11. After this, the portion 6 of the document 1 is photographed and recorded in one frame of a microfilm by a photographing head 5. Thence, a maks 8 is put in the optical path from the photographing head 5 and with the portion 2 being held shaded light, the one frame of the microfilm is exposed sufficiently uniformly by a lighting means 12. By such operation, the recording of the only 2 of the document 1 remains on the microfilm and the rest are uniformly exposed and appear black. In this way, only the information appears white in the black ground on the microfilm with the simple construction and therefore the hard copy of good appearance may be made based on this microfilm.

title: Liquid level detector
abstract: PURPOSE:To surely detect the liquid level by providing a resistance for detection between a first electrode and a power source and deciding whether electric potential between the first electrode and the resistance for detection is prescribed value or below by a decision means. CONSTITUTION:A resistor 14 for detection is provided between a DC power source 12 and a first electrode 16. Electric potential V1 between the resistor 14 for detection and the first electrode 16 is detected by a signal processing circuit 26. When the electric potential V1 is regulated to prescribed value or below, it is decided that the liquid surface of a developer 22 is regulated to at least the position of height wherein the tips of the first electrode 16 and a second electrode 18 are immersed. Further when leakage current I2 is allowed to flow to a heater 24 from the first electrode 16, electric potential detected by a signal processing circuit 26 is made lower than the above-mentioned electric potential V1. Therefore it is judged that the liquid level of the developer 22 is regulated to at least the position of height wherein the tips of the first electrode 16 and the second electrode 18 are immersed. Thereby the liquid surface surely is detected without affecting the leakage current I2.

title: Silver halide photographic sensitive material
abstract: PURPOSE:To release timely a photographic reagent even when processing is carried out with a processing soln. of a low pH or under conditions during usual thermal development, by using a precursor of the photographic reagent having a photographically useful group protected with a bonded protective group having a specified structure. CONSTITUTION:This silver halide photographic sensitive material contains at least one kind of precursor of a photographic reagent represented by formula I. A concrete example of the precursor used is represented by formula I-1. The precursor is stably present under conditions during storage and releases the photographic reagent rapidly and efficiently at the necessary time during processing. Even when processing is carried out with a processing soln. of such a relatively low pH as 9-12 or by thermal development, the photographic reagent is timely released. Desensitization by the addition of the precursor is prevented and the function of the released photographic reagent can well be shown.

title: Color photographic sensitive material
abstract: PURPOSE:To enhance sharpness by incorporating a yellow image forming coupler and a compound for producing a development inhibitor or its precursor in a blue-sensitive silver halide emulsion layer. title: Fine structure, method for creating fine structure, and raman spectroscopy and spectroscope
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a device that has the reinforcing function of Raman scattered light, has high performance and high quality, and can be created relatively easily.  <P>SOLUTION: A substrate 2 in a structure in which a plurality of micropores 6 are formed on the surface, is obtained by anodizing a substrate 1 made of, for example an aluminum layer 4. Metal is filled into the micropores 6 of the substrate 2 by electrical plating, or the like for forming a metal fine particle 8. Plating treatment continues until the head section of the metal fine particle 8 projects from the surface of the substrate 2 and the diameter of the head section is larger than the hole diameter of the micropores after metal is filled to the same position as the surface of the substrate 2. Plating treatment is preferably allowed to continue until the gap between the head sections of the metal particle becomes 10nm or smaller. In the structure thus formed, Raman scattered light is effectively reinforced by an electric field generated at the gap section of the head section, so that high Raman reinforced effect can be obtained.
