title: Magneto-optical recording medium
abstract: PURPOSE:To control the variation in C/N by forming a first dielectric protective layer, recording layer, second dielectric protective layer and metal reflecting layer on a substrate and specifying thickness of each layer to a specified range so as to reduce phase difference in reflected light. CONSTITUTION:The medium has a four-layer structure composed of the first protective layer of 350 - 650 Angstrom  thickness, recording layer of 150 - 250 Angstrom  thickness, second dielectric protective layer of 100 -600 Angstrom  thickness, and metal reflecting layer of 200 - 800 Angstrom  thickness. By this constitution, phase difference due to rotation of polarization plane of the reflected light is made as small as <=15 degrees in absolute value. This almost prevents the reflected light from changing into elliptically polarized light and prevents reduction of the carrier output. Thus, the obtd. medium is hardly influence by the variation in performances of drives, namely, variation of C/N due to drives can be decreased. Thickness of these layers are controlled in a manner that the phase difference shows minimum against variation in thickness of the first protective layer which particularly affects the phase difference, and thereby, time of forming films can be reduced.

title: 画像形成装置及び乾燥装置
abstract: 【課題】結露により生じた水分を記録媒体から離れる方向へ案内しない場合と比較して、記録媒体に水分を記録媒体に付着しにくくすることができる画像形成装置及び乾燥装置を提供する。 【解決手段】画像形成装置１０は、連続紙Ｐにインクを吐出する吐出ヘッド５０Ｙ、５０Ｍ、５０Ｃ、５０Ｋと、連続紙Ｐに光を照射し、連続紙Ｐに付着したインクの水分を蒸発させる照射装置１１０と、照射装置１１０が蒸発させた水分が結露することにより生じた水滴を連続紙Ｐから離れる方向へ案内する案内板１８０とを有する画像形成装置。 【選択図】図２

title: Method for recording optical data and optical data-recording medium
abstract: The invention provides a method for recording optical data being able to carry out the recordation and reproduction in high density by using a laser light having a short wave of length less than 450 nm, and provides an optical data-recoding medium having an excellent recording property and stability of recording data being able to preserve in long term under high temperature and high humidity as well as being able to be utilized in aforesaid optical data recording method. The method for recording optical data according to the invention comprises carrying out an optical recordation of recording an optical data on an optical recording medium by exposing under laser light having a short wave of length less than 450 nm, which is characterized in that the recording layer of aforesaid optical data-recording medium comprises a phthalocyanine derivate. Additionally, the invention further comprises an optical data-recording medium which is characterized in that it utilizes aforesaid method for recording optical data.

title: Method for generating bit map data and printing data preparation system
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To generate bit map data of high picture quality and to execute facing operation and page editing operation in parallel. SOLUTION: Since Thin Flat PS obtained by facing operation using dummy page data (Probe EPS) and output page data obtained by page editing operation are individually rasterized (steps 704 and 712) and then output face data are generated by executing bit map synthesis (step 716), the facing operation and the page editing operation can be mutually independently executed. Since the output page data are processed by affine transformation at least on the basis rotational and enlarged/reduced components (step 710) and rasterized and bit map data are generated in each page (step 712), it is unnecessary to apply the affine transformation such as rotation and enlargement/reduction causing the reduction of picture quality to the bit map data of each page at the time of bit map synthesis.

title: Image receiving sheet element
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the slipperiness of an image receiving sheet surface and image forming material and to prevent intrusion of air bubbles therebetween by roughening the image receiving layer side surface of a removable cover sheet. CONSTITUTION:The cover sheet is made of a high polymer having high dimensional stability and the surface thereof is adequately roughened. The roughening is executed to the extent of the surface roughness having average 2-40mum, more preferably 4-10mum peak valley (dent) distance. The image receiving sheet element is formed by tightly adhering the image receiving layer provided on a base and the roughened surface of the cover sheet roughened in the above- mentioned manner in such a manner that said layer and sheet can be stripped from each other. The surface of the image receiving layer is roughened by the rough surface of the cover sheet when both are stripped at the time of use. The slipperiness between both is thereby improved and the workability is improved in the case of transferring the image from the image forming material to the image receiving layer. The air bubbles are easily removable even if said bubbles enter the spacing between both.

title: 情報分類装置、情報分類方法、情報分類プログラム及びコンピュータ読み取り可能な記録媒体
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  被験者の主観的知見や感性に関連する脳波デ ータに基づいて分類対象情報を自動的に分類する。
【解決手段】  分類対象とされる分類対象情報の一覧が 情報表示装置１４に表示され、ユーザが情報選択デバイ ス１２により上記一覧から分類対象情報を選択すると、 選択された分類対象情報が情報表示装置１４に表示され る。この表示された分類対象情報をユーザが視認したと きに生じる当該ユーザの脳波データを脳波信号計測装置 １３により得て、信号処理部１６により、脳波データに 基づいて分類対象情報が分類され、その分類結果が情報 表示装置１４に表示される。

title: 硬涂膜、具备硬涂膜的物品及图像显示装置
abstract: 根据本发明提供一种硬涂膜、具备上述硬涂膜的物品及图像显示装置，上述硬涂膜具有基材和形成于上述基材的至少一个面上的硬涂层，上述硬涂层含有具有硅倍半氧烷结构的化合物，将上述基材的弹性模量设为σA且将上述硬涂层的弹性模量设为σB时，由σA‑σB表示的弹性模量差Δσ为1800～4900MPa，上述基材的弹性模量为6.0～9.0GPa，上述硬涂层在压入试验中的恢复率为84～99％。

title: Photosensitive planographic printing plate
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain a photosensitive planographic printing plate having satisfactory sensitivity, printing resistance and shelf stability. SOLUTION: A coating solution for a photopolymerizable layer containing a polyurethane resin binder, a compound having an addition polymerizable ethylenically unsaturated bond and a solvent is applied on a substrate having a hydrophilic surface and dried by heating under such conditions as to keep the resulting photosensitive planographic printing plate at 90-140 deg.C for >=10 sec to obtain the objective photosensitive planographic printing plate. Preferably the obtained photosensitive planographic printing plate is cooled to <=50 deg.C, the top of the photopolymerizable layer of the printing plate is coated with a protective layer containing a water-soluble oxygen barrier material and the protective layer is dried by heating.

title: 異常陰影抽出方法および装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  異常陰影抽出装置において、クロージング処 理の中間結果である最大値信号またはオープニング処理 の中間結果である最小値信号を保存するための記憶領域 を低減させる。
【解決手段】  クロージング処理の中間結果である、最 大値信号抽出手段20による原画像信号Ｓorg の最大値信 号を格納するバッファ31〜38をそれぞれ、｛構造要素Ｂ i の大きさ（画素数）と同一のライン分｝×｛原画像の １ラインに含まれる画素数｝の領域とし、このバッファ 31〜38に格納された最大値信号を構造要素Ｂi を用いた 最小値信号抽出手段50による１ライン分の最小値処理を 行ない、１ライン分の最小値処理が終了するごとにシフ ト手段41〜48によりバッファ31〜38に格納された最大値 信号を１ライン分だけバックシフトし、最大値信号抽出 手段20による１ライン分の最大値信号抽出処理を行う。

title: Printing machine and printing method using the printing machine
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a printing machine which is capable of certainly preventing the stretch and positional deviation of a printing plate on the plate cylinder of the machine from occurring in a simple manner and at a low cost and making the printing plate with a support made of a material other than a metal applicable to the printing of many pieces of paper in a variety of colors and further, satisfying printing performance and durability under strict conditions of use. SOLUTION: In the printing machine with the plate cylinder, the plate cylinder has numerous projecting protuberances which are 1-100 μm high when the plate cylinder is dry and formed by making the material adhere to the surface of the plate cylinder from outside.

title: 静電潜像現像剤の寿命検出装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  簡単な構成で現像剤寿命を自動的に容易に検 出し、現像剤交換の時期をタイムリーに知ることができ るようにする。
【構成】  感光体ドラム上のトナー濃度を検出するＡＤ Ｃセンサと、ＡＤＣセンサ出力と基準値とを比較する比 較器と、比較結果を表示する表示装置とを備え、あらか じめカブリの許容レベルを設定し、静電潜像を形成して いない感光体ドラムを現像し、そのときのトナー濃度を ＡＤＣセンサで検出してカブリの許容レベルと比較し、 検出したトナー濃度値が基準値以上になったときに、現 像剤寿命に達しているとして警告を発するようにする。

title: 発光部品、プリントヘッドおよび画像形成装置
abstract: 【課題】複数の発光素子が列状に配列された発光素子アレイのそれぞれの発光素子の発光面に設けたレンズにより、効率よく光を取り出すことのできる発光部品等を提供する。 【解決手段】第１アイランド３０１には、発光サイリスタＬ１が設けられている。発光サイリスタＬ１の発光面３１１上には、発光面３１１から遠ざかるにしたがい狭まりながら傾斜するとともに、発光面３１１から遠い側に凸状となった曲面部９２ｂと、曲面部９２ｂの発光面３１１から遠い側に曲面部９２ｂとつながった平面部９２ａとを備えたレンズ９２が設けられている。 【選択図】図６

title: プラスチック光ファイバの製造方法及び製造装置
abstract: 【課題】機械的強度が強く、外径が均一なプラスチック光ファイバを製造する。 【解決手段】ＰＯＦ原糸１２を連続走行させながら、加熱機７２により加熱するとともに、延伸手段としての第１及び第２ローラ対５６，７３により延伸する。加熱機７２の加熱範囲長さＬ１を０．１〜１ｍとし、長手方向における延伸倍率を１．５〜３．５とする。第１ローラ対５６のローラ５７と第２ローラ対７３のローラ９１は独立駆動とされ、各回転速度は独立して制御される。得られるＰＯＦ１１は、機械的強度に優れるとともに均一な外径を有し、光伝送特性と施工性に優れる。 【選択図】        図５

title: Image data accumulating device
abstract: PURPOSE:To compress and accumulate a document, etc., including a graphic and a graph, etc., at high compressibility by converting image data concerning the graphic into the data in vector expression, and accumulating them. CONSTITUTION:A form recognizing means 2 recognizes whether or not the image data in a form corresponding to the basic graphic exist, when they exist, the means 2 compresses the image data corresponding to the basic graphic by converting the image data in the vector expression into the image data in the vector expression, and accumulates them to an accumulator 4. Next, for the data of a character, etc., they are compressed by MR, MH compressing methods in the same way as before, and accumulated to the accumulator 4. Thus, the contents of the documents, etc., including the graph and the graphic can be compressed at the high compressibility, and accumulated.

title: Image pickup device and controlling method thereof
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To display a subject image from which noise caused by a DMA (direct memory access) transfer clock pulse is eliminated.  <P>SOLUTION: A signal for one horizontal scanning line of an effective pixel area of a CCD is outputted and digitally converted image data is written in a line memory within an effective image display period. The image data is read from the line memory within an ineffective image period. Since an image represented by image data obtained on the basis of the effective pixel area is displayed on a display screen 40, noise caused by the DMA transfer clock pulse can be prevented from being superimposed on the image displayed on the display screen 40 beforehand.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2003,JPO

title: Job processing service device
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a job processing service device little in the labor and time for developing and correcting a user interface means and easy in matching. CONSTITUTION:A user interface means which is common to all the job processing services is arranged respectively by one for each client computer 2. A job processing service 11 desired by a user is selected by this interface means. A job processing service management means 12 supplies information concerning the user interface of the job processing service such as the layout of a screen 50 to the user interface means 21 to generate the user interface in accordance with the information. When the user executes input, selection, etc., the job processing service management means 12 supplies them to a job processing service means to start the job processing service. When the selected job processing service is finished, the processing result such as normal finish is supplied to the user interface means.

title: Optical recording and reproducing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To enable an accurate seek and tracking control by controlling a ratio of currents to flow into 1st and 2nd seek coils in accordance with positions of a carriage part and focus adjustment movable part in the radial direction. CONSTITUTION:A relationship between a radially directional position of an optical recording medium and magnetic fields generated by conducting the coils is measured and a relationship between radially directional positions of the seek coils 41 and 42 to be electrified and a current ratio are stored in advance in a current ratio setting table ROM 83. Then, address information detected by an address detecting circuit 84 from a signal to be outputted from a disk reproducing circuit 85 is inputted to a microcomputer 80, where current amts. to flow into the coils 41 and 42 are instructed to current drivers 81 and 82 respectively with reference to the ROM 83. By this method, even when magnetic fields working the coils 41 and 42 respectively are uneven, a ratio of driving force for working the focus adjustment movable part (p) to driving force for working the carriage part (s) is conformed with a mass ratio of (p) to (s) so that resonance can be prevented, and the accurate control can thus be carried out.

title: Mark imprinting device for rotary camera
abstract: PURPOSE:To confirm continuous relation between mutual films by looking the exposed film with naked eyes and to improve the efficiency of work such as the read or the arrangement of the film by obtaining such constitution that a mark showing the continuous relation between the films is imprinted on the head or the last of the film based on an imprint command. CONSTITUTION:In the case that the film 34 is exhausted on the way of the original of one group, the imprint command is inputted when an imprint key is depressed at the last of the film 34 or the imprint key is depressed before developing is executed by depressing a developing key on the way of photographing. Based on the imprint command, the respective picture elements of a light emitting means 86 are selectively made to flicker by a control means 88. Then, the mark showing a sentence such as 'there is a continuous film' or 'containing to the roll of number (n)', for example, is imprinted on the last of the film 34. When the imprint command is inputted on the head of the film 34, the mark showing the sentence such as 'there is a continuous film' or 'continuing to the roll of number (n+1)', for example, is imprinted on the film 34 to which photographing is performed next. Thus, the continuous relation between the films 34 is easily confirmed with the naked eyes while looking the exposed film 34. Besides, the efficiency of the reading or the arranging work of the film 34 is improved.

title: 記憶装置、画像形成装置およびプログラム
abstract: 【課題】  データの読み出し速度が異なる複数の記憶領域を有する記憶装置を用いて、一定速度で、かつ、高速なデータ転送を行う。 【解決手段】  ＣＰＵ２０１が、入力された画像データに対して、データの読み出し速度が異なる複数の記憶領域を有する記憶媒体２１１の空き領域の中から読み出し速度の最も速い記憶領域を割り当てる。ＣＰＵ２０１が、割り当てられた記憶領域の読み出し速度と出力部２０９が要求するデータ転送速度とから、このデータ転送速度を満たすデータ圧縮率の閾値を求める。ＣＰＵ２０１が、可逆圧縮部２０４１により圧縮された画像データの圧縮率と閾値とを比較する。圧縮された画像データの圧縮率が閾値未満である場合に、非可逆圧縮部２０４２が入力画像データを閾値以上の圧縮率で圧縮する。閾値以上の圧縮率で圧縮された画像データは、割り当てられた記憶領域に格納される。 【選択図】      図２

title: Magnetic resonance imaging apparatus and sampling pattern determination method
abstract: To provide a sampling pattern suitable for image reconfiguration of high-speed imaging using a sensitivity distribution difference of a reception coil and sparsity of measurement data, and capable of generating an image free of noise and artifacts.SOLUTION: An MRI apparatus includes a measurement point determination part for determining each measurement point of three-dimensional k space data. With a kx direction of a three-dimensional k space as a lead-out direction, the measurement point determination part adjusts a first condition that an angle of straight lines connecting the measurement points and the center of a plane changes at a golden angle (α), and a distance (r) from the center point of the plane increases monotonously on a plurality of measurement points in the ky-kz plane, and determines the measurement point to satisfy a second condition that a change in the position of the measurement point is made aperiodic.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title: Positive resist composition for euv exposure, and pattern forming method using it
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an excellent positive resist composition for reducing PEB temperature dependency without any problem of outgasing during exposure, by possessing sufficiently excellent contrast under exposure due to EUV light, and to provide a pattern forming method using it.  <P>SOLUTION: The positive resist composition contains a resin containing a repeated unit of a specific structure and increasing solubility to alkali developing liquid due to action of acid, and a sulfonium salt compound generating acid due to action of EVU light of a specific structure. The pattern forming method using it is provided.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Image recording material
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide an image recording material capable of utilizing a conventional processor or printer and good in recording properties and printing durability enabled in direct plate making from the digital data of a computer or the like. CONSTITUTION:A binder, a substance absorbing light to generate heat and a substance thermally decomposable but substantially lowering the solubility of the binder in an undecomposed state are contained in an image recording material.

title: Head device for side print
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the quality of the side print by forming a rectangular light projection surface, imaging light which is emitted from its peripheral part on an exposure surface, and putting light projected from the center part out of focus on the exposure surface. CONSTITUTION:Monochromatic or multi-color light emitted by a light source 12 under the control of an LED driver is made incident on a bundle 15 and projected from its light projection surface 15. Light Part of the projection light which is emitted from the center part of the surface 15a becomes an out-of-focus image on the surface 18a of a film 18 through the operation of a lens 16 and the colors are mixed sufficiently. The light emitted from the peripheral surface of the surface 15a, on the other hand, forms a sharp image on the surface 18a. The light emitted from the surface 15a forms a latent image which has a sharp contour, but has no color irregularity on the surface 18a. Then respective light sources 12 are made to emit light selectively and a latent image of a mark is formed on the film 18.

title: 尾部質量の低い小滴で可変小滴サイズ放出を行う方法及び装置
abstract: 【課題】複数パルス波形で可変サイズ小滴を発生するように小滴放出装置を駆動するための方法及び装置を提供する。 【解決手段】一実施形態では、アクチュエータを有する小滴放出装置を駆動するための方法は、少なくとも１つの駆動パルス及び少なくとも１つの離脱パルスを有する複数パルス波形をアクチュエータに印加することを含む。更に、この方法は、少なくとも１つの駆動パルスで流体の小滴を形成することも含む。更に、この方法は、少なくとも１つの離脱パルスで小滴の離脱を加速することも含む。更に、この方法は、小滴放出装置が、複数パルス波形のパルスに応答して流体の小滴を放出するようにさせることも含む。離脱パルスは、小滴の尾部質量を減少するために少なくとも１つの駆動パルスにより形成された小滴の離脱を生じさせる。 【選択図】図８

title: 情報提示方法および情報提示装置
abstract: 【課題】ユーザインタフェース表示や管理レポートの印刷出力などを行なう場合における複数の言語体系への対応を、より使い勝手が良くなるようにする。 【解決手段】通常言語設定記憶部１１０にデフォルト用の言語情報を記憶する。一般言語設定記憶部１２０に一般ユーザ設定用の言語情報を圧縮して記憶する。一般ユーザにより何れかの言語設定が選択されるとＲＡＭ１２４に展開して使う。機械管理者による言語設定の切替可能範囲と一般ユーザによる言語設定の切替可能範囲とは、個別に設定可能にしておく。デフォルト設定とするべきメジャー言語と、自由な切替えを可能にするべきマイナー言語の関係のバランスを加味して、それぞれの切替可能範囲を設定する。制御部１００の言語設定切替部１４０は、動作管理部１３０からの情報に従って言語設定を切り替える。 【選択図】図４

title: Conductive film and method of producing the same, and touch panel and integrated solar cell
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method of producing a conductive film in which a fine pattern of a high permeability low resistance conductive film can be formed easily while improving insulation significantly, and to provide a touch panel in which durability against writing pressure and flexibility are improved, and an integrated solar cell in which conversion efficiency is improved.SOLUTION: A conductive film consists of a substrate, and a conductive layer formed on the substrate and containing at least conductive fibers. The conductive layer is patterned and the pattern edge roughness is 5 μm or less. Such an aspect as the conductive layer contains dispersant and the mass ratio (A/B) of the total content A of the dispersant and the content B of conductive fibers is 0.1 to 5.0, or an aspect as the conductive fibers have an average short-axis length of 100 nm or less and an average long-axis length of 5 μm or more is preferable.

title: Photocurable adhesive and bonding process employing same
abstract:
An actinic radiation curable adhesive is provided that includes 50 to 99 wt %
of a bifunctional and/or a polyfunctional oxetane compound, 0 to 40 wt % of a
monofunctional oxetane compound, 1 to 50 wt % of an epoxy compound having a
cyclic structure, and a catalytic amount of a photoinitiator. The adhesive has an
initial viscosity of 10 to 1,000 mPa·s and a viscosity at gel point of 1 × 10 1  to 9 × 10 6 
Pa.s. There is also provided a process for bonding an adherend A and a different
adherend B, the process including forming an adhesive layer by coating a surface of
the adherend A with the above adhesive at a thickness of 0.05 to 50 µm, irradiating
the adhesive layer with actinic radiation, and bonding the adherend B to the
adhesive layer after 0.01 to 4 times the time required for gelling of the adhesive layer
has passed following the start of irradiation with actinic radiation.

title: インスタントフイルムの展開機構
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  電源が消耗しても確実に現像液ポッドの裂開 及び現像液の展開を行う。
【解決手段】  フイルム展開機構４７を展開モータ６ ０、展開ローラ対６１、展開ギヤ列６２とから構成す る。展開ギヤ列６２を、遊星ギヤクラッチ６５を用いて ギヤ列６９とギヤ列７０との２段階の減速ギヤ列から構 成する。ギヤ列７０はギヤ列６９よりもギヤ比が高いの で、展開ローラ対６１の回転速度は遅いが高トルクで回 転する。通常、遮光カバーの搬送時にはギヤ列７０を、 インスタントフイルムの搬送時にはギヤ列６９を用いる ように展開モータ６０を回転させる。展開ローラ対６１ による現像液ポッドの裂開時に、展開モータ６０の回転 速度が所定値以下に減速した場合には、展開モータ６０ の回転方向を切り替えてギヤ列７０を用いて現像液ポッ ドの裂開を行う。現像液ポッドの裂開後に、再び展開モ ータ６０の回転方向を切り替えてギヤ列６９を用いて現 像液の展開を高速に行う。

title: Sheet body fixing device having clamp with uniform nipping force
abstract: When a sheet body such as a printing plate or the like is wound onto a rotation drum, the sheet body is securely fixed to the rotation drum and after being fixed, the coming up of the sheet off the drum is kept at a minimum. In the clamp having two support points, the position of the support points are determined such that the amount of deformation caused when a centrifugal force generated when the rotation drum rotates at a high speed, acts against an urging force of the clamp, in the dimension between the support points and the dimension between the support points and one end portion, is substantially uniform along the entire length of the clamp portion. Thus, the nipping force is uniform along the entire clamp and the printing plate, and the disadvantage of the printing plate inclining on the rotation drum is eliminated.

title: 超低反射光コネクターフェルールの研磨体
abstract:
(57)【要約】

title: Image storing method and image output system
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To more quickly output an image when the output of a highly accurate image is unnecessary in an image output system. SOLUTION: A QA-WS 20 inputs an image obtained by modality to a regulated processing means 22. The means 22 applies regulated processing to the image obtained by the modality, obtains 10-bit regulated image data (a) and stores original image data (p) in an image server 30. An image processing means 24 reads out regulated image data (c) stored in the server 30, applies resolution reducing processing and prescribed image processing to the read data (c) and stores image processed data (d) in the server 30. At the time of diagnosis, a diagnosing WS 12 reads out original image data (f) stored in the server 30, displays a highly accurate image, and at the time of image retrieval, reads out image processed data (h) of which data volume is smaller than that of the data (f) and quickly displays the retrieved image.

title: Device and method for verifying synchronous clock in light beam scanner
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To easily and exactly verify the resolution and state of a linear encoder plate for synchronization. SOLUTION: The number of synchronous clock SYNC generated with the linear encoder plate for synchronization is counted in a counter part 106, is outputted to a comparing part 110 and a counted value storage part 116. With a compared result t obtained by comparing a counted value cnt in one main scanning direction of the forward with a reference value D0 supplied from a reference value setting part 112, the state of the linear encoder plate for synchronization is verified, and the resolution of the linear encoder plate for synchronization is simultaneously verified from the counted value cnt.

title: 画像処理装置、基板配線露光システム及び基板配線形成システム
abstract: 【課題】  設計データに対応する電気特性の配線基板を得る。 【解決手段】  基板設計装置１２から、回路設計、アートワーク設計、シート設計、そして面付け処理が実行された後のＩＣチップを搭載する位置に設けられるパッドや配線の設計データ（ガーバーデータ）が出力され、ＲＩＰ装置１４は、変換部２６における処理において配線の線幅について補正処理を施しつつ、設計データをラスターイメージに変換処理し、ＤＩ装置１６へ出力する。ＤＩ装置１６は、イメージデータにより直接ワークボード２０に画像を露光し現像し、ＤＥＳ装置１８でエッチング処理する。従って、ワークボード２０の基板厚にばらつきを有する場合に生じる特性インピーダンスのばらつき、つまり基板の各所でばらつく板厚や材料厚に起因した電気特性のばらつきを抑制するため、予め求めた補正テーブルによりパターン幅を調整することによって、電気特性ばらつきを抑制できる。 【選択図】  図１

title: Silver halide color photographic sensitive material
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the photosensitive material which has excellent sharpness and suppresses the deterioration in the sharpness by the bleeding of color images during the preservation after processing by respectively specifying the oil drop content ratio in emulsion layers and the average jelly strength of the gelatin contained in the emulsion layers. CONSTITUTION:The oil drop content ratio of at least one layer of the silver halide emulsion layers of the silver halide color photographic sensitive material having protective layers is >=0.6 and <=1.5 and the average jelly strength of the gelatin incorporated into the emulsion layers is >=250. Namely, the oil drop content ratio=the total volume of the oil drops in these layers/the total volume of the gelatin in these layers and the oil drop content ratio is 0.6 to 1.5 and more particularly 0.7 to 1.2. The average jelly strength of the gelatin used for the emulsion layers contg. couplers is >=250 and is more particularly preferably >=260 and <=400. The case in which all of the gelatin kinds incorporated into the emulsion layers are constituted of the gelatin kinds having >=250 and <=350 jelly strength is more preferable.

title: Imaging system and sheet processor
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To prevent incorrect carriage of a sheet through a convenient control method while preventing productivity from lowering even in a mode for passing one sheet through a plurality of sheet processing means. SOLUTION: An imaging system comprising an imaging unit 1 for forming an image on a sheet S, and a sheet processor 3 provided with a plurality of means 2 each performing a specified processing on each sheet S delivered from the imaging unit 1 is provided with means 4 for making a selection whether sheet processing is performed or not using the plurality of sheet processing means 2, and a control means 5 which alters the timing for feeding the sheet S from the imaging unit 1 depending on the processing time of a sheet processing means 2 (e.g. 2a) having a longest processing time per sheet among two or more sheet processing means 2 (e.g. 2a and 2b) selected by the selecting means 4 under conditions that sheet processing is performed using two or more sheet processing means 2 (e.g. 2a and 2b).

title: 信息处理系统及方法
abstract: 本发明提供一种能够容易地掌握规定的区域内的人物的状况的信息处理系统及方法。信息处理系统具备：第1摄影部，拍摄表演者；第2摄影部，拍摄规定的区域内的人物；第1识别部，根据由第1摄影部拍摄到的图像来识别场景；第2识别部，根据由第2摄影部拍摄到的图像来识别人物的表情；计算部，根据场景的识别结果及人物的表情的识别结果来计算与场景对应的人物的状况指数；热图制作部，制作将人物的状况指数与区域内的人物的位置建立对应关联表示的热图；及输出部，输出热图。

title: Image foming luminescent device
abstract: PURPOSE:To stabilize the quantity of light of a fixed fluorescent lamp and prevent defects such as uneven fixing and others generated by the variation of quantity of light by recording an image on a light fixing type photosensitive recording material by means of an image recording section and then emitting light and fixing image. CONSTITUTION:A photosensitive recording material 10 between a guide plate 66 and another guide plate 68 is clamped by a carrier roller 72 guided by a guide 70 and rotated reversely, fed out to a feed-in and out site and disposed on a tray. The heat treatment of one photosensitive recording material is completed by the arrangement. The surface temperature of a fixing flourescent lamp 150 is controlled by an air suction fan 154, a heater 156 and a Pertier element 158 at light sources 64A and 64B. For the purpose of shortening the starting time from putting on the fixing fluorescent lamp 150 to reaching the lowest optimum temperature level, power is applied to the air the suction fan 154 and the heater 156.

title: 画像評価装置、画像評価システム、及び画像処理プログラム
abstract: 【課題】人間の官能評価に近い評価を可能とした画像評価装置及びプログラムを提供する。 【解決手段】空間周波数及びコントラストが各々異なる複数のパターンを含む画像を取得し（Ｓ１０３）、取得した画像に含まれる複数のパターンの各々について、当該複数のパターンに対応する複数の理想パターンの各々と比較して、類似度を各々算出し（Ｓ１１１）、算出した複数のパターンの類似度の和から（Ｓ１２７）、画像の解像性に関する性能を評価する評価値を出力する（Ｓ１２９）。 【選択図】図４

title: Photosensitive material drying device
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To dry a photosensitive material without the occurrence of damages, pressing traces, unequal brightness, etc. SOLUTION: A chamber 64 which has transporting roller pairs 44 to 62 arranged along the horizontal direction and slit holes for blowing hot air to photographing paper P formed on the upper and lower side, is disposed. Only the transporting rollers 54, 56, 58 in contact with emulsion layers among the transporting roller pairs disposed in the region where the moisture content of the emulsion layers of the photographing paper P attains >=2 to <20% are formed as tacky adhesion resistant rollers of PTFE, etc., and the other rollers are formed out of low-cost materials.  The tacky adhesive power of the emulsion layers increases when moisture content falls to <20% but the emulsion layers of the state increased in the tacky adhesive power are composed to come into contact with only the tacky adhesion resistant rollers and, therefore, such troubles as jamming of the photographing paper P and the transfer of the emulsion layers to the roller surfaces are prevented. The pressing trace of the roller is hardly formed.

title: 撮影装置および投光モジュール
abstract: 【課題】  複数の投光素子を用いたとしても小型であって、しかも所定の距離に達するところまである程度の明るさを保ちつつ、かつパララックスを含めた範囲にまで照明が行なえる補助光投光部を備えた撮影装置およびその撮影装置に搭載するのに好適な投光モジュールを提供する。 【解決手段】３つに領域分割されたレンズを用いて３つの光点からの光を被写体に向けて図１１（ｂ）に示す投光パターンで投光する。領域分割された各投光部により３つの光点からの光をそれぞれ３本のビームにして投光するようにして各投光部により投光された、３本のビームのうちの１本づつの光ビームが互いに重なるように投光する。 【選択図】  図１１

title: Microfilter and its manufacture
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a filter having extremely fine pore diameter and narrow distribution of pore diameters by irradiating an energy beam on a substrate, vapor-depositing another substance on the substrate, and then removing the substrate. CONSTITUTION:An energy beam 2 whose flux is extremely narrowed is irradiat ed on a substrate 1 of a Cr sheet, etc. to form selectively an irradiated part 3 and a non-irradiated part 4 on the substrate 1. Then a desired filter-forming substance of Au, etc. is vapor-deposited on the substrate. The vapor is not deposited on the part 3 irradiated with the energy beam 2 to form a part 5 on which vapor is not deposited, and the vapor is deposited on the non-irradiated part 4 to form a vapor-dposited part 6. Moreover, a filter-forming material 7 is separated from the substrate 1 by dissolving the substrate 1 into an acidic soln., for example. A microfilter having <=0.1mu pore diameter and having <=20% variance of diameters is obtained in this way.

abstract: 【課題】画像読取手段によって媒体の表面から読み取られた第１の媒体画像に含まれる或る領域の画像、に対応する画像の、画像読取手段によって第１の媒体画像とは別に上記媒体の表面から読み取られた第２の媒体画像における位置を特定すること。 【解決手段】第２前景画素特定部４８は、第２原稿画像中の前景画素を特定し、基準情報取得部５０は、第１原稿画像中の基準画像から前景画素に応じた位置の画素を除外した第１マスク画像を取得し、比較対象情報取得部５２は、第２原稿画像中の複数の比較対象画像の各々につき、比較対象画像から前景画素に応じた位置の画素を除外した第２マスク画像を取得し、ずれ情報生成部５８は、第１マスク画像と、第２マスク画像の各々と、の比較結果に基づいて選択される一の比較対象画像の位置と、基準画像の位置と、のずれを示すずれ情報を生成する。 【選択図】図６

title: Total photofinishing laboratory system
abstract: A total photo-lab system for automatic printing processing, cutting, sorting and enveloping. Each of a plurality of films spliced into a film roll is provided with a label printed with a respective ID number bar code. The same ID number bar code is provided on a respective envelope. During printing, the ID number of each film set in a printing position is read out so as to record a punch code indicative of the same ID number on a photographic paper besides the first print frame made from that film. The printed film is reserved until the corresponding print frames have been processed. The ID number of the processed photographic paper is read and compared with the ID number of the reserved film. When these ID numbers are identical, the film is cut and inserted into a film sheath sheet, whereas the photographic paper is cut into individual prints, and are sorted into each set of prints belonging to the same film. The film sheath sheet is inserted into the envelope having the same ID number as the film contained in that film sheath sheet, and then the prints having the same ID number are inserted therein.

title: Method and apparatus for setting processing condition of photosensitive material processing line
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method and an apparatus for setting processing conditions with which no error occurs in setting the processing conditions of a photosensitive material processing line and time required for setting is short.  <P>SOLUTION: A display 41 is placed in the vicinity of processing facilities 37. The computer 38 displays the operating instruction data on the display 41. An operator sets the processing conditions in the facility control computer 38 by using an input device 39 while referring to the operating instruction data on the display 41. title: Thermal transfer recording material
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a thermal transfer recording material having favorable heat resistance and high sensitivity, by adding a releasing substance liquefied when being heated, to a matrix polymer constituting a base film. CONSTITUTION:A thermal transfer recording material comprises a heat-sensitive ink layer 1, a base film 2, a releasing substance 3 and a matrix polymer 4. The releasing substance 3, which is liquefied when being heated, is added to the matrix polymer 4 constituting the base film 2. The matrix polymer 4 may be a polyester, triacetyl cellulose, nylon, a polycarbonate or the like. The releasing substance 3 is a waxy substance, e.g., a low molecular weight polyolefin wax such as polyethylene and polypropylene, a modified polyolefin such as polyethylene oxide and polypropylene oxide or a copolymer thereof. With heat applied by a thermal head at the time of recording, the releasing substance exudes to the contact surface of the base film and the thermal head, whereby a sticking phenomenon or defective feeding of the film can be obviated.

title: 画像処理装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  文字を含む画像データを出力装置に適したデ ータに変換する。
【解決手段】  画像処理装置では、ページ記述言語から なる画像データが入力されると、ページ記述言語の各コ マンド毎について、次のような変換処理を行う。まず、 コマンドが文字の背景色であるか否かが判断され（ステ ップＳａ１）、「ＮＯ」の場合、文字に関するコマンド であるか否かが判断される（ステップＳａ２）。ここ で、コマンドが文字に関するコマンドであり、予め設定 された変更すべき色属性を指示するコマンドである場合 （ステップＳａ３）、このコマンドの属性命令が予め設 定された他の属性に変更される（ステップＳａ４）。こ のようにして、出力装置に適したコマンドに変更された 後、変更されたコマンドが出力される（ステップＳａ ５）。

title: 光触媒電極、人工光合成モジュール及び人工光合成装置
abstract: 透明導電体層を用いた場合に、面積を大きくしても電気抵抗が小さい光触媒電極、人工光合成モジュール及び人工光合成装置を提供する。光触媒電極は、基板、透明導電体層、光触媒層及び線状の金属電気伝導体を有する、光により水を分解して気体を発生させる光触媒電極であって、基板、透明導電体層、光触媒層がこの順に積層され、且つ線状の金属電気伝導体が透明導電体層に接している。人工光合成モジュールは、光により水を分解して酸素を発生させる、酸素発生電極と、光により水を分解して水素を発生させる、水素発生電極とを具備し、且つ酸素発生電極と水素発生電極が光の進行方向に沿って直列に配置されている。酸素発生電極と水素発生電極の少なくとも一方が上述の光触媒電極の構成である。人工光合成装置は人工光合成モジュールを有し、水を循環して利用する。

title: System timing synchronizing system
abstract: PURPOSE:To simplify an arithmetic device for executing the arithmetic at each station for the purpose of synchronism by setting a flag only to the packet of a station having leadership, and allowing each station to establish the system timing based on the distance from an optical star coupler. CONSTITUTION:A packet signal formed by a transmission logical circuit 11 is transmitted to optical cables 31a-31d and received by each station. When the transmission of the initial packet signal is succeeded, its station acquires a position as the master station and a flag is set to the packet transmitted from the station to establish the reference of frame synchronism. When stations other than the master station detect that the master flag is set, it is transferred to a timing set circuit 24. The set circuit 24 operates a distance code of the own station and a guard time of a packet signal at a position of the optical star coupler 30 to synchronize the system timing.

title: Color image forming device
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To restrain the color slurring of a full color image with a simple constitution and to restrain the increase of the production cost by transmitting the rotational driving force of a driving motor to plural photoreceptor drums through a belt-like carrying body. SOLUTION: Laser beam scanning units 20A to 20D scan the photo-receptor drums 18A to 18D to which specified charge is previously given by electrifiers 19A to 19D with a laser beam based on image information in accordance with respective colors outputted from an operation control part 12 so as to form electrostatic latent images in accordance with the respective colors. In the case of issuing a command that the latent image is to be formed on the drums 18A to 18D based on scanning with the laser beam, a paper carrying belt 17 is driven based on the rotation of a driving roller 13, and simultaneously, pressure rollers 24A to 24D press the belt 17 to the non-image forming area of the drums 18A to 18D. abstract: 【課題】動体を含む画像をフラッシュ撮影する際、適切な発光量でフラッシュを発光させることができるフラッシュ発光方法及び装置を提供する。 【解決手段】本撮影前にフラシュを発光させないで撮影した非発光画像と、フラッシュをプリ発光させて撮影した発光画像を取得し、得られた非発光画像と発光画像とに基づいて、本撮影時のフラッシュの発光量（本発光量）を算出する場合において、画角内の動体を検出し、検出した動体が主要被写体の場合は、動体の画像に基づいて、本発光量を算出し、検出した動体が主要被写体でない場合は、動体以外の画像に基づいて、本発光量を算出する。 【選択図】      図１７

abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an error diffusion method capable of easily performing the control of a recording level with an easy processing to enable the solution of delay of dots, a reduction in banding, and a stable high-speed recording.  <P>SOLUTION: When an image with a recording level 1 of 100% is formed by performing a half-tone processing with application of a general error diffusion method, the recording level 1 is continued to make banding BD conspicuous as shown in (A). At the same time, according to the half-tone processing of this invention, a recording level free from drops is applied to a pixel position X, as shown in (B), and no ink drop is discharged. Since the recording level free from drops is selected for image data to which a recording level of small drop is naturally selected, the diffusion error to unprocessed image data is increased. In the processing for the following image data, a recording level of middle drop or more is selected, and ink drops C of middle size are discharged, as shown in (B), to form an image.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

title: Apparatus, system and program for forming image
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To match output results of characters and line drawings among different image forming apparatuses.  <P>SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus is so controlled as to store extracted text information and another extracted text information in an associated manner in an HDD24b and to store extracted line drawing information and another line drawing information in an associated manner in the HDD24b. A printer engine 28 is so controlled as to form and output an image based on the extracted text information and the extracted line drawing information, on a paper, on a basis of the contents registered in a line drawing information substitution table and a text information substitution table.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: フィルムミラー及びフィルムミラーの製造方法
abstract: 【課題】銀反射層１６と樹脂製支持体１２との密着性が良好であり、耐光性に優れるフィルムミラー及びその製造方法を提供する。 【解決手段】支持体１２と、樹脂中間層１４と、銀を含有する反射層１６と、樹脂保護層１８と、をこの順に有し、樹脂中間層１４と銀を含有する反射層１６との界面において、樹脂中間層１４の銀を含有する反射層側の表面及び表層、銀を含有する反射層１６の樹脂中間層側の表面及び表層の、少なくともいずれかに銀腐食防止剤２０を有するフィルムミラー。 【選択図】図１

title: Manufacture of mother wafer structure body
abstract: PURPOSE:To carry out position matching of a structure body by scanning a beam to a mother wafer structure body to detect lengthwise and breadthwise edge line information of a rectangular construction part from a stepped section and by obtaining edge corner coordinate of the rectangular construction section. CONSTITUTION:Arbitrary coordinate of a mother wafer structure body 20 on lengthwise and breadthwise edge lines 25, 26 of a specified semiconductor chip 22 on a stage 10 is obtained from a peak section of signal waveform of secondary electron which is emitted by deflection scanning of an electronic beam 2. Then, coordinate X1 and coordinate X2 on a breadthwise edge line 26 of the specified semiconductor chip 22 and coordinate Y1 and coordinate Y2 on the lengthwise edge line 25 are obtained; lengthwise and breadthwise edge line information of [Y=a1X+b1] and [Y=a2X+b2], which are linear equations of each of lengthwise and breadthwise edge lines 25, 26 on the stage 10 are obtained. Thereafter, simultaneous linear equations of lengthwise and breadthwise edge line informations are solved to obtain an edge corner coordinate Z of the specified semiconductor chip 22 which is equivalent to an intersecting point of the lines.

title: Operation display device
abstract: PURPOSE:To facilitate the key operation and the state check by constituting a key input means of a transparent touch switch which is operated by slight pressure, and also, proving a touch switch selecting area and a display part on one sheet of printed surface printing sheet so that a switch operation and a display operation by a light emitting element can be executed. CONSTITUTION:When a display part on a surface printing sheet 1 is pressed with a finger, a touch panel upper sheet 6 which has been placed thereunder and a control circuit part I 13 scan a scan signal, and subsequently, a control circuit part II 14 scans a return signal, and when a touch panel electrode 8 is brought to electric conduction, a switch input is detected. The switch input which has been detected is transferred to a control circuit board 15, in which a light emitting element 10 corresponding to the display part, for instance, an LED is lighted. The light emitting element 10 is loaded on a printed board 17, and also, the side end face of supporting member 12 is surrounded and shielded by a light shielding wall 12a, therefore, it does not occur that a light beam from the LED leaks to the periphery. In such a way, it does not occur that the light beam leaks to the periphery of the display part and it comes to be scarcely visible, and both the switch operation and the display operation by the light emitting element 10 can be executed.

title: 画像形成装置
abstract: 【課題】光書込み装置全体を移動させる場合に比べ、移動させる空間を少なくすることができる画像形成装置を提供することができる画像形成装置を提供する。 【解決手段】画像形成装置１０は、像を保持する像保持体４２と、像保持体４２に保持された像が転写される被転写部材５２と、光書込み装置本体１００と、光書込み装置本体１００が保持された保持体１４０と、を有する光書込み装置３２と、を有し、保持体１４０は、被転写部材５２と対向して固定され、光書込み装置本体１００は、像保持体４２が出し入れされる側と反対側が回転自在に保持体１４０に取り付けられ、像保持体４２が装着されていない場合、光書込み装置本体１００は、保持体１４０に対して、傾斜して支持されている。 【選択図】図３

title: 着色组合物、固化膜、滤色器及显示装置
abstract: 本发明提供一种能够形成耐光性优异的固化膜的着色组合物、固化膜、滤色器及显示装置。着色组合物包含着色剂及具有脂环式环氧基的化合物，上述着色组合物在将其相对于波长445nm的光的吸光度设为1时，其相对于波长535nm的光的吸光度为17以上。

title: Positioning device for thermal head
abstract: PURPOSE:To enable to accurately adjust a fitting position, by a method wherein a guide pin is passed through a through-hole of a base, is inserted into a guide hole of a thermal head, and a metallic fitting having the guide pin projected therefrom is positioned by moving along the major surface of the base. CONSTITUTION:First, the thermal head 2 is placed on a major surface 1a of the base 1, the guide pin 10 of the metallic fitting 11 is passed through the through- hole 6 of the base 1, is inserted into the guide hole 12 of the head 2, and the fitting 11 is affixed to a major surface 1b of the base 1. Next, screws 15, 15' are engaged into threaded holes 17, 17' of the fitting 11 to tentatively fix them, and an adjusting screw 14 is rotated to slide the fitting 11 on the major surface 1b through the large diameter through-holes 6, 7, 7', thereby moving the thermal head 2 to a predetermined position on the base 1. Then, the head 2 is fixed to the base 1 by the screws 15, 15', and the fitting 11 is fixed to the base 1 by a screw 18. Accordingly, fitting can be performed accurately and easily, fine positioning can be achieved, and the fitting position is prevented from being shifted.

title: 検査装置
abstract: 【課題】膨らみ部を有する被検査物の検査が容易な検査装置を提供する 【解決手段】被検査物である円筒体２０は、本体部２０ａと本体部２０ａよりも大径のバルジ部２０ｂを有している。検査装置は、平行かつ水平に配置され、互いに同一の回転方向に回転する２本で一対のシャフト本体６０と、シャフト本体６０の外径よりも大径であり、２本のシャフト本体６０のそれぞれに少なくとも１つ装着されるフランジ６２ｂとを有し、フランジ６２ｂで円筒体２０を支持して円筒体２０の軸を中心に回転させる。フランジ６２ｂは、高さがバルジ部２０ｂの高さよりも高く、シャフト本体６０の軸方向にスライド自在に設けられている。 【選択図】図６

Production of 4-alkylthio-substituted phenol compound
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a compound useful as, e.g., synthetic intermediate for dye, medicine, agricultural chemical, etc., or cyan coupler in photographic chemical field in good yield and one process, by reacting a phenol compound with an alkylsulphenyl chloride. CONSTITUTION:A phenol compound expressed by formula I or formula II (R1 is group capable of substituting at aromatic ring and is substituted at a position other than 4 position of phenol or naphthol; m is 0-4; n is 0-6) is reacted with an alkylsulphenyl chloride expressed by formula III (R2 and R3 are H, alkyl, aryl or aralkyl; Y is alkyl, aryl, alkoxy, aryloxy, alkylthio, etc.) in a solvent such as methylene chloride or chloroform at -78-200 deg.C to provide the aimed product expressed by formula IV or formula V. As necessary, Lewis acid (e.g. aluminum chloride) may be added in the reaction.

title: Production of 4-alkylthio-substituted phenol compound
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a compound useful as a synthetic intermediate for cyan coupler in photographic chemical field, etc., in one process and good yield, by reacting a 4-halogeno-1-naphthol with an alkylthiols in the presence of a base. CONSTITUTION:A compound expressed by formula I (R1 is a group capable of substituting at an aromatic ring; X is Cl, Br or F; m is 0-6) is reacted with a compound expressed by the formula R2SH (R2 is alkyl) in the presence of a base (e.g., NaOH) in a solvent such as N,N-dimethylformamide at -78-250 deg.C to provide the aimed product expressed by formula II. The compound expressed by formula II and base are each used at molar ratio of 0.01-1000 and 0.1-100.

title: Production of 4-alkylthio-substituted phenol compound
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a compound useful as a synthetic intermediate for dye, agricultural chemical or medicine, cyan coupler in photographic chemical, etc., in one process and good yield, by reacting a phenol compound with an asymmetric disulfide in the presence of a base. CONSTITUTION:A phenol compound expressed by formula I or formula II (R1 is a group capable of substituting at aromatic ring and is not substituted at 4 position of phenol or naphthol; m is 0-4; n is 0-6) is reacted with an asymme tric disulfide expressed by formula III (R2 is aliphatic; X is O, S, Se, Te, N or methine; Y is N or methine; Z forms non-metallic atom group of 5 or 6-mem bered ring together with X and Y or may have condensed ring) in the presence of a base (e.g., NaOH) in a solvent such as N,N-dimethylformamide at -78-250 deg.C to provide the aimed product expressed by formula IV or formula V.

title: Production of 1h-pyrazolo(5,1-c)-1,2,4-triazole compound
abstract: PURPOSE:To easily obtain the subject compound useful as a coupler for silver halide color photography in high yield by cyclizing a 5-hydrazino-1H-pyrazole compound with a carboxylic acid in the presence of a phosphonium salt, etc. CONSTITUTION:The objective compound of formula VII can be produced by compounding a compound of formula V (R1 is H or substituent; X is H or substituent; A is acid radical; (n) is 0 or positive number necessary for neutralizing the charge in the molecule) with a compound of formula VI (R2 is H, alkyl, etc.; M is H or alkali metal) at a molar ratio of 1:(1-20) and reacting the compounds with each other at -10 to +150 deg.C for 30min to 20hr, e.g. without using a solvent, in the presence of a phosphonium salt of formula III or phosphorane of formula IV produced by using a tertiary phosphine of formula I (Y is alkyl, amino, etc.) and a halogenation agent of formula II (Hal is halogen atom; Q is substituent) at a molar ratio of 1:(1-100).

title: Novel methine dye
abstract: NEW MATERIAL:The compound of formula I [m is 0-3; p and q are 0 or 1; L is (substituted) methine; R1 and R2 are (substituted) alkyl; Z and Z' are nonmetallic atom group necessary for forming a 5-6-membered ring; X<-> is anion; r is 1 or 2; when the dye forms an intramolecular salt, r is 1]. title: Yellow-forming couplers containing hydantoin groups and their use in photographic materials
abstract: 1477410 Hydantoin derivatives of yellowforming colour couplers FUJI PHOTO FILM CO Ltd 3 April 1975 [3 April 1974] 13788/75 Heading C2C [Also in Division G2] Compounds of the formula wherein Q represents the residue of a yellowforming coupler having an active methylene group attached to the group -Z, and Z represents a group of the formula wherein X<SP>1</SP> represents a hydrogen atom, an optionally substituted alkyl group, an optionally substituted aryl group, a heterocyclic group or an acyl group, X<SP>2</SP> represents a hydrogen atom, an optionally substituted alkyl group, or an optionally substituted aryl group, X<SP>3</SP> represents a hydrogen atom, an optionally substituted alkyl group, an optionally substituted aryl group or an acyl group, or X<SP>2</SP> and X<SP>3</SP> together complete a 5- or 6-membered heterocyclic ring, and Y represents an oxygen or sulphur atom, may be prepared by reacting a compound of the formula Q-P, where P is a halogen atom, with an appropriate hydantoin in the presence of a base. The reaction is suitably effected in an organic solvent at 10-70 C. and the base employed may be either organic or inorganic. Preferred coupler compounds are of the openchain ketomethylene type, e.g. α-acylacetamide couplers, preferably having the formula or bis-derivatives thereof, preferably of the formulµ or wherein R<SP>1</SP> represents an optionally substituted aliphatic, aromatic or heterocyclic group, R<SP>2</SP> represents an optionally substituted aromatic or heterocyclic group, and R<SP>3</SP> and R<SP>4</SP> represent divalent groups corresponding to R<SP>1</SP> and R<SP>2</SP> respectively. The couplers may be employed in a range of photographic materials.

title: Methine compound
abstract: NEW MATERIAL:A methine compound shown by formula I, II or III (wherein Z1, Z2, Z1', and Z1'' are each a group of atoms necessary for forming a five- or six-membered nitrogen-containing heterocyclic ring; R1, R2, R1', and R1'' are each alkyl; L1 to L25 are each a methine group, etc.; M1, M2, and M3 are each a charge-neutralizing counter ion; Q1, Q2, Q1', Q2', Q1'', and Q2'' are each methylene, etc.; R3, R4, R3', R4' R3'', and R4'' are each H, a monovalent organic residue, etc.; D1, D1', D2, and D2' are each a group of atoms necessary for forming a noncyclic or cyclic acidic nucleus; n1 to n6 are each 0 to 1; m1, m2, and m3 are each a number of 0 or greater, necessary for neutralizing the charge in the molecule). USE:This compound has high sensitivity and good sensitizing efficiency, is free from fogging, and is useful as a spectro-sensitizing coloring matter free from variation in sensitivity due to the change in temperature when exposed to light; therefore, it is suitably used for manufacturing a photographic silver halide emulsion, etc. PREPARATION:A compound of formula IV is made to react with a compound of formula V to produce a compound of formula VI.

title: Nitrogen-containing heterocyclic quaternary salt and production thereof
abstract: NEW MATERIAL:A compound expressed by formula I [z is O, S, selenium, tellurium or formula II (R3 is H, alkyl, etc.), etc.; R1 is alkyl; R2 is alkyl or aryl; V1 and V2 are H, alkyl, halogen, acyl, alkoxycarbonyl, etc.; Q is atomic group required to form a condensed ring; X1 is anion; n is 0 or 1]. USE:Useful as a photographic additive and also as a synthetic intermediate or raw material for functional compounds, such as sensitizing coloring matter for photosensitive materials, dyes and laser coloring matters. PREPARATION:A compound expressed by formula III is reacted with a compound expressed by formula IV (X2 is leaving group), the formula R2-C(X3)3 (X3 is leaving group) or formula R2-C(X4)4=NX5 (X4 is leaving group; X5 is H or aryl), as necessary, in a solvent, such as benzene, at 80-1200 deg.C to afford the aimed compound expressed by formula I.

title: Production of 5-amino-1h pyrazole compound
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the subject compound useful as a synthetic intermediate for silver salt color photographic couplers in good yield by reacting a 3,3- dihaloacrylonitrile compound with a thiol compound and then reacting the resultant acrylonitrile compound with hydrazine. CONSTITUTION:A 3,3-dihaloacrylonitrile compound (e.g. 3,3-dichloroacrylonitrile) expressed by formula I (X is halogen; R<1> is monofunctional group) is reacted with a thio compound (e.g., thiophenol) to provide an acrylonitrile compound (e.g. 3,3-diphenylthioacrylonitrile) expressed by formula II or III (R<2> is alkyl, aryl or heterocyclic ring), which is then reacted with hydrazine to afford the aimed 5-amino-1H pyrazole compound (e.g. a compound expressed by formula V) expressed by formula IV. The resultant compound is useful as an intermediate for 6-thio-1H-pyrazolo[1,5-b]-1,2,4-triazole derivatives, etc., useful as silver salt color photographic couplers.

title: Benzoxazole derivative
abstract: NEW MATERIAL:The benzoxazole derivative of formula I (X is Cl or Br; R1 is a group bonded with C wherein the number of H substituent groups is 0 or 1; R2 is H or substituent group). EXAMPLE:2-Phenyl-5-chloro-6-nitrobenzoxazole. USE:Industrial raw material, reducing agent, or an intermediate capable of producing a 2-amino-5-nitrophenol derivative useful as an intermediate, etc. of cyan color-developing coupler for photographic use, in high yield from a raw material available in a mass at a low cost. PREPARATION:The objective compound of formula I can be produced by reacting the compound of formula II with the compound of formula R1COCl in the presence of a strong organic base, and carrying out the dehydrative cyclization of the resultant compound of formula III in the presence of an acid catalyst. The compound of formula IX (R3 is H or CoR1) is obtained in high yield, by the nucleophilic substitution reaction of the compound of formula I followed by the hydrolysis of the resultant compound of formula VIII (Z is group obtained by removing H from the nucleophilic reagent).

title: Production of 7-azolyl-1h-pyrazolo(1,5-b)-1,2,4-triazole compound
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain in high yield in good workability and safety the subject compound useful as e.g. a coupler for color photographs using silver salt by reaction of a halogeno-pyrazolo-triazole compound with an azole compound in the presence of a metal (bi)carbonate. CONSTITUTION:The objective compound of the formula (R1 and R2 are each H or substituent; A is nonmetal atom group necessary for forming an azole ring together with N) can be obtained by reacting (A) a 7-halogeno-1H- pyrazolo[1,5-b]-1,2,4-triazole compound with (B) an azole compound at a molar ratio of pref. (1:1) to (1:10) in the presence of a metal (bi)carbonate (pref. sodium carbonate) pref. in an aprotic polar solvent (pref. 1,3-dimethyl-2-imidazolidone).

abstract: NEW MATERIAL:A compound expressed by formula I [n is 0 or 1; m is 1 or 2; R1 is (substituted) alkyl; R2 is (substituted) aryl or heterocyclic ring; R3 and R4 are H, alkyl, alkoxy, OH, (substituted) amino or halogen; R3 and R4 may form a condensed six-membered ring; Z is atomic group required for formation of five- - six-membered ring; X<-> is anion; p is 1 or 2, and 1 when the dye forms an inner salt]. title: Production of 1h-pyrrolo-(1,2-b)(1,2,4)triazoles
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain triazoles useful as pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, dyes, photographic couplers or their synthetic intermediates and producible in a short step in high synthetic efficiency. CONSTITUTION:This triazole compound is expressed by formula I [R1 is H or a substituent; R2 and R3 are each an electron-attracting group having a Hammett substituent constant sigmap of >=0.2; X is a halogen or OR4 (R4 is an alkyl, an aryl, an acyl, sulfonyl or phosphonyl)], e.g. the compound of formula II. The triazole compound can be produced by reacting a triazole compound of formula III with an olefin of formula IV (Y is a halogen) in a solvent such as dimethylacetamide.

title: Production of 4-mercapto-1-naphthols
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the titled substance by a few processor in high yield, by reacting a 1-naphthol containing a substituent group at the 2-position with S2Cl2 to give a bis(3-substituted-4-hydroxyl-1-naphthyl)polysulfide and reducing this compound. CONSTITUTION:A compound shown by formula I (R is preferably carbamoyl or sulfamoyl; R; is halogen, carbonamide or sulfonamide; l is 0-2) is reacted with S2Cl2 in the molar ratio of 1:0.4-0.6 in a solvent such as benzene at -30-30 deg.C to give a compound shown by formula II (m is 1-4), which is reduced in the presence of Zn-acetate or NaBH4 in a solvent such as water, methanol, THF or benzene at 0-120 deg.C to give a compound shown by formula III. The above-mentioned process can be applied without limitation of kind of reaction substance and has wide general purpose. The titled substance is useful as an intermediate for drugs, agricultural chemicals, developers for leuco dye and coupler for forming cyanide dye for color photography.

title: Novel dye containing crosslinked methine chain

abstract: NEW MATERIAL:The compound of formula [n is 0 or 1; m is 1 or 2; R1 is (substituted) alkyl; R2-R4 are H, alkyl, alkoxy, OH, (substituted) amino or halogen; R2 and R3, R3 and R4 or R2 and R4 may together form a condensed 6-membered ring; Z1 and Z2 are atomic group necessary for forming a 5-6- membered ring; L1 and L2 are (substituted) methine].
