title: Production of 3-alkoxy-5-amino-1h-pyrazoles
abstract: PURPOSE:To easily obtain the titled compound useful as a sensitive material for silver halide color photography, in high yield, by using easily available 3,3-disubstituted-acrylonitriles and hydrazine as raw materials and reacting the compounds with each other. CONSTITUTION:The objective compound of formula III can be produced by reacting (A) 3,3-disubstituted-acrylonitriles of formula II easily producible by the reaction of 3,3-dithioacrylonitriles of formula I (R1 is alkyl; R2 is R1 or aryl; R1 and R2 may together form a heterocyclic group; X is H or substituent) with an alkoxy anion with (B) anhydrous hydrazine or its hydrate in the absence of solvent at 80-150 deg.C for 1-2hr. The objective compound is a synthetic raw material for 6-alkoxy-1H-pyrazolo[1,5-b]-1,2,4-triazole-type or 6-alkoxy-1H- pyrazolo[5,1-c]-1,2,4-triazole-type magenta coupler useful as a sensitive material for silver halide color photography.

title: Production of 3-amino-4-substituted-pyrazolone derivative
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the titled substance in high purity and yield, by subjecting a 4-halogeno-5-pyrazolone having benzoylamino group at the 3-position to substitution reaction to introduce a coupling eliminative group and hydrolyzing the benzoylamino group. CONSTITUTION:A compound expressed by the formula (X is Cl or Br; R<1> is alkyl, phenyl, etc.; R<2> is a substituent group; n is an integer 0-5) is subjected to substitution reaction in various solvents or by a solventless melting method at 50-150 deg.C to introduce a coupling eliminative group into the 4-position and the benzoylamino at the 3-position of the resultant product is then hydrolyzed in the presence of an acid catalyst, e.g. hydrochloric acid or sulfuric acid, in a mixed solvent of an alcohol and water at 50-150 deg.C to afford the titled sub stance. EFFECT:A wide range of substituent groups can be introduced into the 4-position and the substitution and deprotection steps can be carried out in one bath. USE:A raw material for photographic sensitive materials.

title: Production of 7-azolyl-1h-pyrazolo(1,5-b)-1,2,4-triazoles
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the subject compound useful as a coupler for silver salt color photography on an industrial scale at a low cost by reacting halogeno- pyrazolo-triazoles with excess metal salt of azoles. CONSTITUTION:The objective compound of formula II (A is metal atom group necessary to form an azole ring together with N) is produced by reacting 7- halogeno-1H-pyrazolo[1,5-b]-1,2,4-triazoles of formula I (R1 and R2 are substituents such as H, alkyl, aryl, heterocyclic group, alkoxy, amino, anilino or amide; X is halogen) with excess metal salt of azoles.

title: Novel methine dye
abstract: NEW MATERIAL:The compound of formula I [n is 0 or 1; m is 0-2; R1 is (substituted) alkyl; R2 is substituted aryl; Z is atomic group necessary for forming a 5-6-membered ring which may have substituent group or may be condensed with other ring; X<-> is anion' p is 1 or 2; when the dye forms an intramolecular salt, p is 1]. EXAMPLE:The compound of formula II. USE:Dye and sensitizing dye for filter, photographic material, etc. It has excellent fastness. PREPARATION:The heterocyclic quaternary salt derivative of formula III containing active methyl group is made to react with 2,6-dimethyl-4H-pyran-4- thione of formula IV and the resultant intermediate of formula V is condensed with the aldehyde of formula VI.

title: 4-halogeno-1-naphthol derivative
abstract: NEW MATERIAL:The compound of formula I (X is halogen; Y is bivalent linking group or a single bond such as carbonyl, sulfonyl, etc.; R1 is H, aliphatic group, aromatic group, etc.; R2 is H, hydroxyl, aliphatic group, etc.; R3 is halogen, hydroxyl, sulfo, etc.; n is 0-4). USE:A synthetic intermediate for 1-hydroxy-4-alkoxy-5-amino-2-naphthoic acid. The compound is useful as an antioxidant, a synthetic intermediate for cyan- pigment forming coupler of color photographic material. PREPARATION:The compound of formula I wherein R2 is OH can be produced by reacting 1-hydroxy-5-amino-2-naphthoic acid derivative of formula II with a compound of formula R1-Y-Cl in an aprotic solvent at 0-80 deg.C and reacting the resultant compound of formula III with a halogenation agent in a solvent such as methylene chloride.

title: 4-alkoxy-1-naphthol derivative
abstract: NEW MATERIAL:The compound of formula I (Y is bivalent linking group or a single bond such as carbonyl, sulfonyl, etc.; R1 is H, aliphatic group, aromatic group, etc.; R2 is H, hydroxyl, aliphatic group, etc.; R3 is halogen, hydroxyl, carboxyl, etc.; R4 is aliphatic group; n is 0-4). USE:A synthetic intermediate for 1,4-naphthoquinone derivative and 1,4- naphthohydroquinone derivative. It is also useful as a coupler for forming cyan- pigment having high color developing property for color photographic material. PREPARATION:The compound of formula I can be produced by reacting the compound of formula II (X is Cl or Br) with an alcohol in the presence of a base (e.g. sodium hydride) or a copper compound (e.g. CuCl) at 0-60 deg.C.

title: Novel methine dye
abstract: NEW MATERIAL:A compound shown by the formula I [n is 0, or 1; m is 0-2; R1 is (substituted)alkyl; R2 is (substituted)aryl or heterocyclic; Z is nonmetallic atom group required to form heterocyclic 5--6-membered ring; X<-> is anion; P is 1 or 2, and p is 1 when dye forms intramolecular salt]. EXAMPLE:A compound shown by the formula II. USE:Dye for filter, dye for sensitized material for photography, or a sensitized dyestuff. PREPARATION:For example, an active methyl group-containing heterocyclic quaternary ammonium salt derivative shown by the formula III is reacted with 2,6-dimethyl-4H-pyran-4-thione shown by the formula IV to give an intermediate shown by the formula V, which is condensed with an aldehyde shown by the formula VI.

title: Production of 3-alkoxy-5-amino-1h-pyrazole compound
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a compound in high purity and in high yield through a simple process by reaction of a cyanoacetic acid hydrazide compound or pyrazole compound with an alcohol compound in the presence of a strong acid. CONSTITUTION:The compound of formula III can be obtained by reaction between (A) a cyanoacetic acid hydrazide compound of formula I (X is H, halogen, alkyl, aryl, heterocycle, alkoxy, aryloxy, heterocycloxy, alkylthio, amino, cyano, nitro, etc.) or a 5-amino-3-hydroxy-IH-pyrazole compound of formula II and (B) an alcohol compound of formula R-OH (R is alkyl) (e.g. methanol) in the presence of a strong acid (e.g. ptoluenesulfonic acid) in a solvent (e.g. acetonitrile) at 50-200 deg.C. The compound of the present invention is useful as an intermediate for 1H-pyrazoliazolo[1,5-b]-1,2,4-triazole compounds as the magenta couplers for silver halide color photographs and as an intermediate for various kinds of medicines.

title: Production of 2-acylamino-5-alkyl-4,6-dihalogenophenol
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a compound useful as an intermediate for synthesizing a cyan coupler for a color photograph from easily obtainable raw materials in high yield easily, by reacting a 2-acylamino-5-alkylphenol with a halogenating agent. CONSTITUTION:A 2-acylamino-5-alkylphenol shown by the formula I (R1 is aliphatic group; R2 is aliphatic group, or aromatic group) is reacted with a halogenating agent (e.g., sulfuryl chloride) in a solvent such as dioxane, etc. at 0-100 deg.C preferably at <=40 deg.C for 0.5-4hr, to give the aimed substance shown by the formula II. The compound shown by the formula I is obtained by re arrangement reaction of an oxime compound shown by the formula III. The compound shown by the formula II is hydrolyzed by a conventional procedure, and a 2-amino-5-alkyl-4,6-dichlorophenol (or its salt) can be derived.

title: 6-aryloxy-1h-pyrazolo(1,5-b)-1,2,4-triazole compound
abstract: NEW MATERIAL:The compound of formula I (R<1> and R<2> are H, alkyl, etc.; L is alkylene or arylene; R<3> is imide or nitro; X is H, halogen, etc.; n1 and n2 are 0-5). EXAMPLE:The compound of formula II. USE:A synthetic intermediate for 1H-pyrazolo[1,5-b]-1,2,4-triazole-type magenta coupler having aryloxy substitutent at 6-site and useful as a silver halide color photographic material. It is advantageous in view of cost. PREPARATION:The objective compound is produced by (1) adding a phenol of formula R<4>OH (R<4> is alkyl or aryl) to a nitrile of formula R<3>-L-CN in the presence of an acid of formula HY (Y is acid radical), (2) reacting the obtained imide ester of formula III with an aminopyrazole of formula IV, (3) reacting the resultant amidine of formula V with hydroxylamine to obtain a compound of formula VI and (4) subjecting the product to dehydrative cyclization with a dehydration agent (preferably p-toluenesulfonic acid chloride).

title: Synthesis of 1h-pyrazolo(1.5-b)-1,2,4-triazole derivative
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the title compound which is useful as a coupler for silver salt color photography in low costs in high yield with reduced by-products by subjecting an N-pyrazolylamide oxime bearing a substituent in the 4-position to ring closure reaction. CONSTITUTION:An N-pyrazolylamide oxime of formula I (R1 is H, substituent; R2 is substitutent other than aryloxy and amino groups; R3 is H, alkyl, aryl, heteroring) such as an amide oxime of formula II is subjected to dehydrative ring closure reaction, preferably in the presence of a base using a suitable dehydrating agent to give 1H-pyrazolo[1,5-b]-1,2,4-triazole derivative of formula III such as a compound of formula IV. The compound of formula I is obtained by allowing a compound of formula I to react with an orthoester or imidate followed by reaction with hydroxylamine.

title: 3(5)-hydrazinopyrazole compound
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide the subject novel compound useful as a synthetic intermediate for 1H-pyrazolo[5.1-C][1,2,4]triazole compounds especially used as silver halide couplers for color photographs. CONSTITUTION:A compound of formula I (R1 is H, alkyl, aryl. hetero-molecular ring, OH, alkoxy. etc.; R2 is H, acyl; X is aryloxy, alkoxy, azolyl, etc.; M is hydrogen ion, metal ion; Y is acid residue; (n) is 0, positive integer). The compound of formula I is produced by reducing a compound of formula II with a reducing agent (e.g. stannous halide) at 0-30 deg.C. The employment of the compound of formula I permits to synthesize 1H-pyrazolo[5.1-C][1,2.4]triazole couplers each having an aryloxy, alkoxy. hetercyclic ring oxy or azolyl group as a releasable group as such, thus shortening the production process.

title: Pyridylpyrimidine compound and liquid crystal composition containing the same
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a new pyridylpyrimidine compound useful as a component of ferroelectric liquid crystal materials capable of realizing high-speed response. CONSTITUTION:A compound, e.g. 5-heptyl-2-(6-heptyloxy-3-pyridinyl) pyrimidine expressed by formula I (Ar is formula II or III; R<1> and R<2> are 6-10C alkyl and one or two or more unadjacent groups CH2 present in the above-mentioned groups may be substituted with O or S). The aforementioned compound is obtained by reacting an amidine hydrochloride group expressed by formula IV derived from a substituted cyanopyridine with a substituted malonic acid diester in the presence of a sodium alcoholate, providing a diol compound expressed by formula V, then substituting the resultant diol compound expressed by formula V with a halogen using phosphorous oxychloride, etc., affording a dichloro derivative expressed by formula VI and dehalogenating the dichloro derivative expressed by formula VI in the presence of a base.

title: Original plate for electrophotographic planographic printing
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the original plate for printing which has excellent electrophotographic characteristics and is free from scumming of non-image parts. CONSTITUTION:At least one kind of nonaq. solvent type dispersing resin particles of the copolymer resin particles obtd. by bringing a functional monomer [A] contg. at least one kind of the functional groups forming at least one hydroxyl groups by decomposition and a functional monomer [B] contg. a substituent contg. a silicon atom and/or fluorine atom and copolymerizing with the monomer [A] into dispersion polymn. reaction in the presence of a dispersion stabilizing resin soluble in the nonaq. solvent are incorporated into a photoconductive layer contg. photoconductive zinc oxide of the original plate for electrophotographic planographic printing.

title: Original plate for electrophotographic planographic printing
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain an original plate for planographic printing having excellent electrophotographic characteristics and free from the ground stain of the non- image area. CONSTITUTION:Particles of at least one kind of copolymer resin dispersed in a nonaq. solvent are incorporated into the photoconductive layer of an original plate for electrophotographic planographic printing contg. photoconductive zinc oxide. The resin particles are obtd. by bringing a functional monomer (A) contg. at least one functional group which forms at least one of hydrophilic thiol, phospho, amino and sulfo groups by decomposition and a functional monomer (B) contg. an Si- and/or F-contg. substituent and copolymerizing with the monomer A into a dispersion polymn. reaction in the nonaq. solvent in the presence of a resin for dispersion stability soluble in the nonaq. solvent.

title: Electrophotographic type lithographic printing original plate
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain an excellent printing picture and a plate having large plate wear by including a specified resin as a binding resin for a photoconductive layer and including a nonaqueous solvent base dispersed particle resin in a surface layer. CONSTITUTION:One of resins A as a binding resin for a photoconductive layer is included and one of nonaqueous solvent base dispersed particle resins L is included in a surface layer. The resins A have a weight average molecular weight of 1X10<3> to 2X10<4> and include a repeated unit represented by the formula as a polymer component by >=30wt% and a polymer component having at least one polar group selected from-PO3H2, -SO3H, -COOH, etc., by 0.5 to 15wt%. The nonaqueous solvent base dispersed particle resins L are a copolymer obtained by disperse polymerizing one of monofunctional monomers A which are soluble by nonaqueous solvent in nonaqueous solvent but made insoluble by polymerization and include a functional group forming a carboxyl group by decomposition in the presence of a disperse stabilizing resin soluble in nonaqueous solvent.

title: Original plate for electrophotographic planographic printing
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the original plate for planographic printing which is provided with a good-water retaining property by the adequate interaction of zinc oxide, resins [A] and dispersing resin particles, has excellent printed images and high printing resistance even under severe conditions and is effective for a scanning exposing system using a semiconductor laser beam. CONSTITUTION:This original plate for electrophotographic planographic printing contains respectively at least one kinds of the resins [A] which consist of the polymer component having the repeating unit of formula (I) and a polymer component contg. a polar group and has 1X10<3> to 2X10<4> average mol.wt. and the nonaq. solvent type dispesing resin particles obtd. by bringing a monomer (C) contg. a polar group and a monomer (D) having a substituent contg. a silicon atom and/or fluorine atom into polymn. reaction with a dispersion stabilizing resin soluble in the nonaq. solvent.

title: Original plate for electrophotographic planographic printing
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide the original plate for planographic printing which has excellent electrostatic characteristics (particular charge holdability and photosensitivity), does not generate staining and has an excellent desensitization characteristic. CONSTITUTION:This original plate has a photoconductive layer contg. photoconductive zinc oxide and binder resin on a conductive base and contains at least one kind of the nonaq. solvent type dispersing resin particles consisting of the copolymer resin particles obtd. by bringing a monofunctional monomer A contg. at least one kind of functional groups which form at least one carboxyl group by decomposition and a monofunctional monomer B which contains a substituent having at least two silicon atoms and/or fluorine atoms and copolymerizes with the monomer A into dispersion polymn. reaction in the presence of a dispersion stabilizing resin soluble in this nonaq. solvent in this photoconductive layer.

title: Original plate for electrophotographic type planographic printing
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide the above original plate which is improved in water retention by the adequate interaction of zinc oxide, resin A and the dispersed resin particles obtd. by a dispersion polymn. method, has excellent printed images and high printing resistance even under severe conditions and is also effective for a scanning exposure system using a semiconductor laser. CONSTITUTION:This original plate for electrophotographic planographic printing contains respectively at least one kind of the polymer components of the repeating unit expressed by formula I, the resins A which are formed by bonding polar groups to the terminals of the main chains of the polymers and have 1X10<3> to 2X10<4> average mol.wt. and the nonaq. solvent type dispersed resin particles which are obtd. by bringing the monomers having the functional groups forming carboxyl groups by decomposition into polymn. reaction in the presence of resins for stabilizing dispersion having a substituent for forming silicon atoms and/or fluorine atoms and haven <=0.8 average particle size.

title: Original plate for electrophotographic planographic printing
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve electrostatic characteristics, to reproduce the copied images faithful to the images of an original picture and to obviate the generation of surface staining of not only the entire surface but a dot as well, as an offset original plate by incorporating a binder resin and nonaq. solvent type dispersing resin particles which are respectively specific into this original plate. CONSTITUTION:This original plate contains a resin [A] as the binder resin and contains the nonaq. solvent type dispersing resin particles of the particle size which is the same as or smaller than the max. particle size of photoconductive zinc oxide particles in a photoconductive layer. The resin [A] has 1X10<3> to 2X10<4> weight average mol.wt., contains the repeating unit expressed by the formula at >=30wt.% as a polymer component and is formed by bonding polar groups, such as -PO3H21-SO4H to one terminal of the main chain. In the formula, a1, a2 denote hydrogen atom, a halogen atom, etc.; R3 denotes a hydrocarbon group. The nonaq. solvent type dispersing resin particles are obtd. by bringing a monofunctional monomer contg. functional groups forming carboxyl groups when insolubilized and decomposed by polymn. into a dispersion polymn. reaction in the presence of a resin for dispersion stability in a nonaq. solvent.

title: Original plate for electorophotographic planographic printing plate
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide the original plate for electrophotographic planographic printing having excellent printed images and high printing resistance even under severe conditions by incorporating respectively at least one kind of a specific resin and a specific nonaq. solvent type dispersion resin particles into this original plate. CONSTITUTION:Respectively at least one kind of the resin (A) consisting of a polymer component contg. a polar group and contg. the repeating unit expressed by formula 1 and having 1X10<3> to 2X10<4> average mol.wt. and the nonaq. solvent type dispersion resin particles obtd. by bringing a monomer (C) contg. a functional group which forms a carboxyl group by decomposition and a monomer (D) having a substituent contg. a silicon atom/or fluorine atom into a polymn. reaction with a dispersion stabilizing resin soluble in a nonaq. soln. are incorporated into the photoconductive layer of the original plate for electrophotographic planographic printing. In the formula 1, a1, a2 respectively denote a hydrogen atom, halogen atom, cyano group, etc.; R03 denotes a hydrocarbon group. Excellent electrostatic are obtd. in this way and copied images are faithfully reproduced. The bright and good images are thus formed in spite of environmental fluctuations.

title: Original plate for electrophotographic lithographic printing
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the original plate which has excellent electrostatic characteristics, reproduces the copied images faithful to an original picture, does not generate the scumming uniform over the entire surface and dotty scumming as an offset original plate and has an excellent desensitizing property by incorporating a specific resin and nonaq. solvent type dispersion resin particles into a photoconductive layer. CONSTITUTION:This original plate contains the resin of 1X10<3> to 2X10<4>weight average mol.wt. which contains >=30wt.% specific repeating unit expressed by formula I and is constituted by bonding a polar group, such as -PO3H2, to one terminal of the main chain of the polymer. The plate contains the nonaq. solvent type dispersion resin particles obtd. by bringing a monomer contg. a functional group forming at least one group among a thiol group, sulfo group, amino group, etc., into polymn. reaction in the presence of a resin for stabilizing dispersion having a subtd. group contg. a silicon atom and/or fluorine atom. In the formula I, a1, a2 denote a hydrogen atom, halogen atom, cyano group or hydrocarbon group; R03 denotes a hydrocarbon group. A water-retaining property is improved in this way and excellent printed images and high printing resistance are obtd. even under severe conditions.

title: Electrophotographic planographic printing plate material
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve water-holding capacity and to obtain superior prints and printing resistance by incorporating a specified binder resin and specified nonaqueous medium dispersible resin particles. CONSTITUTION:A photoconductive layer contains photoconductive zinc oxide and a spectrally sensitizing dye stuff and further, the binder resin A and the nonaqueous medium dispersible resin particles having an average particle diameter same as or smaller than the maximum particle diameter of the zinc oxide particles. The resin A has a weight average molecular weight of 1X10<3>-2X10<4> and repeating units each represented by formula I in an amount of >=30wt.% and polar groups, such as -PO3H2 or -SO3H, on one terminal of each main polymer chains. The nonaqueous medium dispersible resin is obtained by suspension polymerizing a mono-functional monomer having a functional group represented by formula II or III in the presence of a dispersion-stabilizing resin having substituents each containing Si or F atoms. In formulae I-III each of a1 and a2 is an H, halogen, or the like atom; R01 is a hydrocarbon group; and each of -W1- and -W2- is -SO2-, -CO-, or the like; and X is a halogen atom.

title: Original plate for electrophotographic planographic printing
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the electrostatic characteristics of an original plate for printing, to prevent ground stain and to obtain high printing resistance by incorporating photoconductive zinc oxide, hydrophilic resin particles having a prescribed particle size and two kinds of specified binding resins into a photoconductive layer. CONSTITUTION:Photoconductive zinc oxide, hydrophilic resin particles having an average particle size equal to or smaller than the max. particle size of the zinc oxide and binding resins (A), (B) are incorporated into a photoconductive layer. The resin A is a polymer having 1X10<3>-2X10<4> wt. average mol. wt., contg. >=30wt.% units represented by formula I and having a prescribed polar group at one terminal of the principal chain. The resin B is a copolymer having >=3X10<4> wt. average mol. wt. and consisting of a macromonomer having a specified group at only one terminal of the principal chain of a polymer contg. one or more of units represented by formulae II, III and a monomer represented by formula IV. In the formulae I-IV, each of a1-a8 is H, halogen, etc., R1 is hydrocarbon, each of X0-X1 is -COO-, -OCO-, etc., each of Q0 and Q2 is 1-8C aliphatic group and Q1 is -CN, -CONH2, etc.

title: Original plate for electrophotographic planographic printing
abstract: PURPOSE:To hinder interaction with the surface of zinc oxide and to obtain an original plate for planographic printing having satisfactory printing characteristics without deteriorating electrophotographic characteristics by dispersing hydrophilic resin particles having an average particle size equal to or smaller than the max. particle size of photoconductive zinc oxide particles in a photoconductive layer. CONSTITUTION:The binding resin of hydrophilic resin particles dispersed in a photoconductive layer contains at least one of resins (A), (B). The resin A has 1X10<3>-2X10<4> wt. average mol. wt. and contains a polymer component of repeating units represented by general formula I and 0.5-20wt.% polymer component having a polar group such as -PO3H2, -SO3H, -COOH, -OH or -SH. The resin B is a graft copolymer having 3X10<4>-1X10<6>wt. average mol. wt. and consisting of a monofunctional macromonomer having <=2X10<4> wt. average mol. wt. obtd. by bonding a group having a polymerizable double bond represented by general formula IIc to only one terminal of the principal chain of a polymer consisting of repeating units represented by general formula IIa or IIb and a monomer represented by general formula III.

title: Electrophotographic type lithographic original plate
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide an excellent printed image with satisfactory water retentivity and high printing resistance by containing a specified resin as a binding resin in a photoconductive layer, and further containing a specified nonaqueous solvent dispersed resin particle having a particle size equal to or smaller than the maximum particle size of a photoconductive zinc oxide particle. CONSTITUTION:As a binding resin, a resin containing 30wt.% or more of a repeating unit having a weight average molecular weight of 1X10<3>-2X10<4> and represented by the formula I as a polymer component and 0.5-15wt.% of a polymer component having a polar group such as -PO3H2, -SO3H, a group containing a cyclic acid anhydride, or the like is used. In the formula I, a1 and a2 each represent a hydrogen atom, a halogen atom, or the like, R03 represents a hydrocarbon group. A nonaqueous solvent dispersed resin particle obtained by polymerizing an monofunctional monomer containing a functional group soluble to an nonaqueous solvent but made insoluble by polymerization and generating a hydroxyl group by decomposition in the presence of a dispersion stabilizing resin having a substituent containing a silicone atom or/and a fluorine atom is contained.

title: Electrophotographic type lithographic original plate
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide an excellent image with satisfactory water retentivity and a high printing resistance by containing a specified resin as a binding resin in a photoconductive layer, and further containing a specified nonaqueous solvent dispersed resin particle having a particle size equal to or smaller than the maximum particle size of a photoconductive zinc oxide particle. CONSTITUTION:As a binding resin, a resin which contains 30wt.% or more of a repeating unit having a weight average molecular weight of 1X10<3>-2X10<4> and represented by the formula I as a polymer component and has a polar group such as -PO3H2, -SO3H, a group containing a cyclic acid anhydride, or the like connected to one terminal of its main chain is used. In the formula I, a1 and a2 each represent a hydrogen atom, a halogen atom, or the like, and R03 represents a hydrocarbon group. A nonaqueous solvent dispersed resin particle of a copolymer obtained by dispersing and polymerizing a monomer containing a functional group soluble to nonaqueous solvents but made insoluble by polymerization and generating a carboxyl group by decomposition and a monomer having a substituent containing a silicon atom and/or a fluorine atom in the presence of a dispersion stabilizing resin soluble to nonaqueous solvents is contained.

title: Printing original plate for electrophotographic planography
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain superior printing characteristics and to prevent background staining on nonimage areas by incorporating in a photoconductive layer photoconductive zinc oxide particles and hydrophilic resin particles having an average particle diameter same as or smaller than the maximum particle diameter of the zinc oxide particles. CONSTITUTION:The photoconductive layer contains the photoconductive zinc oxide particles and the hydrophilic resin particles having an average particle diameter same as or smaller than the maximum particle diameter of the zinc oxide particles, and a binder resin contains at least one of a resin having a weight average molecular weight of 1X10<3> - 2X1l0<4> and repeating units each represented by formula I in an amount of >= 30 wt.% of the total polymer, and at least one of polar group at one terminal of the main polymer chain, such as -PO3H2, -SO3H, -COOH, and -OH, and a hardenable resin having a thermo- and/or photo-crosslinkable functional group. In formula I, each of a, and a2 is H, halogen, or the like; and R1 is a hydrocarbon group, thus permitting the obtained planographic original plate to exhibit superior printing characteristics without impairing electrophotographic characteristics.

title: Electrophotographic planographic printing plate material
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the printing plate material enhanced in electrostatic characteristics and desensitization and capable of reproducing a copied image in high fidelity to an original image and to prevent occurrence of surface staining as an offset image by incorporating a specified resin and a specified nonaqueous solvent dispersible resin. CONSTITUTION:The resin to be added is a resin low in molecular weight obtained by combining a polar group to one terminal of each main polymer chain comprising repeating units of formula I, and the nonaqueous solvent dispersible resin to be added is obtained by polymerizing a monomer having functional group to be allowed to produce a thiole, sulfo,or amino group and a monomer having a functional group containing an Si and/or F atom in the presence of a dispersion stabilizing resin soluble in nonaqueous solvents. In formula I, each of a1 and a2 is H, halogen, cyano, or a hydrocarbon group; R03 is a hydrocarbon group; Z0 is 0 or S; R'1 is -Z0-H, a hydrocarbon group, or-Z0-R'; and R'2 is a hydrocarbon group.

title: Electrophotographic planographic printing plate material
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the printing plate material enhanced in electrostatic characteristics and desensitization and capable of reproducing a copied image in high fidelity to an origial image and to prevent occurrence of not only uniform but also spots of surface staining as an offset image by incorporating a specified resin and a specified nonaqueous solvent dispersible resin. CONSTITUTION:The resin to be added is a resin low in molecular weight and comprising repeating units of formula I and repeating units each having a polar group and the nonaquaous solvent dispersible resin to be added is obtained by polymerizing a monomer having a functional group to be allowed to produce a thiole, sulfo, or amino group and a monomer having a functional group containing an Si and/or F atom in the presence of a dispersion stabilizing resin soluble in nonaqueous solvents. In formula I, each of a1 and a2 is H, halogen, cyano, or a hydrocarbon group; R03 is a hydrocarbon group; Z0 is 0 or S; R'1 is -Z0-H, a hydrocarbon group, or -Z0-R'; and R'2 is a hydrocarbon group.

title: Original plate for planographic printing
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the electrophotographic sensitive body which has an improved electrostatic charge characteristic and preexposing fatigue resistance by incorporating hydrophilic resin particles having a prescribed particle size into this original plate and incorporating one kind of prescribed resins and one kind of prescribed resins into a binder resin. CONSTITUTION:This original plate contains the hydrophilic resin particles having the average particle size equal to or smaller than the max. particle size of photoconductive zinc oxide particles in a photoconductive layer and the binder resin contains at least one kind of the resin [A] and at least one kind of the resins [B]. The resins [A]: The resins which have 1X10<3> to 1X10<4> weight average mol. wt., contain >= 30wt.% polymn. component expressed by formula I and 0.5 to 10wt.% polymn. component contg. at least one kind of the acidic group selected from a -PO3H2 group, -SO3H group, -COOH group, the group of formula III {R is a hydrocarbon group or -OR' group (R' denotes a hydrocarbon group)} and cyclic acid anhydride group, and are formed by bonding at least one kind of the acidic groups selected from the acidic groups similar the above-mentioned groups with one terminal of the polymer main chain. The resins [B]: The resins which have 3X10<4> to 1X10<6> weight average mol. wt. and contain >= 30wt.% polymn. component expressed by formula III, where b1, b2, R2 denote respectively the same contents as the contents of a1, a2, R1 of the formula I.

title: Original plate for planographic printing
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the original plate which has a good water retaining property, has excellent printed images and high printing resistance even under severe conditions and is effective for a scanning exposing system using a semiconductor laser beam by incorporating a specific resin as a binder resin of a photoconductive layer into this plate. CONSTITUTION:This original plate contains the nonaq. solvent type dispersion resin particles obtd. by bringing a monomer contg. a functional group forming a hydroxyl group by decomposition into polymn. reaction in the presence of a resin for stabilizing dispersion having a substituent contg. a silicon atom and/or fluorine atom in the surface layer. Further, the original plate contains a polymer of the repeating unit expressed by formula I and a resin (A) of the low mol. wt. formed by bonding a polar group to the side chain of the main chain of the polymer in the photoconductive layer. The resin (A) has 1X10<3> to 2X10<4> weight average mol.wt. and contains >=30wt.% repeating unit of formula I as a polymn. component and 0.5 to 15wt.% one kind of polar group as a polymer component. In the formula, a1, a2 denote a hydrogen atom, halogen atom, cyano group or hydrocarbon group; R03 denotes a hydrocarbon group.

title: Production of original plate for planographic printing
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the original plate for planographic printing having excellent printed images and high printing resistance even under severe conditions by incorporating resin particles consisting of a resin having a formyl group and/or specific functional group into a photoconductive layer. CONSTITUTION:The electrophotographic sensitive body formed by incorporating the resin particles contg. the polymer component having the average particle size equal to or smaller than the max. particle size of photoconductive zinc oxide particles and having the formyl group and/or the functional group expressed by formula I into the photoconductive layer is formed with toner images by image exposing and thereafter, the photoconductive layer of non-image parts is subjected to a desensitization treatment with a treating liquid contg. a substituent-contg. hydrophilic compd. having at least >=5.5 Parson's nucleophilic constant n. In the formula, R1, R2 denote a hydrocarbon group or residual org. group forming a ring by connecting to each other. The original plate for planographic printing which is stable in spite of storage under the extremely severe conditions, can easily exhibit hydrophilicity in a short period of time at the time of a treatment for hydrophilicity impartation and can maintain a polyvalent electrostatic characteristic even with a scanning exposing system is obtd.

title: Electrophotographic planographic printing original plate
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain an original plate with the improved water holding property excellent in printed picture and plate wearing resistance even in severe conditions by incorporating a resin (A) as a binder resin and a nonaqueous solvent-based dispersed resin grains into a photoconductive layer. CONSTITUTION:The resin (A) has 1X10<3>-2X10<4> weight average mol.wt., incorporates >=30wt.% of a polymer component of the repeating ingredient shown by formula I, and combines with a polar group selected among -PO3H, -SO3H, etc., at one terminal of the polymer principal chain. In formula I, a1 and a2 are hydrogen atom, halogen atom, etc., and R03 is a hydrocarbonic group. The nonaqueous solvent-based dispersed resin grain is the copolymer resin grain obtained by dispersing and polymerizing a monofunctional monomer (C) contg. functional groups shown by formulas II and III and which polymerized and insolubilized in the nonaqueous solvent and a monofunctional monomer (D) contg. a substituent contg. silicon atom, etc., and copolymerizable with the monomer (C) in the nonaqueous solvent in the presence of a dispersion stabilizing resin soluble in the nonaqueous solvent.

title: Printing original plate for electrophotomechanical process
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve electrophotographic characteristics even with a scanning exposing system and to further enhance etching processability and printing resistance by using a specific graft copolymer as a binder resin of a photoconductive layer. CONSTITUTION:This printing original plate is constituted by using the graft copolymer of 1X10<3> to 1X10<5> weight average mol.wt. consisting, as its copolymn. components, of a macromonomer of 1X10<3> to 1.5X10<4> weight average mol.wt. contg. >=1 kinds among formulas I, II, III and monofunctional monomer contg. one or more among a monomer of the expression IV, PO3H2 group, SO3H group, phenolic OH group, and cyclic acid anhydride-contg. group, etc. as the binder resin of the photoconductive layer. In the formulas a1, a2, C1, C2 denote hydrogen, halogen, etc.; X1 to X3, A1 denote a single bond, -COO-, etc.; Y1 to Y3 denote a combination group; Z1, Z2 denote an aliphat. group or arom. group; R1 denotes hydrogen or hydrocarbon group; V1 denotes CH2, O, etc.; R2, R3 denote hydrogen, hydrocarbon group, etc.; B1 denotes 1 to 18C aliphat. group, etc.

title: Electrophotographic planographic printing plate
abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate dot like greasing and improve desensitizing property by containing specific binding resin, and containing nonaqueous solvent dispersed resin grain in a photoconductive layer. CONSTITUTION:An electrophotographic planographic printing plate contains binding resin A, and nonaqueous solvent dispersed resin grain B in a photoconductive layer. The binding resin A is a copolymer with polymer components respectively containing a functional group forming a-COOH group and a functional group forming a SO3 group or the like by chemical reaction processing and a polymer component containing a thermo-and/or photo-setting group as a contituent unbit. The nonaqueous solvent dispersed resin grain B contins a polar group such as a carboxyl group and is obtained by dispersing and polymerizing a functional monomer insoluble in a nonaqueous solvent, a-functional monomer containing a silicon atom and/or a fluorine atom, and a functional polymer formed by binding a polymeric double-bond group, expressed by a formula only to one end of a principal chain, under the existencce of dispersion stabilizing resin. In the formula, V<0> is-O-,-COO-, or the like, and a<1>, a<2> are a hydrogen atom, a halogen atom, a hydrocarbon group, or the like.

title: Production of planographic printing original plate
abstract: PURPOSE:To reproduce a copied image which has excellent electrostatic characteristics and is faithful by incorporating a binder resin and nonaq. dispersion resin particles which are respectively specific into the original plate and subjecting the plate to image exposing, then subjecting the non-image part to desensitization processing with a specific processing liquid. CONSTITUTION:This original plate contains the binder resin which has 1X10<3> to 2X10<4> weight average mol.wt., contains >=30wt.% polymer component of the repeating unit expressed by formula I and bonds a polar group, such as -PO3H to the terminal of the main chain in the photoconductive layer. In the formula I, a1, a2 denote a hydrogen atom, halogen atom, etc.; R03 denotes a hydrocarbon group. The photoconductive layer also contains the nonaq. dispersion resin particles formed by bringing a monofunctional monomer which has the average particle size equal to or smaller than the max. particle size of photoconductive zinc oxide particles or and has a functional group, such as formyl group and a monofunctional monomer which contains a substituent contg. a silicon atom and/or fluorine atom into dispersion polymn. reaction. The photoconductive layer of the non-image part after image exposing is subjected to the desensitization processing with the processing liquid contg. a hydrophilic compd. having >=5.5 Parsons nucleophilic constant (n).

title: Electrophotographic original plate for planographic printing
abstract: PURPOSE:To shorten the time for treatment for hydrophilicity impartation of the original plate for printing and to stabilize the original plate even if stored under severe conditions by incorporating a resin contg. a specific polymer component into a photoconductive layer. CONSTITUTION:The original plate for planographic printing is constituted by forming the photoconductive layer contg. photoconductive zinc oxide and binder resin (A) on a conductive base and incorporating a resin (B) contg. the polymer component expressed by formula I and/or formula II as an essential component into the resin A. The resin base B is preferably crosslinked and a functional group which induced a curing reaction by heat and/or light is also preferably incorporated into the resin B. In the formulas, W1, W2 denote SO2, CO, etc.; X denotes halogen; n1, n2 denote 0 or 1. The compd. of formula III, etc., are usable for the resin B.

title: Electrophotographic original plate for planographic printing
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve sensibility of printing original plate, to increase a response speed and to eliminate the fogging in the writing end part in scanning and exposing of a laser, etc., by incorporating a specific copolymer into a photoconductive layer. CONSTITUTION:The above original plate having the photoconductive layer contg. a org. photoconductive compd. (A) and a binder resin (B) is subjected to image exposing, preferably to scanning and exposing with a laser beam or light emitting diode and is thereby formed with toner images; thereafter, the photoconductive layer exclusive of the toner image parts is removed to obtain the printing plate. The copolymer (e.g.: the compd. of formula III) contg. the monomer component of formula I and/or II and an acid functional group is used for the resin B. In the formulas, X1, X2 denote H, Cl, etc., but there is no case in which both denote H; n denotes 0 or 1; m denotes 0 to 2. A hydrazone compd., etc., are usable for the compd. A.

title: Original plate for electrophotographic type planographic printing
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain excellent electrostatic characteristics, printability and printing durability by incorporating resins having a formyl group or specific functional group and thermo- and photosetting resins into at least a part of the binder resin of the original plate for planographic printing having photoconductive layers. CONSTITUTION:The original plate for planographic printing for which an electrophotographic sensitive body is utilized is formed by providing at least one layer of the photoconductive layers contg. photoconductie zince oxide and the binder resin on a base. The binder resin of this original plate for planographic printing contains at least one kind of the resins A and at least one kind of the resins B and contains a crosslinking agent at need. The resins A are the resins contg. the formyl group and/or at least one kind of the polymer components expressed by general formula I and the resins B are the thermo- and/or photosetting resins. The original plate for printing can develop hydrophilicity in a short period of time at the time of processing for hydrophilicity impartation. The effect by the hydrophilicity of the non-image parts is improved and since the original plate is stable in spite of storage under severe conditions, the original plate has the excellent electrostatic characteristics, printability and printing durability.

title: Printing original plate for electrophotographic plate making
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the printing original plate for electrophotographic plate making having a good sensitivity and high response speed by incorporating at least one kind of polymer components having a specific functional group into the binder resin of a photoconductive layer. CONSTITUTION:This printing original plate has the photoconductive layer contg. at least a photoconductive compd. and the binder resin on a conductive base. This photoconductive layer is formed with toner images by image exposing and, thereafter, the photoconductive layer in the non-image parts exclusive of the toner image parts is removed. The functional group having the polymer component contained in this binder resin is expressed by formula I or II. In the formulas I, II, -W1-, -W2- respectively denote -SO2-, -CO- or -OOC-; n1, n2 respectively denote 0 or 1; X denotes a halogen atom. The copied images faithful with an original picture are reproduced in this way and the smoothness and electrostatic characteristics of the photoconductive layer are improved.

title: Electrophotographic planographic printing plate
abstract: PURPOSE:To enhance electrostatic characteristics and dead aliphatic property of a printing plate, and to eliminate a ground fouling by containing specific nonaqueous solvent system dispersed resin grains in a photoconductive layer. CONSTITUTION:In the photoconductive layer of the printing plate, photoconductive zinc oxide and nonaqueous solvent system dispersed resin grains whose grain size is the same as maximum grain size of the zinc oxide, or smaller that, are contained, and the resin grains are prepared by dispersing and polymerizing monomer (A) and polymer (M) in the nonaqueous solvent. Further, for the component A, a monomer which contains functional groups in the formulas I and/or II, and becomes insoluble in the above solvent by polymerization, in used, and for the component M, a polymer which has substituent groups containing Si and/or F, and binding groups in the formula III only at the terminals of the polymer containing repetitive units, is used. In this case, in the formulas, W1, W2 represent -SO2-, -CO-, etc., X represent halogen, n1, n2 represent 0.1, V0 represent -O-, -COO-, etc. a1, a2 represent H, halogen, etc.

title: Original plate for electrophotographic planography
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain an original plate for electrophotographic planography having excellent electrostatic property, ability to reproduce a copied picture accurate to the original, and excellent desensitizing property for flatty matter as an original plate for offset print which prevents not only homogeneous contamination on the whole surface but spot contamination, by incorporating specified non-water solvent-base dispersion resin particles into the surface layer of the original plate. CONSTITUTION:The nonwater-base dispersion resin particles added to the matrix resin of the surface layer contain at least one kind of functional groups expressed by formula I and/or II. This resin consists of the chemical coupling of a polymer component which becomes insoluble in nonwater solvent after polymn., and another polymer component which has a recurring unit containing fluorine atom and/or silicon atom at least as substd. groups and becomes soluble in a nonwater solvent after polyumn. In the formulae I, II, -W- and -W2- are -SO2-, -CO- or -OOC-, n1 and n2 are 0 or 1, and X is a halogen atom. Thereby, the obtd. original plate for printing is excellent in electrostatic property and printing durability with clear and good picture images.

1,184,216. Photographic filter control devices. FUJI SHASHIN FILM K. K. Sept. 8, 1967 [Sept. 30, 1966], No.41166/67. Heading G2A. In a photographic camera, there is provided a control device to set filters of the camera lens system so as to take into account the spectral condition of the prevailing illumination and the spectral sensitivity of the film used. When a film cartridge, e.g. containing film suitable for use in tungsten lighting, is inserted switches (E, F) and (G, K) Fig.2, (not shown) of a selection switch 9 are closed. If the prevailing illumination is tungsten lighting, filters 1, 2 change the light intensity falling on to photoelectric elements 3, 4 causing an unbalance of the bridge circuit to which they belong, and thus causing switch 5<SP>1</SP> to take up the dotted line position. However, no current flows through the switch 9, so colour correction filters 13, 14 remains with grey filters N in front of the taking lens 11 and the photo-electric element 12 for exposure control. If the prevailing illunination is daylight, the light intensity falling on the photo-cells 3, 4 causes the switch 5<SP>1</SP> to take up the solid line position current then flows through the switch 9 causing a driving device 10 to shift the filters 13, 14 so that amber filters are in front of the lens 11 and element 12. For daylight film, switches (H, I) and (K, J) are closed. The photo-electric elements 3, 4 respond to daylight and tungsten lighting as before, but in this case no current flows through the selector switch 9 for daylight, and filters N are in front of the lens and element 12. Tungsten lighting causes the device 10 to shift the filters 13, 14 so that blue filters B are in front of the lens 11 and the element 12. The filters 13, 14 are biased so that when no current flows through the device 10, the central filter remains in the operative position.

In the course of drying after coating, it has an under-coating layer which is hard to bring about failure caused by an outbreak of cracks, etc. There is neither fluctuation of electrification potential in the course of reiterating use, nor rise of residual electric potential. The under-coating layer built up on the conductive substrate is formed by zirconium chelate compound or zirconium alkoxide compound and silane coupling agent as raw material; it is characterized by having more than 25 mole % of organic residual radical among the under-coating layer against the raw material. The under-coating layer is made up of coating liquid obtained from (1) the zirconium chelate compound or the zirconium alkoxide compound and (2) the silane coupling agent, each or mixture of both having more than 50% hydrolysis in the organic solvent solution.

title: Original cassette
abstract: PURPOSE:To make it possible to set an original fixed on a film mount in an original cassette and to improve work for reading an image by demarcating a recessed part where the film mount is housed on a plate material for mounting and directly forming an aperture part for reading an original image. CONSTITUTION:The original cassette 100 is provided with a frame 106 formed in a nearly rectangular shape and the plate material 112 for mounting which is mounted to the rectangular aperture part 110 demarcated in the center part of the frame 106. A pair of nearly rectangular recessed parts 120 is provided on the plate material 112 for mounting and the film mount 130 is housed in the recessed part 120. In such a case, the rectangular aperture parts 120a is formed to penetrate at a position opposed to the original S for reading when the film mount is housed in the recessed part 120. The original S can be irradiated with reading light through the aperture part 120a. Since the original S is positioned and fixed in the original cassette 100 just by setting the film mount 130 in the recessed part, workablity is improved in the case of reading the image.

title: Injection mould
abstract: The invention relates to an improved injection mould for hollow articles which have a base and an orifice, for example for glasses. The injection mould is, in this arrangement, formed by a fixed mould part and a movable core which also has a cooling channel. According to the invention, the cooling channel (11) is formed in the longitudinal direction of the core (1b) by a longitudinally divided basic bore (13), at least one rib (20, 20', 30, 31) being provided in the base region of the basic bore, essentially opposite the nozzle orifice (6) of the injection mould, parallel to the flow direction of the coolant in the core (1b), so that the basic bore (11) forming the cooling channel (13) extends to the vicinity of the front end face of the bore (1b) and the heat exchange between the core (1b) and coolant, and the mechanical strength of the end section (21) of the core (1b) can be improved. The invention can be used for injection moulds. <IMAGE>

title: Silver halide photographic sensitive material
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve dimensional stability at the time of processing by forming an undercoat layer of a specified thickness contg. a vinylidene chloride copolymer contg. a vinylidene chloride monomer and a vinyl monomer contg. a carboxyl group on a polyester base and incorporating N-methylpyrrolidone into the undercoat layer. CONSTITUTION:An undercoat layer of >=0.3mum thickness contg. a vinylidene chloride copolymer contg. 70-99.9 wt.% vinylidene chloride monomer and 0.1-5 wt.% vinyl monomer contg. a carboxyl group is formed on at least one side of a polyester base and N-methylpyrrolidone is incorporated into the undercoat layer. The vinylidene chloride copolymer preferably contains 85-99 wt.% vinylidene chloride monomer and 0.2-3 wt.% vinyl monomer contg. a carboxyl group. Dimensional stability can be improved at the time of processing.

title: Video printing method and video printer
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent stepwise disturbance in a picture in a tilted direction when a field picture is converted into a frame picture and the converted picture is printed out and to obtain a print of natural reproduction even when picture data of two picture elements in the tilt direction are both 0. CONSTITUTION:The result of adding picture data of upper and lower picture elements with respect to a line to be interpolated is D',x',E' and when the relation of them is D'<x'<E' or D'>x'>E', difference values S1,S2,S3 of picture data of two picture elements in an upper left to lower right direction, in the up-down direction and in an upper right to lower left direction around an interpolation picture element are compared. In the case of S1<S2<S3, xD =(AD+Hb)/2 is obtained and in the case of S1>S2>S3, xD=(CD+FD)/2 is obtained. In other cases and when the relation of D'<x'<E' or D'>x'>E' is not in existence, xD(BD+GD)/2 is obtained.

title: Procede de blanchissement d'un colorant d'argent
abstract: Procédé de blanchissement d'un colorant d'argent par l'utilisation d'un révélateur de noir contenant au moins un dérivé de thiazol représenté par la formule générale (I):$(7,)$(où R représente un groupe alkyl substitué ou non substitué, un groupe aralkyl substitué ou non substitué, un groupe aryl substitué ou non substitué, et R' et R'' représente chacun un atome d'hydrogène ou un groupe alkyl substitué ou non substitué, ou R' et R'', pris ensemble, forment un cycle benzénique facultativement substitué par un groupe alkyl) ou au moins un dérivé d'imidazol représenté par la formule générale (II):$(9,)$(où R1, R2, R3 et R4 représentent chacun un atome d'hydrogène, un groupe alkyl substitué ou non substitué ou un groupe alkényl). La graduation d'une image finie peut être amortie aisément et sûrement en utilisant des matériaux photosensibles ordinaires et en exécutant des traitements ordinaires. En outre, le révélateur de noir possède une stabilité accrue de stockage.

title: Procede de developpement de materiau photographique couleur a halogenure d'argent
abstract: Un procédé de développement de matériau photographique couleur à halogénure d'argent consiste à effectuer le développement couleur, à désargenter et à effectuer le rinçage à l'eau et/ou la stabilisation. Selon ce procédé, un matériau photosensible qui contient au moins une couche photographique à haute teneur en chlorure d'argent et au moins une couche photographique contenant une émulsion à dispersion simple, peut être rapidement développé à l'aide d'une soltuion de développement couleur contenant un composé à masse moléculaire élevée et soluble dans l'eau. Il est préférable que le poids de revêtement d'argent dans le matériau photographique décrit ci-dessus soit de 0,75 g/m2 au maximum, et que la solution de développement couleur contienne au moins 0,035 mol/l d'ions chlorure. Le développement rapide et continu permet de réduire de façon remarquable les variations des caractéristiques photographiques, en particulier la sensibilité et la gradation, de prévenir les inégalités de développement et d'empêcher la formation de dépôts sur la paroi du bac de développement.

abstract: 本发明提供一种可以快速判定折射的影响是否存在的超声波图像产生方法和超声波图像诊断装置，它们可以缩短用于测量或计算所花费的时间，可以用小的误差来执行测量或计算，且可以获得准确的局部音速值。在关注区域中设置格子，测量位于在超声波的扫描方向上的不同位置处的两个或更多格点的环境音速值作为初步音速测量，以及当所测量的环境音速值的最大值和最小值之间的差小于等于所述预定阈值时，执行计算格点上的局部音速值的主音速测量。

abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a candidate of an exact correction to a character recognition result of an attribute item contained in an input document.SOLUTION: A character recognition part 14 performs character recognition of an attribute value of an individual attribute item within an input document from an image of the document and analyzes a category code contained in the document to determine a category of the document. title: Information recording medium
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a medium which shows excellent recording/reproducing performance, durability and special deterioration quality in the reproduction and can be produced at high productivity by forming a base layer in a manner that the number ratio of fluorine atoms to carbon atoms is smaller the interface layer on the side contacting the recording layer. CONSTITUTION:The information recording medium 1 consists of a substrate 2, base layer 3 on the substrate, and further a recording layer 4 on the base layer 3. The base layer 3 consists of fluororesin and formed in a manner that the number ratio (FA/CA) of fluorine atoms (FA) to carbon atoms (CA) in the interfacial part 3A of the base layer which is in contact with the recording layer 4 is smaller than the ratio (FB/CB) of fluorine atoms (FB) to carbon atoms (CB) in other parts 3B of the base layer. By this method, adhesion property to the recording layer 4 and heat resistance of the base layer can be improved. Thus, the obtd. medium shows excellent durability, recording/reproducing performance, and special deterioration quality in the reproduction and can be produced at high productivity.

title: Photograph developing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To contrive the decreasing of the quantity of a processing liquid to be used and air oxidation, by providing an inserting member for forming a developing bath for allowing a photosensitive material to pass through, and a wrapping guide means of the photosensitive material provided on a bending part of the developing bath between a recessed part and a projecting part of the body. CONSTITUTION:The titled device is provided with a body 14 in which a recessed part 14E is formed, and a projecting part 24D for going into the recessed part 14E of this body 14, and between this recessed part 14E and the projecting part 24D, a rack 24 being an inserting member for forming a slender developing bath 28 for allowing a photosensitive material to pass through, and a roller 30 being a wrapping guide means of the photosensitive material P provided on a bending part of its developing bath 28. Accordingly, when the rack 24 is inserted into the recessed part 14E of the body 14, the developing bath 28 is formed between the projecting part 24D and the recessed part 14E of the rack 24, therefore, the photosensitive material P passes through the slender developing bath 28. In such a way, the quantity of a processing liquid to be used decreases, an atmospheric contact area of this processing liquid becomes small, and the air oxidation can be reduced.

title: Device for processing photosensitive material

title: 平版印刷方法および平版印刷原版
abstract: 【課題】      平版印刷原版を画像状に加熱した段階で、分割した領域毎に絵柄面積率を求め、絵柄面積率に従い印刷機のインク供給量を分割した量位に毎に調節する。 【解決手段】  画像形成層を有する平版印刷原版を、絵柄のデジタルデータに基づく赤外線レーザー露光によって画像を形成し、現像処理を行わず直接印刷機に装着して印刷する平版印刷方法において、該赤外線レーザーによって４００乃至８００ｎｍの範囲内にある波長における光学濃度が０．２以上変化する平版印刷原版を画像露光する工程、印刷機のインク調整キーの数に応じて分割した領域毎に該波長の光を用いて光学濃度の差を読み取ることで絵柄面積率を測定する工程、該絵柄面積率に従って印刷機のインク調整キー毎の開度を設定してインク供給量を制御する工程、現像処理を行わずに直接印刷機に装着して印刷する工程を実施する。 【選択図】    なし

title: Sprocket and film winding up device
abstract: PURPOSE: To detect the charging of a shutter and the shifting of one frame of a film by mechanically detecting the movement of perforations with a sprocket. CONSTITUTION: The perforations 21 are alternately arrayed on a photographic film 15 at long and short pitches. Two teeth 25a and 25b are provided on the periphery 27 of the sprocket 26 at the short perforation pitch and the circumferential length of the periphery 27 is shorted than the shift length of one frame of the film 15. The teeth 25a and 25b are engaged with the perforations 21 by the shift of the film 15, the sprocket 26 is driven-rotated and after the engagement of two teeth is released, the sprocket 26 is driven by the friction of the periphery 27 and the film 15. Before the film 15 the shifted by one frame, the preceding tooth 25a is abutted on the film 15, to be stopped in an engagement standby position, so that the driven-rotation of the sprocket 26 is inhibited.

title: 並列処理プリンタ
abstract: 【課題】    省スペースでありながら、排紙路の渋滞や用紙ジャムを防止できる並列処理プリンタの提供。 【解決手段】複数の印刷手段と、前記印刷手段で印刷された印刷物が排紙される排紙部と、夫々の印刷手段から前記排紙部に印刷物を搬送する共通排紙路と、夫々の印刷手段における印刷物の印刷および前記排紙部への排出を制御する制御部と、前記共通排紙路に印刷物が存在するか否かを検知する印刷物検知手段とを備え、前記制御部は、前記印刷物検知手段が印刷物を検知したときは、一の印刷手段で印刷された印刷物が前記共通排紙路を搬送されているものと判断し、その他の印刷手段における印刷物の印刷および排出を一時停止する並列処理プリンタ。 【選択図】        図１

title: 写真印画紙用支持体及びその製造方法
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】膜割れやダイリップ筋の発生を防止すると共 に、紙基体と耐水性樹脂層との密着性に優れた、高解像 力写真印画紙用支持体及びその製造方法を提供するこ と。
【構成】基体の両面に耐水性樹脂被覆層を設けてなる写 真印画紙用支持体において、少なくとも、乳剤を塗布す る側の耐水性樹脂被覆層が２以上の層からなると共に、 前記基体と接する最下層の耐水性樹脂被覆層が、メルト フローレートが１．２〜１００ｇ／１０分の範囲である 耐水性樹脂、並びに、該耐水性樹脂に対して０．５〜６ ０重量％の粘着付与剤樹脂、及び／又は、前記耐水性樹 脂に対して５〜５００重量％の接着性樹脂を含有する層 であって、他の耐水性樹脂被覆層の中の少なくとも一層 が、耐水性樹脂及び該耐水性樹脂に対して５〜６０重量 ％の均一に分散された二酸化チタンからなる耐水性樹脂 被覆層であることを特徴とする写真印画紙用支持体。

title: 表面検査装置
abstract: 【課題】欠陥検出の精度を高めるとともに、生産性の低下を防止する。 【解決手段】受光ユニット１３を、ウェブ１１を正透過したレーザ光２４を遮光するマスク３７と、レーザ光２４の照射範囲内でウェブ１１の両側方に位置する標準板３９Ｌ，３９Ｒと、ウェブ１１や標準板３９Ｌ，３９Ｒを通った光を受光する受光器３０とで構成する。標準板３９Ｌ，３９Ｒに、レーザ光２４の走査線Ｌに対するマスク３７の中心線のずれに応じて走査線Ｌ上での幅が変化する形状のスリット穴４２，４３を形成する。スリット穴４２，４３を通過したレーザ光２４を受光器３０で検出した結果に基づき、走査線Ｌに対するマスクの中心線のずれが補正されるように、受光ユニット１３の姿勢を調整する。これにより、マスク３７の幅を極力細くして欠陥検出の精度を高めることができ、さらに、表面検査と並行してずれ補正を実施できるので生産性の低下が防止される。 【選択図】図１

title: Liquid ejection recorder and manufacture thereof
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve energy efficiency by suppressing a parasitic resistance existing on the both ends of a heating section, to improve the reliability by making a structure to have the resistance to corrosion from a liquid and to reduce the cost. SOLUTION: A heating resistor section 31, an interbedded insulation film 36, a metallic pattern layer 38 and a surface protection film 41 are formed on an Si substrate in the above order. After that, the insulation film 36 and surface protection film 41 on a heating region of the heating resistor film 31 are removed by using a photolithography method and a dry-etching method to open a pit 8 and to make an opening. A liquid-resistance layer 40 is formed to cover at least the opening and to be extended beyond a portion of a bypass liquid passage 47. Further, only one resin layer 54 is formed thereon. The pit 8 of the resin layer 54 is made greater than the liquid-resistance layer 40 and the resin layer 54 at the bypass liquid passage 47 is removed, then a heating element substrate is formed.  The substrate is bonded with a liquid passage substrate which is formed independently, thereby forming a liquid ejection recorder.

title: 画像送信方法及び画像送信装置
abstract: 【課題】受信側が必要な解像度の画像を受信できるようにする。 【解決手段】端末３から所望の画像の送信がサーバ１に要求されると、サーバ１はその画像を所定の多重解像度で分割した画像のうち最も解像度の低いものと、分割した画像の解像度の一覧を端末３に送信する（Ｓ１１）。端末３は、受信した画像と解像度の一覧を表示装置に表示し（Ｓ１３）、所望の解像度の指定を受け付ける（Ｓ１４）。サーバ１は、指定された解像度の画像を再構成するのに必要な画像データを端末３に送信し（Ｓ１５）、端末３は受信した画像データから所望の解像度の画像を再構成（Ｓ１７）して表示する（Ｓ１８）。 【選択図】  図３

title: Adaptation type picture compressing system
abstract: PURPOSE:To execute encoding with high efficiency without increasing a distortion quantity by executing variable length enooding with respect to a combination of each component obtained by a sum and difference conversion of an original picture element group and its forecasting conversion. CONSTITUTION:A sum component S0 and a difference component S1 of input picture element groups Uj1, Uj2 of a block Bij are calculated, forecasting error components DELTAS0, DELTAS1 are calculated by a forecasting converter 3, and also they are quantized adaptively. Its quantized forecasting error components DELTAS0, DELTAS1 are brought to variable encoding by an encoder 4, inputted to a buffer memory 5, and in case of an actual time processing, they are read out asynchronously from an input by a prescribed bit rate from the buffer memory 5 at the same time, and sent onto a trasmission line by adding a redundant code which is capable of correcting an error generated on the transmission line. Accordingly, deterioration of a reproducing picture is reduced, considering a high compression rate.

title: Manufacture of semiconductor photodetector
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain accurate positional relationship, and to improve the light response property of the photodetector consisting of an SIT by determining the positions of control and shielding gate regions and the position of a drain or source region through the same mask alignment. CONSTITUTION:An n<-> type layer 2 is grown on an n<+> Si substrate 1 in an epitaxial manner, the whole surface is coated with a pad oxide film 6 consisting of SiO2, and Si3N4 films are formed on the film 6 at regular intervals. Field SiO2 films 6', which are connected to the film 6 and volume thereof are expanded, are formed among the Si3N4 films through heat treatment, and the p<+> type gate region 4, the p<+> type shielding region 5 surrounding the region 4 and the n<+> type source or drain region 3 positioned between these regions 4 and 5 are formed among these films 6' while being positioned under the film 6 through an ion implantation. An electrode 8 is formed in the region 3, the whole surface containing the electrode 8 is coated with a thick insulating film 11, all films on the region 4 are removed, a thin insulating film 12 is formed on the whole surface, a control gate electrode 9 is formed on the region 4 through the film 12. The whole surface is coated with an Al film, one part thereof is in contact with the region 5.

title: 固体撮像装置
abstract: 【課題】画素信号の加算による水平垂直解像度の低下を最小限にとどめて信号加算を行うことのできる固体撮像装置を提供する。 【解決手段】隣接する行間及び隣接する列間で第１の行列を形成し、列方向に空間的位相が異なる２行の画素の信号を１ラインとして並列に転送する複数の垂直転送装置と、ラインメモリと、行方向に直列に信号電荷を転送する水平転送装置とを有する固体撮像装置で、水平方向に隣接する４画素の信号で１グループを構成し、４画素周期をなす３画素の信号を水平転送装置内に待機する先行ラインの信号に加算混合し、先に転送されて前記水平転送装置内に待機する先行ラインの信号に加算混合し、３画素の信号に対し４画素を周期とした１ライン上の空間位相が１８０度異なる３画素の信号を選択的に前記水平転送装置に転送し、前記１グループの１画素の信号と加算混合する。 【選択図】図１

title: Recording medium and method for regenerating the recording
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a high density recording medium performing high density recording and regeneration under vacuum using electron beam, charged particle beam or neutral particle beam, by forming a multilayer structure wherein atom layers comprising at least two kinds of elements different in a secondary electron discharge characteristic and not substantially forming an alloy mutually between adjacent atom layers are alternately stacked. CONSTITUTION:As at least two kinds of atom layers different in a secondary electron discharge characteristic, a first atom layer 2, a second atom layer 3, a first atom layer 4 and a second atom layer 5 are alternately repeatedly stacked on a support 1 to form a recording medium having a four-layered structure. Recording beam is allowed to irradiate this recording medium to remove a part of the second atom layer 5 being the uppermost layer to form a recording part 6. Regenerating beam is allowed to irradiate the surface of the recording medium having information recorded thereon and, by reading the difference between the discharge characteristic of the secondary electron discharged from the recording part 6a of the first atom layer 4 and that of the secondary electron discharged from the second atom layer 5 of the uppermost layer, the regeneration of the recorded information can be performed.

title: Image exposing method using two-dimensional matrix type space optical modulator
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To remove the influence by the DC component in each pixel part by a method wherein counter-polar DC voltages are applied to every pixel part in the exposure of a photosensitive material by irradiating exposing lights, which are modulated at every pixel part arranged in a two-dimensional matrix-fashion by means of space optical modulator. SOLUTION: The light emitted from a light source 3 is focused by a condenser 4 and incident in a polarized light beam splitter (henceforth expressed as a PBS) 2. An S polarized light wave among these rays of light incident is reflected at the PBS 2 so as to be incident in a two-dimensional space optical modulator 1 in order to be reflected at pixel electrodes through a liquid crystal layer, resulting in being incident in the PBS 2 by passing through the liquid crystal layer again. At this time, only the P polarized light wave of the reflected light passes through the PBS 2 so as to form an image on a photosensitive material 7 through a projecting lens 6.  In this case, under the condition that the pixel parts are set for the predetermined time under an ON state, under which an exposing light is outputted, a DC voltage, the absolute value of which is nearly equal to that of an applied DC voltage and the polarity of which is opposite to that of the applied DC voltage, is applied during the period except the On state so as to remove the influence by the DC component in the pixel parts, to which the exposing light is applied during their exposure period.

title: Image forming device
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable an operator to set an adequate job mode and to prevent the occurrence of miscopy by judging whether the job mode is adequate or not after the detection of an original size, stopping a device once and displaying a warning message when inconsistency is judged to exist. SOLUTION: A copy mode managing and control means 76 judges consistency between a function selected by a magnification selecting key 63 or a paper tray selecting key 68, and an original size and the size of a housed paper when an automatic magnification selecting function or an automatic paper size selecting function is selected by the key 63 or the key 68. When the inconsistency is judged to exist, a message display part displays the existence of the inconsistency, and calls operator's attention. The output of the means 76 is inputted to a display control means 77, and the means 77 controls a display means 80 provided with an LED control means 78 and an LCD control means 79.

title: Positive photoresist composition
abstract: A positive photoresist composition is disclosed, comprising a resin having a structural unit containing a specific group and capable of decomposing under the action of an acid to increase the solubility in an alkali developer, a resin having a structural unit containing a specific group and capable of decomposing under the action of an acid to increase the solubility in an alkali developer, and a compound capable of generating an acid upon irradiation with actinic rays or radiation.

title: Drum cleaning device which rotates in small radius for magnetic recording reproducing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To make a configuration of a device small in size and light in weight without interference with other mechanism by moving a cleaning roller connected with links on a required locus with using a guide roller loaded with a tape. CONSTITUTION:The cleaning roller 6 is connected to a base 10 with links 7, 8. When a tape is loaded, one of the guide rollers which moves along the groove abuts on the link 7, by which the roller 6 is moved along a required locus and abuts on a small-sized rotary drum to clean its surface. Then, after the tape is loaded, the roller 6 is reserved in a dead space on the guide roller. Thereby, the constitution of the cleaning device is made small in size and light in weight, which requires no driving force and is free from interference with other mechanism.

title: Ruled line image generator
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a ruled line image generator capable of high-speed processing by preparing raster image data to be sent out to a printer by synthesizing a letter pattern sent out of a font memory and ruled line image data into dot units. CONSTITUTION:Letter data stored in a font memory 20 and ruled line image data transferred from I/P port 60 and DMA controller 70 are each stored in image buffers 40-42 for every raster line correspondingly to the letter information CM and DT of a controller 10. In reading out data, said data are converted in PS converter 55 in a parallel serial manner and sent out to OR circuit 56 for one bit each. In the circuit 56, three outputs of said letter pattern and lateral and vertical ruled lines image are syntherized to prepare raster image data to be sent out to the printer. The printing of any ruled line can be made possible without the use of font for ruled lines.

title: Test piece and image information reader from this test piece
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To dispose more specific bonding substances such as cDNA or the like and read image information from a test piece by multi-layering a surface of the piece for disposing the substance in a thickness direction of a carrier. SOLUTION: A plurality of known cDNAs (as specific bonding substances) different from each other are disposed at a plurality of predetermined positions of surfaces and backsides of a carrier 2 made of a slide glass in the test piece. The cDNAs to be disposed on the carrier 2 correspond to DNAs different from each other and already decoded in its base sequence, and disposing positions spot positions on the carrier 2 are predetermined. Here, the cDNAs on upper and lower surfaces of the carrier 2 are disposed so as not to be superposed with each other as seen from a thickness direction of the carrier 2. In this case, since the upper and lower surfaces of the carrier 2 are surface treated so that the cDNAs are deposited on the carrier 2, the cDNAs disposed on the lower surface side of the carrier 2 are not released from the carrier 2.

title: Ion flow electrostatic recorder and usage thereof
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent a phenomenon of an adhesion of an acicular substance mainly composed of silicon oxide by a method wherein a silicon component in a vapor phase is removed in an air flow path between an ion generation means and an air force-feed means in a recording head, and the silicon-free air is passed to a discharge wire of the ion generation means in the recording head. CONSTITUTION:Dust and the like in air forcibly fed out of a blower 10 are removed through a dust and ammonia removal filter 11, thereafter being led into a dummy ion generation part 50. Since a dummy discharge wire 52 generates a corona discharge in all the area of a cylindrical chamber 51 in a circumferential direction, a plazma generation area in the vicinity of the dummy discharge wire 52 is increased. Silicon in the air is efficiently caught by the plasma area when passing through the cylindrical chamber 51.

title: 光造形装置及び方法
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  簡単かつ短時間で高精度の構造物を光造形す る。
【解決手段】  物品を挟持装置６２で挟持して、光硬化 性樹脂４２内へ埋没させた後に、その物品近傍の光硬化 性樹脂４２へ、レーザ光源１４からのレーザビームを射 出によって２光子吸収光造形法による微細な光造形を行 う。予め製造された物品に、２光子吸収光造形法による 微細な光造形を付加するので、微細な構造のみ２光子吸 収光造形法により造形でき、短時間で高精度の光造形を 実現することができる。
