Method and device for measuring a degree of exhaustion of photographic processing solutions
abstract: An exhaustion degree measuring board for measuring the fatigue of photographic processing solutions including a base member having at least one reference density window formed therein along with graduated scales corresponding to a control strip. The reference density windows have upper and lower portions with the upper portion being transparent for viewing the relevant part of the control strip and the lower part of at least one of the windows having a varying dot density. A center line with a reference mark is formed on the base for alignment with the control strip.

title: Step tablet
abstract: A step tablet in which density steps of a definite shape, each density step having a specific optical density, form a series of decreasing or increasing densities, in which any two density steps contiguous to each other are disposed with a boundary space of a specific shape between the density steps.

title: Step tablet
abstract: A step tablet with which an amount of exposure or degree of exhaustion of a developing solution can very readily been determined. The step chart is composed of a number of rectangular patches of photosensitive material, arranged in an order of sensitivity. The steps are each marked with two indicia, one having an optical density corresponding, upon development, of a step of minimum optical density, while the other corresponds to a step of maximum optical density.

title: Supporting member for sheet-shaped condenser body
abstract: PURPOSE:To invariably keep the incidence end of a sheet-shaped condenser body constant in the light receiving solid angle with respect to a light emitting point and to position the incidence end of a sheet-shaped condenser body without rejecting any laser beam admitted by making the vertical support surface almost parallel to a laser beam which enters to excite a durable fluorescence and the horizontal support surface almost parallel to the durable fluorescent sheet surface. CONSTITUTION:Support members 1 and 1' have a vertical support surface and a horizontal support surface, which makes an L shape crossing each other at the right angle. A pair of the support members 1 and 1' are positioned at both side ends of a linear incidence end 3 of a sheet-shaped condenser body 2 while at both the side ends of the incidence end 3 with respect to a scan line 5 formed by a laser scan light 4 admitted. At the same time, the incidence end 3 is set parallel with respect to the scan line 5 formed by the laser scan light 4 admitted. A laser light irradiates a durable fluorescent sheet in parallel with the vertical support surface of the support members 1 and 1 and the surface of the durable fluorescent sheet is set in parallel with the horizontal support surface of the support members 1 and 1'.

title: Shading cover of sheet type condensing body
abstract: PURPOSE:To easily shade a sheet type condensing body with errors in shapes by comprising the entire side of the sheet type condensing body with a flexible shading member applied to the side without adhering to it and a pair of rod-type core-metals that can hold the vicinity of the linear incident end face of the sheet type condensing body from both sides. CONSTITUTION:The first shading cover member 1A is secured by spacing an end edge with the core metal 2A of the first shading cover member 1A at the distance from the surface side of the sheet type condensing body 10 which is same as the distance from an incident end face 11 of the second cover member 1B to the side thereof provided with the core metal, engaging both face fasteners 4A and 4A' with each other and then engaging the face fasteners provided at protrusions 3A and 3A' with the face fastener of the second shading cover member. In this case, both the core metals 2A and 2B can hold the vicinity of the incident end face 11 from both sides with a proper stress through linear contact. As a result, the shading of the vicinity of the incident end face 11 can be performed without reducing condensation efficiency.

title: Recording and reproducing head and recording reproducing disk device
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To decrease the number of turns of a coil and to make realizable fast modulation by using a material having high magnetic permeability to constitute a light-shielding body having an opening of a specified size to be arranged in the position where the light spot of the condensing face is formed. SOLUTION: A transparent light-condensing medium 6 has an entrance face 6a, aspheric reflection plane 6b as a part of a paraboloid of revolution, a light- condensed face 6c and a bottom 6e. A light-shielding plate 14 having an aperture 13 to limit the range of the near-field light spot 9b leaking from the light spot 9a formed on the light-condensed face 6c is disposed at the position of the light spot on the light-condensed face 6c. The light-shielding body 14 consists of a material having high magnetic permeability such as Permalloy(R). By this method, the number of turns of the coil 10 can be decreased. The light- shielding body 14 is disposed inside of the coil 10 and on the surface of the light-condensed face 6c, and the aperture 13 is formed as tapered with the hole size decreased along the propagation direction of the near-field light.  Thus, the light-condensing effect for the near-field light can be increased.

title: Grease coating method
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the separation of grease and ensure stable coating of a constant quantity by housing a grease in an open type storing means and stirring said grease while keeping the surface of said grease smooth, and coating said grease by a grease coating means which is immersed in said grease. CONSTITUTION:A stirring member 6 for stirring a grease 20 and a smoothing member 7 for smoothing a grease surface are provided in a grease pan 5. Although the smoothing member 7 and the stirring member 6 are fixed, the grease pan 5 is lifted up accompanying the reducing quantity of the grease to keep the height of a grease level constant while keeping the immersing quantity of a coating pin constant. A coating head 1 coats the grease 20 in the grease pan 5 onto a support shaft 14. The coating pin 2 is provided on the coating head 1 while being extended obliquely downward on a head body part 15.

title: Lubrication method for heat resistant chain
abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate the need for a grease up and to simplify maintenance by coating a heat resistant grease or the base oil of a grease on the inner and outer surfaces of a chain forming member and after forming a chin by assembling each forming member coating the heat resistant grease on the chain surface. CONSTITUTION:The like assembly body 2, pin 6 and outer ring 7 forming a chain are dipped in the base oil of a grease or a heat resistant grease of a dipping tank 10 at the stage prior to assembly and made in the state of being sufficiently coated with the base oil of a grease to the inner face of a shaft hole and pin hole. The respective part sufficiently coated with a rust preventive is assembled by a machine 18, but the heat resistant grease is injected by a grease injecting device 15 for the shaft hole which needs much heat resistant grease especially. A chain is made by assembling each part thereafter and in order to prevent the leakage of the inner part grease to the external part the heat resistant grease is coated on the chain surface.

title: Driving apparatus
abstract: PURPOSE:To accomplish cleaning and supply of lubricating oil to a driving chain automatically with no need of labors of an operator, by impregnating lubricating oil in a pair of bosses made of a fibrous material which are disposed on the opposite sides of a sprocket, and keeping a driving chain in contact with the bosses. CONSTITUTION:Since a pin link plate 12 and a roller link plate 13 are rolled along a roller 7 while keeping contact with a pair of bosses 11, 11, lubricating oil impregnated in the bosses 11, 11 is supplied automatically to the rotating parts and contact parts of a driving chain 5 via the pin link plate 12 and the roller link plate 13. Therefore, foreign matter attached to the driving chain 5 is absorbed in fibers of the bosses 11, 11 of the roller 7 by the intermediary of lubricating oil.

title: Image-forming apparatus
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image-forming apparatus which can correctly and easily judge degradation of a light source. SOLUTION: There are provided as means for measuring an output time a clock generator 61 for generating reference clocks, a controller 62 for controlling the whole of a measuring instrument and a counter 63 for counting reference clocks. There are provided as means for measuring an output level a reference level generator 64 for outputting a reference voltage, a comparator 65 for comparing an MO with the reference level and a level detector 66 for judging the output level from outputs of the comparator 65. Moreover, there are provided an arithmetic unit 67 for obtaining a product of the output time and the output level obtained from the counter 63 and the level detector 66 and calculating a quantity of light emitted from an LD 30, and a memory 68 for storing the arithmetic result.  Contents stored in the memory 68 are sent to a reuse-judging means 69 set separately from an LD use state-measuring device.

title: Image forming apparatus, image forming method and its program
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image forming apparatus capable of displaying a magnitude of an environmental burden given by a printed matter printed with specified printing attributes by a numeral value and setting the printing attributes suppressing the environmental burden, an image forming method and its program.  <P>SOLUTION: The image forming apparatus is equipped with a burden point setting means for setting in advance a burden point for calculating an environmental burden value in a case when the printing with the printing attributes is performed in accordance with specifying the printing attributes, and calculates the environmental burden value as the burden point in referring to the specified printing attributes and the burden point set by the burden point setting means, and displays it.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

title: Image forming apparatus
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image forming apparatus capable of appropriately calculating an environmental value in accordance with the situation of the insertion/ejection of an image forming unit.  <P>SOLUTION: The apparatus includes an environment measurement sensor 3 installed in the apparatus main body; the image forming unit arranged so as to be inserted/ejected to/from the apparatus main body; a controller 6 for sampling the output of the environment measurement sensor 3 and calculating the environmental value by using the sampled data output from the sensor; and a timer 8 for counting a time until the image forming unit is inserted after the image forming unit is ejected, and in the case the time counted by the timer is below a prescribed time, the calculation of the environmental value is started by using the sensor output data sampled before and after the image forming unit is ejected, on the other hand, in the case the time counted by the timer 8 is equal to or exceeding the prescribed time, the calculation of the environmental value is started by using only the sensor output data sampled after the image forming unit is inserted.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Trouble data information system of image forming apparatus
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable selection of an information means for reporting the generation of trouble fitting to the user's work content of an image forming apparatus, and to eliminate useless information. SOLUTION: A discrimination means 30 for discriminating the user of an image forming apparatus 10, an input means 12 for inputting the data related to the trouble generated in the image forming apparatus, register means 14, 18 for preliminary registering an information means fitted to the work content of an information destination, the information destination, an information condition and the data of the message sent out to the information destination at every user and trouble, a plurality of information means for reporting the generating of trouble, and control means 16,  20 for forming an information list sowing a series of data necessary for reporting the trouble generated in the image forming apparatus on the basis of the comparison result of the user's discrimination data and trouble data taken in from the discrimination means and the input means and the registered contents of the register means and outputting a trouble information message to a predetermined information means on the basis of the information list when the information condition is formed are provided.

title: Display device, display method and image processing system
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable true cause of an error to be rapidly specified even when a plurality of related errors are generated. SOLUTION: An error treating means 300 for displaying an error message is constituted by providing with a first means 310 for detecting error states of various kinds of apparatuses based on detecting signals from various kinds of sensors and a second means 312 for outputting the error message corresponding to combination of a plurality of detected error states. The second means 312 is constituted by providing with a retrieving means 322 for retrieving an error pattern of this time formed by combination of a plurality of detected error states from an information table 320 and a message output means 324 for reading out the error message corresponding to the error pattern of this time and outputting the error message to a display part 204, for example, when the error pattern of this time is present in the information table 320.

title: Image forming apparatus
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To prevent a user from forgetting to bring back a document, a recording paper, etc. by notifying the user when discrimination start conditions are satisfied and information conditions are satisfied.  <P>SOLUTION: The image forming apparatus Pr1 has: a plurality of information side sensors SN1-SN7 which detect an object brought back by the user after an image is formed; a discrimination start condition storage means C1A which stores the discrimination start conditions for starting the discrimination whether the user is informed or not, based on the detection results of the information side sensors SN1-SN7; a discrimination start condition discriminating means C1B which discriminates whether the discrimination start conditions are satisfied or not; an information condition storage means C1C which stores the information conditions for discriminating whether the user is informed or not, based on the detection results of the information side sensors SN1-SN7; an information condition discriminating means C1D which discriminates whether the information conditions are satisfied or not, when the discrimination start conditions are satisfied; and an informing means C4 which informs the user, when the information conditions are satisfied.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: 洗浄処理液、着色画像の形成方法、カラーフィルターの製造方法、及び、カラーフィルター付きアレイ基板の製造方法
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  現像残渣等の汚れの洗浄除去性に優れ、表面 の平滑性、エッジ形状が良好で、解像度の高い着色画像 を形成可能な洗浄処理液等の提供。
【解決手段】  アルキルエーテル系界面活性剤及び塩基 性化合物を含有し、加圧条件下で被処理対象物に付与さ れることを特徴とする洗浄処理液である。加圧による圧 力が、０．０１〜１００ＭＰａである態様、加圧が、ブ ラシ、スポンジ及び液圧の少なくともいずれかの加圧手 段による態様、被処理対象物が、基板上に、少なくと も、感光層及び酸素遮断層を順次積層してなる態様等が 好ましい。

title: 洗浄処理液並びにそれを用いた着色画像の形成方法、カラーフィルターの製造方法、及び、カラーフィルター付きアレイ基板の製造方法
abstract: 【課題】  現像残渣等の汚れの洗浄除去性に優れ、表面の平滑性、エッジ形状が良好な着色画像を形成可能な洗浄処理液等の提供。 【解決手段】  塩基性化合物と、少なくとも１つの水酸基を含有するアセチレン界面活性剤及びフェノキシオキシアルキレン界面活性剤の少なくともいずれかとを含むことを特徴とする洗浄処理液である。アセチレン界面活性剤が、アセチレンジオール界面活性剤である態様、更にアルキルエーテル界面活性剤を含む態様、加圧条件下で被処理対象物に付与される態様、加圧による圧力が、０．０１〜１００ＭＰａである態様、等が好ましい。 【選択図】        なし

title: 処理液、カラーフィルタの製造方法、カラーフィルタ、及び表示装置
abstract: 【課題】カラーフィルタの作製に感光性転写材料を用いるに際して、現像終了時の仕上がりを高め、回転ブラシの精度管理を厳しく行わなくても、高い品質のカラーフィルタを製造可能なカラーフィルタの製造方法、及びそれに用いる処理液を提供する。 【解決手段】少なくとも、水とアルカノールアミンとを含有し、該アルカノールアミンの含有量が全体に対して２〜４０質量％である処理液であって、前記アルカノールアミンが、トリエタノールアミンと、ジエタノールアミンとを含み、該ジエタノールアミンが、該ジエタノールアミンと前記トリエタノールアミンとの合計量に対して、３〜１２質量％であることを特徴とする処理液、及び感光性転写材料の熱可塑性樹脂層の除去に該処理液を用いるカラーフィルタの製造方法である。 【選択図】なし

title: 表示装置
abstract: 【課題】  電気浸透液の浸透現象を利用した表示装置において、より高いコントラストで表示を行なうようにする。 【解決手段】  透明材料からなり、電気浸透液Ｌ１が内部の孔に浸透可能な透明多孔質層１０と、透明多孔質層１０の一面側に積層された着色多孔質層２０とを積層してなる積層体１５に対して、電源部３５により、表電極３１ａと裏電極３１ｂの間に電位差を付与して電気浸透液Ｌ１にクーロン力を作用させ、透明多孔質層１０への電気浸透液Ｌ１の浸透、あるいは透明多孔質層１０に浸透している電気浸透液Ｌ１の透明多孔質層１０からの排出を行ない、透明多孔質層１０へ電気浸透液Ｌ１が浸透しているときに透明多孔質層１０が透明となり透明多孔質層１０を通して着色多孔質層２０が表示され、透明多孔質層１０から電気浸透液Ｌ１が排出されているときに透明多孔質層１０が不透明となり透明多孔質層１０が表示されるようにする。 【選択図】          図１

title: 表示装置
abstract: 【課題】  電気浸透液の浸透現象を利用した表示装置において、より高いコントラストで表示を行うようにする。 【解決手段】  透明材料からなり、黒色に着色された電気浸透液Ｌ１が内部の孔に浸透可能な透明多孔質層１０に対して、電位差付与部３５により、表電極３１ａと裏電極３１ｂの間に電位差を付与して電気浸透液Ｌ１に電気力を作用させて、透明多孔質層１０内において電気浸透液Ｌ１を透明多孔質層１０の厚さ方向に移動させ、透明多孔質層１０の表示面側１０ａに電気浸透液Ｌ１が集中しているときに、装置１０１の表示面において電気浸透液Ｌ１の色である黒色が表示され、透明多孔質層１０の非表示面側１０ｂに電気浸透液Ｌ１が集中しているときに、装置１０１の表示面において透明多孔質層１０の表示面１０ａ側における照明光Ｌａの散乱に起因する白色が表示されるようにする。 【選択図】          図１

title: 表示装置
abstract: 【課題】  電気浸透液の浸透現象を利用した表示装置において、より高いコントラストで表示を行うようにする。 【解決手段】  透明多孔質層１１を第１のスペーサー２０および空間１４を介して有色多孔質層１０上に積層し、透明基板１２をスペーサー２１を介して透明多孔質層１１上に積層し、電位差付与部３５により、表電極３１ａと裏電極３１ｂの間に電位差を付与して電気浸透液Ｌ１に電気力を作用させて、電気浸透液Ｌ１を有色多孔質層１０と透明多孔質層１１との間で移動させ、透明多孔質層１１へ電気浸透液Ｌ１が浸透しているときに透明多孔質層１１が透明となり透明多孔質層１１および空間１４を通して有色多孔質層１０が表示され、透明多孔質層１１から電気浸透液Ｌ１が排出されているときに透明多孔質層１１が不透明となり透明多孔質層１１が表示されるようにする。 【選択図】          図１

title: Color television signal generator
abstract: Disclosed is a color television signal generator which is capable of producing color television signals directly from an 8 mm-width color film to reproduce the colored images of the film on a home-use color television. The present generator uses a polygonal prism which is rotated in synchronous relation with the feeding of the film, thus assuring that the raster on the flying-spot scanner is in register with the frame of the film, no matter what the feeding speed of the film is. Also, the present generator includes a color reproduction compensator which functions to subtract green and blue contents from the red component color, thus reproducing the color image of the film on the home-use color television with high fidelity of color.

title: Means for generating a signal capable of being used for reproduction of a multicoloured image by television
abstract: 1392863 Colour television FUJI PHOTO FILM CO Ltd 20 Oct 1972 [22 Oct 1971 (3)] 48519/72 Heading H4F A colour film 136 is scanned by a flying spot scanner 130 having a screen formed either of vertical (for horizontal scanning), differently coloured phosphor stripes, or a white phosphor layer covered with one or more striped colour filters, the transmitted signals being detected by a photo-detector 138 to generate a colour television signal. In one embodiment (Figs. 2, 3, not shown), two striped colour filters are used having alternate cyan/transparent and yellow/ transparent stripes respectively at different repitition frequencies, band-pass filters being used to produce respective red and blue signals which are matrixed with the output of a low pass filter to produce a green signal. In alternative embodiments (Figs. 4-7, not shown), repeating red, green and blue filter stripes or phosphor stripes at the same repetition frequency are used, and black or white index stripes may be included to produce an index signal to demodulate the resulting chrominance signals at the correct phases to produce red, green and blue signals. A filter or phosphor layer may be used having repeating red, green and blue stripes in the correct relative widths and transmissions or luminescences to produce an NTSC colour signal directly in the output of the photodetector. Repeating red, magenta, blue, cyan, green and yellow stripes of the correct properties may alternatively be used. abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  画像を劣化させずに、カラー感熱記録紙の余 白を小さくする。
【解決手段】  最初に熱記録が行われるイエロー感熱発 色層を定着するイエロー用定着器３０をピンチローラ２ ８の上方に配置し、ピンチローラ２８の両側から、カラ ー感熱記録紙１６に紫外線を照射する。これにより、従 来のカラー感熱プリンタに比べて、カラー感熱記録紙１ ６の先端縁１６ａ及び後端縁１６ｂの余白Ｌｃ２及びＬ ｃ４を、イエロー用定着器３０の幅Ｌｙの半分程度の長 さだけ、それぞれ小さくすることができる。

title: 写真焼付装置及び露光条件決定方法
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  カラーフェリアの影響を排除することがで き、かつ経時劣化等によるフィルム特性の変化に拘わら ず常に高品質のプリントを得る。
【構成】  第１の記憶手段３４には、測光器２８から入 力され選択手段３８によって選択された測光データが多 数本のネガフィルム２０に亘って濃度別に分類されて記 憶されている。第２の記憶手段３６には焼付ける画像コ マが記録された単一のネガフィルム２０の画像コマに対 する測光データが同様に記憶されている。露光条件決定 手段４０は、焼付ける画像コマの測光データと、第１の 記憶手段３４からのデータと、第２の記憶手段３６から のデータと、の各々に付与する重み係数を設定し、前記 各データの各々に重み係数を付して加えた値に基づいて 露光条件を決定する。

title: カラー感熱プリンタ
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  プリントの余白部分を小さくする。
【構成】  カラー感熱記録紙２２は、第１搬送ローラ対 ３２でニップされて往復動される。この往動中にサーマ ルヘッド２８によって、３種類の感熱発色層中の１つが 選択的に発色される。復動中には、光定着器４２によっ て直前に発色された感熱発色層が光定着される。ニップ ローラ３３を小径にして、光定着器４２をこれにできる だけ近接させている。カラー感熱記録紙２２の挟み代Ｌ ５と、定着不良となる部分Ｌ６とが小さくなり、画像を 記録することができない余白部分が小さくなる。

title: カラー記録方法及び装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  大型紙を簡易カラー記録可能なカラー記録方 法及び装置を提供することを目的とする。
【構成】  直接感熱紙７０３に第１色を発色させるため に、直接感熱紙７０３にサーマルヘッド７１５の熱エネ ルギが直接供給され、直接感熱紙７０３に色インクを転 写して第２色を得るために、夫々直接感熱紙７０３の発 色反応を抑制する減感性物質及び各色インクを塗布した 複数のインクリボン７０９ａ乃至７０９ｄにサーマルヘ ッド７１５の熱エネルギが供給されるようにしたもので ある。

title: カラー感熱プリント方法
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  紫外線ランプの起動特性に起因する定着不足 を防止する。
【解決手段】  カラー感熱記録紙は、３回往復動されて いる間に３色面順次でカラー画像が記録される。マゼン タ画像の記録に際しては、マゼンタ用紫外線ランプを点 灯してから、その発光強度が所定値に達した時点で、カ ラー感熱記録紙の搬送を開始して、マゼンタ画像を記録 するとともに、マゼンタ画像の記録された部分にマゼン タ用紫外線ランプからの紫外線を照射してマゼンタ感熱 発色層を光定着する。

title: カラー感熱プリンタ
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【構成】  光定着時にカラー感熱記録材料１２の端部が 搬送ローラ対２２に位置してその送りを停止する前に、 カラー感熱記録材料１２の送りを減速する。また、減速 した後一定時間経過した時点で、シャッタ板４１の閉じ を開始する。
【効果】  減速前の送りに比べて定着エリアＡ１内を記 録材料１２がゆっくりと移動するため、減速時には積算 定着光量が増加する。したがって、定着エリアＡ１内で 定着光量不足部分がＬ５分だけ少なくなり、この分だけ 記録可能エリアＰＡが広がる。また、シャッタ板の閉じ 動作により、余分な定着光量がカットされる。

title: カラーサーマルプリンタ
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  プラテンドラム又はプラテンローラの歪みの 違いによるレジズレと、カラー感熱記録紙の搬送の負荷 変動によるプリントムラとの発生を防止する。
【構成】  カラー感熱記録紙１０は温度によって摩擦係 数が変化し、この摩擦係数はイエロー熱記録時＞マゼン タ熱記録時＞シアン熱記録時となる。これに合わせて各 サーマルヘッド２６〜２８の圧接力をイエロー用サーマ ルヘッド＜マゼンタ用サーマルヘッド＜シアン用サーマ ルヘッドとし、各サーマルヘッド２６〜２８とカラー感 熱記録紙１０との摩擦力をほぼ等しくする。
【効果】  各サーマルヘッドによるプラテンドラムの歪 み量がほぼ同じになるので、レジズレが発生しない。ま た、各サーマルヘッドの負荷がほぼ同じになるので、負 荷変動による送りムラを防止し、これによる濃度ムラを 無くすことができる。

title: 感熱記録材料の漂白方法
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  クランパで保持された先端部の漂白に要する 時間を短縮することにより、感熱記録材料の給紙から排 紙までのプリント時間全体を高速化する。
【構成】  排紙時にはプラテンドラム１０が停止し、次 にクランパ１３が開放される。この状態でプラテンドラ ム１０が高速回転して、感熱記録材料２の先端部３をマ ゼンタ定着用紫外線ランプ１７の下にセットする。プラ テンドラム１０を停止させたまま、先端部３に紫外線を 照射して漂白する。一定時間紫外線を照射してから、プ ラテンドラム１０を回転して感熱記録材料２を排紙す る。

title: カラー感熱プリンタ
abstract:
(57)【要約】        （修正有）
【課題】  カラー感熱記録紙の無駄をなくするように工 夫したカラー感熱プリンターを提供する。
【解決手段】  カラー感熱記録紙１５の搬送路に沿っ て、イエロー用、マゼンタ用、シアン用サーマルヘッド ２１，２２，２３が上流側から順に配置されており、カ ラー感熱記録紙の１回の搬送でフルカラー画像を面順次 で記録する。定着器３７，３８は、イエロー、及びマゼ ンタ画像の記録後に各色の感熱発色層をそれぞれ光定着 する。各定着器３７，３８には、シャッタ機構７０，７ １が設けられている。シャッタ機構は、紫外線を遮断す るシャッタ幕７４と、この幕をニップして移動させるシ ャッタ搬送ローラ対７８とが設けられている。画像記録 エリアの後端とシャッタ幕の先端とが一致した状態で、 シャッタ幕をニップローラ８１との間でニップしてシャ ッタ幕をカラー感熱記録紙と共に移動させて、画像記録 エリアの後端側の未記録部分が定着されないように遮光 する。

title: サーマルプリンタ
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  サーマルプリンタにおいて、印画ムラの発生 を防止しながらサーマルヘッドと感熱記録紙との間の摩 擦係数を十分に小さくする。
【解決手段】  カラー感熱記録紙３はプラテンローラ１ ２と各発熱素子１７にニップされ、プラテンローラ１２ の正転で排出通路５に向けて搬送される。各発熱素子１ ７の駆動中は、各発熱素子１７の発熱でカラー感熱記録 紙３とサーマルヘッド１３の間の摩擦係数が小さくな り、圧電素子１９は駆動されない。振動コントローラ２ １が直前の各発熱素子１７の平均駆動時間に基づいて圧 電素子１９の駆動時間を算定し、前記平均駆動時間の経 過後に圧電素子１９を駆動する。共振振動体２０が共振 してサーマルヘッド１３が振動し、前記摩擦係数が小さ くなる。以下、同じ動作が繰り返され、最後のラインま でイエロー画像が熱記録される。熱記録されたイエロー 感熱発色層はイエロー用紫外線ランプ２２より光定着さ れる。この後、プラテンローラ１２が逆転してカラー感 熱記録紙３が熱記録開始位置まで戻される。以下同様に マゼンタ，シアンの各画像記録が行われる。

title: カラー感熱プリント方法
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  負荷変動による黒スジや白スジの発生を防止 する。
【構成】  カラー感熱記録紙の通過域に沿って、イエロ ー用サーマルヘッド，マゼンタ用サーマルヘッド，シア ン用サーマルヘッドが配置されており、１回の移動でカ ラー感熱記録紙にフルカラー画像を記録する。イエロー 用サーマルヘッドの記録中に、マゼンタ用サーマルヘッ ドの圧接と通電が開始される。逆にマゼンタ用サーマル ヘッドの記録中に、イエロー用サーマルヘッドの通電停 止と退避とが行われる。このサーマルヘッドの挙動で、 カラー感熱記録紙の搬送負荷が変わる。この負荷変動で 搬送系の歪み量が変化するため、カラー感熱記録紙の搬 送速度が一時的に変化し、記録中のラインが黒スジ，白 スジとなる。このラインに対しては、サーマルヘッドで 発生する熱エネルギーを修正して、スジの発生を防止す る。

title: カラー感熱プリンタ
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  プリント時間を延長したり、装置を大型化， 高価格化させることなく、感熱記録材料の未記録部分を 十分に漂白する。
【構成】  排紙路２８の途中に漂白器３５が着脱自在に 取り付けられている。熱記録が終了したカラー感熱記録 材料１０は、漂白器３５を経てからトレーに排出され る。漂白器３５内に入ったカラー感熱記録材料１０は、 紫外線ランプ３６の周りをまわりながら搬送され、この 間で紫外線が充分に照射される。この紫外線によって、 残っていたジアゾニウム塩化合物が光分解し、薄黄色を した白枠等が白く仕上げられる。

title: 感熱プリンタ
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  プリントの高速化と余白減少とが可能な感熱 プリンタを提供する。
【解決手段】  サーマルヘッド６には、カラー感熱記録 紙３に熱記録を行う発熱素子アレイ６ａと、カラー感熱 記録紙３に紫外線を照射して定着するイエロー用面光源 １１及びマゼンタ用面光源１２とが組み込まれている。 サーマルヘッド６のベース部材である放熱板１４と、イ エロー用面光源１１及びマゼンタ用面光源１２との間に は、発熱素子アレイ６ａに熱の悪影響を与えないよう に、低熱伝導率材で形成されたスペーサー１７が挟み込 まれている。

title: カラー感熱プリンタ
abstract:
(57)【要約】        （修正有）
【課題】  プリント時の無駄な時間と電力との消費を防 止する。
【解決手段】  異なった色に発色する少なくとも第１〜 第３の感熱発色層が層設されたカラー感熱記録紙を搬送 する搬送手段と、このカラー感熱記録紙に圧接して１種 類の感熱発色層を選択的に発色させるサーマルヘッド と、次の感熱発色層を発色させる前に発色済みの感熱発 色層を定着する定着器と、印画完了後に印画エリアの周 囲の余白をカットするカッタと、余白のカットの実施と 不実施とを選択するカット選択手段とを備え、各感熱発 色層への印画完了後に該余白を定着器で定着するカラー 感熱プリンタにおいて、プリント開始時に、カラー感熱 記録紙の印画エリアの周囲の余白をカットするか否かを 設定する。余白のカットを実施する場合には、余白の定 着を省略して、印画完了後に余白をカットしてカラー感 熱記録紙を排出する。

title: 光定着器
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  光定着時間を短縮する。
【解決手段】  サーマルプリンタ２は、感熱記録材料３ に熱記録するサーマルヘッド６と、熱記録後に光定着を するイエロー用及びマゼンタ用の各光定着器９，１０を 備えている。感熱記録材料３は、透明な支持体上に、イ エロー，マゼンタ，シアンの各感熱発色層を層設したＯ ＨＰ用の記録材料である。イエロー用光定着器９は、２ 本のＹ用紫外線ランプ２３ａ，２３ｂを備えている。各 ランプ２３ａ，２３ｂの一方は、感熱記録材料３の記録 面と対面する位置に、他方は、裏面と対面する位置にそ れぞれ配置されている。光定着の際には、各ランプ２３ ａ，２３ｂが点灯し、感熱記録材料３の両面から紫外線 を照射する。マゼンタ用光定着器１０も、イエロー用光 定着器９と同様に、２本のＭ用紫外線ランプ２６ａ，２ ６ｂによって、感熱記録材料３の両面から紫外線を照射 する。

title: カラー感熱プリンタ及びそのプリント方法並びにカラー感熱記録材料及びその製造方法

abstract: １以上の防音セルを有する防音構造であって、その１以上の防音セルの各々が、孔部を持つ枠と、孔部を覆うように枠に固定された振動可能な膜と、膜に穿孔された１以上の貫通孔と、を備え、枠の孔部の両方の端部は、共に閉塞されておらず、枠と膜とが、同じ材質からなり、一体的に形成されていることにより、環境変化や経時に対する耐性が高まり安定した防音性を得ることができることに加え、枠への膜の均一接着、貼り付け等の製造上の問題も回避することができる防音構造、および防音構造の作製方法を提供する。

title: 防音構造
abstract: ２次元平面内に配置され、枠、膜及び穴を含む開口部、又は枠、及び膜を備える１以上の防音セルを有する単層防音構造を積層してなる積層防音構造であって、単層防音構造は、防音セルの膜の第１固有振動周波数より低周波側に、防音セルの開口部に起因して定まり、かつ透過損失が極大となる遮蔽ピーク周波数を有し、単層防音構造の防音セル同士は積層されており、積層された一方及び他方の防音セルとは、枠、膜、及び開口部の少なくとも１つの条件が異なることにより、軽量で薄く、その穴の位置及び形状に依存することなく、遮音材としてのロバスト性が高く、かつ安定性があり、複数音の遮音、又は遮音の広帯域化を実現することができ、更に、目的通りの遮蔽周波数を得ることが可能な防音構造を提供する。

title: 防音结构体
abstract: 本发明的课题在于提供一种在用于防音的间壁部件中，抑制由衍射现象引起的回声而得到充分的防音效果的防音结构体。本发明的防音结构体具有：防音单元，具有具备开口部的框体及覆盖开口部而配置的膜，膜根据入射于膜的声音来振动；及间壁部件，安装有1个以上的防音单元。

title: 防音结构及防音系统
abstract: 本发明提供一种防音结构及防音系统，所述防音结构具有2个以上的防音单元，所述防音结构中，各防音单元具有：框，具有开口部；及吸音部件，安装在框的开口部，相邻的2个防音单元以使各个吸音部件的至少一部分彼此对置的方式配置，至少一部分对置的吸音部件相互间隔开，至少一部分对置的吸音部件彼此的平均距离小于20mm，由此能够通过简单的结构来对低频侧的声音进行防音，且小型轻量，并且能够轻松地改变其频率特性。

Method and jig for cutting brittle plate
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve precision and yield by forming a specified kerf on one side of a brittle plate, placing a buffer plate thereon, placing a cutting jig consisting of a base plate in which a pattern groove including a specified form is formed and a sleeper on the opposite side and pressing the assembly. CONSTITUTION:A grid-shaped groove 1b, for example, is provided on one side of a brittle base plate 1a of glass, etc., having specified thickness and a columnar sleeper 1c of stainless steel, etc., is placed thereon to constitute a cutting jig 1. A first elastic film 2 of PE, etc., is placed on the jig 1, a brittle plate 3 with a kerf 3a provided thereon is placed on the film 2 so that the surface having the kerf 3a is placed on the opposite side of the surface abutting on the jig 1, and further the kerf 3a is confronted with the sleeper 1c. A second elastic film 4 of PE, etc., is placed on the surface of the plate 3 having the kerf 3a, a buffer plate 5 of acrylic resin, etc., is placed on the film 4. The brittle plate is placed between the upper and lower press jigs 6a and 6b, pressed and uniformly cut with good precision.

title: Method for joining band-shaped metallic sheets
abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce a joining time of the title band-shaped metallic sheets by cutting the superposed band-shaped metallic sheets in the specific angular range with respect to the width direction and then, welding a superposed part. CONSTITUTION:A joining device 16 is constituted of an abutting device 18 and a rolling device 20. Clamps 22 and 28, a cutter and welding equipment 26 are arranged respectively to the inside of the abutting device 18. The band- shaped metallic sheets 10 and 30 are clamped respectively by the clamps 22 and 28 and ends 30A and 30A are superposed on each other in the device 18. The superposed part 32 is then cut at >=5 deg. angle with respect to the width direction by the cutter 24 and the welding equipment 26 welds a weld zone 46. Further, the rolling device 20 executes rolling and the difference in level on the weld zone 46 is solved. Since the superposed surfaces of the band-shaped metallic sheets 10 and 30 are easily abutted on each other, the joining time of those is remarkably reduced.

title: Joining method for strip metallic plate
abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce the variation ratio of arc length at the time when an electrode reaches the welding start end and at the time when the electrode is separated from the welding finish end, and to shorten the burn-through length dimensions of the welding start end and the welding finish end, in a joining method for a strip metallic plate. CONSTITUTION:In the joining method for a strip metallic plate for butting or superposing by a minute quantity each end part 10A, 22A of strip metallic plates 10, 22, welding and joining each end part 10A, 22A which is butted or superposed by a minute quantity and rolling the weld joint part, dimensions between each end part 10A, 22A which is butted or superposed by a minute quantity to the tip part of an electrode 30A of a welding torch 30 are set large to >=1.0mm, and >=1.5mm desirably.

title: Method and apparatus for joining hoop-like metal plate
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide joining method and apparatus preventing breakage or rupture of a hoop-like metal plate by uniformly trimming both edges of the wide hoop-like metal plate. CONSTITUTION:The joining apparatus for hoop-like metal plate provides the devices for rolling welded joining part after weld-joining end parts 10A, 22A, e.g. by butting the end parts 10A, 22A of hoop-like metal plate 10, 22 having different width sizes. Further, this apparatus provides means 42 for trimming the end part of the wide hoop-like metal plate 22 in the hoop-like metal plates 10, 22 joining the different widths while corresponding to side edges of the narrow hoop-like metal plate 10 and means 59 for detecting side edge positions of the hoop-like metal plates 10, 22 and shifting the trimming means 42 so as to keep positional relation between the trimming means 42 pre-inputted based on the detected side edge positions and the side edges of the hoop-like metal plates 10, 22.

title: Method and device for joining band-like metallic plate
abstract: PURPOSE:To decrease the generation of perforation of a junction by placing a band-like metallic plate end part on a step difference part of a back bar in which a step difference being equal to plate thickness of the band-like metallic plate is formed, superposing other metallic plate end part thereon by a minute quantity and welding and joining them. CONSTITUTION:Each end part of band-like metallic plates 10, 22 is superposed on each other by a minute quantity and welded and joined. In this case, a step difference part (step difference quantity l) being roughly equal to plate thickness of the band-like metallic plate 10 superposed to the lower side is formed in a back bar 31. Subsequently, an end part 10A of one band-like metallic plate 10 is placed thereon, an end part 22A of the other metallic pate 22 is superposed on this end part 10A by a minute quantity and each band-like metallic plate 10, 22 is welded and joined by an electrode 30A of a welding touch 30. In such a way, warp of the band-like metallic plate of the upper side can be prevented.

title: Method and device for joining beltlike metallic sheets
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the occurrence of cracking of a welding starting end and to improve productivity by superposing or abutting beltlike metallic sheets on each other, fixing these by a couple of clamps provided at a specified interval to perform welding thereon and then, rolling a welded and joined part. CONSTITUTION:Since the beltlike metallic sheets 10 and 22 are superposed or abutted on each other and the respective metallic sheets 10 and 22 are fixed by the couple of clamps 26 and 28 provided at >=10mm interval, cracking does not occur on the welding starting end even when a joining part of the beltlike metallic sheets is welded at the welding speed of >=5m/min.

title: Method for joining beltlike metal plates
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent a joining part from fracturing and to improve the quality of the joining part by butt-welding beltlike metal plates to each other and afterward, rolling the joining part and further, as necessary, performing the trimming processing on both sides of the joining part. CONSTITUTION:A precutting device 18, welding equipment 24, a rolling device 32, an edge trimming device 36, etc., are arranged in order with respect to a beltlike metal plate 10. The beltlike metal plate 10 rewound from a roll 12 is conveyed to a joining device 16 and precut by the device 18. The beltlike metal plate 10 butted against a beltlike metal plate 22 are clamped by clamps 28 and 26 of the welding equipment 24 and welded to each other by a welding torch 30. Next, the rolling device 32 rolls the joining part 40 of the metal plates 10 and 22 by a roller 34 and as necessary, both ends 46 thereof are trimmed by a device 42. Since the joining strength increases, the joining part 40 is prevented from fracturing. As rolling and trimming are performed, the quality of the joining part 40 is improved.

title: Joining method for striplike metal plate
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the joining strength of a welding junction part by arranging the end part of a striplike metal plate in opposition, providing an alloy filler metal to a joining part as well and rolling the joining part after welding the striplike metal plate. CONSTITUTION:The joining device 16 of a striplike metal plate is composed of a precut device 18, welding equipment 24 and rolling device 32. The striplike metal plate 12 rewound from a roll 12 is cut by the precut device 18 and abutted to the rear end part 22A of a preceding striplike metal plate 22. A filler metal 31 is formed by the metal composing metal plates 10, 22 and the alloy contg. the elements excepting it, arranged at the abutting part of the metal plates 10, 22 and the welding is executed. The welding junction part of the metal plate end parts 10A, 22A is rolled in the rolling device 32 to eliminate the step difference. The joining strength of the joining part is improved because the striplike metal plates 10, 22 are welded via the filler metal 31 and moreover the joining part is subjected to a rolling treatment.

title: Joining device for band-shaped metallic sheet
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the strength at the center in the welded joint part of band-shaped metallic sheets and to prevent the burn-through at both ends of the joint part by forming respective recesses to the center of the opposite surfaces of the clamps of clamping members which press and fix the band-shaped metallic sheets. CONSTITUTION:The front end 10A of the succeeding band-shaped metallic sheet 10 and the rear end 22A of the preceding band-shaped metallic sheet 22 are first cut by cutter blades 20, 20 of a precutting device 18. The front end 10A of the band-shaped metallic sheet 10 and the rear end 22A of the band-shaped metallic sheet 22 are superposed slightly on the front surface of a back bar 31. Cylinders 29... are then extended and the band-shaped metallic sheet 10 is pressed and fixed by the clamps 26. The band-shaped metallic sheet 22 is pressed and fixed by the clamps 28. The slightly superposed parts of the band-shaped metallic sheets are then welded and joined by a welding torch 3. The recesses 26A and recesses 28A are formed in the central parts of the surfaces facing each other of the clamps 6 and the clamps 28 in this case and, therefore, the escape of the heat energy at the center of the band-shaped metallic sheets is suppressed in the parts of both the recesses 26A, 28A and the penetration of welding is well executed even at the center of the band-shaped metallic sheets.

title: Device for joining band-shaped metallic sheet
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the generation of holing and unwelded parts which are the cause for the degradation in the strength of the joint part of band-shaped metallic sheets by forming the pressing surfaces of clamping members which press the band-shaped metallic sheets as rough surfaces. CONSTITUTION:The front end 10A of the succeeding band-shaped metallic sheet 10 and the rear end 22A of the preceding band-shaped metallic sheet 22 are first cut by cutter blades 20, 20 of a precutting device 18. The front end 10A of the band-shaped metallic sheet 10 and the rear end 22A of the band-shaped metallic sheet 22 are superposed slightly on the front surface of a back bar 31. Cylinders 29,... are then extended and the band-shaped metallic sheet 10 is pressed and fixed by the clamps 26. The band-shaped metallic sheet 22 is pressed and fixed by the clamps 28. The slightly superposed parts of the band-shaped metallic sheets are then welded and joined by a welding torch 30. The bottom ends of the clamps 26 and the clamps 28 are formed as rough surfaces by knurling, etc., and, therefore, the band-shaped metallic sheet 10 and the band-shaped metallic sheet 22 are surely held by the clamps 26 and 28. The set size of the superposed part does not change even if the ends of the metallic sheets 10 and 26 are expanded by the heat at the time of welding. The joining of the slightly superposed part by welding is, therefore, possible.

title: ベルトユニットの取り付け構造
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  ベルトユニットの各ローラのアライメント誤 差による無端ベルトの横ずれを容易に解消できると共 に、無端ベルトの横ずれ解消を作業工数の増加や部品点 数の増加、あるいは無端ベルトの耐久性低下等を招くこ となく、低コストで実現できる簡素な構成のベルトユニ ットの取り付け構造を提供する。
【解決手段】  ユニットフレーム９に支持された複数の ローラ５、６、７、８間に無端ベルト４を架設してなる ベルトユニット３を装置本体１のフレーム２に位置決め 支持するベルトユニット３の取り付け構造において、上 記ベルトユニット３のユニットフレーム９を上記装置本 体フレーム２に対して、その一側を上記無端ベルト４を 架設する両端のローラ５、６のローラ軸１０、１５を各 々第１支持部１２及び第２支持部１４の２か所で支持す ると共に、他側を第３支持部１７の１か所で支持してな るベルトユニットの取り付け構造。

title: 電池用巻回体の巻回装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】正極板と負極板とがセパレータを介装して巻回 される巻回体を、緩みを生ずることなく円滑かつ高精度 に得るとともに、構成の簡素化を容易に可能にする。
【解決手段】巻き込み機構３０は、巻軸２２に正極板１ ０と負極板１２とがセパレータ１４ａ、１４ｂを介装し て巻回された巻回体１６を、切断機構２６からテープ貼 付機構２８に移行する途上で回転する際に、この巻回体 １６の周面に常時接して巻き込み用摩擦抵抗を付与する 抵抗付与手段４４を備える。

title: キャップ
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  少ないスペースで運搬や保管等ができ、内側 に取り付けられた閉塞部材の運搬過程等での脱落、破断 を防止できるキャップを得る。
【解決手段】  容器の取出口に装着される装着円筒部２ ０の軸方向一端に、装着円筒部２０の内径Ｌ１よりも大 きな外径Ｌ２を有する固着円筒部２６が形成されてい る。複数のキャップ１０を装着円筒部２０の軸方向に並 べた状態で、固着円筒部２６が装着円筒部２０の内側に 入り込み、装着円筒部２０の内面２０Ａが固着円筒部２ ６の外面２６Ａに圧着する。複数のキャップ１０は隙間 なく軸方向に並び、さらに、１つのキャップ１０の装着 円筒部２０と、別のキャップ１０の固着円筒部２６とが 部分的に重なるので、少ないスペースで運搬や保管等が できる。軸方向両端以外のキャップ１０のパッキン１２ は、軸方向両側のキャップ１０によって保護され、脱落 や損傷が防止される。

title: ウエブ接合方法及び装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】狭小な作業スペース内で使用済みのロールと新 たなロールとを簡単かつ確実に接合するとともに、ウエ ブの損傷や蛇行等を有効に阻止する。
【解決手段】第１及び第２ロール２６、２８が装着され て一体的に旋回自在な第１及び第２旋回軸３０、３２ と、この第１及び第２旋回軸３０、３２と一体的に旋回 するとともに、前記第１及び第２ロール２６、２８の第 １及び第２ウエブ２６ａ、２８ａを把持可能な第１及び 第２把持機構４２、４４と、接合位置Ｐ３に繰り出され た第１ウエブ２６ａを切断する切断機構７６と、この第 １ウエブ２６ａと第２ウエブ２８ａとを接合するための 両面テープ７８を供給するテープ供給機構８０とを備え る。

title: シート体の巻回装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】簡単な構成で、高品質な渦巻体を円滑に製造し 得るとともに、巻軸の損傷を有効に回避することを可能 にする。
【解決手段】巻回装置１０は、巻軸１２を備え、この巻 軸１２には、第１スリット２０と第２スリット２４とが 互いに直交して軸方向に延在して設けられる。第１スリ ット２０には、電池構成体３０が挿入される一方、第２ スリット２４が巻軸１２を縮径させる機能を有してお り、前記巻軸１２を、支持ピン１８から離脱させる際に 全周にわたり均一に縮径することができる。

title: シート材固定装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  回転部材周面への固定部材の装着を確実に解 除できるシート材固定装置を得る。
【解決手段】  駆動面７４及び回転面１００が前後方向 （回転ドラム周方向）に平行となる回転位置に昇降フレ ームのソケット７２が後端チャック３６の装着レバー９ ６を回転させることで後端チャック３６が回転ドラム周 面に装着される一方、駆動面７４及び回転面１００が左 右方向に平行となる回転位置にソケット７２が装着レバ ー９６を回転させることで後端チャック３６の回転ドラ ム周面への装着が解除される。このため、回転ドラム周 面に装着された後端チャック３６に昇降フレームが接近 した際に駆動面７４が回転面１００に係合しない場合で も、回転ドラムを周方向へ回転させるのみで駆動面７４ を回転面１００に係合させることができ、回転ドラム周 面への後端チャック３６の装着を確実に解除できる。

title: パトローネの装填方法および装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】ケース内にパトローネを円滑に且つ確実に挿入 するとともに、ケースの小型化を図ることにある。
【解決手段】パトローネ装填機構２２は、四角形状のケ ース１８を回転不能に保持するケース保持手段６０と、 パトローネ１４を回転不能に保持してケース１８内に挿 入するパトローネ保持手段６２と、パトローネ１４を案 内し、パトローネ１４がケース１８内に移送される際に 回転してパトローネ１４の外周に定寸フイルム１２の端 部１２ａを保持するガイド筒体６４を有するガイド手段 ６６とを備える。パトローネ１４は、そのポート部１５ がケース１８の内側角部１９に対応した位置に規制され るとともに、ガイド筒体６４の下端に設けられた筒状突 出部１００によってさらに案内されてケース１８内に挿 入される。

title: ウエブの突き合わせ接合方法及び装置

title: 連発式クリップ処置具
abstract: 【課題】複数のクリップを使用する際に、生体内の体腔などに挿入されて湾曲している内視鏡の鉗子口に挿入されても、クリップを常時安定してクリップ処置動作可能な状態に正確に準備できる連発式クリップ処置具を提供する。 【解決手段】前のクリップの後端に後のクリップの先端が係合することにより連結した複数のクリップおよび最後尾のクリップに連結した接続部材からなるクリップ列と、複数のクリップのクリップ列が装填されるシースと、シース内に移動可能に配置され、その先端が接続部材に着脱可能に接続されて複数のクリップの前記クリップ列を牽引する操作ワイヤと、シースの基端側に設けられ、シースと操作ワイヤとを相対的に所定長ずつ段階的に移動させるための操作部とを備え、操作部は、さらに、シースと操作ワイヤとを相対的に所定長未満だけ微調する微調整手段を有することにより、前記課題を解決する。 【選択図】図５

title: 連発式クリップ処置具
abstract: 【課題】連結して装填されるクリップの連結状態を確実に維持することができ、かつ、先頭クリップによる十分な締め付け力でのクリップ処置と、先頭クリップの切り離し（連結解除）とを、一方向への一連の操作で、同時に行うことのできる連発式クリップ処置具を提供する。 【解決手段】クリップの係合部を覆ってクリップの連結状態を維持する連結リングを備え、この連結リングが、次のクリップの２つの爪部が先のクリップの尾部を挟んで閉じた状態で、次のクリップを保持する連結保持領域を有し、連結保持領域のクリップの進退方向の長さを、連結リング先端部の締付部による締め付けにより、先のクリップの爪部が最大勘合力を発揮する位置までの、締付部の移動量に等しくすることにより、上記課題を解決する。 【選択図】図３

title: 連発式クリップ処置具
abstract: 【課題】安定してクリップをクリップ処置動作可能な状態にできる連発式クリップ処置具を提供することにある。 【解決手段】前のクリップの後端に後のクリップの先端が係合することにより連結した複数のクリップおよび最後尾のクリップに連結した接続部材からなるクリップ列と、前記複数のクリップの前記クリップ列が装填されるシースと、前記シース内に移動可能に配置され、その先端が前記接続部材に着脱可能に接続されて前記複数のクリップの前記クリップ列を牽引する操作ワイヤと、前記シースの基端側に設けられ、前記シースに対し前記操作ワイヤを相対的に所定長ずつ段階的に移動させるための操作部とを備え、前記操作部は、さらに、前記シースと前記操作ワイヤとを相対的に前記所定長未満だけ微調する微調整手段を有することにより、前記課題を解決する。 【選択図】図９

title: Probe assembly for ion activity measuring apparatus
abstract: PURPOSE:To measure ion activity in a solution with limited noise by spotting a solution to be inspected on an ion selective electrode while an impedance lowering means is provided near a probe for detecting the potential difference thereof. CONSTITUTION:A reference solution is spotted on the side A at one end of ion selective electrodes 3.1A and 3.1B, 3.2A and 3.2B and 3.3A and 3.3B while a solution to be inspected done on the side B at the other end thereof and connected with a bridge. Pairs of probes 11A and 11B, 12A a and 12B and 13A and 13B are brought into contact with the reference solution and a solution to be inspected on both sides of these electrodes and the potential difference is detected between the reference solution and the solution being inspected. A circuit board 15 as electric impedance lowering means is provided near the probes 11A, 11B-13A and 13B to amplify a potential difference signal. In this manner, Na, K and Cl ions are measured selectively separately with the electrodes 3.1A-3.3B, for instance. Thus, as the circuit board 15 is provided near the probes, ion activity in the solition can be measured at a high accuracy with limited noise.

title: Measuring apparatus of ion activity
abstract: PURPOSE:To measure the ion activity with high accuracy, by providing >=1 pair of solid-state ion selective electrodes on the first supporting body and providing a bridge capable of migrating ions between the electrodes by cross-linking between a pair of said ion selective electrodes on the second supporting body and opposing and bringing both supporting bodies close to each other. CONSTITUTION:A pair of ion selective electrodes is provided on the first supporting body 60, and liquid storing parts 28, 29 for maintaining a standard solution and a sample liquid to be inspected on a imperforated hydrophobic layer are formed on the electrodes 10, 10' made of polyester, etc. On the other hand, holes 62, 63 fitting accurately to the parts 28, 29 are formed on a bridge 20 formed of a porous member on the body 61. The bodies 60 and 61 are engaged with e.g. a hinge 67 and a prescribed liquid is introduced into the parts 28, 29. Thereafter, the body 60 is brought into contact with the body 62 and the measurement of ion activity is performed by using an electrometer 51, etc. Different ion activities may be measured continuously by providing plural pairs of solid- state electrodes and the bridges to long-sized supporting bodies 60, 61 and drawing out of housings 68, 69. In this manner, many measurements are made possible quickly and accurately.

title: Measurement of liquid
abstract: PURPOSE:To realize a highly accurate and short time measurement and secure a wide measuring range by making a fuzzy inference from the flow rate characteristics of an opening regulating valve for limiting the flow rate of a liquid and a measurement set value, determining the initial opening of the valve before the initiation of the measurement and conducting a fuzzy control on the basis of the actual measurement. CONSTITUTION:When a measurement setting value is given to a measurement controller 1, the initial opening of an opening regulating valve 6 is calculated by fuzzy inference from the flow rate characteristics of the valve 6 and a liquid flows out from a measuring tank 8 by an instruction from the controller 1. The actual weight value of a load cell 2 charges. The controller 1 measures the actual weight value from a gravimeter amplifier 3 at prescribed control periods and calculates a deviation between the measurement set value and the actual weight value and the quantity of temporal change in the deviation. When an observation resulting from the low-pass filter processing of those quantities is calculated, the inferential calculation of the opening of the valve 6 is conducted on the basis of a fuzzy rule. Thus, the valve 6 is controlled so as to take the suitable opening, the infection of a backlash or the like is absorbed and highly accurate measurement can be performed.

title: Liquid weighing and mixing apparatus
abstract: PURPOSE:To perform a wide range of weighing within a short time with high accuracy, by a method wherein opening degree control valves are respectively provided to a plurality of supply containers while a liquid amount detector is provided to a liquid receiving container to control the opening degree control valves on the basis of an actually weighed value and a weighing set value. CONSTITUTION:For example, in a system for weighing and mixing two kinds of liquids, when a manufacturing condition is indicated to a weighing control apparatus 3, a weighing set value is set and valves 9, 19, 10 are changed over to a weighing system line. When a stopper valve 8 is opened and an opening degree control valve 7 is adjusted to a predetermined opening degree, the raw material of a tank 1 is transferred to a tank 2 and the wt. of the transferred raw material is detected by the load cell 4 of the tank 2 and the value thereof is fed back to the weighing control apparatus 3 through a load cell amplifier 5. The control apparatus 3 operates the deviation between the actual wt. value and the set value and the timewise change quantity of the deviation to issue a new opening degree order to the next control cycle. A tank 11 is also controlled in the same way.

title: Liquid weighing and mixing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To weigh and mix plural raw liqs. by using a closed-loop weighing controller for changing the flow velocity of the liqs., and controlling the weighing controller based on fuzzy logic reasoning. CONSTITUTION:When two kinds of liqs. are weighed and mixed, for example, a weighing set value is set to the weighing controller 3. When the start of weighing is indicated, an opening adjusting valve 7 is controlled to the estimated opening by the weighing controller 3, and the flowing out of a raw material is started. In this case, the initial opening of the opening adjusting valve 7 is calculated from the flow rate characteristic of the valve and the weighing set value based on fuzzy logic reasoning. The raw material in a tank 1 is transferred to a tank 2, and the weight of the material is detected by a load cell 4 and fed back to the weighing controller 3. The opening is operated from the actual weight value by the weighing controller 3 based on fuzzy logic reasoning, and the appropriate opening of the valve is obtained in the succeeding control cycle. When the weighing deviation is reduced after the weighing is started, the opening of the opening adjusting valve 7 is reduced, and the weighing is discontinued when the opening is reduced to lower than a certain value. Weighing is switched to a tank 11, and weighing is carried out in the same way.

title: Method and instrument for measuring ion activity
abstract: PURPOSE:To measure the activity of one kind or plural kinds of ions by using one measuring instrument, by respectively applying a reference liquid and a liquid to be inspected to the surfaces of the ion selection layers of at least a pair of sheet like ion selection electrodes separated electrically to each other. CONSTITUTION:Sheet like ion selection layers 115, liquid imparting parts for imparting a reference liquid and a liquid to be inspected to the surfaces of respective selection layers 115 and a bridge 19 for bringing both liquids to a mutually electrical continuity state are provided to the uppermost part. The electrodes 11a-11c are arranged so as to direct the selection layers 115 to the downside and the reference liquid and the liquid to be inspected imparted from above is once moved to the parts below the surfaces of the selection layers 115. Thereafter, said liquids are raised to the surface positions of the selection layers 115 from the surfaces of the selection layers 115 through liquid rising guide passages 15a-15c of which the top parts of the side walls are set apart so as to have a gap accompanying no generation of a capillary phenomenon to the surfaces of the selection layers 115 to impart both liquids to the surfaces of the selection layers 115. Subsequently, the potential difference between electrodes 11a-11c is measured in such a state that both liquids are brought to a mutually electrical continuity state by the bridge 19.

title: Instrument for measuring ionic activity
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a measuring instrument which can be easily produced and can measure always exactly ionic activity by adhering the end edge of the ion selective electrode layer of an ion selecting electrode pair to the upper part of a supporting plate. CONSTITUTION:The measuring instrument is constituted of the ion selecting electrode pair 20 consisting of a pair of ion selecting electrodes 21, 22 disposed on the supporting plate 10 and a porous bridge 50 which conducts electrically the sample liquid and reference liquid spotted respectively to both electrodes 21, 22. The end edge of at least the ion selective electrode layer of the electrode pair 20 is adhered by an adhesive agent 30 to the upper part of the plate 10. The reference electrode and sample electrode arrive respectively at the electrodes 21 and 22 when the reference electrode having the known activity of ions and the sample liquid having the unknown activity are respectively spotted to spotting holes 41 and 42. On the other hand, the boundary faces of both liquids contact with each other to establish the electrical conduction therebetween the therefore the potential difference corresponding to the difference of the ionic activity between the reference liquid and the sample liquid is generated near the center of the bridge 50. The ionic activity in the sample liquid is calculated if the potential difference is measured.

title: Method of and apparatus for measuring electrolyte
abstract: When determining an activity of particular predetermined ions in a sample liquid by use of a device for measuring ionic activity including a pair of ion-selective electrodes which are selectively responsive to particular predetermined ions, a pair of spotting holes through which a sample liquid and a reference liquid are respectively supplied to the ion-selective electrodes and a porous bridge which communicates the spotting holes with each other so as to permit the sample liquid and the reference liquid spotted to the spotting holes to electrically contact with each other, for instance, the sample liquid is first spotted to one of the spotting holes of the device for measuring ionic activity with a first spotting tool, and at least one of the first spotting tool and the device for measuring ionic activity is thereafter moved to remove the first spotting tool away from the device for measuring ionic activity. Then the reference liquid is spotted to the other spotting hole of the device for measuring ionic activity with a second spotting tool within a predetermined time after the sample liquid is spotted to the spotting hole.

title: Method and element for dry analysis
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To analyze a substance to be inspected, simply, quickly and with high accuracy by the substitution and discharge reaction of the substance to be inspected (e.g. an antigen), a labeling specific binding substance (e.g. an antibody) and a weak affinity substance [e.g. a substance whose affinity is weaker than that of the antigen and which is bound to a specific binding substance (an antigen)] with a complex. SOLUTION: A weak affinity substance is immobilized to a detecting layer 14, a labeling specific binding substance is bound in advance to it, and a complex is formed. A water absorbing layer 12 is formed under the detecting layer. Only when a liquid sample which contains substance to be inspected is inspected, a substitution and discharge reaction progresses inside the detecting layer, and the discharged labeling specific binding substance is moved to the water absorbing layer so as to be removed due to the diffusion and the movement of the liquid sample inside this analytical element. As a result, a cleaning operation or the like is not required. The amount of the labeling specific binding substance which is left in the detecting layer according to the amount of the substance to be inspected can be measured easily on the basis of the absorption of labeling coloring particles.  Also the amount of the labeling specific binding substance which is shifted to the water absorbing layer can be detected. Since the substance to be inspected is analyzed by the dry analytical element, it can deal easily with a small measuring apparatus.

title: Simple checking jig for analyzer for measuring ion activity
abstract: PURPOSE:To permit simple checking of whether an analyzer for measuring ion activity is normal or not by use of a checking jig by providing a conductor (metallic plate) between two sheets of supports, thereby constituting the checking jib. CONSTITUTION:A slide provided with an ion selective electrode or the like is mounted on the analyzer for measuring the ion activity and measurement is made at the time of measuring the ion activity. The checking jib 1 is mounted in place of the slide on the analyzer in order to check the normal condition of said analyzer. The jig 1 is formed to the same outside dimensions as the outside dimensions of the slide and constituted by providing an upper mount 2 and a lower mount 3 as the supports and fixing the metallic plate 4 therebetween. Probes for measuring a potential difference are raised and penetrated through holes 3a-3f of the lower mount 3 and are brought into contact with the plate 4 to short circuit the plate. The short circuited potential difference between the probes decreases to zero if an electric circuit is normal at this time. Since the zero potential difference between the probes is detected by the checking jib, the simple checking of whether the analyzer is normal or not is permitted.

title: Liquid/powder measuring, mixing and distributing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve measuring accuracy and to simplify its facilities by using the measurement controller of a closed loop which make a flow velocity variable, performing a control based on a fuzzy inference, and performing the measurement mixing and measurement distribution with a single measurement controller. CONSTITUTION:Using a measurement controller 44 to perform a closed loop control which makes the flow velocity variable, and by the control system of the fuzzy inference, a switching device 46 controls the revolution of screw feeder 32 of plural flowrate regulator corresponding to the number of supplying containers, a closedown valve 2N of an opening damper, an opening regulating valve 11, etc., and makes a granule backflow velocity variable. Further, liquid, powder, mixed liquid of the liquid and the powder, which are shifted to a mixing container 40, are measured by a detector 42 arranged at the mixing container 40, and the liquid or the powder in the supplying container is measured by an adding measurement using one measurement controller 44, and when the mixed liquid is shifted to the distribution container, it is measured by a subtracting measurement using the device 44.

title: Ion activity measuring instrument
abstract: PURPOSE:To facilitate manufacturing, by respectively communicating two ion selection electrodes each of which has a pair of liquid dripping holes arranged in parallel. CONSTITUTION:An ion selection electrode pair 201 is set as an Na<+> ion while an ion selection electrode pair 202 as a K<+> ion and, when a reference solution, of which the ion activity is known, is dripped to a liquid dripping hole 410 and an unknown specimen solution to a liquid dripping hole 420, the reference solution is distributed to liquid supply holes 321, 322 to be supplied to the ion selection layer of each electrode while the interface of the reference solution and the specimen solution is contacted with a porous bridge 500 in the vicinity of the center thereof to form liquid communication. As a result, because potential difference corresponding to the difference between ion activities of Na<+> and K<+> between the reference solution and the specimen solution is respectively generated not only between electrodes 211, 211 but also between electrodes 212, 222, measuring probes are inserted in measuring probe insert holes 461, 462, 471, 472 to be contacted with the electrodes to measure potential difference. By this method, the ion activity in the specimen solution can be measured.

title: Ion activity measuring instrument
abstract: PURPOSE:To enable accurate measurement, by providing liquid supply holes respectively communicated with the electrodes of an ion selection electrode pair while providing liquid dripping parts respectively communicated with said liquid supply holes. CONSTITUTION:It is assumed that an ion selection electrode pair 20 responds to certain specific ions and, if a reference solution, of which the ion activity is known, is dripped to a liquid dripping part 53 and a specimen solution, of which the ion activity is unknown, is dripped to a liquid dripping part 54, the reference solution is supplied to a liquid supply hole 31 and the specimen solution to a liquid supply hole 32. The interface of the reference solution and the specimen solution is communicated with a porous bridge 60 in the vicinity of the center thereof. As a result, because potential difference corresponding to the ion activities between the reference solution and the specimen solution is generated between the ion selection electrodes 21, 22, measuring probes are inserted in measuring probe insert holes 56, 57 to be contacted with both electrodes and the ion activity in the specimen solution can be measured.

title: Ion activity measuring apparatus
abstract: PURPOSE:To shorten the arrival time of a liquid at an electrode surface, by sticking at least one of the ends of a distribution member downwared below a liquid supply port to permeate the liquid from the side of the end. CONSTITUTION:When, for example, three types of reference liquids each with the known ion activity spotted at liquid spotting hole 510 and a sample liquid is spotted at a liquid spotting hole 520, the reference liquids permeate into porous liquid distributing members 410A and 410B to be distributed into liquid receiving holes 311-313 while the sample liquid permeates into porous liquid distributing members 420A and 420B to be distributed into liquid receiving holes 321-323. Here, as the members 410A and 410B are separated with a clearance 430 while the members 420A and 420B are done with a clearance 440, the liquid are fed to end faces of the members through these clearances. After the distribution of the liquids into respective liquid receiving holes, potential differences which will be generated due to differences of ion activities between ion selection electrodes 211 and 221, 212 and 222 and 213 and 233 is measured. This can shorten the arrival time of the liquids at the electrode surface thereby eliminating the possibility of hemolysis of the whole blood sample liquid.

title: Simple inspection device for analyzer for ionic activity measurement
abstract: A simple inspection device is constituted for inspection of an analyzer for measuring ionic activity by using an ionic activity measuring device provided with at least one ion selective electrode pair for generating an electrical potential corresponding to ionic activity of a predetermined ion, and a porous bridge for associating the electrodes of the ion selective electrode pair with each other, and by contacting potential difference measuring probes respectively with the electrodes of the ion selective electrode pair, to thereby measure a difference in potential between the electrodes. The simple inspection device employs a supporting member having outer dimensions approximately equal to the outer dimensions of the ionic activity measuring device, and an electrically conductive member supported on the supporting member for short-circuiting across the potential difference measuring probes when the potential difference measuring probes are contacted with the electrically conductive member.

title: Method and apparatus for measuring, mixing and distributing liquid
abstract: PURPOSE:To realize an improvement of measurement accuracy, an enlarge ment of measurement range, and a shortening and fixing of measurement time by carrying out a fuzzy inference etc., based on observed values obtained in the course of measurement and by varying sequentially a flow rate of a liquid to be measured with a special flow rate control valve. CONSTITUTION:In a closed loop control method for measurement of a liquid, a fuzzy control, a learning control or an optimal control of a liquid to be measured with a flow rate control valve 7 is carried out based on observed values of deviations and their differentials with respect to time between measurement values set arbitrarily beforehand and those really measured with measurement sensors 4 weighing the liquid. As the flow rate control valve 7, a control valve driven by a motor 11, which has a property of small and linear flow rate change with respect to a valve lift and, furthermore, a large maximum allowable flow rate, is used. It becomes possible, as a results, to shorten a measurement time while keeping an accuracy of measurement and to carry out a wide range measurement without being influenced by flow rate fluctuations due to disturbances.

title: Analysis element used for inspection method of specimen
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an analysis element used for a blood inspection method that can be operated easily and is capable of measurement rapidly.  <P>SOLUTION: The multiple item measurement dry analysis element is used for a specimen inspection method for obtaining measurement results from information on 1,000 pixels or higher for one item and measuring a plurality of items simultaneously, by using an area sensor as a detector.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Analysis method and device
abstract:
The purpose of the present invention is to improve the processing capacity of an analysis device wherein, as reaction containers are successively switched out, specimen spots deposited therein are analyzed one after another.
