title: 血液検査キット及び血液分析方法
abstract: 本発明の課題は、採血量の可視化及び一定化を図ることによって微量血液での血液検査を高精度で行うことができる、血液検査キット及び血液分析方法を提供することである。本発明によれば、血液検体の成分を希釈するための希釈液と、血液検体の成分及び希釈液を収容するための少なくとも１つの透明容器とを含む血液検査キットであって、血液検体の成分及び希釈液の液量を測定するための目盛りが、血液検査キットに含まれる少なくとも1つの構成要素に付与された、血液検査キットが提供される。

title: Blood test kit, its component and their manufacture method
abstract: The problem of the present invention carries out the analysis of object component being contained in micro blood sample with high precision in the standard analysis being present in using permanent property in blood.The present invention provides a kind of blood test kit, it includes：Dilution, for dilute blood sample；And component, selected from the first accommodation tool including accommodating the dilution, for being separated and recovered from the separator of blood plasma in the blood sample after with the diluted, for keeping the holder of the separator, second accommodation tool of the blood plasma recycled for receiving and the group for the blood plasma accommodated to be maintained to the sealing appliance in the second accommodation tool, standard analysis that the blood test kit is present in blood using permanent property analyzes the concentration of the object component in blood sample, the blood test kit is characterized in that, define the amount for the standard analysis for coming from the component that may be included in the dilution.

title: Blood test kit and blood analysis method
abstract: An object of the present invention is to provide a blood test kit and a blood analysis method capable of performing a blood test with a small amount of blood at high accuracy by visualizing a volume of blood collection and keeping the volume constant. According to the present invention, a blood test kit including a diluent solution for diluting components of a blood sample; and at least one transparent container for storing the components of the blood sample and the diluent solution, in which at least one constituent component included in the blood test kit is marked with a graduation for measuring the components of the blood sample and a liquid volume of the diluent solution, is provided.

title: Blood analysis method and blood test kit
abstract: An object of the present invention is to provide a blood analysis method and a blood test kit, which are for performing quantitative analysis of components by precisely obtaining a dilution factor. According to the present invention, provided is a blood analysis method including: a step of diluting a collected blood sample with a diluent solution; a step of determining a dilution factor by using a normal value of a normal component which is homeostatically present in blood; and a step of analyzing a concentration of a target component in the blood sample, in which the blood analysis method uses a member selected from the group consisting of a first storing instrument for storing the diluent solution, a collection instrument for collecting the blood, a separation instrument for separating and recovering blood plasma from the blood sample diluted with the diluent solution, a holding instrument for holding the separation instrument, and a second storing instrument for storing the recovered blood plasma, and in which the dilution factor is corrected after calculating in advance an amount of the normal component derived from the diluent solution, and/or an amount of the normal component derived from at least one of the members which may be contained in the diluent solution.

title: 血液分析方法及血液检查试剂盒
abstract: 本发明的课题在于提供一种准确地求出稀释倍率并进行成分的定量分析的血液分析方法及血液检查试剂盒。根据本发明，血液分析方法包括：用稀释液来稀释所采集的血液样本的工序；使用恒久性地存在于血液中的标准成分的标准值来确定稀释倍率的工序；分析血液样本中的对象成分的浓度的工序，血液分析方法是使用选自包括第1容纳器具，容纳有稀释液；分离器具，用于从用所述稀释液稀释后的血液样本中分离并回收血浆；保持器具，用于保持所述分离器具；第2容纳器具，用于容纳所回收的血浆；及密封器具，用于将所收容的血浆维持在第2容纳器具内的组中的部件的血液分析方法，稀释液是将源于稀释液及/或部件的可包含于稀释液中的标准成分的量进行了规定的稀释液，血液样本的容量为50μL以下，血液样本中的血浆成分的稀释倍率为14倍以上。

title: Evaluation method of test substance
abstract: The present invention addresses the problem of providing an evaluation method of a test substance using an M cell model similar to M cells in a living human body. Provided is an evaluation method of a test substance, the method including: preparing intestinal epithelial cells containing M cells from intestinal stem cells induced from induced pluripotent stem cells; co-culturing lymphocytes with the intestinal epithelial cells containing the M cells; bringing the M cells into contact with the test substance having a diameter of 0.3 μm or greater; and evaluating the uptake of the test substance by the M cells and discharge of the same from the M cells.

title: Liquid ejection head and its manufacturing method
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a liquid ejection head which can fulfill properties particularly required by a three-dimensional structure such as corrosion resistance, affinity in a deposition method, liquid-philicity, rigidity, etc. by forming all or part of the three-dimensional structure having space such as a pressure chamber filled with liquid by the deposition method.  <P>SOLUTION: The liquid ejection head has the three-dimensional structure including a pressure chamber partition wall 94 between a diaphragm 90 formed of stainless steel (SUS430) and a nozzle plate 92 formed of nickel (Ni), and a piezoelectric element 96 for changing the volume of the pressure chamber by driving the diaphragm 90. In the liquid ejection head, the pressure chamber partition wall 94 is formed by an aerosol deposition method for depositing two or more kinds of powder raw materials on the diaphragm 90. Particularly, the compositions of the powder raw materials to be deposited are gradually changed from SUS430 to Ni, thereby improving the affinity between the pressure chamber partition wall 94 and the diaphragm 90 and improving the affinity between the pressure chamber partition wall 94 and the nozzle plate 92.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Liquid-droplet discharging head, manufacturing method of the same head and liquid-droplet discharging device
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a manufacturing method of a liquid-droplet discharging head which can realize a high-resolution and miniaturization, a liquid-droplet discharging head manufactured by the same method and a liquid-droplet discharging device equipped with the same head.  <P>SOLUTION: The liquid-droplet discharging head 32 is equipped with a nozzle 56 discharging the liquid droplet, a pressure chamber 50 communicated with the nozzle 56 and filled with liquid, a diaphragm 48 composing a part of the pressure chamber 50, a pool chamber 38 pooling the liquid which is fed into the pressure chamber 50 through passages 66, 68 and, a piezoelectric element 46 making the diaphragm 48 displaced. While the diaphragm 48 is provided on a supporting substrate 76, the diaphragm 48 is provided with the piezoelectric element 46 and a panel 40 equipped with wiring 90 is provided to the diaphragm 48. After a passage substrate 72 where the pressure chamber 50 has been formed is joined to a piezoelectric element substrate 70 which is formed by separating the supporting substrate 76 from the diaphragm 48. The liquid-droplet discharging head 32 manufactured by the same method and the liquid discharging device 10 equipped with the liquid-droplet head 32 are provided.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Fluid drop ejection system capable of removing dissolved gas from fluid
abstract: A drop ejection system includes a drop ejection head and a reservoir. An air pump produces a partial vacuum above a fluid body in the reservoir to remove dissolved air or vapor in the fluid.

title: Liquid ejection head and image forming apparatus
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable high-frequency driving by realizing densification while enhancing rigidity of a bulkhead of a pressure chamber and accomplishing high-speed ejection and high-speed refilling.  <P>SOLUTION: Characteristically, a liquid ejection head comprises a nozzle for ejecting a liquid, a pressure chamber which communicates with the nozzle, a common liquid chamber for supplying a liquid to the pressure chamber, a piezoelectric element for deforming the pressure chamber, and a liquid supply passage for making the common liquid chamber communicate with the pressure chamber; and the liquid supply passage is formed in such a manner as to pass through an active part of the piezoelectric element.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Liquid ejection apparatus
abstract: The liquid ejection apparatus comprises: a nozzle through which liquid is ejected; a pressure chamber which accommodates the liquid to be ejected from the nozzle; a supply side flow path which fills the liquid from a supply system into the pressure chamber; an actuator which is provided on at least one wall of the pressure chamber and changes a volume of the pressure chamber; and a drive signal generating device which generates a drive signal including at least a first drive signal having a time period T 1  which drives the actuator so as to expand the pressure chamber, and a second drive signal having a time period T 2  which drives the actuator so as to contract the pressure chamber, wherein: a relationship between the time period T 2  of the second drive signal and a Helmholtz period Tc of the pressure chamber satisfies T 2 ≦Tc/2; and when the actuator is operated by means of the drive signal to generate, in the nozzle, a pressure having a prescribed cycle in which a negative pressure acting in a direction which causes the pressure chamber to expand, and a positive pressure acting in a direction which causes the pressure chamber to contract arise alternately, a relationship between an absolute value of a first negative pressure Pn 1  generated initially from a static meniscus state of the liquid in the nozzle and an absolute value of a second negative pressure Pn 2  generated one cycle after the first negative pressure, satisfies |Pn 1 |≦|Pn 2|.

title: Liquid discharging head, method for manufacturing it and image forming apparatus equipped with this
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To realize high-density nozzles, to prevent the lowering of yield caused by breakage or the like of a piezoelectric body or the like, and to improve the productivity.  <P>SOLUTION: A method for manufacturing a liquid discharging head comprises a process for forming a resist layer on a vibration plate on which a piezoelectric element is formed, an electric wiring forming process wherein the resist layer located on a predetermined position on the piezoelectric element is removed, a hole approximately vertically to the piezoelectric element reaching the piezoelectric element is opened, and an electric wiring for feeding a driving signal to the piezoelectric element is formed in the hole, and a common liquid room forming process wherein after the electric wiring is bonded to a wiring board, by removing the resist layer, as a space in which the electric wiring is approximately vertically stood to the piezoelectric element and formed between the vibration plate and the wiring board, a common liquid room for feeding a liquid to a pressure room is formed.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Liquid ejection head
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a liquid ejection head having a wiring structure suitable for a liquid ejection head where drive elements are arranged two-dimensionally with high density.  <P>SOLUTION: The liquid ejection head comprises a flexible substrate 100 on which a wiring pattern 102 for transmitting a drive signal to actuators 58 arranged two-dimensionally is formed wherein the end face 110 of the flexible substrate 100 is formed to make an oblique angle α against a wiring layer 104, and each wiring pattern 102 is taken out directly from the end face 110 and bonded to each individual electrode 57 of the actuator 58. Since each wiring pattern 102 is taken out from the end face, wiring of the flexible substrate 100 can be omitted in the vertical direction and high density wiring of the flexible substrate 100 is realized. In case of a print head constituting of a plurality of heads, respective heads can be arranged in proximity to each other because the flexible substrate 100 is arranged obliquely to the actuator arranging face 50A of the print head 50.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Piezoelectric element, and droplet discharge head and device
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a piezoelectric element which can prevent time-lapse deterioration under a high temperature and high humidity, and to provide a droplet discharge head and a droplet discharge device using the droplet discharge head.  <P>SOLUTION: The piezoelectric element comprises a piezoelectric layer 156, a first electrode layer 158 on a high potential-side which is arranged by bringing it into contact with one face side of the piezoelectric layer 156, and a second electrode layer 160 of a low potential-side which is disposed by bringing it into contact with an opposite face side of the piezoelectric layer 156. The first electrode layer 158 comprises a metal A whose standard electrode potential is higher than 0 V, and a metal B whose standard electrode potential is higher than the metal A. The second electrode layer 160 comprises a metal C whose standard electrode potential is lower than the metal A. It is preferable that the metal A is Ag, or Cu and the metal B is Ir, Pt or Pd.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Liquid ejection head and image forming apparatus
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enhance ejection efficiency of liquid by pressurizing liquid directly through displacement of a piezoelectric element in a specified direction when the liquid is ejected thereby reducing pressure loss.  <P>SOLUTION: The liquid ejection head 50 comprises a pressure chamber 52 communicating with a liquid ejection opening and supplied with liquid from a supply channel, and a piezoelectric element 70 constituting a wall face opposing the ejection opening of the pressure chamber 52. When liquid is ejected, liquid in the pressure chamber is pressurized through displacement of the piezoelectric element in the direction d33, and the gap formed between the partition wall of the pressure chamber and the piezoelectric element is made narrower than that during refill thus increasing fluid resistance of the liquid flowing from the pressure chamber side toward the supply channel side as compared with that during refill.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Liquid discharge head
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a liquid discharge head which absorbs fluctuation in electric connection height, and a thermal expansion difference without hindering drive of a piezoelectric element so as to improve connection reliability.  <P>SOLUTION: The liquid discharge head comprises: a piezoelectric body 58 generating pressure to discharge a liquid; a spacer member 90 to form a space 94 for securing displacement of the piezoelectric body; and an electric connection member 98 provided in the space so as to connect the piezoelectric body and a substrate 92 in which wiring 92 is formed, to each other. The liquid discharge head is characterized in that the Young's modulus of the spacer member satisfies a following formula: σ<SB>min</SB>×L/δL<SB>min</SB>≤E≤σ<SB>max</SB>×L/δL<SB>max</SB>, wherein a range of a pressing force when the piezoelectric body and the substrate are connected to each other via the electric connection member, is σ<SB>min</SB>to σ<SB>max</SB>; a thickness of the spacer member is L; and a range of a compression displacement amount of the spacer member when it is pressed within the range of the pressing force is δL<SB>min</SB>to δ<SB>max</SB>.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Liquid discharge head and its manufacturing process
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a liquid discharge head which can simplify a manufacturing process and assure the reliability of a connection and to provide its manufacturing process.  <P>SOLUTION: A liquid resist is applied so that a piezoelectric element 58 may be covered on a diaphragm 56 in which the piezoelectric element 58 is installed, cured and a resist layer 98 is formed. Further, the resist layer 98 formed on its diaphragm 56 is exposed, and developed. Additionally, the resist covering the movable part 58a and the electric connecting part 58b of the piezoelectric element 58 are divided and removed, and the movable space 100 and the connection space 102 of the piezoelectric element are partitioned and formed in the resist layer 98. After this, the connection space 102 is filled up with a conductive adhesive 108, and the connection with the piezoelectric element 58 is assured. Thereby, an encapsulation is carried out with the perimeter of the piezoelectric element 58 filled with the resist, so that leakage current can be inhibited.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Liquid ejection head, its manufacturing method, and image forming apparatus
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To downsize a liquid ejection head, and to enhance the reliability of high-density wiring.  <P>SOLUTION: In this liquid ejection head with a piezoelectric substance generating pressure for ejecting a liquid, a common liquid chamber is arranged on the other side of a pressure chamber, communicating with a nozzle, in the piezoelectric substance. The liquid ejection head keeps at least five bulkheads of the common liquid chamber are integrally molded from a resin material, has wiring shaped in a groove on the at least two of the five bulkhead surfaces, and a liquid supply channel which communicates with the pressure chamber on the bulkhead on the side of the pressure chamber, and keeps one side of the wiring connected to the piezoelectric substance, and the other side of the wiring connected to an electronic circuit which is arranged on the wall surface of the bulkhead of the common liquid chamber.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Method for manufacturing droplet ejection head and droplet ejection head
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for manufacturing a droplet ejection head superior in water repellent characteristic in the vicinity of a nozzle and having an improved directional property of ejection of droplets, and the droplet ejection head.  <P>SOLUTION: This method for manufacturing the droplet ejection head comprises a first process for bonding a projecting plate 9 for forming a projection on a surface in the vicinity of a nozzle 2a on a nozzle plate 2 to the surface of the nozzle plate 2 on which the nozzle 2a is to be formed, the surface roughness (Rz) of the face 9c to be bonded to the nozzle plate 2 being not greater than 0.4 μm, a second process for bonding a pool plate 3 having a communicating hole 3a to the back surface of the nozzle plate 2, a third process for forming a water-repellent film 10 on each of the surface of the nozzle plate 2 and the side face and the surface of the projection 9a, and a forth process for forming the nozzle 2a on the nozzle plate 2 by drilling the nozzle plate 2 from the back surface side to form a through-hole through the communicating hole 3a.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Liquid ejector and image forming apparatus equipped with it
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To make a liquid ejection head perform individual suction by means of a simple constitution, when the liquid ejection head performs suction.  <P>SOLUTION: This liquid ejector comprises: a plurality of nozzles for ejecting a liquid; a pressure chamber for supplying the liquid to the nozzles; a common liquid chamber for the liquid to each of the pressure chambers; and an individual suction part for sucking in the liquid in the nozzles, when the suction is performed by the some nozzles selected from among the nozzles. When the nozzles suck in the liquid, the liquid ejector satisfies the inequality: P0-ΔPin<Pn. In the inequality, Pn represents pressure in the non-suction nozzle, which is not subjected to the suction by the individual suction part, among the nozzles; and P0-ΔPin represents a threshold value of the pressure in the non-suction nozzle, which prevents air from flowing in from the non-suction nozzle.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Manufacturing method of liquid droplet discharge head
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a manufacturing method of a liquid droplet discharge head by which the droplet discharge head excellent in the adhesiveness of a nozzle plate and a pool plate, excellent in stability of the discharge direction of droplets, and excellent in liquid discharging property during maintenance can be effectively manufactured.  <P>SOLUTION: The liquid droplet discharge head is manufactured by the steps including a first step for connecting a planar shape convex portion plate 9 onto the front face of the nozzle plate 2, a second step for connecting the planar shape pool plate 3 onto the rear face of the nozzle plate 2, a third step for forming convex portion 9a in the periphery of the region where a nozzle 2a of the front face of the nozzle plate 2 is formed, a fourth step for forming the communicating hole 3a communicating with the nozzle 2a in the pool plate 3, a fifth step of forming water repellent film 10 on the front faces of the nozzle plate 2 and the convex portion plate 9, and the sixth step for forming the nozzle 2a by boring the through hole in the nozzle plate 2 through the communication hole 3a of the pool plate side from the rear face of the nozzle plate 2.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title: Droplet discharge head and droplet discharge apparatus
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To make high in the density of electric wirings in a liquid droplet discharging head in which a plurality of piezoelectric bodies are arranged for one nozzle.  <P>SOLUTION: One side 70A of each of the plurality of piezoelectric bodies 70 is electrically connected to a drive circuit 82 in common through the electric wring 72. Thus, the number of wirings connecting the piezoelectric body 70, and the drive circuits 82 and 83 is reduced to about 1/2 of that in constitution where they are all connected individually because it is the number of lines connected in common in addition to lines connected individually. Therefore, the high density of the electric wirings is contrived.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&amp;INPIT

title: Liquid droplet discharging head
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a liquid droplet discharging head which improves the characteristics of fluid crosstalk and refill.SOLUTION: In the liquid droplet discharging head, a liquid droplet discharging part includes a pressure chamber 222 connected to a nozzle 180, a drive element 227 for applying pressure to the liquid, an individual supply channel 221 for supplying the liquid to the pressure chamber, and an individual recovery channel 224 for recovering the liquid in the pressure chamber. The liquid droplet discharging head is also equipped with a common supply channel 212 connected to an individual supply channel 221, and a common recovery channel 214 connected to the individual recovery channel 224 for recovering liquid. A flow channel resistance R1 (Ns/m) of the individual supply channel 221, a flow channel resistance R2 (Ns/m) of the individual recovery channel 224 and a diameter Dn (μm) of the nozzle 180 satisfy the following equations: 3.247×10exp(-0.1717Dn)≤R1≤3.278×10exp(-0.1456Dn), and 3.247×10exp(-0.1717Dn)≤R2≤3.278×10exp(-0.1456Dn).

title: Liquid discharge device and foreign matter discharge method for liquid discharge head
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a liquid discharge device and a foreign matter discharge method for a liquid discharge head capable of efficiently discharging foreign matter existing in an internal flow passage of the liquid discharge head and securing stable discharge performance.SOLUTION: A liquid discharge device includes: each of a plurality of ejectors (22) including a nozzle, a pressure chamber, and a discharge energy generating element; a common flow passage (26) to which each of the plurality of ejectors (22) is connected; and a foreign matter discharge flow passage section (32) to be a flow passage section for discharging foreign matter from the common flow passage (26). A dummy jet is executed to discharge liquid from the nozzle by driving the discharge energy generating element of the ejector (22) in the order of a farther distance from the foreign matter discharge flow passage section (32) among the plurality of ejectors (22) connected to the common flow passage.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title: Fluid ejection devices with reduced crosstalk
abstract: A fluid ejection apparatus includes a fluid ejector comprising a pumping chamber, an ejection nozzle coupled to the pumping chamber, and an actuator configured to cause fluid to be ejected from the pumping chamber through the ejection nozzle. The fluid ejection apparatus includes a first compliant assembly formed in a surface of an inlet feed channel, the inlet feed channel fluidically connected to a fluid inlet of the pumping chamber; and a second compliant assembly formed in a surface of an outlet feed channel, the outlet feed channel fluidically connected to a fluid outlet of the pumping chamber. A compliance of the first compliant assembly is different from a compliance of the second compliant assembly.

title: Radiation image storage panel
abstract: A radiation image storage panel comprising a support and phosphor layers provided thereon which comprise a binder and a stimulable phosphor dispersed therein, characterized in that said phosphor layers comprise the first phosphor layer on the support side and the second phosphor layer provided on the first phosphor layer, and that the mean particle size of the stimulable phosphor contained in said first phosphor layer is smaller than the mean particle size of the stimulable phosphor contained in said second phosphor layer.

title: Radiation image storage panel
abstract: A radiation image storage panel having a fluorescent layer which comprises a binder and a stimulable phosphor dispersed therein. Further, the panel has a light-reflecting metallic layer on one side thereof with respect to the fluorescent layer opposite to the side exposed to the stimulating rays for said stimulable phosphor. The panel provides an image of high sharpness.

title: Radiation image storage panel
abstract: RADIATION IMAGE STORAGE PANEL                 ABSTRACT OF DISCLOSURE    A radiation image storage panel comprising a sup-port, a phosphor layer provided on the support which com-prises a binder and a stimulable phosphor dispersed therein, and a protective film provided on the phosphor layer, characterized in that a mixing ratio of the binder to the stimulable phosphor in said phosphor layer so va-ries as to show a minimum value within a region of depth of from 1/5 to 4/5 of the thickness of the phosphor lay-er, the depth being expressed in terms of relative dis-tance from the protective film-side surface.

title: Radiation image conversion panel
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a radiation image conversion panel superior in moisture resistivity and producing a high quality radiation image. SOLUTION: The radiation image conversion panel has a support body 11, a fluorescent substance layer 12 formed by a gas phase deposition method and a protection film 13 in this order. The support body 11 is ceramics, glass, or metal sheet and the protection film 13 is ceramics or glass sheet. The support body 11 and the protection film 13 in the panel are contacted at 4 side end surfaces with metal solder 14 having a lower melting point than that of the fluorescent substance layer 12 and the fluorescent substance layer 12 is sealed in.

title: Radiation image storage panel
abstract: A radiation image storage panel comprising a phosphor layer which contains a stimulable phosphor, characterized in that one surface of said phosphor layer is provided with a multi-layer optical filter having a reflectance of not less than 60% at the stimulation wavelength of said stimulable phosphor.

title: Radiation image storage panel and process for the preparation of the same
abstract: A radiation image storage panel comprising a phos­phor layer which comprises a stimulable phosphor, in which said phosphor layer consists essentially of a sintered stimulable phosphor and has a relative density of not less than 70 %. Processes for the preparation for the same are also disclosed.

title: Radiation image storage panel and process for the preparation of the same
abstract: A radiation image storage panel comprising a support and a phosphor layer provided thereon which comprises a binder and a stimulable phosphor dispersed therein, characterized in that said phosphor layer consists essentially of one part on the support side which contains the stimulable phosphor and the other part on the panel surface side which does not substantially contain the stimulable phosphor. Processes for the preparation of said radiation image storage panel are also disclosed.

title: Radiation image storage panel, radiographic intersifying screen and processes for the preparation of the same
abstract:
Disclosed is a radiation image storage panel com­
prising a support and a compressed phosphor layer provided 
thereon which contains a phosphor and a binder of which 10 
wt.% - 300 wt.% content is thermoplastic elastomer. 
Further disclosed is a radiographic intensifying screen 
having the same structure as the above radiation image 
storage panel. The processes for preparation of the radia­
tion image storage panel and the radiographic intensifying 
screen are also disclosed.

title: Radiation image storage panel
abstract:
A first radiation image storage panel comprises a
stimulable phosphor layer (2), and a transparent protective film (6),
which comprises at least one layer of a water vapor proof film (5a),
the water vapor proof film comprising a base material film (3a) and

film. The transparent protective film is located such that
the transparent inorganic layer of the water vapor proof film

inorganic layer.

title: Radiation image storage panel and its preparation
abstract: A radiation image storage panel composed of a support, a phosphor matrix compound layer covering a surface of the support at a coverage percentage of 95% or more, and a stimulable phosphor layer (which is composed of multiple prismatic stimulable phosphor crystals standing on the phosphor matrix compound layer) formed on the phosphor matrix compound layer shows a high peel resistance between the support and the stimulable phosphor layer, and a high sensitivity, and gives a reproduced radiation image of high quality.

title: Radiological image conversion panel
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a radiological image conversion panel that prevents corrosion of a substrate, even if a phosphor layer is constituted by a material having a property of corroding the substrate for example, has high adhesion to a polyparaxylene film and the phosphor layer, prevents peeling of the phosphor layer for a long time, and has high durability.  <P>SOLUTION: This radiological image conversion panel comprises the substrate whose at least the surface is constituted by metal or alloy, the polyparaxylene film formed on the surface of the substrate, an oxide film formed on the surface of the polyparaxylene film, and the phosphor layer formed on the surface of the oxide film. The polyparaxylene film is constituted by polyparaxylene containing fluorine, and the ratio between oxygen amount and fluorine amount on the surface of the polyparaxylene film is 0.15-2.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Integrated multi-layer analysis element for calcium analysis
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain an analysis element free from a problem of environmental pollution owing to toxin, which provides a wide measuring area and a high measuring accuracy with improved stability in preservation. CONSTITUTION:An integrated multilayer analysis element for calcium analysis has a reagent layer containing an indicator that couples to calcium ions and can change to allow the detection thereof optically and a porous development layer in the order on a light transmitting non-water permeable support while containing a pH buffer agent in at least any one layer thereof. The indicator herein used is chlorophosphonazo III or a similar compound while a certain amount of light scattering fine particle is contained being dispersed in the reagent layer or in a layer on the side of the support so as to bring the light permeability to 1.2-50%.

title: Multilayer analytical element for analyzing whole blood sample
abstract: PURPOSE:To achieve easy processing at the time of preparation and to enhance the reproducibility of the measured value of an analyte by partially bonding a detection function layer containing one or more reagent layer to glass fiber filter paper. CONSTITUTION:Glass fiber filter paper and a detection function layer are partially bonded. This glass fiber filter paper has high blood corpuscle/plasma separation function separating whole blood into a blood corpuscle and plasma. The detection function layer is composed of at least one reagent layer or said layer and a detection layer. The reagent layer is composed of a water permeable layer of a hydrophilic polymer binder containing a composition capable of generating color development or a color change or a change in the absorption wavelength of an ultraviolet region capable of being optically detected in the presence of a component to be examined or a porous layer containing a reagent composition. In the detection layer, the dye formed in the presence of the component to be examined is diffused and optically detected through a transparent support. This analytical element is integrated in a closely bonded state by the adhesive arranged partially between interfaces.

title: Integral multilayer analytical element for urea analysis
abstract: PURPOSE:To carry out an urea analysis in high accuracy by laminating an absorbing layer, color reagent layer, porous developing layer on a light- permeable and water-impermeable support and containing ascorbic acid oxidase on upper side than the color layer. CONSTITUTION:An absorbing layer containing a hydrophilic polymer is provided on a light-permeable and water-impermeable support such as polyethylene terephthalate and polystyrene. Further, a color reagent layer dispersing and containing an uricase-containing color reagent composition in a hydrophilic polymer binder and porous developing layer consisting of a fibrous developing layer, etc., are bonded and laminated one after another on the absorbing layer. Moreover, a light-shielding layer, adhesive layer, etc., are provided between the color reagent layer and developing layer and ascorbic acid oxidase is contained in either one or more layers on upper side than the color reagent layer e.g. in the light-shielding layer, adhesive layer, etc., over the range of about >=5mum thickness.

title: Dry glucose-analyzing element
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a dry glucose-analyzing element capable of quantitatively analyzing glucose in a high accuracy up to a high concentration region of the glucose by adding specific components to a reagent layer and an enzyme- containing layer, respectively, disposed on a support and using a special material in a light-shielding layer. CONSTITUTION:A reagent layer, enzyme-containing layer, light-shielding layer and porous developing layer, all being water-permeable, are laminated in this order to a water and light-impermeable support. At least a coupler among a hydrogen peroxide-detecting coloring composition comprising a hydrogen donor and the couple is added to the reagent layer and gluxose oxidase, peroxidase and a mordant are added to the enzyme-containing layer. An oxygen- permeable and protein-impermeable material is used for the light-shielding layer. It is preferable that the light-shielding layer is a non-porous layer wherein titanium dioxide fine powder having a light-shielding property and a light- reflecting property are bonded with a hydrophilic polymer haivng a little film formability.

title: Dry immunity analyzing element
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain high analyzing sensitivity and accuracy in quantitative analysis, by a constitution wherein at least two water permeability layers form a unitary body, at least one of the water permeability layers is a porous layer, and components related to the reaction of antigen/antibody are added in the water permeability layers. CONSTITUTION:An element comprises at least two water permeability layers which form a unitary body. At least one of the water permeability layers is a porous layer. Components related to the reaction of antigen/antibody are added in the water permeability layers. One of the components related to the antigen/antibody is the labelled antigen. The other is the antibody for the non- labelled antigen and the labelled antigen. The labelled antigen is incorporated in the porous layer until the time when liquid to be checked comes to contact. The porous layer does not have the antibody substantially. The antibody is incorporated in the second water permeability layer which is located at a position separated remotely from the surface that receives liquid of the analyzing element from the porous layer. Said second layer does not incorporate the labelled antigen substantially. In this way, high analyzing sensitivity and the accuracy in quantitative analysis can be maintained.

title: Dry type analysis element
abstract: PURPOSE:To determine hydrogen peroxide with high sensitivity by using the imidazole deriv. expressed by specific formula as a color forming component. CONSTITUTION:A coating liquid for a reagent layer contg. uricase, the compd. expressed by formula, and peroxidase is coated on a colorless transparent polyethylene terephthalate film having an under coating layer of gelatin and is dried. The reagent layer is then moistened with water and a cellulose acetate membrane filter is laminated and integrated as a porous developing layer thereon to prepare a multi-layered chemical analysis element for determination of uric acid. A sample is spotted onto the porous developing layer of such analysis element and the reflected light is measured at about 670nm from the polyethylene terephthalate film side to determine the concn. of the uric acid. Since the compd. expressed by formula is extremely stable as chromogen, the measurement with the high accuracy is permitted.

title: Integral type multi-layered analyzing element
abstract: PURPOSE:To make possible the substantial elimination of the influence of a reagent layer without decreasing sensitivity by dispersing and incorporating pulverous light scatterable particles of the amt. at which the light transmittance attains 10-2.5% into a hydrophilic layer where detecting seeds are accumulated and/or the layer nearer the base side than said layer. CONSTITUTION:At least one layer of the layer (hydrophilic layer) contg. a water absorbing hydrophilic polymer binder and development layer are laminated in this order on a light transmittable water impermeable base. The integral type multilayer analyzing element contg. at least one reagent which forms the detection seeds to be photodetected by reacting with the component in the sample is further provided thereto. The pulverous light scatterable particles of the amt. at which the light transmittance attains 10-2.5% are dispersed and incorporated into the hydrophilic layer where the detection seeds are accumulated and/or the layer nearer the base side than said layer. The influence of the reagent layer is thus substantially eliminated without decreasing the sensitivity.

title: Liquid analyzing material for oxidase enzyme reaction system
abstract:
PURPOSE: To provide a liquid analyzing material capable of giving the accurate analytical data rapidly, and consisting of a multi-layered laminate wherein the oxidase enzyme is contained in a separate layer above the reagent-containing layer.  
     CONSTITUTION: A light-transmitting substrate 1, a reagent-containing layer 2 (a reagent necessary for the conventional colorimetry of hydrogen peroxide produced by the enzymatic reaction of the oxidase enzyme with a specific component in a liquid specimen), a non-porous opaque layer 3 (a layer obtained by dispersing fine powder such as titanium dioxide, aluminum, barium sulfate, etc. in a water-permeable hydrophilic polymer binder), and a fibrous layer 4 (e.g. paper, cloth, etc.) for developing the liquid specimen, are laminated in the order. The oxidase enzyme is impregnated in the non-porous opaque layer 3 or in the fibrous layer 4. A timing layer may be inserted between the reagent- containing layer and the opaque layer. 
     COPYRIGHT: (C)1982,JPO&Japio

title: Integration type multi-layer analysis element for determining ammonia product
abstract: PURPOSE:To analyze an ammonia product at a high sensitivity, by providing an ammonia diffusion preventing layer between an endogenous ammonia trapping layer to trap ammonia existing in a liquid reagent and an ammonia product reaction reagent layer. CONSTITUTION:A gaseous ammonia indicator layer (b) and a gaseous ammonia transmission layer (c) are provided on a support (a). An ammonia production reaction reagent (d) is provided on the layer and made to react with an ammonia product (creatine, urea or the like) to form a gaseous ammonia. An ammonia diffusion preventing layer (polymer binder or the like) (e) is provided on the layer to prevent ammonia generated in the layer (d) from diffusing to an endogenous ammonia trapping layer (f) provided thereon. The endogenous ammonia trapping layer (f) traps ammonia present in a water liquid. Thus, the diffusion preventing layer (e) arranged prevents ammonia from diffusing upward, thereby enabling analysis of creatine, urea the like at a high accuracy.

title: Multilayer analytical element
abstract:
A multilayer analytical element for fluorometric assay of an analyte contained in an aqueous sample liquid, utilizing a competitive binding reaction to a protein between the analyte and a fluorescent-labelled analyte substance or analogue thereof, which comprises:
     a porous fibrous or non-fibrous spreading sheet containing a predetermined amount of the fluorescent-labelled analyte substance or analogue thereof;   a porous sharing sheet enabling substantial separation of a bound fluorescent-labelled complex (B) of the protein from the free fluorescent-labelled analyte substance or analogue thereof (F); and   a reaction sheet containing a predetermined amount of the protein specifically bindable to the analyte fixed therein;   
     being under laminated structure in this order. 
     A slide enclosing the multilayer analytical element and a fluorometric assay employing the multilayer analytical element are also disclosed.

title: Dry-type liquid analyzing element
abstract: PURPOSE:To enable determination of hydrolase in a body fluid preventing the interference of other components, by using a carrier containing a self-developing substrate which contains a hydroxydiarylazo dye having an absorption peak at a wavelength longer than a specific level in dissociated state in the molecule. CONSTITUTION:A self-developing substrate containing a hydroxydiarylazo dye having an absorption peak at >=500nm in dissociated state and bonded through an ether bond or ester bond to the molecule of the substrate, e.g. 4-(2'- methylsulfonyl-4'nitrophenylazo)-2-chlorophenylphosph-ate disodium (formula I), 4-(2'-methyl-sulfonyl-4'-nitrophenylazo)phenylphosphate disodium (formula II), etc., is included in a liquid developing porous layer. As an alternative, a cationic polymer is included in another water-permeable layer contacting with the above developing layer via liquid. A multilayer dry-type analyzing element composed of the above layers is obtained thereby.

title: Dry analytical element for measuring enzyme activity
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a high sensitive enzyme activity to a dry type analytical element, by providing a porous liquid developing layer consisting of water- unabsorbing fiber on a support and simultaneously incorporating a specific hydrophilic high polymer into the liquid developing layer in order to constitute the dry analytical element. CONSTITUTION:A porous liquid developing layer consisting of a water- unabsorbing fiber is provided on a support and simultaneously a hydrophilic polymer which is a polymer of a monomer component expressed by formula I of amount having effect decreasing a developing area by at least 20% or copolymer of the above-mentioned monomer and other monomer component copolymerizable with the above-mentioned monomer is contained in the liquid developing layer to form the aimed dry analytical element. In the formula I, R<4> is H and methyl group and Q is formula II (q is integer of 2-4), formula III (R<5> is 1-4C alkyl group; R<6> is H, 1-4C alkyl group) etc. The above- mentioned water-unabsorbing fiber includes polyester, polyamide, etc.

title: Integrated type multilayer analytical element for measuring gamma-glutamyltransferase activity
abstract: PURPOSE:To carry out measurement with a high accuracy, by incorporating a cationic surfactant and nonionic surfactant and hydrophilic polymer in a porous development layer in an analytical element containing the porous development layer, containing a substrate and laminated to water absorbing layer and support layer. CONSTITUTION:A water absorbing layer containing a hydrophilic polymer as a layer-forming component is provided on a light-transmitting and water- impermeable support consisting of a polymer, e.g. polyethylene terephthalate, polystyrene, cellulose ester, etc. A matrix containing filter paper, nonwoven fabic or woven fabric cloth, etc. as a material is laminated on the resultant layer, and a substrate sensitive to gamma-glutamyltransferase and exhibiting the self-developing property and gamma-glutamyl-p-nitranilide, etc., are contained in the above-mentioned development layer. A cationic surfactant, nonionic surfactant and hydrophilic polymer in respective specific amounts are further contained to give the aimed element for measuring gamma-glutamyltransferase activity.

title: Integrated-type multi-layer analyzing element
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a high-sensitive integrated type multi-layer analyzing element available for quick, easily operatable and high-accuracy analysis of an ammonium producing substance in bodyily liquid, by installing an air barrier layer permitting passage of gaseous ammonia only between indicating chemical layer and reagent layer. CONSTITUTION:An air barrier layer set on an indicating chemical layer is composed of continuous air gap structured porous substance of mutually entangled, bonded or connected fibrous substance and on the occasion of analyzing operations, etc., it does not permit passage of aqueous water and that containing as solved an inhibitory agent, such as alkali substance, permitting only gaseous ammonia. And, a reagent layer is set on said air barrier layer and further, a porous developping layer on said reagent layer. The main integrated multi-layer analyzing element being provided with the air barrier layer, a dispersion velocity of ammonia gas is high and consequently, measurement time can be remarkably reduced as compared with the case of the conventional element and accuracy can be highly improved also.

title: Integral multilayer analysis element
abstract: PURPOSE:To enable a quick quantitative analysis of various components to be inspected in a chemical emission analysis by dry operation, by laminating a diffusive layer, a chemical emission reagent layer and a water non-permeable support integral in this order to form a multilayer analysis element. CONSTITUTION:In this multilayer analysis element, a diffusive layer which is adapted to diffuse components to be inspected in a liquid sample into a chemical emission reagent layer before chemical emission reaction starts in substance, a chemical emission reagent layer containing a polymer binder which is swelled by chemical emission reaction reagent composition and water or water-soluble and a water non-permeable support allowed to transmit light at least in a wavelength range of chemical emission are laminated integrally in this order. With such an arrangement, an angular drop spotted is diffused sideways along the surface of the diffusive layer and brought into contact with the chemical emission reagent layer. This enables the participation in the chemical emission analysis reaction of the sample spotted in substance entirely in a short time, and thus emission takes place evenly to elevate the measuring accuracy significantly.

title: Monolithic multilayer analytical element for analyzing calcium
abstract: PURPOSE:To quantify calcium with high accuracy by excluding the effect of protein, in a monolithic multilayer analytical element wherein a reagent layer containing at least one kind of an indicator and a porous developing layer are provided on a light pervious and water impervious support in this order, by containing polyhydric alcohol in at least one layer above the reagent layer. CONSTITUTION:As the light pervious and water impervious support of a multilayer analytical element, a transparent planar support having a smooth surface composed of a polymer, for example, polyethylene terephthalate is used. Next, gelation (deionized gelatin) is most pref. used in a reagent layer and o-cresol phthalein is pref. as an indicator from such a viewpoint that the most accurate quantitative analysis of total calcium is possible. As a porous developing layer, a fabric developing layer is used. As polyhydric alcohol contained in at least one layer above the reagent layer, the effect of hexahydric alcohol or pentose is high and, as polyhydric alcohol fatty acid ester, sorbitol monolaurate is pref.

title: One-piece type multilayer analysis element
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a one-piece type multilayer analysis element with a porous development layer whose film thickness is thin and has an improved development operation. CONSTITUTION:In a one-piece multilayer analysis element where a water- absorption layer 12 or a reagent layer and a porous development layer 14 including a hydrophilic polymer binder are laminated in one-piece on a water- impermeability support 10, the development layer 14 is constituted by a fine porous layer which consists of a polymer containing fluorine and further an interface activator is contained in this development layer 14, thus obtaining a rapid development time and a uniform analysis result. Also, an improved globule/plasma separation function is provided, which is suited for analysis of a whole blood sample.

title: Multilayer chemical analysis element
abstract: PURPOSE:To enhance accuracy in analysis, by including the fine powder of titanium dioxide, which has not undergone specified surface treatment, in a light shielding layer on a reagent layer, thereby eliminating errors caused by the interfering action of a fluoride. CONSTITUTION:A reagent layer, a light shielding layer, and a porous developing layer are provided in this order on a supporting body having water impermeability and light transmitting property such as a transparent polymer sheet characterized by poor hydrophilic property such as cellulose acetate. The reagent layer is prepared by including a hydrogen peroxide indicator, which yields the change that can be detected under the presence of peroxidase and hydrogen peroxide, peroxidase, and oxidase in a polymer binder. The fine powder of titanium dioxide, which has not undergone surface treatment including aluminum oxide or the hydrated oxide of aluminum, or the fine powder of titanium dioxide, which has not undergone surface treatment, is included in the light shielding layer characterized by oxygen permeability and protein impermeability on the reagent layer. Thus interference by fluoride can be eliminated.

title: Analysis element used in measurement of enzyme activity
abstract: PURPOSE:To minimize errors due to the interference of endogenous pyruvic acid without complicating the analysis operation and increasing the analysis time, by laminating a reagent layer containing pyruvate oxidase and a porous development layer on a non-aqu permeable light transmitting support with a void volume set at a specified value. CONSTITUTION:A reagent layer in which pyruvate oxidase is dissolved or dispersed into gelatin or a mixture of a gelatin and another hydrophilic polymer is formed on a non-water permeable light transmitting support made of polyethylene terephtharate, cellulose ester or the like. The reagent also contains an indicator which detects hydrogen peroxide to be generated by pyruvate oxidase. A porous development layer with a void volume of 3-15mul/cm<2> is formed thereon. The development layer may contain various substrates, a hydrophilic polymer, a surfactant, a light shielding composition and the like. In the measurement of transaminase activity of a body fluid (especially, blood) with a relatively high concentration of endogenous pyruvic acid, the measurement of enzyme activity is possible accompanied by no measuring errors without enlarging the reaction time.

title: Immunological analytical element and method therefor
abstract: PURPOSE:To high-sensitively and quickly carry out analysis with a simple operation by providing a substrate layer containing a nondiffusive substrate and a reagent layer containing a low molecular enzyme. CONSTITUTION:On a light-transmissible base material 10, a reagent layer 12 and a substrate layer 14 are laminated. The substrate layer 14 is made up of a water-permeable layer, and contains a nondiffusive substrate being the substrate of enzyme that has been combined with an antibody as a label. This substrate produces a diffusive substance by the enzyme activity of an enzyme labeled antibody that remains in inverse proportion to the amount of a high molecular antigen being the measuring object. The reagent layer 12 is made up of a water-permeable layer, and contains a low molecular enzyme by which the diffusive substance that has diffused and shifted from the substrate layer is changed into a product of a lower molecular weight. The substrate layer 14 also contains a reagent constituent for detecting this low molecular enzyme. The substrate layer 14 is preferably made of a porous layer consisting of a porous medium, or of a layer consisting of a hydrophilic polymer binder. The reagent layer 12 is preferably made of a continuous layer consisting of a hydrophilic polymer binder.

title: Dry type analyzing element for analyzing whole blood sample
abstract: PURPOSE:To facilitate processing at the time of production (molding) and to allow rapid measurement as well as to enhance the reproducibility of an analyte measured value by laminating a non-woven fabric having a prescribed average fiber diameter and density and a detecting function layer. CONSTITUTION:The non-woven fabric having 0.2 to 10mum average fiber size and 0.01 to 0.2g/cm<2> density and the detecting function layer are laminated or a porous layer as a development layer is held in place therebetween to form the dry analyzing element for the whole blood sample. There are no particular limitations on the fiber blank material of the non-woven fabric and spinning method. Filter paper, non-woven fabric, woven fabric, knitted fabric, etc., are usable for the porous layer and the woven fabric and knitted fabric are more preferable. A reagent layer, light shielding layer and non-woven fabric are laminated on a base to form the analyzing element. The reagent layer is the layer contg. the compsn. which can generate the coloration, discoloration or the change in absorption wavelength optically detectable in the presence of the component to be detected. This layer is formed by incorporating the reagent compsn. into a water permeable layer or pours layer consisting of a hydrophilic polymer binder.

title: Integral type multi-layered analyzing element
abstract: PURPOSE:To quickly diffuse and penetrate the analyte of the amt. enough for coloration reaction into a reagent layer by adhering 3 layers of porous sheets by an adhesive agent constituting fine through-gaps. CONSTITUTION:This integral type multi-layered analyzing element has a fibrous porous sheet, upper non-fibrous porous sheet, lower non-fibrous porous sheet and water absorptive layer contg. a hydrophilic polymer binder. Three layers of these sheets are adhered by the adhesive agent so as to constitute the fine through-gaps to substantially prohibit the uniform passage of the liquid between the adjacent faces. The fibrous porous sheets have the effect of diffusing the received sample in a horizontal direction and to supply the same at the same instant to the lower layer so as to distribute the liquid sample of the approximately specified amt. per unit area in a manner as to substantially prohibit the uneven presence of the components contained in the aq. liquid sample spotted and supplied to the surface of the upper side.

title: Integral type multilayered analyzing element for analyzing calcium
abstract: PURPOSE:To exactly and quantitatively analyze the total calcium or calcium ions in an aq. liquid sample with high accuracy by decreasing the total content of the calcium and materials analogous to calcium which can bond to the indicators in a reagent layer and development layer. CONSTITUTION:This element has the reagent layer and porous development layer contg. at least one kind of the indicators which can made the optically detectable change by bonding to the calcium ions in this order on a light transmittable water impermeable base and contains a pH buffer in at least any one layer thereof. The total content of the calcium and materials analogous to calcium which can bond to the indicators incorporated as extraneous materials, impurity materials or contaminating materials in the component more particularly gelatin which is a hydrophilic polymer binder contained in a relatively large amt. in the multilayered analyzing elements or/and the porous stock used as the porous development layer is substantially decreased so that the calcium and materials analogous to calcium are incorporated therein in the trace amt. to the extent of generating substantially no determination errors or are substantially not incorporated therein.

title: Analytic element
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a multi-layer dry-type chemical analytic element having a water-permeable layer containing a specific substrate and a water-permeable detection layer and capable of detecting a specific component (hydrolase) in an aqueous liquid in high sensitivity. CONSTITUTION:A detection layer 20, a substrate layer 30 and a developing layer 50 are laminated on a transparent and impermeable supporting member 10 in the order. The substrate layer 30 and the detection layer 20 are formed of water-permeable porous layer. The substrate layer 30 contains a non-diffusible substrate. The non-diffusible substrate has a site (e.g. a pigment part) directly detectable by optical means in the molecule and forms a compound diffusible in a water-permeable medium by the action of the substance to be examined (an enzyme) or an enzyme-supporting substance (the enzyme itself or a substance bonded with enzyme) which is produced or diminished according to the amount of the substance to be examined.

title: Dry liquid analysis element
abstract: A dry multilayer analysis element which allows easy permeation of a high molecular weight component or hydrophobic component, which has, in order, at least a water permeable porous reagent laeyr, a water permeable light reflecting/screen layer, and a water permeable porous spreading layer on a water-impermeable transparent support, a reagent composition capable of producing an optically detectable substance in the presence of a component to be detected being incorporated in at least one of the water-permeable layers including said reagent layer, said light reflecting/screen layer being porous and comprised microcapsules having a core containing light reflective/screen grains and a shell made of a high molecular weight compound, wherein each of said reagent layer, spreading layer, and reflecting/screen layer allows permeation of a high molecular weight or hydrophobic component therethrough.

title: Integral multilayer analytical element for analysis of ammonia-forming substrate
Multilayer analysis element
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a multilayer analysis element with lessened inter-lot difference and intra-lot difference, lessened liquid volume dependency, and enhanced measuring accuracy.  <P>SOLUTION: This multilayer analysis element for liquid specimen analysis is a multilayer analysis material for liquid specimen analysis made by layering/unifying at least one functional layer and at least one granular structure developing layer in this order on one side of a water-impermeable and light-transmissive planar support body and is characterized in that the functional layer has a film swelling property of a water swelling rate of 300% or less.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Liquid crystal composition, cholesteric liquid crystal layer, cured product, optically anisotropic body, and method for producing cholesteric liquid crystal layer
abstract: A first objective of the present invention is to provide a liquid crystal composition which has excellent characteristics capable of reflecting light, which is incident in the normal direction onto the surface of a layer, in a direction other than the normal direction, and is for forming a cholesteric liquid crystal layer. In addition, a second objective of the present invention is to provide a cholesteric liquid crystal layer formed by using the liquid crystal composition. In addition, a third objective of the present invention is to provide a cured product obtained by curing the liquid crystal composition. In addition, a fourth objective of the present invention is to provide: an optically anisotropic body formed by using the liquid crystal composition; and an optically anisotropic body comprising the cholesteric liquid crystal layer. In addition, a fourth objective of the present invention is to provide a method for producing a cholesteric liquid crystal layer using the liquid crystal composition.　A liquid crystal composition according to the present invention includes: a liquid crystal compound; a chiral agent A; and a chiral agent B in which spiral-inducing force is increased by light irradiation, wherein the chiral agent A induces a spiral in the direction opposite to that of the chiral agent B.

title: A method for the separation and purification of nucleic acid
abstract:
An object of the present invention is to provide: a method for isolating and
purifying nucleic acids which employs a solid phase wherein the solid phase has
excellent isolating capability, good washing efficiency, and easy workability, and can be
mass produced with substantially identical isolating capability, the solid phase being
used in a method for isolating and purifying nucleic acids by adsorbing nucleic acids in
a sample onto a solid phase surface and desorbing the nucleic acids by washing and the
like; and a unit for isolation and purification of nucleic acid which is suitable for
carrying out said method. The present invention provides a method for isolating and
purifying a nucleic acid, comprising the step of: adsorbing a nucleic acid onto a solid
phase composed of an organic high polymer having a hydroxide group on a surface
thereof, and desorbing the nucleic acid from the solid phase, and a unit for isolation and
purification of nucleic acid comprising a container having at least two openings wherein
the container contains a solid phase composed of organic high polymers having a
hydroxyl group on a surface thereof.

title: Washing solution for separating and refining nucleic acid
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a washing solution used in a separating and refining method of a nucleic acid including a step for absorbing the nucleic acid into a solid phase composed of an organic polymer having a hydroxy group on the surface and desorbing the nucleic acid from the solid phase and capable of washing away only impurity nonspecifically absorbed to the solid phase without detaching the nucleic acid absorbed in the solid phase.  <P>SOLUTION: The washing solution is composed of an aqueous solution of a water-soluble alcohol and used in the separating and refining method of the nucleic acid including the step for absorbing the nucleic acid into the solid phase composed of the organic polymer having the hydroxy group on the surface and desorbing the nucleic acid from the solid phase.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO&NCIPI

title: Method for separation and purification of nucleic acid
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for the separation and purification of a nucleic acid containing a step to adsorb the nucleic acid to a solid phase by pressurizing a nucleic acid containing specimen solution in a container and passing the specimen solution through the solid phase placed in the container while preventing the formation of droplets of the liquid in the container from leaving the droplet liquid behind in the container.  <P>SOLUTION: The method for the separation and purification of a nucleic acid contains (1) a step to adsorb the nucleic acid to the solid phase by pressurizing a nucleic acid containing specimen solution in the container and passing the solution through the solid phase placed in the container, (2) a step to add a cleaning liquid to the container and pressurize the cleaning liquid to pass the liquid through the solid phase, and (3) a step to add a liquid for desorbing the nucleic acid from the solid phase to the container, pressurize the liquid and pass through the solid phase to recover the nucleic acid in the liquid. The pressurization of the specimen solution in the step (1) is stopped when the pressure in the container reaches a prescribed level.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

title: Method for isolating and purifying nucleic acid
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for isolating and purifying a nucleic acid, having an excellent separation performance and good washing efficiency, capable of being simply and rapidly conducted, and having excellent adaptability to be automatized and miniaturized, by using such a porous membrane that membranes having a substantially identical separation performance are mass-produced.  <P>SOLUTION: This method for isolating and purifying the nucleic acid comprises a process (1a) for passing a sample solution containing the nucleic acid through a nucleic acid adsorbing porous membrane by acting centrifugal force on the sample solution, so as to adsorb the nucleic acid inside the porous membrane, a process (2a) for passing a washing liquid through the nucleic acid adsorbing porous membrane by acting the centrifugal force on the washing liquid, so as to wash the porous membrane in such a state that the nucleic acid is adsorbed, and a process (3a) for passing a recovery liquid through the nucleic acid adsorbing porous membrane by acting the centrifugal force on the recovery liquid, so as to desorb the nucleic acid from the porous membrane. Further, the method comprises a process (1b) for passing the sample solution containing the nucleic acid through the nucleic acid adsorbing porous membrane in a state of reduced pressure, so as to adsorb the nucleic acid inside the porous membrane, a process (2b) for passing the washing liquid through the nucleic acid adsorbing porous membrane in the state of reduced pressure, so as to wash the porous membrane in such a state that the nucleic acid is adsorbed, and a process (3b) for passing the recovery liquid through the nucleic acid adsorbing porous membrane in the state of reduced pressure, or by acting the centrifugal force on the recovery liquid, so as to desorb the nucleic acid from the porous membrane.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

title: Method for separation and purification of nucleic acid
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To easily and quickly separate and purify a nucleic acid from a nucleic acid-containing specimen in high separation performance by an automatable means.  <P>SOLUTION: The method for the separation and purification of a nucleic acid comprises the adsorption and desorption of a nucleic acid-containing specimen solution by using a nucleic acid separation and purification cartridge containing a nucleic acid adsorbing porous membrane held in the nucleic acid separation and purification cartridge having at least two openings and an apparatus to generate a pressure difference between at least two openings of the nucleic acid separation and purification cartridge.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

title: Method for separating and purifying nucleic acid
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for separating and purifying nucleic acid, which has excellent separation performance and improved cleaning efficiency, is simple and rapid, has excellent automation and miniaturization suitability and in which a porous membrane having substantially the same separation performance, being mass produced and performing safe separation and purification operation without causing enzyme reaction inhibition by extracted and purified nucleic acid is used.  <P>SOLUTION: In the method for separating and purifying nucleic acid comprising (1) a process for passing a sample solution containing nucleic acid through a nucleic acid adsorbing porous membrane to adsorb nucleic acid on the porous membrane, (2) a process for cleaning the porous membrane in an adsorbed state of nucleic acid and (3) a process for passing a recovered solution through a porous membrane to desorb nucleic acid from the porous membrane, the nucleic acid adsorbing porous membrane is a porous membrane on which nucleic acid is adsorbed by interaction substantially not associated with ionic bond and a cleaning liquid contains no chaotropic substance.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

title: Method for separating and purifying nucleic acid
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To highly efficiently recover nucleic acid contained in a sample at a high recovery ratio by a method for separating and purifying the nucleic acid using whole blood as the sample, comprising a step for allowing the nucleic acid to be adsorbed to the solid phase, a step for washing the solid phase at the state of the nucleic acid adsorbed thereon, and a step for allowing the nucleic acid to be desorbed from the solid phase.  <P>SOLUTION: The method for separating and purifying the nucleic acid comprises a step for putting the sample solution containing the nucleic acid in contact with a solid phase to allow the nucleic acid to be adsorbed to the solid phase, a step for putting a washing solution in contact with the solid phase to wash the solid phase at the state of nucleic acid adsorbed thereon, and a step for putting an elution solution in contact with the solid phase to allow the nucleic acid to be desorbed from the solid phase, wherein the step of preparing the sample solution containing the nucleic acid comprises at least one selected from the group consisting of vortexing, mixing with inversion, and pipetting.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Method and apparatus for isolating and purifying nucleic acids
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method that can obtain sample solutions including nucleic acids having reproducibility efficiently, simply, rapidly with excellent automation adequacy in the isolation and purification method for nucleic acids in which the nucleic acids in a sample solution including nucleic acids is adsorbed to a nucleic acid-adsorbing porous membrane, then desorbed via washing and the like and the nuleic acids are isolated and purified.  <P>SOLUTION: In the nucleic acid isolation and purification method comprising step (1) where sample solution including nucleic acids is prepared; step (2) where the sample solution is allowed to contact with a solid phase so that the nucleic acids are adsorbed to the solid phase; step (3) where the washing solution is allowed to contact with the solid phase and the solid phase is washed as the nucleic acids are adsorbed; step (4) where the recovering solution is allowed to contact with the solid phase to adsorb the nucleic acids from the solid phase, the particle size of the nucleic acid particles in the sample solution is adjusted to less than 1μm in the step (1) where the sample solution including nucleic acids is prepared.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Method for separating and purifying rna
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To efficiently separate and purify an RNA contained in a leukocyte from blood or the leukocyte with high purity.  <P>SOLUTION: A method for separating and purifying the RNA includes a process for passing a sample solution containing a nucleic acid, a washing solution, and a recovering solution through a nucleic acid-adsorbing porous membrane, so as to conduct adsorption, washing, and recovery, wherein the nucleic acid-adsorbing porous membrane comprises a porous membrane on which the nucleic acid is adsorbed by interaction not participated by an ionic bond and the sample solution is obtained by preparation processes including (I) a process for injecting a specimen containing at least one of the blood and the leukocyte and further containing an anticoagulant into a container, (II) a process for adding a hemolyzing agent to the container, so as to obtain leukocyte pellets, (III) a process for adding a nucleic acid-solubilizing agent to the leukocyte pellets, so as to obtain a mixed liquid, and (IV) a process for adding a water-soluble organic solvent to the mixed liquid, so as to obtain the sample solution containing the nucleic acid.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Method for separating and purifying RNA
abstract: A method for separating and purifying RNA including the steps of passing a sample solution containing a nucleic acid, a washing solution and a recovering solution through a nucleic acid-adsorbing porous membrane to adsorb nucleic acid, adsorbing, washing and recovering, in which the nucleic acid adsorbing porous membrane is a porous membrane capable of adsorbing a nucleic acid by interaction involving substantially no ionic bond, and the sample solution is obtained by a process, comprising the steps of (I) injecting a test sample containing at least one of blood and leukocyte, and further containing an anticoagulant to a container, (II) adding a hemolytic agent to the container to obtain a leukocyte pallet, (III) adding a nucleic acid-solubilizing reagent to the leukocyte pallet to obtain a mixture solution and (IV) adding a water-soluble organic solvent to the mixture solution to obtain the sample solution containing the nucleic acid.

title: Method for extracting nucleic acid
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for extracting nucleic acids which easily enables preparation of samples for DNA microarray in a short time.  <P>SOLUTION: The method comprises a process (a) of adsorbing a nucleic acid on a solid material by bringing adsorptive liquid in which a sample comprising at least one kind of nucleic acid and at least one kind of repetitive sequence blocking nucleic acid are mixed with a buffer solution in contact with a solid material comprising a cellulose derivative as a main ingredient and a process (b) of obtaining eluate containing a nucleic acid by contacting the solid material with a recovery liquid. It is preferable that the nucleic acid contained in the sample is a nucleic acid obtained by nucleic acid amplification reaction, the nucleic acid contained in the sample is a nucleic acid bound to a fluorescent material, and the repetitive sequence blocking nucleic acid is Cot-1 DNA. Further it is preferable that a sodium salt or water-soluble organic solvent is contained in the adsorptive liquid and a process (c) of washing the solid material by a washing liquid is included between processes (a) and (b).  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Method for cleaning and cleaning liquid
abstract: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a semiconductor substrate cleaning method that enables excellent performance in removal of polishing particles from a semiconductor substrate subjected to chemical-mechanical polishing (CMP). The present invention also addresses the problem of providing a cleaning fluid for a semiconductor substrate subjected to CMP. This cleaning method is a semiconductor substrate cleaning method comprising a cleaning step for cleaning, using a cleaning fluid, a semiconductor substrate subjected to a CMP treatment using a polishing fluid that includes polishing particles. The semiconductor substrate includes a metal. The pH of the cleaning fluid at 25 DEG C is over 7. The cleaning fluid includes: a chelating agent; a constituent A that is at least one selected from the group consisting of primary amines, secondary amines, and tertiary amines, and that has a first acid dissociation constant for conjugate acids of at least 8.0; and an anti-corrosive agent. The condition is met that the product of a contact angle ratio obtained by a designated test method 1 and a specific degree of aggregation obtained by a designated test method 2 is 15 or less.

title: Cleaning liquid for semiconductor substrate
abstract: An object of the present invention is to provide a cleaning liquid for a semiconductor substrate, which has excellent cleaning performance and excellent ruthenium oxide dissolving ability in a case of being applied as a cleaning liquid after a CMP treatment of a semiconductor substrate including a metal film. A cleaning liquid for a semiconductor substrate according to the present invention is a cleaning liquid for a semiconductor substrate, which is used for cleaning a semiconductor substrate, where the cleaning liquid contains at least one purine compound selected from the group consisting of purine and a purine derivative and a compound represented by Formula (A).

title: 金属用研磨液及び研磨方法
abstract: 【課題】  迅速なＣＭＰ速度を有し、ディッシング、研磨残りの発生が少ない、ＬＳＩの作製を可能とする、特に研磨対象が銅金属及び銅合金である金属用研磨液及び該金属用研磨液を用いた化学的機械的研磨方法を提供する。 【解決手段】  下記一般式（Ｉ）で表される化合物、及び、酸化剤を含有し、ｐＨ２〜８であることを特徴とする金属用研磨液。     【化１】     一般式（Ｉ）中、   Ｒ 1 、Ｒ 2 は、各々独立して、炭素原子または窒素原子を表す。但し、Ｒ 1 とＲ 2 とが同時に窒素原子となることはない。   Ｑ 1 、Ｑ 2 は、各々独立して、Ｒ 1 、Ｒ 2 と連結して５員または６員からなる複素環を形成する２価の連結基を表す。   但し、Ｑ 1 がＲ 1 、Ｒ 2 とともに形成する環、および、Ｑ 2 がＲ 1 、Ｒ 2 とともに形成する環の、それぞれの環中に、窒素原子を１〜３個含む。 【選択図】  なし

title: 研磨液及びそれを用いる研磨方法
abstract: 【課題】    高研磨速度で、ウェハ面内における均一な研磨を達成し、均一性の高いＬＳＩの作製に有用な金属用研磨液、及び、そのような金属用研磨液を用いた研磨速度と研磨の均一性に優れた化学的機械的研磨方法を提供する。 【解決手段】    半導体デバイス製造の化学的機械的平坦化に使用する金属用研磨液であって、研磨液１Ｌ中に０．０００１ないし０．０１ｍｏｌの複素環化合物を含有し、〔（研磨温度４０℃における研磨速度）／（研磨温度２５℃における研磨速度）〕が１．０５ないし１．５であることを特徴とする。 【選択図】     なし

title: 水系研磨液及び化学機械的研磨方法
abstract: 【課題】  保存性に優れ、迅速なＣＭＰ速度を有し、スクラッチが少なく、平坦性が向上したＬＳＩの作製を可能とする水系研磨液、及び、前記水系研磨液を用いた化学機械的研磨方法を提供すること。 【解決手段】  酸化剤、３つ以上の窒素原子を有する５員環単環化合物又は該化合物に複素環が縮合した化合物並びに、分子内に少なくとも２つの硫黄原子を有する化合物及び／又は臭素又はヨウ素を含む有機化合物を含有することを特徴とする水系研磨液。 【選択図】  なし

title: 金属用研磨液
abstract: 【課題】迅速な研磨速度、及び、良好な銅／タンタル研磨選択性を有し、更に、ディッシングが少なく平坦性を向上させることが可能な金属用研磨液を提供する。 【解決手段】半導体集積回路用基板の化学的機械的平坦化に用いる、下記式（Ｉ）で表される化合物を含有することを特徴とする金属用研磨液である。また、下記式（Ｉ）で表される化合物は、分子中に、カルボキシ基、ヒドロキシ基、カルバモイル基、アルキル基、アリール基、ヘテロ環基、アミノ基、ハロゲン原子、又はこれらの基を部分構造として含む置換基が導入されていることが好ましい。     【選択図】なし

title: 研磨方法
