title: 金属用研磨液及びそれを用いた化学的機械的研磨方法
abstract: 【課題】半半導体デバイスの製造における化学的機械的研磨に用いられ、被研磨体の低ディッシングを達成し、且つ、被研磨面の面内均一性に優れた研磨が可能な金属用研磨液、及び、該金属用研磨液を用いた化学的機械的研磨方法を提供すること 【解決手段】半導体デバイスの製造における化学的機械的研磨に用いる金属用研磨液であって、（ａ）環状α−アミノ酸と、（ｂ）複素環化合物と、（ｃ）酸化剤と、を含有することを特徴とする金属用研磨液、及び、該金属用研磨液を用いた化学的機械的研磨方法である。 【選択図】なし

title: 化学的機械的研磨方法
abstract: 【課題】半導体デバイスの製造工程において、バリア金属膜と、該バリア金属膜上に設けられた導体膜とを有する被研磨体を研磨する化学的機械的研磨方法であって、導体膜とバリア金属膜とを同じ研磨定盤上で連続的に研磨することができ、研磨処理の効率が向上しうる化学的機械的研磨方法を提供すること。   【解決手段】バリア金属膜と、該バリア金属膜上に設けられた導体膜とを有する被研磨体を研磨する化学的機械的研磨方法であって、研磨液Ａを用いて前記導体膜を研磨する第１の研磨工程と、研磨液Ｂを用いて前記バリア金属膜を研磨する第２の研磨工程と、を研磨パッドが配置された同一の研磨定盤上で連続的に行い、且つ、前記研磨液Ａ及び前記研磨液Ｂが下記の（１）〜（３）の成分を含むことを特徴とする化学的機械的研磨方法。   （１）一次粒子径が２０〜５０ｎｍであり、且つ、会合度が２〜５である粒子   （２）有機酸   （３）酸化剤   【選択図】なし

abstract: 【課題】ウェハを研磨する際に、ウェハの被研磨面と研磨パッドの接触圧と定盤の回転数が低い条件であっても高研磨速度で低エロージョンの研磨が可能な化学的機械的研磨方法を提供すること。 【解決手段】下記式（Ｉ）で表されるノニオン性界面活性剤及び２級又は３級の窒素原子を含む有機酸を含む金属用研磨液を、研磨定盤上の研磨パッドに供給し、ウェハの被研磨面と研磨パッドの接触圧力が４，０００〜１２，０００Ｐａであり、定盤の回転数が５０〜１５０ｒｐｍである条件下で被研磨面を研磨することを特徴とする研磨方法。     Ｒ 1 Ｏ−（Ｘ） m −ＣＲ 3 Ｒ 5 −Ｃ≡Ｃ−ＣＲ 4 Ｒ 6 −（Ｙ） n −ＯＲ 2     （Ｉ） （但し、式中のＲ 1 〜Ｒ 6 は水素原子又は炭素数１〜１０のアルキル基をそれぞれ表し、Ｘ及びＹはエチレンオキシ基又はプロピレンオキシ基をそれぞれ表し、ｍ及びｎは０〜２０の整数をそれぞれ表す。）

title: 金属研磨用組成物及びそれを用いた化学的機械的研磨方法
abstract: 【課題】ディッシングやエロージョンを抑制し、研磨後の洗浄性の良好な金属研磨用組成物、及びそれを用いた化学的機械的研磨方法を提供する。 【解決手段】（ａ）コロイダルシリカをアルミン酸イオンまたはホウ酸イオンを用いて表面改質した砥粒と、（ｂ）アニオン性置換基を有し、分子内に３つ以上の窒素原子を有する複素芳香環化合物と、を含有することを特徴とする金属研磨用組成物、及びそれを用いた化学的機械的研磨方法。 【選択図】なし

title: 金属用研磨液及びその調製方法
abstract: 【課題】酸化剤添加後も極めて安定な性能を示す化学的機械的研磨用の金属用研磨液を提供すること。また、簡単な方法で効率よく金属イオンを低減し、酸化剤添加後も極めて安定な性能を示す化学的機械的研磨用の金属用研磨液の調製方法を提供すること。 【解決手段】本発明の研磨液は、半導体デバイスの化学的機械的研磨に用いられる金属用研磨液であり、有機酸および不動態膜形成剤の少なくとも一方をイオン交換水に溶解した溶液を、金属キレート能を有する基を有する水不溶性樹脂で処理して重金属イオンを固体質量換算で１ｐｐｍ以下とし、処理後の溶液に、砥粒および酸化剤を含有させてなる研磨液である。 【選択図】なし

title: 金属用研磨液、及び化学的機械的研磨方法
abstract: 【課題】被研磨体（ウエハ）を研磨する際に、高い研磨速度と低ディッシングとの両立を可能とする金属用研磨液、及びそれを用いた化学的機械的研磨方法を提供すること。 【解決手段】半導体デバイス製造工程における化学的機械的研磨に用いられ、下記一般式（１）で表される界面活性剤と、一次粒子径が２０〜４０ｎｍであり、且つ、会合度が２以下のコロイダルシリカと、を含有することを特徴とする金属用研磨液、及びそれを用いた化学的機械的研磨方法（一般式（１）中、Ｒは、炭素数８〜２０の直鎖又は分岐のアルキル基を表し、Ａｒは、アリール基を表し、Ｍ ＋ は、水素イオン、アルカリ金属イオン、又はアンモニウムを表す。）。     Ｒ−Ａｒ−Ｏ−Ａｒ−ＳＯ ３   − Ｍ ＋       一般式（１） 【選択図】なし

title: 金属用研磨液
abstract: 【課題】迅速な銅研磨速度、及び、良好な銅／タンタル研磨選択性を有し、更に、ディッシングが少なく平坦性を向上させることが可能な金属用研磨液を提供すること。 【解決手段】半導体集積回路用基板の製造工程における化学的機械的平坦化に用いられ、（Ａ）有機無機複合粒子、（Ｂ）キノリンカルボン酸又はその誘導体、（Ｃ）アミノ酸、及び（Ｄ）酸化剤を含有することを特徴とする金属用研磨液。主として銅配線の研磨に用いられることが好ましい。 【選択図】なし

title: 金属用研磨液、及び化学的機械的研磨方法
abstract: 【課題】被研磨体（ウエハ）を研磨する際に、高い研磨速度が得られ、且つ、経時による研磨速度の低下が抑制された金属用研磨液、及びそれを用いた化学的機械的研磨方法を提供すること。 【解決手段】半導体デバイス製造工程における化学的機械的研磨に用いられ、下記一般式（Ｉ）で表されるアミノ酸誘導体、複素芳香環化合物、砥粒、酸化剤、及び金属キレート剤を含有することを特徴とする金属用研磨液［一般式（Ｉ）中、Ｒ １ は炭素数１〜４のアルキル基を表し、Ｒ ２ は炭素数１〜３のアルキレン基を表す。］。     【選択図】なし

title: 研磨液
abstract: 【課題】有機重合粒子の表面が十分な強度及び硬度を有し、耐熱性に優れ、適度に柔軟であって、研磨速度を大きくすることができるとともにスクラッチの発生も抑えられる研磨液を提供する。 【解決手段】半導体集積回路の平坦化工程における主としてバリア層の化学的機械的研磨に用いられる研磨液であって、（１）有機重合粒子表面の酸素原子を介して、Ｔｉ、Ａｌ、Ｚｒ、およびＳｉからなる群より選択される少なくとも一種の無機原子が結合してなる表面修飾粒子、（２）有機酸、（３）カルボキシル基を２つ以上有するアゾール化合物、及び（４）酸化剤を含み、かつ、ｐＨが１〜７である研磨液である。 【選択図】なし

title: 金属用研磨液、及び化学的機械的研磨方法
abstract: 【課題】被研磨体（ウェハ）を研磨する際に、高研磨速度とディッシングの低減とを両立することが可能な金属用研磨液、及び該金属用研磨液を用いた化学的機械的研磨方法を提供する。 【解決手段】半導体デバイス製造工程における化学的機械的研磨に用いられ、ペルオキソ二硫酸塩と、親水性基を置換基として有するアゾ−ル化合物と、を含有することを特徴とする金属用研磨液、及び該金属用研磨液を研磨定盤上の研磨パッドに供給し、該研磨定盤を回転させることで、該研磨パッドを被研磨体の被研磨面と接触させつつ相対運動させて研磨することを特徴とする化学的機械的研磨方法。 【選択図】なし

title: 金属用研磨液、および化学的機械的研磨方法
abstract: 【課題】半導体ウエハを研磨する際に、高い研磨速度と低ディッシングとの両立を可能とする金属用研磨液、及びそれを用いた化学的機械的研磨方法を提供する。 【解決手段】半導体デバイス製造工程における化学的機械的研磨に用いられ、下記一般式（１）で表される化合物、酸化剤、および有機酸を含有する金属用研磨液。     （一般式（１）中、Ｑは窒素原子またはＣＲ ５ を表す。Ｚは、水素原子、ハロゲン原子、脂肪族炭化水素基、アリール基、ヘテロ環基、カルボキシル基、カルバモイル基、アシルアミノ基、アミノ基、またはシアノ基を表す。） 【選択図】なし

title: 金属用研磨液、及び化学的機械的研磨方法
abstract: 【課題】半導体デバイスの製造工程において、被研磨体（ウエハ）を研磨する際に、高い研磨速度が得られ、且つ、金属用研磨液の経時による研磨速度の変動が抑制された金属用研磨液、及びそれを用いた化学的機械的研磨方法を提供する。 【解決手段】（Ｉ）有機酸、（II）不動態膜形成剤、(III)砥粒、（IV）酸化剤、及び（Ｖ）下記一般式（Ａ）または一般式（Ｂ）で表される化合物を含有する金属用研磨液。             【選択図】なし

title: 化学的機械的研磨液及び研磨方法
abstract: 【課題】沈殿形成がなく、研磨速度が速い化学的機械的研磨液、及び、研磨方法を提供すること。 【解決手段】（Ａ）シリカ粒子、（Ｂ）酸化剤、（Ｃ）０．０１ｐｐｍ以上、１０ｐｐｍ未満の範囲内にある金属イオン、及び、（Ｄ）酸化剤と金属イオンとによる反応活性を向上させる化合物を含有し、ｐＨが２．０〜５．０の範囲内にあることを特徴とする化学的機械的研磨液。前記化学的機械的研磨液を、研磨定盤上に貼付した研磨パッドに供給する工程、及び、前記研磨定盤を回転させることで、前記研磨パッドを被研磨体の被研磨面と接触させつつ相対運動させて研磨する工程を含むことを特徴とする研磨方法。 【選択図】なし

title: 药液、药液的制造方法、基板的处理方法
abstract: 本发明提供一种对过渡金属含有物具有优异的蚀刻性能，且具有优异的缺陷抑制性能的药液、上述药液的制造方法及基板的处理方法。本发明的药液为包含选自由高碘酸及其盐组成的组中的一种以上的高碘酸类、选自由Ti及Zr组成的组中的一种以上的第1金属成分及水的药液，药液包含一种第1金属成分时，一种第1金属成分的含量相对于高碘酸类总质量为1质量ppt～100质量ppm，药液包含两种第1金属成分时，两种第1金属成分的含量分别相对于高碘酸类总质量为100质量ppm以下，两种第1金属成分中的至少一种成分的含量相对于上述高碘酸类总质量为1质量ppt以上。

title: 處理液、處理方法
abstract: 本發明提供一種去除目標物的去除性優異的同時，能夠抑制包含選自包括Co及Cu之群組中之1種以上的第1金屬之第1金屬含有物的蝕刻之處理液及處理方法。本發明的處理液係對含有包含選自包括Co及Cu之群組中之1種以上的第1金屬之第1金屬含有物之被處理物進行處理時使用之處理液，該處理液含有蝕刻劑、有機溶劑及防腐劑，相對於前述處理液的總質量，有機溶劑的含量為80質量％以上，防腐劑係選自包括化合物X、化合物Y及化合物Z之群組中之1種以上的化合物。

title: 處理液、被對象物的處理方法、半導體器件的製造方法
abstract: 本發明的課題為提供一種Cu的腐蝕抑制性優異並且有機殘渣去除性亦優異的處理液。前述處理液含有：還原劑；及特定化合物，選自包括脫氫抗壞血酸、2,3-二酮古洛糖酸、4-草醯巴豆酸及3,4,5-三氧環己烷-1-羧酸之群組中之至少1種。

title: 处理液、被对象物的处理方法、半导体器件的制造方法
abstract: 本发明提供一种在适用于具有实施了化学机械研磨处理的铜表面的被对象物时铜的腐蚀少且铜表面上的有机残渣的去除性优异的处理液、及使用上述处理液的被对象物的处理方法、及半导体器件的制造方法。本发明的处理液包含阴离子性聚合物、膦酸化合物及含有羟基的羧酸，上述膦酸化合物的含量相对于上述阴离子性聚合物的含量的质量比为0.1～1000，该处理液的pH为0.1～7.0，并且使用于半导体制造工序。

title: 薬液、被処理物の処理方法、半導体デバイスの製造方法
abstract: 本発明は、組成の異なる２種のシリコンゲルマニウム含有物を有する被処理物中から、ゲルマニウム濃度が高いシリコンゲルマニウム含有物を選択的に除去できる、薬液の提供を課題とする。本発明の薬液は、ゲルマニウム濃度が異なる２つのシリコン－ゲルマニウム含有物を有する被処理物に対して用いられ、ゲルマニウム濃度が高い上記シリコン－ゲルマニウム含有物の少なくとも一部を除去する薬液であって、フッ化物イオン源と、酸化剤と、式（１）Ｒ ２ Ｃ＝ＣＨ－＊　で表される基を有する特定不飽和化合物と、溶媒と、を含む。

title: 藥液、被處理物之處理方法、半導體器件之製造方法
abstract: 本發明提供一種藥液、藥液所涉及的被處理物之處理方法、及半導體器件之製造方法，所述藥液能夠從具有Ge濃度不同之兩種含SiGe物的被處理物中，相較於Ge濃度較低的含SiGe物選擇性地去除Ge濃度較高的含SiGe物。本發明之藥液係用於具有鍺濃度不同之兩種含矽-鍺物的被處理物的藥液，所述藥液包含水、氯化氫、及過氧化氫，並且過氧化氫的含量與氯化氫的含量之質量比為0.20以上，水的含量與氯化氫的含量之質量比為130～560。

title: 薬液、被処理物の処理方法、半導体デバイスの製造方法
abstract: 本発明は、ゲルマニウム濃度が異なる２つのシリコン－ゲルマニウム含有物、及び、酸素原子を含みゲルマニウム原子を含まないシリコン含有物を有する被処理物中から、酸素原子を含みゲルマニウム原子を含まないシリコン含有物の除去が抑制され、ゲルマニウム濃度が高いシリコンゲルマニウム含有物を選択的に除去できる、薬液、被処理物の処理方法及び半導体デバイスの製造方法を提供する。本発明の薬液は、フッ化物イオン源と、酸化剤と、溶媒と、特定不飽和化合物と、を含み、以下の条件１及び条件２の少なくとも一方を満たす。　（条件１）　上記特定不飽和化合物が二重結合を含み、アミド基を有さない化合物であり、　上記薬液が、シラン化合物、アミド化合物、及び窒素含有ポリマーから選択される特定化合物を更に含む。　（条件２）　上記特定不飽和化合物が三重結合を含む化合物であり、　上記薬液が、窒素含有ポリマーを更に含む。

title: 薬液、被処理物の処理方法、半導体デバイスの製造方法
abstract: 本発明は、ゲルマニウム濃度が異なる２つのシリコン－ゲルマニウム含有物を有する被処理物中から、ゲルマニウム濃度が高いシリコン－ゲルマニウム含有物を選択的に除去できる、薬液を提供する。また、本発明は、上記薬液に係る被処理物の処理方法及び半導体デバイスの製造方法を提供する。本発明の薬液は、ゲルマニウム濃度が異なる２つのシリコン－ゲルマニウム含有物を有する被処理物に対して用いられる薬液であって、フッ化物イオン源と、酸化剤と、水と、を含み、試験１で測定される、腐食電位Ｅ（Ｖ　ｖｓ．　Ａｇ／ＡｇＣｌ）と、上記フッ化物イオン源由来のフッ化物イオン及びフッ素含有イオンの上記薬液中の濃度Ｃ（ｍｏｌ／Ｌ）とが、以下式（Ｘ）の関係を満たす。　Ｅ－０．０５×Ｃ＞－０．２０　・・・式（Ｘ）

title: Fire-retardant optical fiber cable and its manufacturing method
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a plastic optical fiber cable having fire retardancy without lowering mechanical characteristics in forming a fire-retardant coating layer, and its manufacture method.  <P>SOLUTION: The optical fiber cable has a plastic optical fiber as a strand, has a coating layer containing a metal hydroxide whose average particle size is ≤2μm, and has a stage for coating the plastic optical fiber with the coating layer containing the metal hydroxide whose average particle size is ≤2μm.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO

title: Plastic optical fiber cable and manufacturing method
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a multi-core plastic optical fiber cable with a high density and superior humidity resistance.  <P>SOLUTION: A clad part 33b is produced by polymerizing (met)acrylic acid ester having an alicyclic hydrocarbon group with MMA. A core part 33a is produced by an interfacial gel polymerization method. A primary coating layer 33c with a thickness of ≤450μm is formed on a circumferential surface of the clad part 33b. Seven cables 34-39 same as the above single-core optical fiber cable 33 are bundled, a filler 41 is filled into gaps, and the outer surface of the bundle is covered with a secondary coating layer 43 to produce the multi-core optical fiber cable 40. The cable 40 has superior flexibility because of its thin coating layer, to reduce bending loss.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO&NCIPI

title: Plastic optical fiber and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain a plastic optical fiber which is superior in mechanical strength and suppresses the deterioration in transmission loss.  <P>SOLUTION: An inner clad pipe 12 is manufactured from PVDF by using a melt extrusion process. An outer core 14a consisting of PMMA is formed in the inner clad pipe 12 by a rotation polymerization method. An inner core 14b is formed in the outer core by an interface gel polymerization method, and thus a GI type core part forming rod 15 is obtained. An outer clad pipe 16 is manufactured from PVDF by using a melt extrusion process. The core part forming rod 15 is put in the outer clad pipe 16 to obtain a preform 19. The plastic optical fiber is obtained by hot melt drawing the preform 19.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Manufacturing method of plastic optical fiber, plastic optical fiber, and optical transmission body
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To manufacture a plastic optical fiber (POF) that materializes low transmission loss.  <P>SOLUTION: A first member 17 in which a plurality of polymerized body layers are laminated and a cylindrical second member 19 are separately formed. The first member 17 is inserted into the second member 19 and then combined with a cylindrical third member 21 to make a preform 12. In a first member forming process 18, the first member 17 is formed so that a difference between the orientation S1 of the innermost layer and the orientation S2 of the outermost layer of the first member 17 becomes not less than 0 but below 0.2. Also, in the first member forming process 18, a layer forming material containing at least one or more kinds of polymerizable compositions and a chain transfer agent comprising a thiol group is poured into a hollow tube and polymerized, with this process repeated to form the first member 17. By heating and drawing the preform 12, the POF 11 can be obtained in which thermal contraction due to heat is suppressed, resulting in a low transmission loss.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Conductive metal film and translucent electromagnetic shield film
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an electromagnetic shield film for a plasma display which has an excellent electromagnetic shielding property and therefore can effectively cut off electromagnetic waves, near infrared rays, stray light, outside light, etc., has little change in hue even if it is stored under a high temperature and a high humidity, has a good adhesiveness, and hardly has a separation of a blackened layer; and also to provide a conductive metal film to be widely used for houses, factories, etc.  <P>SOLUTION: This is a translucent electromagnetic shield film which has an electromagnetic shielding capability and includes a patterned conductive metal film whose surface is covered by the blackened layer, and which is formed on a transparent support. The blackened layer is formed of nickel, with an amount of nickel being 0.06-5.0 g/m<SP>2</SP>.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title: Conductive film, manufacturing method, and light transparency electromagnetic wave shield film
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an electromagnetic wave shield film of plasma display having good adhesion property and hardly exfoliating property of blackened layer, small hue variation in a stored state under humid high temperature conditions, and advantages in electromagnetic wave effective shield property for shielding electromagnetic waves, near infrared ray, stray light, outdoor daylight or the like.  <P>SOLUTION: In the light transparency electromagnetic wave shield film having electromagnetic wave shield ability, a pattern-shaped conductive metallic film with its front face covered by a blackened layer is provided on a transparent support body. The light transparency electromagnetic wave shield film is characterized by the blackened layer made of alloy of nickel and zinc with a mass ratio of 0.5-50 in nickel/zinc.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title: Touch panel, method for manufacturing touch panel and conductive film
abstract: A conductive film is disposed on a display panel. The conductive film includes a conductive part having a mesh pattern composed of thin metal wires. The mesh pattern has moire prevention portions at intersections thereof. The area Sa of the intersection and the area Sb of the moire prevention portion satisfy the following expression: Sa*0.01 < Sb ≤ Sa*5.00. The conductive film includes a transparent substrate, the conductive part composed of the thin metal wires, and a transparent coating layer. The conductive part is formed on one main surface of the transparent substrate with an adhesive layer being interposed therebetween. The transparent coating layer is coated on the conductive part and the exposed portions of the adhesive layer. The difference in refractive index between the adhesive layer and the transparent coating layer is 0.1 or less.

title: Touch panel conductive film and touch panel using the same
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a conductive film which has a simple configuration, is less susceptible to moire when installed on a display panel of a versatile display device, and can be manufactured at high yield, and to provide a display device having the same. 
     SOLUTION: A conductive film 10 comprises a transparent base 12, and a conductive layer 14 formed on a principal surface of the transparent base 12. The conductive layer 14 consists of a mesh pattern 20 comprising rhombus-shaped openings 18, each rhombus having a vertex angle (2θ) in a range of 60-120°.

title: Transparent conductive laminate and touch panel
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a transparent conductive laminate with a low profile and light weight, which has a low haze and does not cause rise of resistance even if voltage is applied under a high temperature and a high humidity, and to provide a touch panel with a low profile and light weight, which has superior visibility and does not cause failure of operation even if driven under a high temperature and high humidity.SOLUTION: A transparent conductive laminate has: a first barrier film; a patterned transparent conductive film which contains metal nanowires having an average minor axis length of 5-50 nm and is formed on the surface of the first barrier film directly or with another layer being interposed therebetween; an adhesive layer covering the patterned transparent conductive film; and a second barrier film arranged adjacent to the adhesive layer. The water vapor transmission rates of the first and second barrier films are ≤0.1 g/(mday).

title: Conductive film and touch panel module
abstract:
Provided are: a conductive film which is configured such that disconnection of a thin metal wire does not easily occur by making ink filling defects less likely to occur in a groove of the film surface when net-like fine metal wires are formed on the film surface by nanoimprinting; and a touch panel module which uses this conductive film. With respect to the cross-sectional shape of a groove that is formed in the surface of a film member, if W O  is the width of the opening, W B  is the width of the bottom, d is the depth and θ is the angle of the inner wall lateral surface of the groove relative to the direction perpendicular to the surface of the film member, the groove satisfies the following relations.
W O  > W B 
0 < θ ≤ 53.74 × (d/W O ) + 50
0 < θ ≤ 64
0.2 ≤ W O  ≤ 4
0.1 ≤ d ≤ 5

title: Touch panel conductive film and touch panel
abstract: The present invention provides touch panel conductive film and touch panel, touch panel have with conductive film: transparent resin substrate, with a thickness of 40 μm or less and has flexibility；Multiple detecting electrodes are formed at least one face of resin substrate；Multiple periphery wirings are formed at least one face of resin substrate and respectively with multiple detecting electrodes and connect；And multiple external connection terminals, it is formed at least one face of resin substrate and is connect respectively with multiple periphery wirings, in multiple external connection terminals, adjacent external connection terminals separate distance between 100 μm or more and 200 μm of terminals below, and with 500 μm of spacing arrangements below, and it is respectively provided with the termination width more than distance between terminal, in resin substrate on the face of face opposite side for being formed with multiple external connection terminals, accordingly also have with the terminal forming region for being formed with multiple external connection terminals with a thickness of 20 μm or more and 150 μm of insulating protective layers below.

title: Conductive film for touch panel
abstract: Provided is a conductive film for a touch panel including: an insulating substrate including a pair of surfaces facing each other; a detection electrode pattern portion which is formed of thin metal wires formed on at least one surface of the pair of surfaces of the insulating substrate; a wiring portion which is disposed on the same surface as the surface of the insulating substrate where the detection electrode pattern portion is formed, and includes a plurality of lead-out wirings formed of metal which are connected to the detection electrode pattern portion; and a shielding electrode farmed of metal which is disposed on a surface on a side opposite to the surface of the insulating substrate where the wiring portion is disposed and at a position corresponding to the wiring portion, in which the shielding electrode includes a mesh-like pattern portion which is formed of metal wires respectively intersecting with the lead-out wirings of the wiring portion and has an opening ratio equal to or greater than 80%, and has sheet resistance equal to or smaller than 20 Ω/sq.

title: Conductive film laminate, touch sensor, and method of manufacturing touch sensor
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a conductive film laminate which can prevent separation between a support and a conductive film even when formed in a three-dimensional shape.SOLUTION: A conductive film laminate for forming a three-dimensional touch sensor having detection areas formed on a top face and side faces connected to the top face includes: an insulating planar support; and a conductive film bonded on the surface of the support with adhesive. The conductive film includes a flexible insulating substrate and a conductive film arranged on the insulating substrate. The insulating substrate includes at least one opening formed to include a part of boundary between the top face and the side faces. The conductive film includes detection electrodes and multiple pieces of electrically connected peripheral wiring in each of the detection electrodes. At least a part of the peripheral wiring is arranged to surround at least a part of the opening. The opening is closed by the support.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Touch panel conductive film, touch panel, and display device
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a touch panel conductive film excellent in visibility, adhesion property and abrasion resistance of a thin metallic wire, and further in step followability.SOLUTION: The touch panel conductive film comprises: a transparent insulation substrate; a detection electrode including thin metallic wires formed on the transparent insulation substrate; and a protective layer formed on the transparent insulation substrate and covering at least part of the surface of the thin metallic wire. The thin metallic wire includes an apical surface facing opposite to the transparent insulation substrate and a lateral face extending from a marginal part of the apical surface to the transparent insulation substrate, and includes a narrow part with a line width smaller than a line width of the apical surface. The protective layer covers the lateral face of the thin metallic wire at the height of equal to or higher than 50% of the thin metallic wire, and covers the apical surface of the thin metallic wire with a thickness of 1 nm to 5 μm.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Conductive film for touch panel, conductive member, and touch panel
abstract: Provided are: a conductive film for a touch panel, the conductive film being capable of facilitating reliable connection with an external wiring board and suppressing the occurrence of migration in an external connection terminal; a conductive member; and a touch panel. The conductive film for a touch panel has: a substrate 5; a plurality of detection electrodes 11 formed on a substrate surface 5A; a plurality of lead-out wires 12 formed on the substrate surface 5A and respectively connected to the detection electrodes 11 via one end; a plurality of external connection terminals 13 formed on the substrate surface 5A and respectively connected to the other ends of the lead-out wires 12; and a protective layer 7 formed on the substrate surface 5A, wherein at least a portion of the top surface 13A of the external connection terminal 13 is left exposed by the protective layer 7, the top surface 7A of the protective layer 7 is positioned further away from the substrate surface 5A than the top surface 13A of the external connection terminal 13, and the height difference between the top surface 7A of the protective layer 7 and the top surface 13A of the external connection terminal 13 is 15 µm or less.

title: PRINTING INKS
abstract: Non-aqueous printing ink for "drop-on-demand" ink jet printers comprising pigment and dispersant which is a polyester chain attached to a polyamine or polyimine chain via amide and/or salt linkages and where the ratio of polyester chain to polyamine or polyimine is from 5:1 to 20:1 by weight. Preferably the polyimine is polyethyleneimine.

title: Printing ink
abstract: The present invention provides an inkjet ink comprising: 6-35% by weight of NVC; 5-60% by weight of PEA; 15-35% by weight of a C8.12 alkane diol di(meth)acrylate; a radical photoinitiator; and a colorant, wherein the percentages by weight are based on the total weight of the ink. The present invention further provides an inkjet ink set wherein at least one of the inks in the set, preferably all of the inks in the set, is an inkjet ink as defined above. Furthermore, the present invention provides a method of inkjet printing comprising inkjet printing the inkjet ink or inkjet ink set as defined above onto a substrate and curing the ink.

title: Printing ink
abstract: The present invention provides an inkjet ink comprising: an N-vinyl amide and/or N-acryloyl amine monomer; at least two cyclic monofunctional (meth)acrylate monomers; a difunctional (meth)acrylate monomer; a radical photoinitiator; and a colorant, wherein one of the cyclic monofunctional (meth)acrylate monomers is PEA, and wherein the difunctional (meth)acrylate monomer is a C8-12 alkane diol di(meth)acrylate. The present invention further provides an inkjet ink set wherein at least one of the inks in the set, preferably all of the inks in the set, is an inkjet ink as defined above. Furthermore, the present invention provides a method of inkjet printing comprising inkjet printing the inkjet ink or an inkjet ink set as defined above onto a substrate and curing the ink.

title: A printing ink
abstract: The invention relates to an inkjet ink comprising: one or more monofunctional (meth)acrylate monomers, including 2-methyl-2-ethyl-1,3-dioxolane-4-yl)methyl acrylate (MEDA); a pigment; and a photoinitiator.

title: A printing ink
abstract: The invention relates to an inkjet ink comprising a solvent, a vinyl and/or polyester resin dissolved in the solvent and a dispersed pigment, wherein the ink contains no more than 10% by weight of hyperdispersant, based on the total weight of the ink absent the solvent.

title: Printing ink
abstract: The present invention provides an inkjet ink comprising: an aqueous polyurethane (meth)acrylate dispersion, which is redispersible in water after thermal drying and before curing; more than 5% by weight but less than 15% by weight of a non-UV-curable humectant, based on the total weight of the ink; and a water-dispersible or water-soluble photoinitiator. The present invention also provides a method of inkjet printing said ink, drying and curing the ink.

title: Ink, ink cartridge, ink set, inkjet printer, and inkjet textile printing method
abstract: The present invention provides: an ink which comprises water, an aqueous organic solvent, and colored resin particles, wherein the resin particles comprise a resin (B) and a dye (A) represented by a specific structure, and the mass ratio (dye (A))/(resin (B)) between the dye (A) and the resin (B) is at least 1.2; an ink cartridge being loaded with said ink; an ink set; an inkjet printer; and an inkjet textile printing method comprising a step for printing on a cloth with said ink by an inkjet method.

title: A method of printing
abstract: A method of inkjet printing comprises (i) providing an inkjet ink containing radiation-curable material, 8 wt.% dispersed organic pigment, and <5 wt.% combined water and volatile organic solvent, (ii) inkjet printing the ink onto a substrate to produce a film, and (iii) curing the film by exposure to low energy electron beam radiation. The ink may comprise 10-40 wt.% monofunctional monomer and/or 40-80 wt.% difunctional monomer as radiation-curable materials. Monofunctional monomers may include lauryl acrylate, isobornyl acrylate, phenoxyethyl acrylate, cyclic-TMP formal acrylate, tetrahydrofurfuryl acrylate, (2-methyl-2-ethyl-1,3-dioxolane-4-yl)methyl acrylate, 4-tert-butylcyclohexyl acrylate, 3,3,5-trimethylcyclohexyl acrylate, octadecyl acrylate, 2-(2-ethoxyethoxy)ethyl acrylate, tridecyl acrylate, or isodecyl acrylate. The difunctional monomer may be 3-methyl-1,5-pentanediol diacrylate, triethylene glycol divinyl ether, 1,10-decanediol diacrylate, hexanediol diacrylate, polyethylene glycol diacrylate, tripropylene glycol diacrylate, dipropylene glycol diacrylate, tricyclodecane dimethanol diacrylate, propoxylated neopentyl glycol diacrylate, trimethylolpropane triacrylate, di-trimethylolpropane tetraacrylate, dipentaerythritol hexaacrylate, ethoxylated trimethylolpropane triacrylate, or ethoxylated pentaerythritol tetraacrylate. The ink is typically free of photoinitiators.

title: Printing ink
abstract: The present invention provides an inkjet ink comprising: a radiation-curable material; 4-hydroxy- 2,2,6,6-tetramethylpiperidin-1-oxyl; and one or more photoinitiators selected from ethyl (2,4,6- trimethylbenzoyl) phenyl phosphinate, ethyl(3-benzoyl-2,4,6-trimethylbenzoyl)(phenyl) phosphinate, a polymeric phosphine oxide photoinitiator and mixtures thereof. The present invention also provides a method of inkjet printing using the inkjet ink.

title: Printing ink
abstract: The present invention provides an inkjet ink comprising benzyl acrylate, (2-methyl-2-ethyl-1,3-dioxolane-4-yl)methyl acrylate, and an N-vinyl amide monomer and/or an N-(meth)acryloyl amine monomer, wherein the ink has a viscosity of less than 15 mPas at 25° C. The present invention also provides a method of inkjet printing comprising inkjet printing the inkjet ink onto a substrate and curing the inkjet ink by exposing the inkjet ink to a curing source.

title: Printing ink
abstract: The present invention provides a white inkjet ink comprising: tricyclodecane dimethanol diacrylate; at least one of a difunctional urethane (meth)acrylate oligomer, (2-methyl-2-ethyl-1,3-dioxolane-4- yl)methyl acrylate and a polyethylene glycol diacrylate; a white pigment; and a monofunctional monomer, other than (2-methyl-2-ethyl-1,3-dioxolane-4-yl)methyl acrylate. The present invention further provides a method of inkjet printing comprising inkjet printing the inkjet ink of the present invention onto a substrate and curing the inkjet ink by exposing the inkjet ink to a curing source, preferably wherein the curing source is a UV LED light.

title: Printing ink
abstract: The present invention relates to an inkjet ink comprising: at least one N-vinyl amide monomer, N- (meth)acryloyl amine monomer and/or N-vinyl carbamate monomer; one or more difunctional (meth)acrylate monomers; one or more divinyl ether monomers; and one or more radiation-curable oligomers, wherein the ink is free of benzophenone. The present invention also relates to a method of inkjet printing.

title: Printing ink
abstract: The present invention relates to an inkjet ink comprising 1,10-decanediol diacrylate (DDDA), lauryl acrylate, polyethylene glycol 600 diacrylate (PEG600DA), a photoinitiator package comprising one or more photoinitiators, and optionally a colourant, wherein PEG600DA is present in 8-40% by weight, based on the total weight of the ink. The present invention also relates to a method of inkjet printing and a printed substrate.

title: Printing ink
abstract: The present invention provides a white inkjet ink comprising: at least one N-vinyl amide monomer, N-(meth)acryloyl amine monomer and/or N-vinyl carbamate monomer; a white pigment; and 4.0 to 7.0% by weight of ethyl phenyl (2,4,6-trimethylbenzoyl) phosphinate, based on the total weight of the ink, wherein the ink is free of diphenyl(2,4,6-trimethylbenzoyl)phosphine oxide and phenylbis(2,4,6-trimethylbenzoyl)phosphine oxide. The present invention further provides a method of inkjet printing comprising inkjet printing the inkjet ink onto a substrate and curing the inkjet ink by exposing the inkjet ink to a curing source. Further, the invention provides a substrate having the inkjet ink printed thereon.

title: Packaging material for photosensitive material
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide the packaging material which can surely assure light shieldability without generating heat-seal cutting and has good film flatness and photographic characteristic by using a compounded resin of a low-density polyethylene (LDPE) resin and straight chain low-density polyethylene resin (L-LDPE) resin having specific performances and various additives. CONSTITUTION:The polyolefin resin film contg. 50 to 95wt.% high-pressure method branched LDPE resin having 0.5 to 10g/10min melt index, 0.915 to 0.935g/cm<3> density, and >=4.0mol.wt. distribution, 5 to 49wt.% ethylene/alpha-olefin copolymer resin having 0.5 to 10g/10min melt incex, 0.890 to 0.940g/cm<2> density, and 2.5 to 9.0mol.wt. distribution, 0.5 to 15wt.% carbon black, 0.01 to 5wt.% blocking preventive material, and 0.01 to 1.0wt% antioxidant is used for the photosensitive material. This film 1a is capable of satisfying all the characteristics including light shieldability, film formability, heat-seal cutting preventiveness, heat-seal strength, blocking preventiveness, lubricity, etc., required for the packaging material for photographic sensitive materials.

title: Packaging material for photographic sensitive material and its manufacture
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To ensure perfect light shielding and to prevent occurrence of melt fracture and to enhance physical strength and the like by forming at least plural resin layers containing a specified amount of a light shielding material same as each other in composition. SOLUTION: This packaging material for the photographic sensitive material is perfect light shielding thermoplastic resin film layers comprising an outer layer 1a and an inner layer 2a both containing the light shielding material and formed by the coextrusion inflation process. Both layers 1a and 2a have the same thickness and >=70weight% of both layers are same as each other in composition, and the use of >=2 light shielding films permits the perfect light shielding to be ensured for the packaging material of the photosensitive material, and even if pinholes occur in one layer, light shielding to be acquired by the other light shielding film.

title: Packing material for photosensitive material
abstract: PURPOSE:To enhance the light shielding properties, etc. of the titled packing material by sticking two uniaxially oriented high density polyethylene films together with an adhesive layer contg. Al paste or the like so that the orienting axes of the films make a specified angle. CONSTITUTION:At least two uniaxially oriented films 1', 1' made of high density polyethylene having >=0.94g/cm<3> density and cotng. a light shielding substance such as carbon black are stuck together with adhesive layer 3 contg. Al paste or Al powder so that the orienting axes of the films make 45-90 deg. angle. Thus, the desired material for packing a photosensitive material is botd. inexpensively. This packing material has various characteristics required as a photosensitive material packing material, e.g., physical strength, light shielding properties, moistureproof, antistatic properties and suitability to heat sealing.

title: Easily openable packaging material for photographic photosensitive materials
abstract:
An easily openable packaging material for photographic photosensitive materials which comprises, a light-shielding heat-sealable film layer containing a lubricant, a light-shielding material and more than 50 wt. % of a high-pressure low-density polyethylene resin and being located as the inner layer, an aluminum foil layer which is laminated on the above heat-sealable film layer with a delamination resistance of greater than 400 g/15 mm width and on the heat-sealable film layer side of which an anchor coat layer is formed and, a heat-resistant flexible sheet layer which is laminated on the above aluminum foil layer and of which heat resistance is higher than the above heat-sealable film layer by 5° C. or more. 
     This packaging material can easily be torn by hand without a notch.

title: Packaging material for photographic sensitive material
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enhance film forming aptitude and to ensure heat salability and physical strength and restraining photographic performance from being adversely affected and the like by arranging multilayer co-extruded films so as to locate a single-site type L-LDPE resin layer and a multisite type L-LDPE resin layer in both surfaces. SOLUTION: The single-site type L-LDPE resin layer 1 composed essentially of an ethylene-α-olefin copolymer resin polymerized by a single-site catalyst and the multi-site type L-LDPE resin layer 2 composed essentially of an ethylene-α-olefin copolymer resin polymerized by a multi-site catalyst are used and the multilayer coextruded film II locating both layers 1 and 2 on both surfaces. Further, when the film II is used for the use necessitating light shielding, it is preferred that a light-shielding material is contained by 0.1-40 wt.% in a layer above the layer 1 of the film II, thus permitting the light- shielding ability to ensured.

title: Material for packaging photosensitive material
abstract: PURPOSE:To enhance product insertion easiness, slittability, physical strength, heat sealability, etc., by using a packaging film specified in thickness composed of linear low-pressure low-density polyethylene L-LDPE having a specified density or more, containing a metallic powder or carbon black, and a lubricant. CONSTITUTION:The packaging film has a film thickness of 50-250mum is composed of >=50wt% L-LDPE having a density of >=0.930g/cm<3>, and containing >=0.5g/m<2> metallic powder or carbon black, and 0.05-1.0wt% lubricant. The addition of the metallic powder or carbon black and the lubricant prevents blocking between the L-LDPE films themselves, reduces anisotropy due to orientation, and improves humidity resistance, rigidity, slittability, heat cuttability, tensile strength, antistaticness, and slidability, and gives light shading property, too. Especially when a precious product or highly sensitive product or product liable to adverse effect by oxygen or sulfur gases is packaged, it is necessary to use a film having a thickness of >=70mum, preferably, >=100mum.

title: Packaging material for photographic sensitive material
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the packaging workability, moistureproofness and light shieldability of the packaging material by using laminated films formed by combining respectively 3 kinds of flexible sheets. CONSTITUTION:The easily steam permeable flexible sheet 2a having >=5g/m<2>.24 hour steam permeability on one surface of a water absorptive flexible sheet 1 contg. water absorptive material and the hardly steam permeable flexible sheet 6 having <=5g/m<2>.24 hour steam permeability on the other surface are laminated, respectively. The steam permeability of the sheet 2a is made >=1.5 times the steam permeability of the sheet 6. For example, the sheet 6 formed by vapor deposition of an Al film 5 on a polyester film 4 and the film 2a consisting of an ethylenic copolymer added with a carbon black and antioxidant are laminated via adhesive agent layers 3 on the sheet 1 coated with a water absorptive resin, by which the packaging material is produced.

title: Packaging material for photosensitive materials
abstract:
A packaging material for photosensitive materials for photographic purpose being light-shielding and having the following polyethylene polymer layer; 
     (a) containing 40 to 99% by weight of a low-pressure linear low-density polythylene (L-LDPE) produced by copolymerization of ethylene and heptene-1 or octene-1 by a liquid phase method, the density of said polyethylene is in the range from 0.870 to 0.925 g/cm 3 , and the melt index of the above polyethylene is in the range from 1.2 to 10 g/10 minutes. 
     (b) having a thickness of thicker than 20 μm, 
     (c) being formed by inflation process, and 
     (d) having a tear strength in longitudinal direction/a tear strength in lateral direction ratio of more than 0.6. 
     The packaging material of the invention is superior in the small difference in tear strength between longitudinal direction and lateral direction, in physical strength, in heat sealing properties and in light-shielding property. As a result, it can be made thinner than the conventional packaging material, and its cost is lowered. By blending a fatty acid amide lubricant, packaging aptitude is further improved, and blocking problems can be solved.

title: Negative photosensitive material
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain a negative photosensitive material having high sensitivity and practically sufficient adhesion between a protective layer and a photopolymerizable layer without deteriorating the other performance by forming a specified protective layer on the photopolymerizable layer containing an additionally polymerizable compound and a photopolymerization initiator and a polymer binder. SOLUTION: The protective layer containing a water-soluble vinyl polymer and a polymer not compatible with polyvinyl alcohol but water-soluble itself is formed on the photopolymerizable layer containing the additionally polymerizable compound having an ethylenically unsaturated double bond and the photopolymerization initiator and the polymer binder. It is preferred that these 2 kinds of polymers have a structure of sea islands or 2 laminated layers. The water-soluble vinyl polymer can be embodied by a polyvinyl alcohol and its partially ester and ethers and like. It is preferred that the polymer not compatible to the polyvinyl alcohol but itself water-soluble polymer is a polymer having a polyoxyalkylene group.

title: Photomask blanks and photomask
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide photomask blanks which has a superior storage stability and a high sensitivity even when containing a large quantity of a light shielding material, and to provide a photomask which allows image formation with high resolution and ensures high linearity of an image edge.  <P>SOLUTION: The photomask blanks have, on a substrate, a photosensitive composition layer containing a sensitizing dye (A), a polymerization initiator (B), a multifunctional thiol compound (C) having 2 to 4 mercapto groups in a molecule, a polymerizable compound (D) having at least two ethylenically unsaturated bonds in a molecule, a binder polymer (E), and a light shielding material (F).  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title: Pair of blades and photosensitive material processing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To exhibit the squeezing function (a function to scrape off the liquid stuck on the photosensitive material surface) and the sealing function (a function to cut off the circulation of a liquid) sufficiently and successively for a long period of time and to keep the conveying property of the photosensitive material in good condition. CONSTITUTION:In each of the passages 71-74 of the processing tank 2 in which a processing space being formed by connecting plural processing rooms 6A-6E with the narrow width of passages 71-74 is formed, a pair of blades 15 is provided. The pair of blades 15 is symmetrically provided with a blades 15A composed of a hard material and a blade 15B composed of a soft material so as to closely contact the tip parts by themselves.

title: Photosensitive material processing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To facilitate maintenance of a drying part by providing an inner lid above a drying rack to form a part of an exhaust passage from a development processing part. CONSTITUTION:The upper end part of a photosensitive material passage chamber 29 is divided from an exhaust passage 76 of the development processing part. A sensitive material such as a photographic paper carried from the development processing part is held between an endless belt 42 and a guide roll 44, and sent downward. Hot blast in a hot blast supply chamber 52 is supplied to the sensitive material through an aperture 64 and a slit 68 on the way of this carrying. Thereafter, a part of hot blast is sent in the direction of an arrow B and circulated, and another part is discharged by a fan 84 together with air which flows in the passage 76 in the direction of an arrow F. By this constitution, a drying rack 30 can be lifted and taken out when an outer lid 82 and the inner lid 74 are detached.

title: Processing device for photosensitive material
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide the processing device for photosensitive materials which can prevent the adverse influence at the time of supplying a replenishing liquid even if the volume of the housed processing liquid is small like with a slit type processing tank. CONSTITUTION:A replenishing liquid supply port 6 is provided in the first half region of a stage from the start before the end of immersion of the slit type processing device for photosensitive materials which processes the silver halide photographic sensitive material by immersing this material into the processing liquid. The replenishing liquid supply pipe 4 arriving at this supply port 6 is immersed into the processing liquid in the process of heading toward the first half part from the second half part of the processing so that a heat exchange of the replenishing liquid and the processing liquid is easily executed via the supply pipe 4. The replenishing liquid supply pipe 4 is immersed into the processing liquid in the process of heading to the first half part from the second half part of the processing stage and the supply port 6 is provided in the first half region of the processing, by which the replenishing liquid is heat exchanged with the processing liquid via the supply pipe 4 in the process of arriving at the supply port 6 and its temp. is equilibriated. Then, the temp. difference between the processing liquid and the replenishing liquid is eliminated at the time of the replenishing and the temp. fluctuation of the processing liquid is prevented. The specified photographic characteristics of the photosensitive material are thus obtd.

title: Device for processing photosensitive material
abstract: PURPOSE:To facilitate the inspection, repair, etc., in a processing tank by vertically moving an auxiliary tank for temporarily storing the processing liquid in the processing tank for processing a photosensitive material subjected to image exposing. CONSTITUTION:The auxiliary tank 100 is integrally housed in a frame body 124 and is so constituted that the tank can be moved vertically along a guide 126. A cock 108 is opened to admit the developing soln. in a developing tank 86 at a prescribed rate into the tank 100 before a housing 12 of a plate inspection device 10 draws out a photosensitive material processing device 24. The liquid is temporarily stored therein and the liquid level in the tank 86 is lowered down to the level at which the developing soln. in the tank 86 does not overflow or splash to the outside of the tank at the time of drawing out or moving the photosensitive material processing device 24. The remaining of the processing liquid in the auxiliary tank for liquid level adjustment and a hose connected thereto is obviated in this way at the time of drawing the photosensitive material processing device out of the plate inspection device body or moving the processing device for the purpose of a jam treatment or the inspection and repair, etc., in the processing tank.

title: Device for processing photosensitive material
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the generation of fur by a purifying device and to suppress the passage of washing water having a large degree of contamination through a filter and an adsorbent tank as well as to prolong the life of the filter and adsorbent. CONSTITUTION:This device 1 for processing the photosensitive material has a developing tank 2, a fixing tank 3, a washing tank 4, a squeezing section 7, and a drying section 8, and processes the exposed photosensitive material S by successively transporting the material by means of rollers 51 to 54, 71, 82. Further, the device 1 has a washing water supplying means 18 for supplying the washing water to the washing tank 4, a control means 10 for controlling the operation of the means 18, and the purifying device 9 having the filter 91, a UV rays ozone processing chamber 93 and the adsorbent tank 98. This device 1 detects the passage of the photosensitive material S by a sensor 19 and determines the processing quantity per unit time. The operating time of a pump 15 is prolonged to control the supply rate of the washing water to the washing tank 4 so as to increase this rate when the continuous processing is judged.

title: Photosensitive material processing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the sealing performance between a partition member and a processing tank which constitute the processing device while maintaining the conveyance performance of photosensitive materials as to the photosensitive material processing device providing with a blade in passages connecting processing chambers in the processing tank. CONSTITUTION:The respective processing chambers 6A-6E in the processing tank 2 are constituted by inserting the partition member 3 into the processing tank 2 and coupled by passages 71-76. The blade 15 is arranged in the passages 71-76 to substantially cut off a liquid flow among the processing chambers 6A-6E. The partition member 3 and processing tank 2 contact each other in a liquid-tight state vertically at step parts 33, 34, and 35, and 23, 24, and 25 provided at mutually opposite positions, thereby cutting off the liquid flow. Further, a seal means 36 may be provided between the partition member 3 and processing tank 2 to obtain sufficient sealing effect with contact pressure obtained without increasing the contact pressure of the blade 15.

title: Phtosensitive material processor
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent condensed water droplets from being attached to a photosensitive material. CONSTITUTION:On the inserting port 22 side of a crossover rack 12 arranged at the upper part of a developing tank 10, an inserting roller pair 44 and a guide roller 46 which are surrounded by guide members 30, 32 and 34 and driven to be rotated and which interpose and carry the photosensitive material 14 are arranged. Then, blades 52 are projectingly provided on the guide members toward the respective rollers 44A and 44B of the roller pair 44 and the guide roller 46 and the tip parts thereof are made to abut on the circumferential surfaces of the respective rollers. Therefore, when the rollers is driven to be rotated in order to start the processing of the material 14, the water droplets condensed and attached to the circumferential surfaces of the rollers are scraped by the blades 50 brought into contact with the circumferential surfaces of the rollers. Besides, they are not attached to the material 14 when the rollers are brought into contact with the material 14.

title: Photosensitive material processing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To lessen the generation of unequal processing and the fluctuation in photographic characteristics by connecting a nozzle provided in the vicinity of a photosensitive material feed port and a processing liquid suction port provided in the vicinity of the bottom in a processing space via a circulating means and directing the injection direction of the nozzle toward the direction where the photosensitive material is transported. CONSTITUTION:The processing liquid is injected from the nozzle 19 provided in the vicinity of the feed port 12 in the processing space 11 toward the photosensitive surface of the photosensitive material S and is sucked from the suction port 21 provided in the vicinity of the bottom. This liquid is sent to the nozzle 19 via the circulating means P. Since the injection direction of the processing liquid from the nozzle 19 is directed toward the direction where the photosensitive material S is transported, the tailing and unequal processing generated at the end edge in the opposite direction of the photosensitive part with respect to the direction where the photosensitive material is transport are prevented. In addition, the unequal photosensitive is lessened. Since the processing liquid is injected to the photosensitive surface, the material eluted from the photosensitive surface into the processing liquid is wiped away and the photosensitive surface is processed by the uniform processing liquid at all times. The processed photosensitive material having the good photographic characteristics is obtd. with stability in this way.

title: Photosensitive material processing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve processing efficiency and to reduce the size of the device by installing blades in the respective narrow-width passages successively connected with plural processing chambers and using panel heating element as temp. control means. CONSTITUTION:The plural processing chambers 6A to 6E successively connected by the narrow-width passages, the blades 15 installed in the respective passages, transporting means 8 for successively passing a silver halide photosensitive material S in the respective processing chambers 6A to 6E and the panel heating elements 5 for heating the processing liquids (for example, washing water W) in the processing chambers 6A to 6E are provided. Consequently, the liquid compsn. gradients of the processing liquids are formed between the respective processing chambers 6A to 6E. In addition, the liquid compsn. gradients are maintained by the shielding effect and squeezing effect of the blades 15 and further, since the temp. control is executed by the panel heating elements 5, there is no need for installing the heaters on the outside of a processing tank 2 and the need for temp. control means is eliminated according to the kinds and functions of the panel heating elements 5. The processing efficiency is improved and the replenishing quantity of the processing liquid is decreased. The size of the device is thus reduced.

title: Photosensitive material processor
abstract: PURPOSE:To effectively prevent processing solution from evaporating and being deteriorated and to smoothly open and close an aperture by the expansion and the contraction of a hollow body. CONSTITUTION:A photosensitive material processor 1 is provided with a processing tank 2 where the processing solution Q is put in. The liquid level of the solution Q is covered by a cover body 6 provided with the carrying-in port 66 and the carrying-out port 67 of a photosensitive material S. Besides, the expanding and contracting hollow bodies 71 and 72 are respectively installed in the ports 66 and 67. Then, the bodies 71 and 72 are made to expand and contract by changing the internal pressure of the bodies 71 and 72 by a pressure adjustment means such as a compressor, for example. In accordance with it, the ports 66 and 67 are opened or closed. Such opening and closing of the ports 66 and 67 is executed according to the processing and the non-processing of the material S.

title: Device for processing photosensitive material and method for processing photosensitive material
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the deterioration of a processing liquid and to speed up processing as well as to decrease the volume of the processing liquid and replenishing liquid by providing supply ports which supply the replenishing liquid to a processing path of a slit-shaped section in which a combined developing and fixing bath is packed. CONSTITUTION:The combined developing and fixing bath 10 for developing and fixing a photosensitive material S after exposing is packed into the slit- shaped processing path 15 of a processing tank 1. This device is constituted to supply the replenishing liquid contg. developer components at a high ratio from the replenishing supply port 21 in the inlet part of the replenishing path 15 and to supply the replenishing liquid contg. fixer components at a high ratio from the replenishing supply port 25 or 23 above photosensitive material feed reels. The photosensitive material S is carried into this processing path 15 by means of an inlet reel 24 and while the material is transported by feed reels 16 to 20, the material is processed by the liquid 10. The processed material is taken out by a take-out reel 26. Shutters to parting the processing liquid are preferably provided in front of the supply ports 23, 25.

title: Photosensitive material processing device and replenishing liquid replenishing method for the same
abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce the fatigue of processing liquid and to decrease the amount of supplementary liquid by closing the upper part of a processing tank with a 1st and a 2nd closure part and providing an opening for passing a photosensitive material between those closure parts. CONSTITUTION:A liquid surface lid 66 which is the 1st closure part is fixed to the upper end of the outer periphery of the rack 33 of the developing tank 28 and a conveyance rack 37 which is the 2nd closure part having an arcuate refracting surface 67 is arranged inside the lid 66. Then the photosensitive material 14 where an image is printed is passed through the opening 68 between the lid 66 and rack 37 and carried in the tank 28, and further passes through the other opening 68 of similar constitution and carried to a fixing tank. Further, a level sensor 70 judges the liquid level of a liquid developer in the tank 28 and a replenishing means 77 operates when an electrode 112 does not detect the liquid any more to replenish the replenishing liquid into the tank 28; and the operation of the means 77 is stopped when an electrode 110 detects the liquid.

title: Photosensitive material processing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the accuracy of the positioning of a conveyance rack on a processing tank and to prevent the processing tank from damaging by fitting the conveyance rack to the processing tank through the bent piece of a metallic bracket. CONSTITUTION:Brackets 92 made of metal such as stainless steel are fitted to a couple of opposite sides of the opening edge part of a processing tank main body 30 and racks 40 and 42 are positioned with the lower bent pieces 96 of the brackets 92 and the lower end surfaces of the hanger parts 102 of the conveyance racks 40 and 42. Then a film 20 is sent in the processing tank 34 from an insertion opening 26, lowered by the rack 40 and then elevated, and conveyed and developed. Then the film 20 is sent in the fixing tank 36, conveyed similarly by the rack 42 and fixed, and sent in a washing tank 38, and the film is conveyed similarly by the rack 42 and washed, and then dried.

title: Photosensitive material treating device
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a photosensitive material treating device which can execute a uniform processing. CONSTITUTION:The treating tank 2 of the photosensitive material is partitioned by a partition wall 4. The lower part of the partition wall 4 is held open and serves as a passage for the photosensitive material 12. A solvent liquid 6 is filled in the bottom of the treating tank 2. A developer 8 and a bleach-fixing bath 10 are filled respectively in both sides of the partition wall 4 above the solvent liquid 6. Liquid shielding members 14 are provided on a boundary between the respective processing liquids 8, 10 and the solvent liquid 6. The liquid shielding members 14 is provided with photosensitive material passages 16. Then, the liquid shielding members 14 press the solvent liquid 6, therefore, the waving of the solvent liquid 6 surface is prevented even in the case of the stirring of the processing liquids and the carrying of the photosensitive material. The functions for treating the photosensitive material 12 and for squeezing the photosensitive material 12 by the solvent liquid 6 are thus maintained constant.

title: Photograph processor
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the washing processing efficiency by providing a reservoir of a small capacity on the downstream of a photosensitive material carrying path from a washing tank, feeding a photosensitive material which is brought to washing processing in the washing tank, to the reservoir and bringing it to washing processing again. CONSTITUTION:A reservoir 56 of a small capacity is provided on the downstream of a photosensitive material carrying path from washing tanks 16, 18, and washing water for washing processing from a water feeding source 54 to the washing tanks 16, 18 is allowed to flow in from one side of this reservoir 56 and allowed to flow out to the washing tanks 16, 18 from the other side, and a photosensitive material 20 which is brought to washing processing by the washing tanks 16, 18 is fed to the reservoir 56 and brought to washing processing again by the reservoir 56. That is, the photosensitive material 20 which is exposed is fed to a developing tank 12, a fixing tank 14 and the washing tanks 16, 18, and brought to a series of processings, and thereafter, further fed to the reservoir 56 and brought to washing processing repeatedly. As for the reservoir 56, on one side, washing water is allowed to flow in from the water feeding source 54, and on the other side, the washing water is allowed to flow out to the washing tanks 16, 18, and also, since its capacity is small, it is always filled with washing water by replenishing a small quantity of fresh washing water from the water feeding source 54. In such a way, not only the washing processing can be executed repeatedly but also the washing processing can be executed by replenishing a small quantity of fresh washing water from the water feeding source 54.

title: Photosensitive material processing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To properly process a photosensitive material even with a small quantity of processing liquid and to lessen the makeup liquid. CONSTITUTION:A processing tank 2 is divided in two by a partition 6 except the lower part. The tank is charged with a solvent liquid 14 in the part below both sides of the partition 6 and with a bleaching fixing solution 16 and washing water 18 on both sides of the partition 8 above the solvent liquid 14. A photosensitive material 4 is carried into the bleaching fixing solution 16, the solvent liquid 14 and the washing water 18 in this order. A washing part on the downstream side of the solvent liquid 14 is divided into plural water washing cambers 29 which are arranged in cascades so that the washing water may overflow from the downstream side to the upstream side.

title: Photosensitive material processor
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a photosensitive material processor which suppresses the situation that dust floats up in processing liquid inside a processing liquid tank main body, is attached to the photosensitive material and leaves flaws and which maintains the stable processing performance of forming images without the flaws on the photosensitive material. SOLUTION: A filter 40 is arranged inside an auxiliary chamber 38 formed at the bottom of a processing liquid tank main body 32 and the outer side face of the filter 40 and the inner side face of the auxiliary chamber 38 are separated by 5 mm or more. Then, processing liquid purified through the filter is taken out from the lower layer part of the processing liquid stored in the processing liquid tank main body 32 and fed to the upper layer part of the processing liquid in the processing liquid tank main body 32 through a processing liquid circulation pipeline 30. The processing liquid stored in the processing liquid tank main body 32 is made to flow from the upper layer part to the lower layer part.  The dust in the processing liquid is put on the flows of the processing liquid, made to descend by gravity and caught by the filter 40 to prevent the dust from being stuck to the photosensitive material.

title: Device for processing photosensitive body
abstract: PURPOSE:To miniaturize the device and to lower the amt. of the processing liquid to be replenished by providing liquid drain ports in positions exclusive of a processing chamber where a photosensitive material passes first and a processing chamber where the photosensitive material passes last. CONSTITUTION:The device for processing photosensitive materials which has the processing chambers 6A to 6E segmented to plural chambers in a processing tank 2, are formed with a continuous processing path to connect these processing chambers 6A to 6E, and is so constituted as to process the photosensitive material 100 by bringing the photosensitive material into contact with the processing liquid Q respectively filled in the chambers during the successive passage through the chambers is provided with a liquid feed port 11 in communication with the continuous processing path and is provided with at least one of the liquid drain ports 120 in the positions exclusive of the processing chamber 6A where the photosensitive material 100 passes first and the processing chamber 6E where the photosensitive material passes last. The supply of >=2 kinds of the processing liquids Q having different functions respectively from the plural points is, therefore, possible. The device is miniaturized in this way and the amt. of the processing liquid to be replenished is decreased.

title: Photograph producing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent dirt and dust, etc., from being stuck between a photosensitive material and an image receiving material by pinching the end part of a heat developing photosensitive material in a transverse direction and feeding it from a housing part to a contact part. CONSTITUTION:A gear 102 which receives the driving force of a timing belt 68 is fixed to a conveying roll 95 in order to convey the photosensitive material P and plural pairs of conveying rolls 104 and 106 are provided on the back stream side of conveying rolls 98 and 100. And a small diameter part 112 is formed on the middle part of the conveying rolls 98 and 100 and the conveying rolls 104 and 106 and a small diameter part 120 is formed on the middle part of the conveying rolls 116 and 118 in the same way. Therefore, the photosensitive material P is prevented from contacting with said middle part and the dust can be prevented from sticking to an emulsion surface formed on one side of the photosensitive material P and an image formed part to a back surface. Thus, the dust is prevented from sticking to the central part of a photosensitive surface from the conveying roll and the image of good quality can be transferred on the image receiving material even at the time of developing and transfer.

title: Photograph producing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To easily separate a heat developing photosensitive material from an image receiving material by making the heat developing photosensitive material and the image receiving material project in different directions respectively and guiding these projection part in different directions respectively. CONSTITUTION:Endless belts 398 and 400 for pinching the circle of the leading edge part of the image receiving material are provided on a separation take-out part 38. The endless belt 398 and 400 corresponds to both end parts in the transverse direction of the image receiving material and pinches the leading edge part of the image receiving material fed out from a heat developing part in a horizontal direction so as to bend it upward to raise. Namely, the leading edge part of the image receiving material are allowed to be contact in projecting from the leading edge part of the photosensitive material and the projection part of the image receiving material is pinched with the endless belts 398 and 400 to be raised. In such a state, the leading edge part of the photosensitive material is guided in a downward direction with the lower guide plate 390 and an upper guiding plate 392 and the image receiving material R which is allowed to be raised upward is separated from the photosensitive material which is guided downward by the plates 390 and 392.

title: Image recorder
abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate flawing of the surface of image receiving paper and to reproduce a high-quality image by maintaining the angle at which a photosensitive recording material and the image receiving paper join at <=80 deg. at the time of joining and superposing said material and the image receiving paper via a guide part. CONSTITUTION:The photosensitive material A subjected to a heat developing process is then carried by a Y-shaped guide plate 72 and a 1st feed path 72a via a 5th roller pair 44e into a superposing part 19. The material A and the image receiving paper C are joined and pressed with and to each other in such a manner. The material A is flawed and uneven images are induced if the joining angle thereof is about 90 deg.. The joining angle theta deg. is set at <=80 deg. and the superposing part is so constituted that either of the material A or the paper C advances rectilinearly to the superposing part and the other enters the same at <=80 deg. angle in order to eliminate such formation of the uneven image. The flawing of the material A and the paper C is thereby prevented.

title: Image recorder
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a stable and satisfactory image quality by providing a pressure force adjusting means of a photosensitive material nip part, and adjusting automatically the pressure force of a pressure transfer device in accordance with thickness and rigidity of an image receiving material to be used. CONSTITUTION:By changing the energizing force applied to an oscillation tip part by a pressure adjusting device 53 provided on the oscillation tip part of a supporting member 42, the press-contacting force of a photosensitive material nip part 48 of a fixed nip roller 38 and a free nip roller 23 is adjusted. That is, when a bolt 52 is turned by a motor 47 of the pressure adjusting device 53, a pressure member 41 moves in the axial direction of the bolt, therefore, the compression quality of a coil spring 45 is changed, and the energizing force applied to the oscillation tip part is varied. In such a way, in accordance with the kind of an image receiving material to be used, the pressure force applied to the photosensitive material nip part 48 of a pressure transfer device 22 is adjusted in optimum, and even in the case of bringing an image to a pressure transfer by using the image receiving material whose thickness and rigidity are different, a stable and satisfactory image quality being free from an uneven image and a color shift can be obtained.

title: Peeling device for image recorder
abstract: PURPOSE: To prevent contact marks on image receiving material, and to hold the tight contact of the image receiving material with the outer periphery of a heating drum so as to excellently secure the drying property of the image receiving material. CONSTITUTION: Photosensitive material which is image-exposed is superposed on the image receiving material and wound round the outer periphery of the heating drum 106. When the drum 106 is rotated after heat developing and transferring, a photosensitive material peeling pawl 126 is turned in an opposite direction to the rotating direction of the drum 106 through a pawl shaft 128 and engaged with the preceding edge of the photosensitive material, so that the preceding part is peeled from the drum 106. Thereafter, when the pawl 126 is turned in the same direction as the rotating direction of the drum 106 and moved to a separate position, the photosensitive material is peeled from the image receiving material, and the image receiving material passes between the pawl 126 and the drum 106 with the rotation of the drum 106.  At such a time, a rolling wheel 200 is positioned more proximately to the outer periphery side of the drum 106 than the pawl 126 and rolls in a state where it abuts on the image receiving material, thereby preventing the image receiving material from coming in contact with the pawl 126.

title: Image recorder
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain an image recorder where the drying property of an image receiving material on which an image is formed by thermal developing and transfer can be enhanced, unnecessary traces are not left and the quality of the image can be improved. CONSTITUTION:The peeling position of a photosensitive material 16 by a bending and guiding roller 142 and a peeling pawl 154 is provided on an upstream side in a carrying direction and at a higher position than the peeling position of the image receiving material 108 by a peeling roller 174 and a peeling pawl 176. Therefore, vapor generated when the material 16 is separated from the material 108 and peeled from a heating drum 116 rises as it is and it is not attached on the material 108. Therefore, the drying property of the material 108 is enhanced and the traces of the roller or the like are not left on the material 108 when the material 108 is carried thereafter. Besides, the quality of the recorded image is improved.

title: Image recording system
abstract: PURPOSE:To facilitate handling, control or the like of a photosensitive material and make a device smaller in size, by exposing the photosensitive material to light while paying out the photosensitive material from a first magazine and taking up the material onto a take-up roll in a second magazine, and transferring an image thus obtained onto an image-receiving material separately supplied, thereby recording the image. CONSTITUTION:A thermally developed type photosensitive material 100 is contained in the state of being wound around a payout roll 105 in a magazine 103, and the material 100 paid out through a paying-out part 120 in a sheet form is fed to and taken up around a take-up roll 102 in another magazine 104. An exposure part 200 is provided between feeding rollers 110 and feeding rollers 111, and exposure is conducted in the manner of line scanning by directing transmitted light to the photosensitive material 100. By the feeding, the material 100 and an image-receiving paper 301 are superposed on each other, and are passed over a developing plate 502 at a position A, at which heating to a predetermined temperature is conducted by a heater 503 to transfer an image from the photosensitive material 100 exposed and coated with water to the image-receiving paper 301, and then the material 100 is taken up onto the take-up roll 102. Thus, there is no need for a discarding tray or the like, and handling and control of the photosensitive material are facilitated.

title: Image recording device
abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce the size of an image recording device and to process a photosensitive material and an image receiving material thermally with high efficiency by forming a straight conveyance path for the photosensitive material and conveying it in a sheet shape, and rotating a heating means from a stand-by position to a heating position and transferring an image. CONSTITUTION:A supply roller 105 and a take-up roll 102, and conveyor rollers 110, 111, and 112 are driven to convey the heat-developed photosensitive material 100, an exposure part 200 and a water coating part 400 are elevated, and the positions of three color filters of a filter plate 205 and the on-off states of respective picture elements of a liquid crystal shutter array 207 are controlled to perform exposure. Then, the photosensitive material 100 which is coated with water by the water coating part 100 has slack 100A, the image receiving paper 620 which is supplied from a cassette 621 is mounted on a development plate 602 at a position A, and a heater 603 generates heat;and the image receiving paper 620 is rotated to a position B and superposed upon the photosensitive material 100 to perform image transfer, and then falls by its own weight.

title: Picture recorder
abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate the jamming of photosensitive materials in an accumulating section so that the materials can be accumulated smoothly by providing an air blowing means which blows air on the photosensitive materials separated from image receiving materials for drying the materials. CONSTITUTION:A heat development photosensitive material 16 put between and carried by carrying rollers 66 is moved under the guidance of a guide plate 68 and sent to rollers 70 with skirt. While the photosensitive material 16 is wet because water is applied to the material 16 when the material 16 passes through a water applying section, air is directly blown on the material 16 moved under the guidance of the guide plate 68 from an air blowing port 90A by means of a cross fan 90 provided just above the guide plate 68 and the material 16 is fed to the rollers 70 while it is forcibly dried. Therefore, even when the material 16 is brought into contact with a previously accumulated photosensitive material 16, no strong frictional force is produced between the materials 16. Thus the heat development photosensitive material 16 fed by the rollers 70 smoothly slides in an abandoned tray 86 and is successively put on the previously accumulated material 16 without jamming.

title: Image recorder
abstract: PURPOSE:To easily prevent the photographic fog by supplying a photosensitive material in a sheet state and supplying an image receiving material in a rolled state in a device where the photosensitive material is subjected to image exposure and is put on the image receiving material and the image is transferred by pressurizing. CONSTITUTION:A sensitive material supply part 12 is provided in the side part of a housing 1, and a sensitive material cassette 14 in which sheet-shaped photosensitive materials S are laminated and stored is freely detachably attached to this part 12. A sensitive material feeding roll 16, a pair of sensitive material feeding-out rolls 21 and 22, and a guide plate 24 are arranged in the exit side of the photosensitive material S, and stored photosensitive materials S are selectively fed out to an exposure part 25 one by one at a prescribed time. An image receiving paper roll 74 is axially supported by an arm member 73 in an image receiving paper housing 71 and a pair of feeding-out rolls 75 and 76 are arranged in the housing 1 to constitute an image receiving paper supply part 72. Since the photosensitive material is supplied in the sheet state, the photographic fog is easily prevented in comparison with the use of a photosensitive material roll where the photographic fog is apt to occur by the pressure of winding.

title: Photosensitive material treating device
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a photosensitive material treating device which enhances photosensitive efficiency and simultaneously prevents the uneven drying by efficiently discharging the humid dried air after blowing to the photosensitive material. CONSTITUTION:The dried air is blown to a filmstrip 20 by being guided by plural guiding plates 100. That is, there are cases where the vaporaized moisture-contd. humid dried air from the filmstrip 20 is stagnated in the vicinity of rollers disposed on the filmstrip transfer path in a drying section, which becomes the cause of the reduction of a drying efficiency. Thus, the dried air is branched and guided by the guiding plates 100 so as to blow a portion of the dried air to an area where the humid dried air is stagnated, thereby preventing the humid dried air from being retained. Further, a transfer guide for changing the direction of transferring the filmstrip 20 from the horizontal transfer to the vertical transfer is a plate whose surface is emboss-finished and has a little amount of ruggedness, thus preventing the humid dried air from being stagnated.

title: Photographing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a photographing device which can provide an excellent image while the intrusion of dust is being prevented between sensitive material and image receiving material even by means of diffusion transfer by keeping a carrying passage for the thermal developing sensitive material and the image receiving material higher in pressure than the outside. CONSTITUTION:In a photographing device 10 in which an image is exposed to thermal sensitive material P so as to be piled up onto image receiving material R thereafter, and the thermally developed image is then transferred to the image receiving material R so as to be separated, a carrying passage for the thermal developing sensitive material P and the image receiving material R is constituted to be provided with a pressurizing means (a duct 50, a fan 66 and motor 69) which keeps the passage higher in pressure than the outside. In this constitution, the material P is pulled out of a housing section 26 so as to be exposed at an exposure section 28, it is then forwarded to a thermal developing section 36 thereafter, and the material P is pulled out of the housing section 34 so as to be forwarded to the thermal developing section 36, so that both of them are closely attached therein. Since the passage section for the material P and R is kept high in pressure, dust in a photograph forming chamber and outside will never be attached on the materials, this thereby prevents the occurrence of spot failures caused by dust coming in at the time of contact printing.

title: Image recorder
abstract: PURPOSE:To constitute the title recorder so that it is scarcely influenced by hot air of a high temperature, which flows out of a heat developing device, by providing the heat developing device provided with a photosensitive material admission port and a photosensitive material feeding-out port, and allowing a normal of the opening surface of the admission port and the feeding-out port to be directed to the horizontal direction. CONSTITUTION:A photosensitive material S is housed in a magazine 4 and drawn out by a roller 5. The material S which has been exposed by an exposing device 3 and has been cut by a cutter 6 is carried to a heat developing device 12 by carrying rollers 10, 11. The material S is carried, while being inserted and held between a belt 16 of the device 12 and a heating roller 14, and heated by a halogen lamp 17 provided in the roller 14.
