The material S which has been brought to a heat development is superposed on image receiving paper C, and carried to a heating transfer device 22. A normal of the opening surface of a photosensitive material admission port and a photosensitive material feeding- out port of the device 12 is opened to the horizontal direction. In such a way, an image recorder which is scarcely influenced by hot air of a high temperature in the device 12 can be obtained.

title: Photographic device
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the dislocation of sensitive material and image receiving material by absorbing the deformation of holding parts in the state of holding heat developed sensitive material and image receiving material by small diameter parts so as not to transmit this deformation to driving parts. CONSTITUTION:Holding parts 52A, 53A are deformed by the elastic force in the state of holding heat developed sensitive material P and image receiving material R, but this deformation is blocked at small diameter parts 92 and 94 so as to be prevented from being transmitted to driving parts 52B, 53B. Driving force is thereby transmitted at constant speed through the constant diameter parts of these driving parts 52B, 53B. The heat developed sensitive material P and the image receiving material R thus fed in the undislocated state are sent to a separating part 38 and held between holding carrier rollers 102, 104. This results in obtaining a desirable image without image dislocation.

title: Photographic device
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the generation of dislocation by forming a separating part in such a way as to guide both heat developed sensitive material and image receiving material rectilinearly at an acute clamp angle to separate them. CONSTITUTION:Heat developed sensitive material P after the application of an image forming solvent is attached to image receiving material R so as to be subjected to developing transfer. The sensitive material P and the image receiving material R after this transfer are fed to a separating part 38 so as to be separated. In the separating part 38, the heat developed sensitive material P and the image receiving material R are both guided rectilinearly at an acute clamp angle. Accordingly, even if one material is going to be straight by rigidity at the separating terminal of the sensitive material P and image receiving material R, the force acting in the dislocating direction to the other material is small, and therefore the possibility of image dislocation is extremely small. A desirable image without image dislocation can be thereby obtained.

title: Photosensitive material drier
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the photosensitive material drier capable of discharging the hot air blown against a photosensitive material to dry the material from the surface of the material. CONSTITUTION:A passage for a film 14 is formed in a photosensitive material drier by plural rollers 42. A hot air feed chamber 48 is arranged in the vicinity of the roller arranged along the passage. A couple of hot air discharge parts 50 are provided to the hot air feed chamber between the rollers and directed toward the film passage. A hot air discharge part 52 for discharging the hot air on the upstream side of the contact part between the roller and the film and a hot air discharge part 53 for discharging the hot air on the downstream side are formed with the interval between the discharge parts varied. Meanwhile, an exhaust port 54 connecting the passage side and the opposite side is formed between a couple of the discharge parts, and the space between the hot air feed chambers is used for exhausting the hot air blown against the film from the passage side to the opposite side.

title: Photosensitive material drier
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the photosensitive material drier for uniformly blowing hot air against a photosensitive material in its cross direction without the overdried part being generated in the cross direction of the material. CONSTITUTION:Hot air is blown from a hot air feed part 114 against a film which is dried, and a hot air receiving opening 48B is formed on one end of a hot air feed chamber 116 with the cross direction of the film as its longitudinal direction. A hot air discharge port 118 is formed at the hot air discharge part 120 arranged in the longitudinal direction of the hot air feed chamber and projected from the hot air feed chamber. The width of the hot air discharge part is gradually decreased from its middle toward the wall 122 on the opening side of the hot air discharge part and closed in the vicinity of the wall. Besides, an opening 124 for communicating the hot air discharge part with the outside is formed in the wall of the hot air discharge part. Consequently, the hot air discharged from the hot air discharge part is almost uniformized in the cross direction of the film, and the almost uniform discharge area is increased.

title: シート部材供給装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  受像材料等のシート部材を正確な姿勢で供給 できるシート部材供給装置を得る。
【解決手段】  受像材料４２を吸着して搬送する吸盤１ ７２の前方には、受像材料４２を挟持した状態で回転し て送り出す搬送ローラ２５６、２５８が配置されてお り、吸盤１７２によって搬送された受像材料４２の先端 部が搬送ローラ２５６、２５８へ突き当てられる。ここ で、吸盤１７２は弾性変形可能であり、また、吸盤１７ ２による受像材料４２の搬送速度は搬送ローラ２５６の 回転周速度よりも速い。このため受像材料４２の姿勢が ずれて、先端部の幅方向一端が幅方向他端よりも先に搬 送ローラ２５６、２５８へ突き当たった場合には、幅方 向一端が搬送ローラ２５６、２５８の間へ挟み込まれる 前に、搬送ローラ２５６からの反力によって吸盤１７２ が弾性変形して、受像材料４２の姿勢を修正する。

title: シート体の幅寄せ方法および装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】シート体の搬送不良を阻止するとともに、幅寄 せ時のシート体先端位置の設定自由度を有効に向上させ ることを可能にする。
【解決手段】幅寄せ位置に搬送された蓄積性蛍光体シー ト２０をその両方の面２０ａ、２０ｂ側から挟持する支 持手段５０と、前記支持手段５０により挟持されている 前記蓄積性蛍光体シート２０の一側面２０ｃを押圧し、 該蓄積性蛍光体シート２０の他側面２０ｄを基準にして 該蓄積性蛍光体シート２０を幅寄せする幅寄せ手段５２ とを備える。支持手段５０は、蓄積性蛍光体シート２０ の面２０ａに接触した状態で前記蓄積性蛍光体シート２ ０が矢印Ｃ方向に幅寄せされる際に回転可能な押圧ロー ラ５４を備える。

title: シート体搬送機構
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】寸法の異なる種々のシート体を片側基準で高精 度に搬送するとともに、構成を有効に簡素化することを 可能にする。
【解決手段】シート体搬送機構１０は、蓄積性蛍光体シ ート３２を挟持して搬送するローラ対９０を備えるとと もに、このローラ対９０の左右のニップ圧がそれぞれ異 なる値に設定されている。このため、寸法の異なる蓄積 性蛍光体シート３２に作用するニップ圧が、該蓄積性蛍 光体シート３２の左右で不均一になることがなく、高精 度な搬送処理が遂行される。

title: シート材給送装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  シート材に走行負荷を与えずにシートガイド 部材を適切に位置決めできる安価なシート材給送装置を 提供する。
【解決手段】  シート材収容部でのシート材の収容位置 を規制するガイド機構の構成として、ガイドシャフト４ にサイドガイド５を摺動可能に係止するとともに、ガイ ドシャフト４の一端４ａを押し戻し用の圧縮コイルバネ １２を介してスラスト軸受部材９に嵌合した。そして、 シート材１３の端部に向けてサイドガイド５を摺動させ た際に、その摺動抵抗によって圧縮コイルバネ１２を圧 縮変形させ、シート材１３の端部にサイドガイド５を押 し付けて係止した際には、圧縮コイルバネ１２の反力で スライドシャフト４と一緒にサイドガイド５を押し戻 し、これによってシート材１３の端部とサイドガイド５ との間に微小ギャップｇを確保するようにした。

title: 多軸ターレット式ウエブ巻取装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】装置の大型化を抑制しながら、合わせて巻取ロ ールの大径化や広幅化に対応することができる。
【解決手段】作業床７０上に対向する支持フレーム７ ６、７７に、面板７２、７３の外周部を旋回軸受７４、 ７５を介して支持する面板支持機構、作業床７０下に配 設されて前記面板支持機構の面板７２、７３を回転駆動 する面板駆動部、面板支持機構の面板７２、７３に面板 駆動部からの動力を伝達する動力伝達機構から構成され る。

title: シート体用搬送装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】幅寸法の異なる種々のシート体を、損傷させる ことなく円滑に搬送するとともに、構成の簡素化を図る ことを可能にする。
【解決手段】ガイド機構７２は、蓄積性蛍光体シートＳ の搬送方向に交差する幅方向に延在する軸部材８２と、 前記蓄積性蛍光体シートＳに接触するとともに、前記軸 部材８２に対して軸方向に移動可能に設けられる第１お よび第２可動ローラ部材８４ａ、８４ｂと、該蓄積性蛍 光体シートＳの幅寸法に応じて、前記第１および第２可 動ローラ部材８４ａ、８４ｂを前記軸方向に移動させる 駆動機構８６とを備える。

title: シート体搬送装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  少なくとも幅方向の寸法が異なる複数種類の シートを片側基準で高精度に搬送する。
【解決手段】  蓄積性蛍光体シート４０を挟持して基準 位置５において片側基準で搬送するローラ対３を、駆動 ローラ１およびニップローラ２により構成する。ニップ ローラ２は中空の中軸２１とゴム製のローラ部２２Ａ， ２２Ｂ，２２Ｃとからなる。中軸２１は、基準位置５側 の外径が基準位置５とは反対側の外径よりも大きく形成 された中芯軸２３により回転自在に支持される。また、 中芯軸２３の両端部は圧縮バネ２７ａ，２７ｂにより駆 動ローラ１側に付勢される。圧縮バネ２７ｂのバネ力は 圧縮バネ２７ａのバネ力よりも大きく設定される。これ により、シート４０のサイズに拘わらずシート４０は駆 動ローラ１およびニップローラ２に均等に挟持されて搬 送される。

title: シート搬送装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  シートのジャム処理時における弾性ゲート部 材の変形を防止し得るシート搬送装置を提供する。
【解決手段】  弾性ゲート部材５を有する搬送路切り替 え部６を備え、この搬送路切り替え部６を露出させるべ く、シートガイド７の少なくとも一部が通路内部に滞留 したシート１０を除去処理可能な方向に移動する可動シ ートガイド７ａとなっているシート搬送装置であって、 可動シートガイド７ａの少なくとも弾性ゲート部材５と 対向する部分を固定ガイド部８とする。また、弾性ゲー ト部材５を回転支持部材５ａにて回転可能に支持した。 さらに、可動シートガイド７ａの開放時に、可動シート ガイド７ａに連動して弾性ゲート部材５をジャム処理時 のシート１０と接触しない位置まで待避させる。

title: シート供給装置及びこれを用いる画像処理装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】揺動する積載台を持つシート供給装置におい て、送り手段へのシート突入位置の変動を少なくする。
【解決手段】シート供給トレイ１８にはシートを多数積 載する積載台５６が揺動自在に設けられている。この積 載台５６の上部に供給ヘッド２０が設けられ、この供給 ヘッド２０は、ナジャーロール６４、フィードロール６ ６及びリタードロール６８とから構成され、ナジャーロ ール６４の回転により積載台５６のシートがフィードロ ール６６とリタードロール６８とのニップ部８０へ押出 される。ナジャーロール６４のシート押出し位置は位置 検出手段８６により検出される。積載台５６のシート残 量が少なくなると、ナジャーロール６４から押出される シートの角度が上昇するが、ナジャーロール６４のシー ト押出し位置が積載台５６のシート残量に応じて制御さ れ、ナジャーロール６４から押出されたシートは適正範 囲内でリタードロール６８に突き当てることができる。

title: シート搬送装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】ジャムしたシートの確認を確実にでき、しかも 確実にジャム処理を行うことができるシート搬送装置を 提供する。
【解決手段】内側扉部３および外側扉部４を有する二重 扉構造の開閉扉２を備え、この開閉扉２と装置本体１と の間に第１のシート搬送路５を設けると共に、前記内側 扉部３と外側扉部４の間に第２のシート搬送路６を設け てなるシート搬送装置であって、開閉扉２の開放時に、 自動的に内側扉部３と外側扉部４とが離間せしめられる 間隔作成手段７ａを設ける。更に、両扉部の開放間隔が 調整せしめられる間隔調整手段７ｂを設ける。また、内 側扉部３と外側扉部４間のロック解除手段８を複数箇所 に設け、いずれのロック解除手段８によってもロックを 解除可能に構成する。さらに、ロック解除手段８の操作 部８ａの設置方向を表示する表示部９を設ける。

title: Magnetic recording/reproducing method and recording/ reproducing head in one
abstract: PURPOSE:To execute recording with high density, and also, to obtain a high reproducing output, by executing the recording of a magnetizing direction corresponding to the polarity of a recording signal, in the width direction of a recording track. CONSTITUTION:To an E type core 11 having gaps g1, g2, of a recording/ reproducing head 10, a core 12 is wound in the reverse direction so that a direction of a magnetic flux passing through the gaps g1, g2 becomes reverse. Accordingly, when the direction of a recording signal is the direction as indicated with an arrow (a), the magnetizing direction becomes the direction of both end parts from the center of a magnetic medium 15, and when said direction is the direction as indicated with an arrow (b), the center direction from both ends becomes the magnetizing direction, and the magnetization corresponding to the recording signal is executed in the direction vertical to the running direction of the medium 15. Accordingly, comparing with the case when the running direction of the recording medium becomes the magnetizing direction, a higher recording density can be obtained, and also, a reproducing output is raised by a sufficient magnetization in the width direction of the recording medium.

title: Vertical magnetic head
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a stable reproducing output extending over a long period of time without generating a reproducing demagnetization, by providing the first block of a soft magnetic material by separating it magnetically, in the vicinity of one side end face of a soft magnetic film for constituting a main magnetic pole, and also providing the second block of a soft magnetic material which is coupled magnetically to the first block in a position of a face symmetry, too, by placing the first block and a recording medium between. CONSTITUTION:A soft magnetic material block 12a and 12b consist of ferrite, etc., respectively, and insert and hold as one body a nonmagnetic base body 11a and 11b which have inserted and held a main magnetic pole film 1a. A soft magnetic material block 14a and 14b consist of ferrite, etc., and they are supported by a nonmagnetic base body 13, place a recording medium between them in the same way as the soft magnetic material block 12a and 12b and provided on a position of a face symmetry, respectively. In this way, a main magnetic pole 1 is shielded magnetically by the soft magnetic material blocks 12a, 12b and 14a, 14b, and it is not magnetized unnecessarily.

title: Vertical magnetic head
abstract: PURPOSE:To wind and install easily a coil, and also to improve the recording and reproducing sensitivity by providing a conductive coil which is wound and installed to the periphery of a projecting part of the first block of a high magnetic permeability magnetic material, the second block holding in common the same plane as the tip of a soft magnetic thin film, and a packing member. CONSTITUTION:A coil 20 is wound and installed to the periphery of a projecting part PJ of a high permeability magnetic material block 12 which has been coupled magnetically to the bottom end of a main magnetic pole 10. Therefore, the titled head can be manufactured very easily. Also, the magnetization efficiency of the tip of the main magnetic pole 10 is improved. Furthermore, the surface area of the surface which is joined to the main magnetic pole 10 and both nonmagnetic base bodies 11a, 11b in the projecting part PJ of the magnetic material block 12 is set the same as this actual joint area, its periphery is packed with a packing material 40, and they are fixed as one body to a nonmagnetic material block 30. A length of the main magnetic pole 10 secures a good recording and reproducing characteristic, therefore, even if it is set pretty short, the mechanically excellent durability can be maintained, and an abrasion of the tip of the main magnetic pole 10 can also be suppressed to the minimum.

title: Magnetic recording and reproducing method
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve practicality by separately recording and reproducing two kinds of signals on the same track of a magnetic layer containing both combined high and low coercive-force magnetic materials. CONSTITUTION:Along track 3 of magnetic layer 2 of magnetic recording medium 1 formed by combining a high-coercive-force magnetic material with a low-coercive- force magnetic material, magnetic recording head assembly 5 for the high-coercive- force magnetic material, erasing head 6 and magnetic recording head 7 for the low- coercive-force magnetic material are arranged. Then while magnetic recording medium 1 is run as shown by arrow 4, a recording signal is inputted to terminal 8 to record signal inverted in polarity as magnetization patterns on track split parts 31 and 32 by magnetic heads 52 and 51 and a current needed to erase only the signal of the low-coercive-force magnetic material is supplied to terminal 10 to erase a signal, recorded on the low-coercive-force magnetic material, by erasing head 6. Next, another recording signal is inputted to terminal 11 to attain recording on the low-coercive-force magnetic material over the whole width of track 3 by magnetic head 7.

title: Magnetic head
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the information recording density by arranging a first magnetic head for forming a gap by inclining it by a prescribed angle against the width direction of a sliding surface in an advance direction side in a relative moving direction to a magnetic recording medium, and a second magnetic head inclined to the side opposite to an advance direction, so as to run along the same track of the medium. CONSTITUTION:When a pair of magnetic heads 20X, 20Y are arranged and its slide-contacting surfaces 25 are made to slide-contact a magnetic recording medium which is not shown in the figure, respectively, the head 20X and 20Y are structured as follows. That is to say, the head 20X is constituted by sticking a head core 23a and 23b on which a notch 22 for winding round an exciting coil 21 is provided, respectively, and a gap 24X which is generated in the sticking part is inclined by an angle thetaX to the side opposite to a relative moving direction A. Also, the head 20Y also consists of the same structure, but only a gap 24Y is inclined by an angle thetaY in the direction A. By providing side by side the head 20X and 20Y in this way, an azimuth for generating no crosstalk is obtained, and recording can be executed with high density.

title: Magnetic recording and reproducing method
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the recording density by arranging and supporting a pair of heads having each different azimuth, in the moving direction of a tape by piezoelectric elements, driving the heads by the piezoelectric elements so that tracks by both the heads are superposed, and executing the recording and reproduction by superposing two signals without causing a crosstalk. CONSTITUTION:Magnetic heads 30, 31 are supported by bimorph elements 32, 33 by setting an azimuth between gaps (g) to 90 deg., made to contact a tape 34 which moves in the direction (a), and placed side by side. In this state, the first information is recorded by adjusting the time of the applied polarity of AC voltages 35, 36, and moving the head 30 from a point a1 to a point b1. When the head 3 is in the point b1, the head 31 is in the point a1. Subsequently, the second information is superposed and recorded in the first information by switching the recording head to the head 31 and moving it to the point b1. Since there is an azimuth of 90 deg. between both the gaps, the information can be recorded without generating an interference. Thereafter, recording is executed by the same repetition,and the recording density can be improved. Even at the time of reproduction, no interference is generated owing to a large azimuth angle.

title: Composite magnetic head
abstract: PURPOSE:To record two types of signals on the same disk and to ensure a highly accurate tracking action by using magnetic heads to form the sound signal tracks adjacently to the picture signal tracks via the prescribed guard bands. CONSTITUTION:A sound signal magnetic head 30 and a gap part 33a are provided at the positions in parallel to gap parts 13a and 23a of picture signal magnetic heads 10 and 20 and also distant toward the track width Tw by a distance l respectively. The picture signals are recorded on tracks 61 and 62 of a magnetic recording disk 60 by heads 10 and 20. While the sound signals are recorded by the head 30 onto a track 63 set between both tracks 61 and 62 via a minute guard band corresponding to the distance l. Thus the sound signals are recorded without decreasing the number of tracks for picture signals. Furthermore, the crosstalk can be satisfactorily reduced because both heads are separate from each other by a prescribed distance. Thus, a highly accurate tracking action is ensured without using a large magnetic head.

title: Vertical magnetic recording/playback head
abstract: PURPOSE:To assure the mechanical strength of members and to improve the efficiency of recording/playback by constituting a high permeability magnetic core in such a manner that the decrease in the sectional area of sandwiching surfaces is compensated. CONSTITUTION:A deformed I-shaped member is obtd. by working aluminum titanium carbide, etc. to form a non-magnetic member 11a, polishing the right end face to a specular surface, forming a soft high permeability magnetic film by sputtering to the specular surface, working a nonmagnetic member 11 of the same material and adhering and fixing both members to sandwich a main magnetic pole 1 from the right and left with said member and the member 11a. The magnetic head body is enclosed by nonmagnetic materials 41a, 41b and 42a, 42b on the side faces of the magnetic circuit and are adhered and fixed to each other to form a slider 40. The head is subjected to lapping and polishing on the top surface by which the vertical magnetic recording/playback head is completed. title: Magnetic recording and reproducing method
abstract: PURPOSE:To fade out the final part of reproduced sound by gradually reducing the level of a sound signal on a sound track for the final several seconds in case of recording the sound signal on a magnetic disk or in case of reproducing the sound signal recorded in the magnetic disk. CONSTITUTION:At 1-2sec before the arrival of a sound signal in each mode, an address counter 10 sends a fade-out signal indicating said state to a microphone amplifier 2. The amplifier 2 is gradually reduced at its amplification factor from a point of time receiving the fade-out signal and the final part of the sound signal recorded in a floppy disk 19 through a magnetic head 18 is gradually reduced at its level. When the floppy disk 19 recording the sound signal is reproduced, the reproduced sound is gradually reduced at its final part i.e. faded out.

title: Head for magnetic recording
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the density of a magnetic recording by causing the surface of a non-magnetic substance, which faces to a recording medium, to be parallel to the proceeding recording medium and magnetizing both the surface layer and depth layer of the recording medium in the same direction. CONSTITUTION:Since the surface of a trailing side magnetic pole 4 to face to a recording medium 2 is caused to be the opened surface in a proceeding direction to the proceeding recording medium 2, an equal magnetic field curve is distributed in a shape to turn into the opened surface. Thus, in an area where the recording medium 2 in a space area C, an equal magnetic field curve 7 cross to the recording medium 2 almost vertically. As the result, a magnetization transition area 2-1 goes to be almost vertical to the surface of the recording medium 2. Namely, the both surface layer and depth layer of the recording medium 2 are magnetized in the same direction. Thus, the density of the magnetic recording can be improved.

title: Method for reducing granular noise in radiograph
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a natural image with high image quality by adding random noise to smoothed image data. abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a radiation image conversion panel having good stimulable luminescence characteristics such as PSL sensitivity.  <P>SOLUTION: The production method comprises performing cooling which follows the formation of a photostimulable phosphor layer by a chemical vapor deposition process in an atmosphere having an oxygen partial pressure in the range: 0%<O<SB>2</SB><25% and having a degree of vacuum of 1 Pa to atmospheric pressure.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Manufacturing method for radiation image conversion panel, and manufacturing device for radiation image conversion panel
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To manufacture a radiation image conversion panel capable of restraining a point defect from being generated, and capable of obtaining an image of high grade reduced in a defect.  <P>SOLUTION: This manufacturing method for forming a phosphor layer by a vapor deposition method in a closed vacuum chamber 12 has a process for setting a substrate 70 in the vacuum chamber 12, a process for removing dust from a surface 70d of the substrate under the condition where the substrate 70 is set, and a process for forming the phosphor layer on the substrate.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Radiation image conversion panel and method for manufacturing it
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for manufacturing a radiation conversion panel which eliminates the necessity of heat treatment by another device in a postprocess by cooling an accelerated phosphor layer properly after forming it and makes the radiation image conversion panel include an accelerated phosphor layer whose accelerated phosphorescence luminescence properties such as PSL sensitivity are good, and to provide an excellently efficient radiation image conversion panel manufactured by the method in the manufacture of the radiation image conversion panel.  <P>SOLUTION: The method for manufacturing the radiation image conversion panel includes a process for changing the cooling rate of the accelerated phosphor layer in the range between 70 and 150°C of the temperature of the formed accelerated phosphor layer after finishing the formation of the accelerated phosphor layer by a gas phase lay-up method and is characterized in that the accelerated phosphor layer is cooled at the average cooling rate of 0.5 to 5°C/min. before changing the cooling rate and that it is cooled at the average cooling rate of 0.01 to 1°C/min. after changing the average cooling rate, and the conversion panel is manufactured by the method.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title: Optical branching device, optical data bus, and signal processor
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain the optical branching device which can prevent a defect in signal light transmission, projects signal light with nearly uniform intensity, and has high use efficiency for the light by equipping a light-transmissive medium propagating the signal light by the repetition of internal reflection, with plural projection parts which emit part of the signal light to the outside. SOLUTION: The optical branching device 10 is formed of a light-transmission medium which has a slanting surface 100 at one end and also has a uniform refractive index and is almost in a quadrangular prism shape. On the top surface 101, linear light projection parts 121 to 123 are formed which extend along the width of the optical branching device 10. The light projection parts 121 to 123 have projection opening parts formed of refracting surfaces 111 to 113 crossing the slanting surface 100 at right angles. The refracting surfaces are formed of one internal surface of a linear V groove. Light which is made incident vertically on the slanting surface 100 is totally reflected by the reverse surface 102.  Part of the totally reflected light is projected from the refracting surface 111 of the light projection part 121 and the rest is totally reflected by the top surface 101 and propagated to the reverse surface 102.

title: Optically coupled element and light transmission system
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a optically coupled element that a signal light propagating at a propagating angle beyond a prescribed propagating angle range can be prevented from outgoing to an optical element and which is miniaturized by providing a light transmitting body having plural specific faces with refractivity larger than that of a light transmitting medium. SOLUTION: An optically coupled element 2 is provided with a light transmitting body having an incident face 3, reflecting surface 4, and outgoing face 5 with refractivity larger than that of a light transmitting medium. The incident face 3 makes a signal light propagating in a free space incident to the inside part of the opticaly coupled element 2, and reflects the signal light temporarily made incident inside and returned to the incident face 3 to the inside part of the optically coupled element. The reflecting surface 4 which is inclined only at an angle β to the input reflects the signal light made incident on the incident face 3 within a prescribed propagating angle range for an arrow 1 to the incident face 3 side, and introduces the signal light to a direction with a wider interval between the reflecting surface 4 and the incident face 3.  The outgoing face 5 makes the light signal introduced to the direction with the wider interval between the incident face 3 and the reflecting surface 4 outgo to a light receiving element 6.

title: Optical signal transmitter, optical data bus system and signal processor
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve light utilizing efficiency. SOLUTION: An optical signal is made incident on an incidence/emission part 13 provided on the end face of a translucent medium 1 on which a reflective type light diffusing layer 2 is arranged. The incident optical signal, upon reaching the reflective type light diffusing layer 2, is simultaneously diffused and reflected in the up and down and left and right directions. The diffused light is not all directly made incident on each of the plural incidence/emission parts formed on the end face of the translucent medium 1, but is propagated while reflecting on the side of the translucent medium 1 and emitted from the plural incidence/emission parts.

title: Optical transmission module
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an optical transmission module using a light transmissive medium which has excellent transmission efficiency and uniformity of a light signal.  <P>SOLUTION: This optical transmission module has a plane back-plane unit 20 where circuit boards 11 to 18 having light reception parts 11a to 17a and a light emission part 18a are arranged side by side and the light transmissive medium 21. The light transmissive medium 21 has a plurality of step parts 27 on one side and incidence/emission parts 23 for receiving and/or emitting light signals are formed on surfaces of the respective step parts which form steps with one another. The other side of the light transmissive medium 21 is a mixer part 28 and has a diffuse reflecting film 24 which diffuses and reflects light signals. The plurality of step parts 27 of the light transmissive medium 21 are arranged nearby the circuit boards 11 to 18.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO

title: Transmission type optical modulation array device and optical device using the same
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To form a high quality image and improve a degree of design freedom and reliability without inviting upsizing and cost increase due to complication of an optical system.  <P>SOLUTION: An optical path of the light that is driven according to an input signal and is made incident and transmitted there-through is provided with a transmission type optical modulation array element 101 polarizable for each pixel. An optical path isolating prism 103 comprising a total reflection interface 103c is arranged on an exit light side of the light in the transmission type optical deflection array element 101. The exit light whose optical path is deflected by the transmission type optical deflection array element 101 is separated into transmitted light passing through the total reflection interface 103c and reflected light reflected by the total reflection interface 103c.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Light guide plate, planar lighting device using this, and liquid crystal display
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a light guide plate having a simple structure, thin, and light in weight, and capable of emitting an illumination light having a high utilization rate of light and uniform and high luminance with little unevenness, from the light-emitting face, a planar lighting device, and a liquid crystal device.  <P>SOLUTION: The light guide plate has a rectangular light-emitting face 18a, a thick portion 18b which is nearly parallel to its one side and is located at its central part, a pair of thin end portions 18c formed in nearly parallel to the thick portion 18b, parallel grooves 18f formed at nearly a center of the thick portion and at the reverse side to the light-emitting face and housing a rod-shape light source 12, and a pair of inclined back-face portions 18e which become thin from the thick portion 18b toward the thin portion 18c on both sides and form a pair of inclined back faces respectively on both sides of the parallel grooves 18f. The parallel grooves 18f are constructed of a pair of contour lines which become narrower toward the light-emitting face 18a and cross each other at the top-most vertex in cross-section in right angle directions, and each contour line is formed so as to become a more acute angle at the farther base end side from the vertex than the top end side near the vertex.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Light guide plate and planar lighting device using the same
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a light guide plate which has a low-profile and large-area light outgoing surface and a capability of emitting the incoming light as a high-luminance light with no or less luminance variation from the light outgoing surface.  <P>SOLUTION: The light guide plate has a flat light outgoing surface, a surface facing the light outgoing surface, and many parallel grooves formed in parallel with each other at a predetermined spacing interval on the surface facing the light outgoing surface. The surface facing the light outgoing surface takes the inclined shape, such that the thickness in the direction perpendicular to the light outgoing surface gets smaller as it separates from the parallel grooves in the direction orthogonal to the extending direction of the parallel grooves, while the thickness in the direction perpendicular to the light outgoing surface gets greater as it separates from the end of the light outgoing surface in the direction parallel to the extending direction of the parallel grooves.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title: Optical branching apparatus and optical transmission system
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an optical branching apparatus capable of reducing a branching ratio without extending the length of a sheet like waveguide, and to provide an optical transmission system.  <P>SOLUTION: This optical branching apparatus 1A is equipped with: a light emitting element array 2 having a plurality of light emitting parts 2a; a ball lens 4 as an imaging optical system that forms, on a prescribed surface, an image of a light signal 3 emitted from the plurality of light emitting parts 2a of the light emitting element array 2; a sheet like waveguide 5 that is provided with an incident face 5a arranged on the prescribed face and an exiting face 5b formed opposite to the incident face 5a and that, while totally reflecting on a side face 5c the light imaged on the incident face 5a, diffuses the light to the entire exiting face 5b; and a plurality of optical fibers 6 connected to the exiting face 5b of the sheet like waveguide 5.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title: Optical waveguide device, and light outputting module
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an optical waveguide device having a high degree of flexibility in the layout of a waveguide for monitoring, and a light outputting module using the optical wave guide device.  <P>SOLUTION: A first mirror face 24 and a second mirror face 26 are formed at the rectangular corner parts of a clad part 22. A wave guide core 30 is disposed in the thickness direction of the clad part 22 so that its one end is disposed on the lower surface 22D of the clad part 22 and the other end is disposed on the first mirror face 24. A main waveguide core 32 is disposed along the top face 22A in the longitudinal direction of the clad part 22 so that its one end is connected to the end part on the first mirror face 24 side of the waveguide core 30, and the other end reaches the side face 22E facing the side face 22B. A waveguide core for monitoring 34A is disposed in the lateral direction of the clad part 22 so that its one end is connected to the end part of the mirror face 24 side of the waveguide core 30, and the other end is disposed on the second mirror face 26.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title: Optoelectronic circuit board and optical transmission device
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an optoelectronic circuit board and an optical transmission device by which signals accompanied with conversion process from electricity to light or vice versa can be transmitted in a simple structure with low loss.  <P>SOLUTION: A first inter-circuit-board optical transmission module 1 is structured by mounting a connector 12, a logic IC 13, and a first optical module 14 on a first optoelectronic circuit board 11. To an optical layer 116 laminated inside the substrate of the first optoelectronic circuit board 11, one end of an optical waveguide 15 having a mirror 153 on the end is provided, with an MT connector 16 mounted on the other end of the optical waveguide 15. The mirror 153 faces the light emission face of a VCSEL array 143A through the opening 118 of the substrate, to form an optical path between itself and the core 151 of the optical waveguide 15.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title: Optical transmission apparatus and optical waveguide
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an optical transmission apparatus that can be easily manufactured compared with a case of using an additional component or a specially designed element.  <P>SOLUTION: The optical transmission apparatus includes a light receiving element 2 for receiving light and an optical waveguide 6 having a core 3, a cladding 4 adjacent to the core 3, and a light-diffusing recessed part 5 formed in the cladding part for emitting light toward the light receiving element 2. The recessed part 5 diffuses a light beam through a concave lens effect to irradiate the light receiving face 21 of the light receiving element 2 with the light beam. The spot diameter emitted to the light receiving face 21 can be changed by adjusting the radius of curvature of the recessed part 5.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Light emitting element, light emitting element head, and image forming apparatus
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a light emitting device or the like which suppresses total reflection on an interface of an inside and external of the light emitting device and extracts light to the external efficiently.  <P>SOLUTION: An LED (light emitting diode) 102 includes: a substrate 202; a light emitting layer 206 which emits light when a current is supplied, and has a first recessed and projected structure on a surface; a coating layer 208 which has a second recessed and projected structure corresponding to the first recessed and projected structure, is formed to be in contact with the light emitting layer 206, and transmits the light emitted from the light emitting layer 206; and a reflection layer 204 which is formed between the substrate 202 and the light emitting layer 206, and reflects the light emitted from the light emitting layer 206.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Optical transmission apparatus and optical waveguide
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an optical transmission apparatus in which the division ratio of emitted light from a light emitting element into two directions is simply controlled and to provide an optical waveguide.  <P>SOLUTION: The optical transmission apparatus 1A includes: a substrate 2A on which a light emitting element array 3 and a light receiving element array 4A are mounted; first and second cores 60A, 60B which transmit light; a clad 61 which covers the first and the second cores 60A, 60B; a light splitting face 62 which is disposed on the optical axis 30a of the light emitted from the light emitting element array 3 and splits the emitted light into the direction in which the first core 60A propagates the light and the optical axis 30a direction; a first reflection face 63A which guides the light which is split by the light splitting face 62 into the direction in which the first core 60A propagates the light and is propagated in the first core 60A onto the light receiving element array 4A; and an optical waveguide 6A which is disposed on the optical axis 30a and includes a second reflection face 63B which guides the light split by the light splitting face 62 into the optical axis 30a direction into the second core 60B.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Light source device and endoscope system using the same
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve light use efficiency.SOLUTION: A light source device 13 that supplies illumination light to a light guide 43 of an endoscope 10 includes a light-emitting device 66, a fluorescent body 36, and a light guide rod 40. The light-emitting device 66 has a laser diode LD1 that emits excitation light for the fluorescent body 36. The light guide rod 40 includes an incident end surface 70, an emission end surface 71, and a side surface 72 that connects the incident end surface 70 and the emission end surface 71, and guides the light incident from the incident end surface 70 to the emission end surface 71 while totally reflecting it, the side surface 72 being a shape tapered with respect to the optical axis so that the area of the emission end surface 71 is larger than that of the incident end surface 70. The incident end surface 70 is optically connected to a light emitting surface 69 of the fluorescent body 36. In the range from the incident end surface 70 to midway toward the emission end surface 71, a reflection film 73 is formed on the whole periphery of the side surface 72.

title: Light-emitting element array, optical device, optical measurement device, and method for manufacturing light-emitting element array
abstract: A light-emitting element array includes a substrate, plural light-emitting elements arranged on the substrate, plural constriction grooves being provided in a periphery of each of the plural light-emitting elements and forming a current constriction layer that constricts a current flowing through a light-emitting layer by oxidizing the light-emitting layer, and a block separation portion that is provided in a curved shape so as to include at least one inflection point at which a sign of curvature changes along each of positions where the plural light-emitting elements are arranged, and separates the plural light-emitting elements into plural blocks.

title: Light emitting element, light emitting element array, light emitting component, optical device and optical measurement device
abstract: To provide a light emitting element in which a thyristor is not electrically separated when the thyristor is stacked on top of the light-emitting part.SOLUTION: A light emitting element has a substrate, a light emitting part stacked on the substrate, and a thyristor stacked on the light emitting part and set to emit light or increase the amount of light emitted by the light emitting part when it is turned on, the thyristor having a low resistance layer with resistance that does not electrically separate the thyristor at the position where current from the electrode contacting the thyristor flows.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Cache structure in multiprocessor
abstract: PURPOSE:To easily confirm the necessity and unnecessity of the writing of data to a cache memory and to decrease the number of accesses to a main memory by providing a flag area, which corresponds to a data area, in a local cache, transferring the changed data, to which the flag is caused to stand, and flag information through a system bus to another processor and copying the data and information. CONSTITUTION:Local caches 2a and 2b are provided in the respective insides of plural processors 1a and 1b of a multiprocessor system and data areas 3a and 3b and flag areas 2a and 2b are respectively arranged in the respective local caches 2a and 2b. When the data of the area 3a or 3b are changed, the flag is caused to stand to show that the data are changed in the area 4a or 4b to correspond to the data and the changed data and flag information are transferred through a system bus 8 to another processor 1b or 1a and copied. Then, whether the main memory is written or not is confirmed by the local caches 1b or 1a.

title: Program reading control circuit
abstract: PURPOSE:To attain the reading at a high speed even with use of a low-speed ROM by providing in parallel plural memories which store previously programs of the same contents and then outputting these programs selectively if necessary. CONSTITUTION:Address latch signals g0-gn which are outputted from buffer circuits 50-1-50-n are supplied to program memories 10-1-10-n which store previously microprograms of the same contents, and the storage contents P0-Pn are outputted. A sequence control part 40 and above-mentioned buffer circuits are controlled with the clock signal outputted from a timing generating circuit 70. The contents of storage are selected by a register circuit 20 on the basis of the controlsignal M outputted from the part 40. Then the high-speed reading is possible although the working speed of each memory is low by actuating plural memories in parallel.

title: Storage device
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve operation efficiency by allowing a memory to access itself and generate and transmit an overflow signal to access the remaining data in other memory when an address signal to the former memory causes an overflow. CONSTITUTION:Memories 210, 220, 230... are equipped with address overflow detecting means. For example, if the memory 210 is not capable of outputting all necessary data when an address for reading and writing close to the upper limit of its address range is specified, the memory outputs only its holding data and sends the address overflow signal OFO to the memory 220 with adjacent addresses, which outputs data corresponding to the deficient data of the memory 210. Consequently, the reading or writing of data starting at an optional address is performed to improve the operation efficiency and the effective use of storage areas.

title: Memory controller
abstract: PURPOSE:To make a storage means for every memory block unnecessary by providing a memory controller with a buffer of a first in first out FIFO memory and reading out data from the buffer memory at the timing of a prescribed memory cycle. CONSTITUTION:When the second memory access to the first memory block #1 is requested, execution stop of system execution clocks is indicated to a processor 24 from the first memory block #1 by a control bus 21. Read for the first memory access to the first memory block #1 is performed by a read control bus 25, and simultaneously, data is stacked in an FIFO memory 26. Similarly, the second and following data of the first memory block #1 are taken into the FIFO26 successively and are stacked in order. Read of the first data of the first memory block #1 out of these data is indicated by a control line after three steps, and this data is fetched into the processor 24.

title: Virtual storage computer system
abstract: PURPOSE:To supply a virtual storage computer system which can improve operation speed by means of reducing the frequency of address conversion from a virtual memory to a real memory. CONSTITUTION:A processor 11 accesses the virtual address of a corresponding global frame on the virtual memory 17 at the time of executing a program module stored in a main storage device 13. A map table 19 is referred to as to initial access by a certain program module so as to obtain a real address concerned on the real memory 18. The real address obtained at that time is stored in a cache register 14. The map table 19 is not successively referred to as to second and succeeding accesses but the target real address is directly calculated based on the real address which is cached, whereby the real memory 18 is accessed.

title: File version management device
abstract: PURPOSE:To secure the matching of versions between a host and a terminal and to reduce the version management load by storing the updating degree information as long as the change of this information is designated after a file of unupdated terminals is updated. CONSTITUTION:When the updating or such a degree that requires the change of the major number of a file stored in a file storing part 207 is carried out, an updating information storage part 201 is initialized and an updating degree storage part 204 is checked in sequence for all terminals recorded at the part 201. If a major column is turned on and a selected unupdated terminal is operating at the part 204, the occurrence of updating is reported to a terminal by an updating occurrence reporting part 202. Then a file transfer part 203 transfers the relevant file to the terminal. This file is received by the file reception part of the terminal and stored in a file storing part 303 through the updating processing. When all updating processes are finished, these results are reported to a host by an updating result reporting part 302.

title: Controlling method of rotation type memory
abstract: PURPOSE:To evade the transfer omission of a time-series signal by eliminating the need to take a long time for access to a substitute sector even when a defective spot characteristic to a rotation type memory is present on a storage medium. CONSTITUTION:When a track write command is supplied to an input port 102 externally, a CPU 114 selects a specified track in response to the command. If the write command is supplied while a head runs on some sector on some track, the CPU 114 detects the next index to the sector to discriminate the address of the new sector. A substitute table is searched by the sector address and when the sector is an unused sector 412 or a bad sector, the next sector is waited for. When the sector is usable, a status display part is checked and when a bit W is ''0'', data is read out of a buffer 106A or 106B and written in the sector.

title: Shared memory control system
abstract: PURPOSE:To perform the distribution processing of the access from two masters such as CPU and DMA and to eliminate the competition for a memory by dividing a memory bank into two and providing the system with the doubled memory banks. CONSTITUTION:The shared memory is divided into mutually independent two 0-th memory bank 650 and 1st memory bank 651. These memory banks 650 and 651 shares one part or all of the address space. The connection of buses 14 and 16 for the memory banks 650 and 651 is exclusively performed one by one. For example, the system bus 14 is connected to the 0-th memory bank 650 through a 0-th selector 630, the DMA bus 16 is connected to the memory bank 651 through the 1st selector 631. Thus, the access from the two masters such as the CPU and DMA devices is distributedly performed and the competition for the memory can be deleted.

title: Digital filter integrated circuit device
abstract: PURPOSE:To decrease number of terminals and to improve the integration efficiency by writing once a write data, giving it to a data shift register and writing the data simultaneously to all lookup table RAMs. CONSTITUTION:After a write data is shifted out in write data shift registers 16-1 to 16-5 corresponding to lookup table RAMs 3-1 to 3-5, the data is written. Since the built-in lookup table RAMs 3-1 to 3-5 are all in the chip enable state, the write is implemented simultaneously by a common read/write signal. Thus, a signal comprising plural bits making each of the lookup table RAMs 3-1 to 3-5 into the chip enable state individually is not required. Thus, number of terminals is less and the integration efficiency is improved.

title: System starting device
abstract: PURPOSE: To easily change a constitutive state corresponding to the instruction of a user after starting by shortening starting time in the case of system start and preventing abnormality in start by stably starting a system while being exactly reflected with a state before stop and holding the instruction contents of the user before stop when starting the system. CONSTITUTION: A multitask system is provided with a task information storage part 12 for storing the information of respective tasks, task state storage part 13 for storing the state of start/stop of each task, and initialize task 16 for reading an information table and a state table when starting the system, starting the task of 'start' and not starting the task of 'stop' based on the information table while referring to the state of start/stop of each task at the time of last system stop required for the system, after the system is started, the started task is managed and the stored contents in the task state storage part are edited (changed).

title: Memory device
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the using efficiency of a memory which stores n-notation data by dividing this data into groups every P pieces and also m-notation memories into groups every Q pieces and securing prescribed relations among these values (n), (m), P and Q respectively. CONSTITUTION:When the n-notation data is written on an m-notation memory 3, the n-notation data train is converted into P pieces of n-notation parallel data by an S/P converter 1 and then into Q pieces of m-notation parallel data by an n/m converter 2. These converted parallel data are stored in a parallel memory 3. When the n-notation data given from the memory 3 is reproduced, the Q pieces of m-notation parallel data are read out of the memory 3. These parallel data are turned into P pieces of n-notation parallel data by an m/n converter 4 and then reproduced to an n-notation data string by a P/S converter 5. Here the relation between the data and the memory 3 is set so as to satisfy (mQ-nP)>=0.

title: Memory control circuit
abstract: PURPOSE:To control an external RAM commonly with different control means to improve the operation efficiency by connecting a data selector to a bus connected to the external RAM and connecting selectively the bus which is connected to plural control means respectively to the bus connected to the RAM. CONSTITUTION:A data selector 21 is connected to an address bus 24, which is connected to an external RAM 12 of a memory control circuit, to select data to be supplied to the RAM 12. Address information from a CPU 19 and an external address control circuit 29 connected to address busses 22 and 23 are supplied to this selector 21. Data 28 from an external device 27 is supplied to a data bus 13 through an input port 15 and is supplied to the CPU 19 and the RAM 12. A write indication signal 33 from the CPU 19 is supplied to the selector 21 and the circuit 29, and busses 22 and 23 are selected by the selector 21 to perform the data write from the bus 13 to the RAM 12 under the control of the circuit 29, thus reducing the burden of the CPU 19 to improve the operation efficiency.

title: Resource control device
abstract: PURPOSE:To efficiently utilize a resource by setting up and controlling the storage period of the resource taken in a storage position by an icon taking-in means. CONSTITUTION:A resource icon such as a document is taken in a storage position icon for displaying a temporary storage position of a document or the like by the icon taking-in means 24 for taking-in a required icon among resource icons in the storage position icon. The number of icons to be displayed on a display 21 is practically reduced and the storage periods of the resources icon taken in by the means 24 is set up by a storage period setting means 25. Namely, the storage periods of respective resources of a dust box icon or the like are set up. Consequently, all the resources are not collectively erased in error, and when the set period has elapsed, these resources can be erased by a proper means such as an alarm display or transferred to another storage medium.

title: Network system
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the efficiency of the development and maintenance of software by automatically performing the management and installation of the software. CONSTITUTION:A file server 2 to store the software, and a storage means 10 to store the information of an installation destination work station name at every software are provided. Also, means 9, 8 which automatically install the software on a work station 1 whose installation is required by referring to the content of the storage means 10 at every storage of new software in the file server 2 are provided. Namely, when the new software is released, the information of a file name and the installation destination work station name at every software are referred from the storage device 10, and the new software is automatically installed on an object work station 1 based on those information. Thereby, the efficiency of the development and maintenance of the software can be improved, and also, response to a request from a user can be attained at early stages.

title: Memory controller
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve data transfer capacity and memory using efficiency by using an operatable memory in each nibble unit and executing arbitration in each nibble unit. CONSTITUTION:At the time of receiving an access request from a section A, an access determining means (arbitor) 11 accepts the access request and informs the request to a nibble unit detecting circuit 12A. A controller 13 allows the section A to execute access to a memory 14 in accordance with the reception of the access to transfer data. The circuit 12A counts up the number of memory accesses by using the contents of a nibble bit as an initial value, and when the count value reaches the nibble unit, outputs an end signal to the arbitor 11. When an access request from a section B is received, the controller 13 accepts the access request and allows the section B to execute access to the memory 14.

title: Bit map memory controller
abstract: PURPOSE:To permit the efficient writing of data with a memory size of a small capacity as well as the control of an address with a simple constitution by a method wherein the title device is controlled so that a writing line will never exceed a reading line, depending on the contents of counting. CONSTITUTION:The time division treatments of writing and reading are effected. When the number of reading lines has exceeded N lines (>=2), N line writing process can be effected if N line writing can be effected in the disable period of time of a L and a SYNC. In this case, a memory control unit 1 monitors the code bit of a U/D counter 7 so that the number of writing lines will never exceed the number of reading lines and executes the writing by receiving a writing request WRLN only upon a minus code.

title: Cache memory device
abstract: PURPOSE:To shorten the processing time of the whole system by detecting which block of a cache memory each bus accesses and rewriting the contents of the dual port cache memory at the same time when a different block is accessed. CONSTITUTION:A processor address 1 and a system bus address 4 are compared by comparators 10-12 to detect which data block of the cache memory 27 each bus accesses. Then, when a different block from the cache memory 27 is detected being accessed, the dual port is employed and the same contents are rewritten in different data blocks of the cache memory 27. Consequently, even if one bus is in process of rewriting the contents of the cache memory, the other bus can advances its process, so that the total processing time is shortened.

title: Developing device of one-component system
abstract: PURPOSE:To keep the quality of pictures for a long period by providing an auxiliary trimming member in a part of the peripheral area of a developing roll so that this trimming member is deflected in the direction opposite to the toner carrying direction with respect to a trimming member and making the gap between the auxiliary trimming member and the peripheral face of the developing roll wider than that between the trimming member and the peripheral face of the developing roll. CONSTITUTION:A toner supplied from a hopper part 4 is held on a developing roll 3 as shown by an arrow (a) and passes parts where an auxiliary trimming member 20 and a trimming member 5 are arranged, and thereafter, the toner is carried to a developing part between the developing roll 3 and a photosensitive drum 2. At this time, the surface of the toner layer on the developing roll 3 is first scraped by the auxiliary trimming member 20, and the thickness of the toner layer becomes delta', and the surface of the toner layer is next scraped by the trimming member 5, and the thickness of the toner layer becomes a trimming gap delta (delta'>delta). Thus, the toner layer on the developing roll 3 has a certain thickness, and stable pictures are obtained.

title: Method and device for development
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent a developing bias from being discharged and to form a uniform image having no development irregularity by forming a thin and uniform toner layer on the surface of a toner carrier by a layer control member, and sending the toner layer to an electrostatic latent image holder which forms an electrostatic latent image on the surface and applying the developing bias to the toner carrier. CONSTITUTION:The rolled toner carrier 2 is structured having a semiconductor layer 6 on the surface of a developing electrode 8 and arranged opposite the electrostatic latent image holder 4 which holds the electrostatic latent image across a development gap (d). Toner 3 is carried as the toner layer on the semiconductor layer 6 of the toner carrier 2 by a toner supply roll 7 and the layer control member 1 and electrostatic charging is performed at the same time. The developing electrode 8 of the toner carrier 2, on the other hand, is applied with a bias voltage on which a rectangular alternating electric field is superposed by a developing bias power source 9. The toner layer which is carried to a development area by the rotation of the toner carrier is scattered to the electrostatic latent image holder 4 and the electrostatic latent image 5 is visualized. Consequently, the image with high resolving power having no dot deformation is obtained.

title: Developing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To supply a developer to a carrier stably and to obtain an excellent image by pressing a leveling member against the carrier and setting the contact depth between the leveling member and carrier within a specific range. CONSTITUTION:The carrier 5 and leveling member 4 are provided under a hopper 2. The carrier 5 and leveling member 4 are pressed against each other while carrying a developer 1 and the carrier 5 and leveling member 4 are rotated as shown by arrows A and B respectively; the 1st blade 31 contacts the carrier 5 and the 2nd blade 32 contacts the leveling member 4. The contact depth between the carrier 5 and leveling member 4 is set to about 0.3 - about 2.0mm.. Consequently, the developer is supplied stably to the carrier 5 by the leveling member 4. Consequently, a solid-black image with high density and wide area is reproduced faithfully and an excellent image is obtained.

title: Nonmagnetic single-component developing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To reproduce a solid-black image with high density and wide area faithfully, and to facilitate the manufacture and to reduce the cost by using a conductive foamed body for a leveling member which levels a toner layer. CONSTITUTION:The 1st and the 2nd blades 3A and 3B are fixed at both sides of the opening part 2A of a hopper 2 which contains a developer 1 and a carrier 5 which carries the developer 1 and the leveling member 4' are provided rotatably under the hopper 2 while pressed against each other. Then, the 1st blade 3A contacts the carrier 5 and the 2nd blade 3B contacts the leveling member 4' respectively; and a holder 7 holding an electrostatic latent image 6 is provided rotatably oppositely to the carrier 5 and the carrier 5 is applied with a bias voltage generated by superposing an AC voltage upon a DC voltage from a bias power source 8. The developer is charged electrostatically by the friction between the leveling member 4' and carrier 5 and the friction between the carrier 5 and the 1st blade (control member) 3A. The leveling member 4' is formed by winding and adhering the conductive foamed body 4B' on a mandrel 4A'.

title: Nonmagnetic single-component developing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To reproduce a solid-black image with high density and wide area faithfully and to minimize the falling of a developer by forming a leveling member which levels a toner layer by covering the surface of an elastic body with a skin layer of rubber. CONSTITUTION:The 1st and the 2nd blades 3A and 3B are fixed at both sides of the opening part 2A of a hopper 2 which contains a developer 1, and a carrier 5 which carries the developer 1 and the leveling member 4' are provided rotatably under the hopper 2 while pressed against each other. Then, the 1st blade 3A contacts the carrier 5 and the 2nd blade 3B contacts the leveling member 4' respectively; and a holder 7 which holds an electrostatic latent image 6 is provided rotatably opposite the carrier 5. The leveling member 4' is constituted by forming the elastic body by winding and adhering an urethane foamed body 3B' on a mandrel 4A' and covering the surface of the obtained elastic body with conductive rubber 4C' to 1mm. thickness. When the leveling member 4' and carrier 5 are rubbed against each other, the carrier 5 contacts the leveling member 4' sufficiently without flexing even if the leveling member 4' is pressed strongly, so no developer falls from between the carrier 5 and leveling member 4'.

title: Developing device of electrophotographic copying machine
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the fluidity of a developer to keep it uniform by separating the residue of a toner, which is supplied from a roll to develop a latent image on a photosensitive drum in a developing part, from a sleeve by a magnet provided on the outside of a housing. CONSTITUTION:The developer is supplied to a photosensitive drum 1 from a pickup magnet 12 of a fixed magnet cylinder 10 by a sleeve 11 rotated in the direction of an arrow to develop the latent image on the drum 1, and a magnet 16 is provided in the position, where the developer is not supplied from a pick off magnet 13, on the outside of a housing 3 near the developing part. The developer remaining on the sleeve 11 is separated from the sleeve 11 by the magnetic force of the magnet 16 and is fed to a mixer 6 through a paddle wheel 5. Thus, the unused developer is prevented from being formed to blocks, and the fluidity is improved to keep the developer uniform, and the life is extended.

title: Non-magnetic one component developing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To constitute a titled device so that a carrying quantity of a developer carried toward a holding body of an electrostatic latent image is contant at all times, and to execute a uniform and stable development by setting a surface roughness of a developer carrying surface to within a specified range. CONSTITUTION:When moving onto an outside peripheral surface 6c of a carrying body roll 6 from a carrying roll 5, a developer 2 is brought to triboelectrification by a slide-contact of both the rolls 5, 6, and a sufficient charge is given. Also, the developer 2 on the carrying body roll 6 reaches a contact position of the second blade 4 by a rotation of its roll 6, it is formed to a developer layer of a prescribed thickness by this blade 4, and also, a sufficient charge is given to its developer layer by a slide-contact of the blade 4 and the roll 6. In this case, a surface roughness of the outside peripheral surface 6c of the carrying body roll 6 is set to a range of 0.1-0.5mum by a center line average surface roughness (Ra), therefore, a carrying quantity of the developer 2 by the carrying body roll 6 is constant even if it is used continuously for many hours. That is to say, the layer thickness of the developer layer formed by the blade 4 is constant.

title: Non-magnetic one component developing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To execute a uniform development having a high quality by forming the outside peripheral surface of an equalizing roll member made to abut by a prescribed pressure onto a carrying body of a developer, to a shape of a curved surface, so that said member has the minimum radius in both ends, and has the maximum radius in the center part in the member axis direction. CONSTITUTION:A shape of an equalizing roll member 5 is cylindrical, and when a pressing force to a carrying body roll member 4 is made to work, a contact pressure of both these members 4, 5 becomes a curved-shaped stress distribution in which said pressure becomes maximum in both ends 5c, 5d, and becomes minimum in the center part 5e. Therefore, the equalizing roll member 5 having an outside peripheral surface of sauc a curvature as shown in the figure is formed so that the pressing force applied to both the ends 5c, 5d is distributed equally to each point. As a result, in the abutting part of the equalizing roll member 5 and the carrying body roll member 4, the almost same contact pressure is generated in each point. In this way, a developer 1 of the almost same quantity is supplied in an about uniformly electrostatically charged state, to each point of the outside peripheral surface of the carrying body roll member 4 from the equalizing roll member 5.

title: Nonmagnetic one component developing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To reproduce faithfully a solid black piclture of a high density and a wide area, and also to prevent a fog under a high temperature and a high humidity by forming a control member contacting by pressing to a carrying body, by a rotating elastic body of a cylindrical shape. CONSTITUTION:A control member 4 is formed by sticking an elastic body 4b in a cylindrical shape to a metallic core bar 4a, and contacts by a prescribed pressure to the surface of a carrying body 5. A nonmagnetic developer 1 in a hopper 2 is supplied onto the elastic body 4b of the member 4 by gravity, adheres to a fixed thickness by the first blade 31, sent to the carrying body 5 by a rotation of the member 4, brought to frictional electrostatic charge efficiently by a slide-rub of the member 4 and the carrying body 5, and a uniform thin layer is formed on the carrying body 5. A part of a residual developer on the carrying body 5 is collected by the member 4, carried to the lower part of the hopper 2, and a part of the other is used for a development again together with the developer fed from in the hopper 2, a uniform developer layer of a fixed quantity can be formed on the carrying body 5, and also a sufficient charge can be given.

title: Non-magnetic one-component developing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To enable reproduction of a solid black image having high density and wide area with fidelity by providing a leveling member which supplies a developer to a carrying body and recovers the same therefrom prior to formation of a thin layer of the developer on the carrying body by a regulating member. CONSTITUTION:A carrying body 5 which carries a non-magnetic one-component developer 1 and a leveling member 4 are provided below a hopper 2 freely rotatably in press contact with each other. The member 4 is made into the shape consisting of an elastic material 4b adhered into a cylindrical shape to an arbor 4a. The developer 1 is frictionally electrified and is impressed with charge by the sliding contact with the member 4 and the body 5 and thereafter the developer layer of the thin layer having a prescribed thickness is formed by a regulating member 31. The developer failing to contribute to the development remains in a nonuniform state on the body 5, but a part thereof is recovered by the member 4 and the developer 1 is supplied by the member 4 to the part where the developer does not exist. The developer is thus corrected to approximately the uniform state and is eventually fed to the member 31.

title: Developing method
abstract: PURPOSE:To make a developer ambipolar and multifunctional by preliminarily apply electric charge to a toner by an external electric field in the preceding stage of a developing nip and applying electric charge to the toner by a latent image electric field in the developing nip to develop an electrostatic latent image. CONSTITUTION:A layer thickness control member 5 in connected to a developing bias power source 6, and a voltage is applied between the member 5 and a developing roll 2. The thickness of the developer layer formed on a cylindrical sleeve 3 of the developing roll 2 is controlled by the layer thickness control member 5, and a bias voltage is applied to the layer thickness control member 5 by the bias power source 6 to generate an electric field between the nonmagnetic sleeve 3 and the layer thickness control member 5, and toner particles are electrified in this electric field. The developer on the sleeve reaches a developing nip 10, and the toner is furthermore electrified by the developing electric field in the nip, and the electrostatic latent image on a photosensitive body is developed by the sufficiently electrified toner. Thus, the developer has the ambipolar property and is made multifunctional for image forming.

title: Developer carrying member
abstract: PURPOSE: To provide a developer carrying member which has a sufficiently low resistance value, surface roughness and sectional curve and with which good images are obtainable. CONSTITUTION: A one-component developing device has the developer carrying member 4 disposed opposite to an electrostatic latent image holder to transport a developer in the state of sticking this developer to its surface and a developer regulating member for forming the developer sticking to the surface of the developer carrying member 4 to a thinner layer by regulating the amt. of the developer. The device described above visualizes the electrostatic latent image formed on the electrostatic latent image member by sticking the developer having the charges on the developer carrying member 4 to the electrostatic latent image within the electric field formed in the developing region where the developer carrying member 4 and the electrostatic latent image holder face in proximity to each other.  The developer carrying member 4 is formed by coating the surface of a substrate 11 consisting of a conductive material with a surface layer 12 contg. at least a binder resin 13, carbon black 14 and conductive carbon beads 15 formed by baking polymer beads.

title: Developing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To make a developing device which develops an electrostatic latent image, compatibility with a magnetic one-component toner and to obtain a developed image of satisfactory image quality by means of a relatively simple structure and at a low cost, in a developing device. CONSTITUTION:A fur brush 30 is provided between a developing part 10 and a storage part 20. This fur brush 30 rotates in the same direction as a rotary sleeve 11, separates developed toner from the rotary sleeve 11 in the middle between the magnetic poles N1 and S2 of a fixed magnet 12, and supplies toner in the storage part 20 to the rotary sleeve 11. The fur brush 30 comes into contact with a part of a housing 40 (projection 41), and prevents a leak of toner in the storage part 20 when it is carried. Further, the bristles 32 of the fur brush 30 are made of a material which promotes the electrification of toner on a electrification line.

title: Developing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To form the copied image of a sufficient developing concentration, in a developing device having a developer carrier forming the magnetic brush of a two-component developer and attaining development without contacting with an electrostatic latent image holder. CONSTITUTION:The developer carrier 11 provided with an electrically conductive sleeve 11a whose surface can be rotated and a magnet 11b magnetized in such a manner that plural N- and S-poles are alternately placed side by side along the outer periphery of tone side opposite to the electrostatic latent image holder 61 inside the sleeve 11a is disposed to face the electrostatic latent image holder, inside the developing device 10 housing the two-component developer 14. Moreover, constitution that the sleeve of the developer carrier and the magnet are rotated/driven in a reverse direction can be adopted and the constitution that a conductive covering layer is provided on the outer periphery of the magnet can be adopted as well. Thus, plural parts where the nap of the developer is erected toward the electrostatic latent image holder are formed in a developing region and the quantity of toner contributed to the development is increased.

title: Magnetic brush developing device for copying machine
abstract: PURPOSE:To remove a bucket wheel, a mixer, etc., which mixes and supplies supply toner and a developer to a developing roller and the high-height constitution part of a developing device and to reduce the size and cost of the device on the whole by providing an upper auger and the 1st and the 2nd augers. CONSTITUTION:A developer 5 received on a receiving plate 6 is conveyed to the 1st opening part 11 provided at one end side of the receiving plate 6 by the upper auger 7 to fall from the 1st opening part 11, and then supplied to the developing roller 3 by the 1st lower auger 8. At this time, the developer 5 supplied to the developing roller 2 is agitated uniformly on the receiving plate 6 by the upper auger 7 and then supplied. Therefore, electrostatic charging characteristics are superior and a toner image corresponding to the electrostatic charge of a latent image on a photosensitive drum 1 is formed, so that copy density and copy picture quality are held constant for a long period.

title: Developing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the occurrence of irregularities in a toner image formed by other developing devices and color mixture, in a multicolor developing system, in a simple constitution without using a mechanical means. CONSTITUTION:Out of pole magnets 23, a pole magnet (for instance, N3-pole) for drawing a developer 30 onto a developing sleeve 22 is composed of an electromagnet 23a. The other ones are composed of a permanent magnet such as a ferrite sintered magnet. The electromagnet 23a is energized at the time of closing a changeover switch 26, to take the drawing action of the developer 30, the developing device 6 is changed over from a state where it is under use to a state where the use is stopped and simultaneously, the changeover switch 26 is opened to lose a function for drawing the developer 30. Thus, a developer layer having been formed on the developing sleeve 22 up to then is eliminated and a developing function is lost, so that the irregularities in the toner image on a photosensitive drum, formed by other developing devices and the color mixture never occur.

title: Developing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain an excellent image by forming an uniform developer layer in non-contact with an electrostatic latent image holding body on a developer carrier and securing the sufficient carrying amount of the developer in a developing device where the two-component developer is used and the toner is made to fly to a latent image on the electrostatic latent image holding body so as to visualize the image. CONSTITUTION:A layer thickness regulating member 3 is disposed, which is constituted of a soft elastic member 13 press-contacted with the surface of a sleeve 1a at a position opposed to the developer carrier 1 and sliding and rubbing with the circular movement of the sleeve 1a, a sheet-like spring member 14 to which the member 13 is stuck in the vicinity of its one end, and a blade holding member 15 supporting the vicinity of the other end of the member 14. The members 15 and 14 are formed of the material having the same coefficient of linear expansion. Thus, the deformation such as waviness, etc., of the member 3 caused the environmental change is prevented and the irregular density of the image is prevented.

title: Coating device
abstract: PURPOSE:To avoid contact of the coating part at both ends of a flexible band- shaped support with both ends of the tip of a coating head and to uniformize a coating soln. by discharging a pressurized fluid toward both ends of the support from both ends of the tip of the coating head. CONSTITUTION:A discharge port 8 for discharging a pressurized fluid toward both ends of the flexible band-shaped support 1 is provided to both ends of the tip of the coating head 10 corresponding to the coating part at both ends of the continuously traveling support 1. Since the pressurized fluid injected from the discharge port 8 is interposed between both ends of the support 1 with the coating head 10, contact of the coating part at both ends of the support 1 with both ends of the tip of the coating head 10 is avoided. Accordingly, both ends of the support 1 are pushed up by the deposit on both ends of the coating head 10, hence the thickness of the coating soln. is uniformized, and the oozing out of the coating soln. is prevented.

title: Coating device
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the deposition of a coating soln. on the end of a support and a roller by providing a thin-tube nozzle for blowing air against the coating soln. cross-linking part and a slit nozzle for expanding the coating soln. to the uncoated part at the end of a support from the inside of the coating surface.
