CONSTITUTION:The thin-tube nozzle 5 for blowing the injected air against the coating soln. cross-linking part to be formed between the support 1 and the soln. discharged from a slot and a slit nozzle 13 for spreading out the coating soln. to the uncoated part at the end of the support 1 from the inside toward the outside of the coating surface so as to form an uncoated part having 0.1-2mm width at the end of the support 1 are provided. By such a structure, the coating soln. is not deposited on the end of the support 1 and the roller 3 even when the width of the coater slot is larger than that of the support 1 and the end of the support 1 is thickly coated, hence the production efficiency is not decreased, the product quality is not deteriorated, and coating is carried out with high efficiency and yield.

title: Magazine for rolled material
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent generation of loose winding by oscillation during transportation by providing a leader part having front and rear faces which have the lower tendency to slipping than a rolled material to the leading-out end of the rolled material, covering the outside circumference of the rolled material and fixing the leader part by taking advantage of the non-slipperiness between the leader parts. CONSTITUTION:The leader part 6 which is connected to the leading-out end of the rolled material 3 or the extension of the material 3 is wound at least around the outermost circumference of the material 3, is led out through a slot 2 extending in the axial direction of a winding core 5 at the corner on one face of a body part 1 to the outside of a magazine and is stuck by a tape 10 to one face of the part 1. The part where the leader parts 6 overlap on each other is provided by several cam if the leader part 6 is made of a self-adhesive material or if the self-adhesive material is coated on the material 3. Generation of the loose winding by the oscillation during transportation is thereby prevented.

title: Roller leveling device
abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce the reduction in working efficiency and to decrease the flaw of a metal strip plate by arranging a nozzle integrating a blowing port and suction port removing a foreign matter on a metal strip plate with its suction by blowing an air jet at the vicinity where the metal strip plate approaches a work roll. CONSTITUTION:The nozzle 5 integrating the blowing port 3 and suction port 4 continuously removing with suction the foreign matter on a metal strip plate 1 is arranged near the inlet port where the metal strip plate 1 approaches a work roll 7. The foreign matter on the strip plate 1 to which the airstream injected from an injection port 3 is proceeding is continuously cut off and the suction port 4 catches the air and foreign matter without fail. The foreign matter on the strip plate 1 is thus removed at the front of the work roll inlet port to prevent the damage of a work roll and the generation of a flaw on the strip plate.

title: Coating apparatus
abstract: PURPOSE:To enable high speed coating while eliminating stripe irregulality, by constituting the titled apparatus so that roundness is imparted to a doctor edge surface and a liquid sump is present in a pressurized state at the time of coating. CONSTITUTION:When the downstream end of a doctor edge surface is set to B and the slot outlet end part of a back edge surface to B while the angle formed by the tangential line drawn to the back edge surface at B and that drawn to the doctor edge surface at A is set to theta1 and the angle formed by the tangential line drawn to the back edge surface at B and that drawn to the doctor edge surface from B to theta2, the slot outlet edge part B of the back edge surface is placed at a position satisfying a formula theta1<theta2<180 deg.. By this method, contamination or foreign matter is hardly accumulated to a liquid sump part and thin layer coating having no stripe irregularity is enabled at a high coating speed.

title: Coating apparatus
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a coating apparatus capable of uniformizing a coating thickness by avoiding the contamination of a coating head with a coating solution in a coating process and suppressing the generation of a stripe. CONSTITUTION:An extrusion type coating apparatus 10 emits a coating solution F from the slit 6 between a front edge 2 positioned on the upstream side in a support moving direction and the back edge 3 whose leading end part has an acute angle positioned on the downstream side in the support moving direction and retreating in the direction opposite to the support so that the leading end thereof has difference in level with respect to the front edge 2 to apply the same to the support in a state sealed with the precoat solution 11 based on an org. solvent preliminarily applied to the surface to be coated of the support 1. The leading end part 3a of at least the back edge of the leading end part of a head is constituted so that the contact angle with ion exchange water becomes 35 deg. or more.

title: Coater
abstract: PURPOSE:To enable coating at a uniform thickness by forming a coating liquid discharge slot to a tapered shape having a gradually decreasing width, curving the front edge side thereof and retreating the back edge in a counter support direction. CONSTITUTION:The slot part 4 is tapered from a pocket part 3 toward the support W in such a manner that the slot width decreases from the inlet side for a coating liquid toward the discharge side. The outlet top end part of the slot part 4 is further so curved that the surface of the front edge part 5 bulges to the support W side. The top end of the back edge part 6 is retreated in the counter support direction by giving a step (t) from the front edge part 5. The scorelines on the coating surface by the foreign matter trapped in an extruder and the fluctuation arising from the nonuniformity in the thickness, Young's modulus, etc., of the support is prevented and the coating is executed with the uniform thickness.

title: Coater
abstract: PURPOSE:To enable coating at a uniform thickness by forming a slot formed of both edge parts of an extrusion type head to a tapered shape having the width decreasing gradually toward a discharge side. CONSTITUTION:The outlet top end of the slot part 4 of a coater provided with an extruder is delieated of the front edge part 5 and back edge part 6 on the upper stream side and lower stream side of a support W. The slot part 4 is provided with the taper from the pocket part 3 toward the support W in such a manner that the slot width decreases from the inlet side for a coating liquid toward the discharge side. Then, the drop of the coating liquid pressure is minimized just before the liquid is discharged and the high discharge speed is obtd. The trapping of foreign matter at the edge faces is, therefore, obviated, and the formation of uneven lines is prevented. The uneven thickness of the coated film is thus prevented in spite of the fluctuation in the thickness and Young's modulus of the support.

title: Wind-up device
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent a slippage in winding and longitudinal wrinkling from occurring, by using rolls each having its diameter which increases toward the center section of te roll from each end thereof, as a spool core and a path roll which is arranged in the vicinity of the spool core. CONSTITUTION:A web 1 is wound up on a spool core 2 by way of a path roll 3. In this arrangement, a crown rolls each having a wind-up shaft section whose diameter increases toward the center section from each end thereof (the diameter is increased by 0.1-10mm with respect to the width of a roll which is 1m), are used as the spool core 2 and the pass roll 3. As a result, the tension in the center section of the web 1 may be increased so that the center section is firmly wound up in comparison with the other sections, and therefore, there is a less possibility of occurrence of a slippage in winding even though the tension in winding is low. Further, since the center section of the web is firmly wound up while edge sections are slackly wound up, air introduced by the web may be easily relieved from the center section to the edge section thereof, and therefore, there is a less possibility of occurrence of longitudinal wrinkles.

title: Original cassette
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent transporting failure due to flowing out of fluid and to attain accurate automatic transportation by providing a recessed part and/or protruding part for prevention of slipping on a transporting surface coming into contact with a transportation means of a frame body. CONSTITUTION:The frame body 12, a supporting glass plate 16 to install an original S attached to an opening part 14 in the center of the frame body 12, and a cover glass plate 18 retaining the original S as well as the supporting glass plate 16 are provided. Then, V-shaped groove parts 20a and 20b are formed extended in the direction X on both side parts of the frame body 12, and the transportation surfaces 22a and 22b are provided in the direction X in an upper surface part, and the recessed parts 24a and 26a, 24b and 26b for prevention of slipping are formed crossed with each other on the transportation surfaces 20a and 20b. Therefore, even when fluid such as oil is stuck to the transportation surfaces 22a and 22b of the frame body 12, generation of slipping in the transportation means 62 at the recessed parts 24a, 24b, 26a, and 26b can be prevented. Thus, judgement failure due to flowing out of the fluid can be prevented, and accurate automatic transportation can be carried out.

title: Coating method and apparatus
abstract: PURPOSE:To apply a coating solution without changing the liquid emitting orifice width of a coater by a method wherein the pressure of the coating solution is controlled in a slot and the interval of the slot in the thickness direction is gradually expanded immediately before emission to gradually relax the flow resistance in the slot and the coating solution is applied while the lowering of pressure and the decrease of flow velocity are brought about. CONSTITUTION:An extrusion type injector is used to apply a coating solution to the web with 300mm width on a support with 200mum thickness over the emitting width 500mm of the injector. The width l1 of the front lip surface 10 turned in the advance direction of the support is not specifically limited but generally about 0.1-5mm and the width l2 of the rear lip surface is not also limited but generally 0.2-5mm. Further, the width l3 of a rear lip inclined surface 9 is pref. 0.5-1.0mm. The angle formed by the rear lip inclined surface 9 to the center line of the slot is 5-45 deg., pref., 10-30 deg.. The web can be coated in low coating quantity and quality and productivity can be enhanced.

title: Coating method for coating liquid, coater for coating liquid and optical film
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a technology for accurately delivering a coating liquid by preventing intrusion of the coating liquid near a width restriction member.  <P>SOLUTION: A downstream side die tip surface 16B in a downstream side from a slot of a tip surface of a slot die 18 is arranged at a position in proximity to a support 14 from an upstream side die tip surface 16A. The width restriction member 60 is inserted to the slot and coating width of the coating liquid delivered from the slot toward the support 14 is restricted. A tip surface 62 of the width restriction member 60 is approximately continued to the upstream side die tip surface 16A and is approximately continued to the downstream side die tip surface 16B.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Lighting apparatus of electrophotography copying machine
abstract: PURPOSE:To work a reflector easily with good accuracy and also at a low cost, by making it possible to irradiate the original surface extending over the width direction by use of a reflector whose width is narrower than that of the copying original. CONSTITUTION:The light source 1 is equipped with a lamp 2 and an auxiliary reflector 3, is placed at the focus of the paraboloid reflector 4, and a light beam which has been emitted from the light source 1 is reflected by the paraboloid reflector 4, becomes a collimated two-dimensional light beam width 5 and is irradiated by the convex cylindrical reflector 6. And, the luminous flux 5 beomces a collimated two-dimensional luminous flux 8 which has been expanded in the width direction of the copying original 7, by the covex cylindrical reflector 6, is irradiated on the original surface, and it scans and exposes the original surface in the form of a slit as the convex cylindrical reflector 6 moves in parallel with the original surface. In this way, width of the reflector 6 can be made narrower than that of the copying original 7 and width of the paraboloid reflector 4 can also be made narrower than before, therefore the apparatus is made simple and at a low cost.

title: Illumination device for copied original
abstract: PURPOSE:To install a illumination system without leaving a large space before and after a photoreceptor, by scanning an original on an original table by using light sources positioned at an interval in the axial line direction of the photoreceptor. CONSTITUTION:Near image-forming lens 4, at least a couple of light sources 6 are provided at an interval in the axial line direction of photoreceptor 3, and those light sources 6 are rotated synchronously with lens 4 as photoreceptor 3 rotates to illuminate copied original 2 on original table 1. Then, each light source 6 illuminate the opposite side of original table 1, and consequently even when light sources 6 are provided closely to lens 4, any positive reflected light is not incident to lens 4 from original table 1, so that the illuminating system is easily installed in a samll space. Further, if light sources 6 are provided right under original table 1, they can be installed in parallel to the axial line of photoreceptor 1 and with their rotation centers agreeing with each other, so both the light sources is synchornized with each other without providing a complex synchronizing means between the both, so that the cost is reduced.

title: Scan exposing device of copying machine
abstract: PURPOSE:To enhance copying speed, by selectively using a collective optical system and a usual lens optical system for forward and backward movement of an original platen, and obtaining 2 copies in one reciprocation of the platen. CONSTITUTION:A pair of light sources 5, 6 are installed spaced in the movement direction of an original platen 2 for placing an original below the platen, one source 5 illuminates the face of the original to be copied at the forward movement of the platen 2 in the direction of arrow (a), and the other source 6 illuminates that at the reverse movement in the direction of arrow (b). An ordinary lens optical system 1 consisting of an ordinary lens 11 and plural mirrors 12-15 and a collective optical system 1' consisting of a strip lens, a lens array, etc. are installed below each corresponding light source 5, 6, and the original images are projected onto a photoreceptor 3 through the ordinary lens optical system 1 at the forward movement of the platen 2, and through the collective optical system 1' at the backward movement.

title: Exposing device of copying machine
abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce the number of parts, and to simplify assembling work by forming as one body a passive reflector for leading a direct light of a lamp light source into a high reflection cavity, in a part of a housing. CONSTITUTION:A direct light of a lamp light source 2 is reflected by a reflecting surface 3a, led into a high reflection cavity 4, and an original 7 on a platen glass 6 is exposed. An irregular reflection-shaped reflecting surface 3a whose section is a waveform is formed as one body at a position which is a part of a housing 3 containing the cavity 4 and corresponds to the rear of the light source 2, and a high reflection painting is performed onto its surface. In this regard, a cooling air of a cleaning fan 12 cools the light source 2 through a notched part 3b. In this way, since the reflecting surface 3a is formed as one body, the number of parts is reduced, and an assembling work is also executed easily.

title: Exposing device of copying machine
abstract: PURPOSE:To make reflected light uniform so that a distinct latent image is obtained, by shielding direct light of a light source, which is made incident to a projection lens, by a passive reflector, when the projection lens moves to a lamp light source side. CONSTITUTION:In a constitution consisting of a housing for supporting a platen glass 2 for placing a copying original 6 on it, a high reflection cavity 4 and a lamp light source 5, a passive reflector 21 having a prescribed height is provided vertically in the vicinity of a projection lens 7 moves to the light source 5 side. A tip part 21a of the passive reflector 21 is positioned in an area shown by oblique lines between a light B which is made incident to the lens 7 from the maximum copying original position, and a direct light C which is made incident to the lens 7 from the light source 5. In this way, it is prevented exactly that the direct light of the light source 5 is irradiated to a photosensitive body 11 through the projection lens 7, therefore, a distinct electrostatic latent image is obtained by a simple constitution, and also an intensity of illumination to an original can be made uniform by reflecting the direct light in the high reflection cavity.

title: Copying machine
abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce the size of a device by driving a platen upward and downward synchronously with the movement of a movable mirror which forms an original image on a photosensitive body. CONSTITUTION:The platen 1 mounts an original, a driving means consists of the 1st and the 2nd racks 14 and 21 and the 1st and the 2nd pinions 15 and 22 which drive the platen 1 upward and downward at the same speed, and a movable mirror 20 is driven synchronously with the movement of the platen 1, at the same speed with them, and in parallel to the surface of the platen 1. Then, an optical system forms an image of light which is emitted from the surface of the original and reflected by the movable mirror 20 on the surface of the photosensitive body 8. This optical system consists of a condenser lens 6, fixed mirror 31, and the movable mirror 20.

title: Exposing device of copying machine
abstract: PURPOSE:To hold nearly uniform the illuminance distribution of a projection image on a photosensitive surface by controlling the distribution of the quantity of light on a platen surface so that a decrease in the quantity of light based upon the cosine biquadratic rule of an image forming lens is canceled. CONSTITUTION:Annular flash light sources 20 and annular light quantity control members 30 having an arcuate light shield part 32 which is nearly a quarter as large as the section are arranged at the bottom part 2c of a housing 2. Light from each light source 20 is emitted through a gap 33 and reflected by the internal wall surface of a side peripheral part 2b to reach a surface of platen glass 5. The illuminance distribution on the surface of the platen glass 5 is not uniform, but too high at the periphery and an image of a body 4 to be copied is projected on the photosensitive surface 10 through the image forming lens 8. Then, a projection image having a large angle theta of incidence is large in the quantity of light, so the decrease in the quantity of light based upon the cosine biquadratic rule of the image forming lens 8 is canceled effectively and the illuminance distribution of the projection image on the photosensitive surface 10 becomes nearly uniform.

title: Exposing device for copying machine
abstract: PURPOSE:To irradiate the light from a flash light source at a uniform quantity to a platen by providing a shade above the light source and a reflector below said source and sloping the inside wall surface facing the light source in such a way that the light is reflected to the platen. CONSTITUTION:Platen glass 4 is provided to the top part of a housing 2 and a flash light source 5 is provided to the inside wall surface 2b. The shade 11 is provided above the light source 5 and the reflector 20 below the light source. The reflector 20 is formed by vapor depositing aluminum on aluminum or the like and inclining the surface so as to reflect the light advancing in the direction right under the light source 5 from said source toward the opposite surface A. The slope 25 is so formed as to reflect the light incident on the bottom of the surface A toward the platen 4. The light from the light source 5 advances along courses a1, a2, b, c1, c2, is reflected by the inside wall of the housing 2 and irradiates uniformly the platen 4. The light passes through an imaging lens 7 and is imaged on a photosensitive surface 9. The reflection of the light from the light source to the platen without waste in the irradiating quantity thereof is thus made possible and the life of the light source lamp is extended.

title: Electrostatic photographic copying machine
abstract: PURPOSE:To take an interruptive copy speedily and easily and to attain size reduction and a decrease in price by using one projection system in common to two lighting systems. CONSTITUTION:Two lighting systems 10 and 20 are provided in a copying machine (a). The light system 10 uses an entire-surface exposure system which lights up a platen 13 at a time with flash lamps 11 and 12, and the light system 20 exposes an original onto an original rotary drum 21 through a slit with light sources 22 and 23. The projection system 5 consisting of a projection lens 3 and a reflecting mirror 4 forms images of reflected light beams 6 and 7 of the systems 10 and 20 on a beltlike photosensitive body 8. The reflecting mirror 31 is supported rotatably on a shaft 32 and is a selecting means which guides the reflected light 7 of the system 20 to the system 5. Therefore, when the mirror 31 rotates as shown by an arrow A, the reflected light 6 of the system 10 enters the system. Further, a mirror 30 may be moved without providing the mirror 31 to use the systems 10 and 20 selectively.

title: Original lighting device
abstract: PURPOSE:To perform uniform lighting even when the illumination light source is put close to an original, and to obtain a compact device by lighting the part of the original close to the illumination light source indirectly through a reflecting plate and lighting the part of the original at the distant side directly. CONSTITUTION:A lamp 13 having a linear light emission source 12 is arranged on both right and left sides of the original 1; direct illumination light beams 14 from both lamps 13 are cut off partially by a light shield plate 15 and the remaining direct light beams 14 illuminate a nearly half area of the original 11 which is on the side distant from the lamps 13. Further, the remaining nearly half area of the original 11 at the side close to the lamps 13 is irradiated with indirect illumination light beams 17 guided from those lamps 13 through a couple of reflecting plates 16. The surfaces of the reflecting plates 16 are finished into sprinkled lacquer surfaces and the reflecting plates are so arranged that the illuminance on the surface of the original 11 by the direct illumination light beams 14 is equal to that by the indirect illumination light beams 17, so the original 11 is lighted uniformly and the original 11 and lamp 13 are put closer to compact the device.

title: Dimming device of electrophotographic copying machine
abstract: PURPOSE:To photodetect light at the center part of a fluorescent lamp having the best stability of the quantity of light and to control the quantity of light of the fluorescent lamp with fidelity by constituting a lamp housing so that it shakes around the lengthwise axis of the fluorescent lamp, and fitting a photodetecting element nearly at the lengthwise center part and shaking the lamp housing. CONSTITUTION:When a motor 22 rotates except in a copy cycle, the lamp housing 12 shakes around the lengthwise axis 41 at some angle through a line 13. The size of the link 13 and the fitting position of the photodetecting element 8 are so set that the photodetecting element 8 reaches the light irradiation area during exposure, and consequently light used actually for the exposure is detected by the photodetecting element 8. The output of the photodetecting element 8 is amplified by an amplifier 27 to control electric power supplying to the fluorescent lamp 1, thereby adjusting its quantity of light to a specific value.

title: Dimmer for electrophotographic copying machine
abstract: PURPOSE:To detect accurately the quantity of irradiation light in copying operation and to perform proper exposure, by arranging a photodetecting element to the position where the light irradiating an original from a light source is not prevented. CONSTITUTION:A reflecting mirror 10 arranged in parallel to a long and thin fluorescent lamp 1 has a lighting window 11 cut long and thin in the lengthwise direction of the fluorescent lamp 1 where the light from the fluorescent lamp 1 to the original 8 is not prevented and large influence upon the quantity of light to the original is not exerted. A photosensor 3 goes and returns to the overall length of the fluorescent lamp 1 throughout when the fluorescent lamp 1 turns on for copying and the total detection amount of light in a single going and returning period of the photosensor is detected; when the quantity of light of the fluorescent lamp 1 deviates from a set value, the electric power supply amount to the fluorescent lamp 1 is adjusted stepwise every time the photosensor 3 goes and returns once. Therefore, the quantity of light of the fluorescent lamp 1 is controlled to a specific value throughout the copying period.

title: Dimming device of electrophotographic copying machine
abstract: PURPOSE:To execute high speed copying and original object copying by executing an illuminating scanning by a quantity of light corresponding to an angle in a state that an illuminating lamp and an original placing plate remain fixed. CONSTITUTION:A lamp housing 5 having a slit 3 is fitted so as to be rotatable to an illuminating lamp 1, the housing is rotated by a servomotor 7, and a potentiometer 8 for detecting a rotation angle theta is connected to a dimming means 6. This dimming means is constituted of a lamp rotation angle detecting part 9, a lamp current control part 10 and a correcting circuit 11. A lamp current is controlled and also corrected by the current control part 10 and the correcting part 11 so that the quantity of light of a lamp for irradiation increases in accordance with the rotation angle theta, and an obtained current is supplied to an illuminating lamp.

title: Copying device
abstract: PURPOSE:To simplify the positioning and the focusing of an original by providing a movable mirror to be inserted to an optical path between an image forming lens and an exposure position, and a mask having a mark representing a print size and a mark for focusing at a position conjugate with the exposure position via the movable mirror. CONSTITUTION:At the time of performing the focusing of the image forming lens 8 and the positioning of the original, the movable mirror 45 is inserted to the optical path after placing a reflecting original 2 on an original platen 1, and a light source (halogen lamps 3a and 3b) is lit. An optical image projected by the light sources 3a and 3b and transmitting the mask is reflected on the movable mirror 45, and projected adversely on the reflecting original 2 via the image forming lens 8. The focusing of the image forming lens 8 or the positioning of the original is performed as observing an adversely projected optical image. After that, the light sources 3a and 3b light out, and also, after the movable mirror 45 is retreated, the copy of the reflecting original 2 is performed. In such a way, it is possible to perform the alignment and the focusing simply and easily.

title: Copying device
abstract: PURPOSE:To simplify the positioning and focusing of an original by providing a mask provided with a mark which represents a print size and a mark for focusing and set at an exposure position at the time of performing the positioning and focusing of a reflecting original, and a light source to illuminate the mask from a back part. CONSTITUTION:At the time of performing the focusing of an image forming lens and the positioning of the original, the light source (halogen lamps 3a and 3b) is lit after the reflecting original 2 is placed on an original platen. An optical image transmitting the mask projected by the light sources 3a and 3b is projected adversely on the reflecting original 2 via the image forming lens 8. The focusing of the image forming lens or the positioning of the original is performed as observing an adversely projected optical image. Afterwards, the light sources 3a and 3b light out, and also, the light sources 3a and 3b and the mask are retreated then, the copy of the reflecting original 2 is performed. In such a way, it is possible to perform the positioning and the focusing easily and surely.

title: Device and method for shape measurement
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a device and a method for shape measurement which are small-sized and inexpensive, has high light use efficiency, and can accurately measure the distance to a body without being affected by external conditions such as a difference in the reflection factor of the body surface. SOLUTION: First and second shutters 11A and 11B are opened and a semiconductor laser 3 emits intensity-modulated illumination light 4a. A plane sensor 9 detects the composite light of reflected light 4b from an object 6 and reference light 4c from a half-mirror 10 and outputs a detection signal. The 2nd shutter 11B is closed and the semiconductor laser 3 emits intensity-modulated illumination light 4b. A distance arithmetic part 13 after making corrections for removing the influence of the reflection factor of the body according to the detection signal of the composite light and the detection signal of the reflected light 4b calculates the distance to the body according to the detection signal of the composite light which has been corrected.

title: Measuring device, measuring method, and image output unit
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a measuring device and a measuring method by which the characteristics of an object can be measured with high accuracy regardless of the distance and a position of the object, and which can be made compact at a low cost, and to provide an image output unit which utilizes the measuring device of method. SOLUTION: The light is emitted toward an irradiation area 5 on an object 2 from a light source 2. The reflected light or scattered light from the irradiation area 5 on the object 2, is focused by a lens 3, to be entered into a photoelectric transfer element 4. The photoelectric transfer element 4 is located so that the boundary part of the irradiation area 5 and an area except for the irradiation area 5, is located on a light receiving face of the photoelectric transfer element 4. Further, the light is received at a position where an image of the irradiation are 5 becomes smaller, when the object 1 comes close to the lens 3, and the image of the irradiation area 5 becomes large, when the object 1 is far from the lens.  Thereby, the increase or decrease of the quantity of light of the irradiation area 5, is balanced by the decrease or increase of the irradiation area 5, and the characteristics of the object 1 can be measured.

title: Optical scanner
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an optical scanner capable of detecting the accurate subscanning position of a light beams even when the fluctuation of light quantity and the fluctuation of scanning speed are found with respect to the light beams. SOLUTION: A photosensor 70 is arranged so that the staring edge 92A and the finishing edge 92B in a main scanning direction of a light receiving area 91 are non-parallel with each other, and is connected to a light receiving time detection part 99. Since the length of the light receiving area 91 where the light beam passes is different according to the position of the subscanning direction, of the light beams the light receiving time is different. The detection part 99 sets 1/2 of the amplitude of an output signal from the photosensor 70 as a threshold and takes the time exceeding the threshold as the light receiving time. The subscanning position of the light beams is detected on the basis of the light receiving time.

title: Sensor utilizing attenuated total reflection
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To accurately analyze a sample by adjusting a width of dark line corresponding to the attenuated total reflection part of a light beam incident on a light detecting means, for improved detection precision. SOLUTION: Related to a sensor utilizing attenuated total reflection, a light beam 13 enters, at various angles, a thin film layer 12 formed on one surface of a dielectric block 10 so that a total reflection condition is provided at an interface 10b between the dielectric block 10 and a thin film layer 12. The light detection signal outputted from each light receiving element of a light detecting means 17 which detects the light beam totally reflected on the interface 10b, is differentiated for the parallel arrangement detection of the light receiving elements by a differential means 13. The differential value is taken as a characteristic value for acquiring a sample characteristics by a signal processing means 20. A concave lens 16 is provided on the light path of the light beam 13 between the thin film layer 12 and the light detecting means 17, to enlarge the beam diameter of the light beam 13. An incidence width d1 of dark line D incident on the light detecting means 17 is enlarged wider than a parallel arrangement pitch of the light receiving elements, for improved detection precision.

title: Sensor utilizing total reflection attenuation
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To also measure the absorbance of a sample in a sensor utilizing total reflection attenuation.  <P>SOLUTION: The sensor utilizing total reflection attenuation comprises a dielectric block 10, a light source 14 for generating light beams 13, an optical system 15 for allowing the light beams 13 to enter an interface 10b so that various incident angles can be obtained, and a light detection means 17 for detecting the light beams 13 that are totally reflected from interface 10b for making parallel. The sensor further has a light source 50 for generating light beams 56 for measuring thermal lens effect, an optical system 51 for allowing the light beams 565 to enter the dielectric block 10, a mask 52 for shielding one portion of the light beams 56 through the dielectric block 10, and a light detection section 54 for detecting the light beams 56 through the dielectric block 10 via a mask 52 and an optical system 53, thus measuring thermal lens effect that depends on the absorbance of a sample 11.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2003,JPO

title: Blood vessel imaging device, blood vessel discriminating device, and frequency deviation measuring device
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain a device capable of imaging an artery and a vein clearly discriminating one to the other loading little on the subject. SOLUTION: The measurement light L is made incident on a subject 22 and scanned by an X-Y stage 23. The measurement light L is branched into two lines by a homodyne interference optical system and each measurement light is made incident on a subject 20 in mutually different angles and reflected two lines of measurement light are synthesized. A part of the measurement light L before incidence on the subject 20 is branched by a heterodyne interference optical system 12 and a frequency shift is given thereto by a frequency shifter 40 and is synthesized with the measurement light L from the homodyne interference optical system 11. The synthesized measurement light is detected by a light-intercepting element 13 and the beat component is detected by a signal detector 14.  Image signals are generated by a personal computer 15 based on the large-small relation between the frequency of the beat component by the homodyne interference optical system 11 showed by beat signal I from the signal detector 14 and a prescribed threshold value.

title: Sensor for utilizing total reflection attenuation
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To accurately measure the state of total reflection attenuation regardless of the refractive index of a sample in a sensor utilizing total reflection attenuation.  <P>SOLUTION: In the sensor, light beams 13 are applied so that various incident angles can be obtained to an interface 10b between a dielectric block 10 and a metal film 12, the light beams 13 that are totally reflected from the interface 10b are detected by a photodiode array 17, and the characteristics of a sample liquid 11 are analyzed. In the sensor, the following dark line position adjustment operation is made before measurement. First, an incident angle control section 34 detects the profile of the light beams 13, thus obtaining the relative position of a dark line D for indicating the state of total reflection attenuation in the profile. A light source 14 and a condensing lens 15 are moved so that the dark line D is at the center of the profile, and an incident angle where the beams 13 enter the interface 10b is adjusted. Measurement can be made in a state where the dark line D is at the center of the profile regardless of the refractive index of the sample liquid 11.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2003,JPO

title: Device for measuring by utilizing total reflection light
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To suppress the degradation of the measurement accuracy of a total reflection attenuation angle by entering stray light to a light receiving means in a device for measuring by utilizing total reflection light.  <P>SOLUTION: A light beam from mutually different light sources from among a light sources 7, 8, and 9 is entered into dielectric blocks 52 individually corresponding to mutually adjacent light receiving means 30, from a means 10 for generating an light beam with a plurality of the light sources 7, 8, and 9 fewer than the dielectric blocks 52 parallelly arranged. The light beam is entered into each of the dielectric blocks 52 with an incident optical system 20 at an incident angle obtained total reflection conditions at an interface between the blocks 52 and a thin film layer 14, and then the strength distribution of the light beam, which are totally reflected at each of the interfaces, individually received with a plurality of the light receiving means 30.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO

title: Measuring apparatus
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve the measuring accuracy of a total reflection declining angle θ<SB>SP</SB>in a measuring apparatus detecting the position of a dark line by measuring the intensity of light beam by a plurality of light receiving elements and differentiating light detection signals outputted from the light receiving elements for each output from two light receiving elements adjacent to each other.  <P>SOLUTION: A light receiving element in which detected signal values of the light receiving elements of a specified quantity are monotonously increased in a direction separating from the element itself as a standard to both sides, i.e., a light receiving element detecting the root part of a dark line area having a some width is detected as a standard light receiving element (photo diode 17n in this case). The total reflection declining angle θ<SB>SP</SB>is calculated based on the differentiated values obtained by differentiating an output from the light receiving elements of the specified quantity holding the reference light receiving element therebetween with respect to the juxtaposed direction of the light receiving elements.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO

title: Measuring device
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To perform accurate measurement even if the removal or reinstallation of a measuring plate is performed, in a measuring device comprising the measuring plate having a plurality of specimen wells and observing a time change in total reflection attenuation.  <P>SOLUTION: This measuring device is constructed so that a light beam L1 totally reflected on an interface 202a is detected by making the light beam L1 incident at various angles so that a total reflection condition is obtained on the interface 202a of a thin film layer 12 on a light incidence/projection part 202. In this measuring device, a light beam L2 for measuring inclination is made incident on the interface 202a, the light beam L2 for measuring the inclination reflected on the interface 202a is light received by a light detection means 37, slope between the first and second measurement of total reflection attenuation measurement of the interface 202a is obtained, and the second measurement value is corrected in a signal processing part 20 according to the obtained slope.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

title: Sensor using total reflection attenuation
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To shorten a measuring interval, in a sensor using total reflection attenuation by a surface plasmon or the like using two-dimensional imaging means.  <P>SOLUTION: A two-dimensional CCD imaging element 40 is a full frame type imaging element, a lateral direction of an array of vertical transfer CCDs is in parallel to a face including incident light and reflection light with respect to an interface 12a of a light beam 30, and an output is executed under the condition where charges of only the vertical transfer CCDs arrayed vertically are summed up, that is, after so-called binning treatment. When detecting intensity of the light beam 30 total-reflected on the interface 12a by the two-dimensional CCD imaging element 40, a component in every of respective reflection angles is photoreceived by the array of the vertical transfer CCDs. When reading out a signal from the two-dimensional CCD imaging element 40, a reading time is shortened and a noise is reduced by executing the vertical directional binning treatment.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Birefringence measurement device and stokes parameter calculation program
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a birefringence measurement device that is easily manufactured and capable of high accuracy measurements, while having an inexpensive and simple structure.  <P>SOLUTION: This birefringence measuring device 100 for measuring a birefringence characteristics of light is equipped with a phase plate 5 for changing the phase state of light, from a light source 1 passing through a sample 4 which is an object of measurement, a polarizer 6 for polarizing light passing through the phase plate 5 in a prescribed polarization direction, an image sensor 7 for detecting the light passing through the polarizing plate 6, and a control part 81 for calculating a Stokes parameter related to the light from the sample 4, based on the intensity of the light detected by the image sensor 7. In the phase plate 5, the main axis azimuth, wherein the light passes is different according to the position and the phase plate 5, has at least four main axial azimuths, and is constituted of a single phase plate.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Light measuring apparatus
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To conduct light measurement by using light of an appropriate luminescence wavelength based on light transmission property of a part to be measured and the like.  <P>SOLUTION: Excitation light emitted from a semiconductor laser 102 is made incident on an optical fiber 101 of which core is evenly dispersed with lead sulfide nanoparticle group controlled to have a radius 5.75 nm to 7.1 nm. The nanoparticle group is optically excited, fluorescence is emitted and a wide band low coherence light L1 of 1 μm to 1.2 μm, most appropriate for measurement of a living body and the like is emitted from an end of the optical fiber 101 and introduced to a fiber 204 of a fiber joint optical system 20. By controlling the radius of the nanoparticle group, light of intended wavelength band and spectral width can be emitted from a light source 10. In a fiber coupler 201, the low coherence light L1 is separated into a measurement light L3 to be radiated to a part 1 to be measured and a reference light L2. A measurement light L4 reflected by a predetermined deep part of the part 1 to be measured and the reference light 2 are coupled and light intensity of an interference light is detected by a balance difference detection part 50 and image processing is conducted to obtain an optical tomographic image.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Sensor, sensing device, and sensing method
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a sensor capable of detecting highly efficiently fluorescence emitted from a fluorescent label with high S/N ratio, and capable of dispensing with a complicated optical system for the detection.  <P>SOLUTION: This sensor 1 has a sensing surface 1s bonded only with a specific substance R to be detected, and a metal portion 20 with at least a portion exposed on the sensing surface 1s and capable of exciting a localized plasmon. The sensor 1 is used in sensing for detecting two-photon excitation fluorescence or multi-photon excitation fluorescence of the fluorescent label Lu, by labeling the substance R to be detected with the fluorescent label Lu coupled selectively with the substance R to be detected, and the sensing surface 1s is irradiated with a measurement light L1 of a wavelength that can excite the localized plasmon in the metal portion 20 and that is an absorption wavelength emitting the two-photon excitation fluorescence or the multi-photon excitation fluorescence of the fluorescent label Lu.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title: Sensing method and sensing kit to be used of the same
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable a high quantitative sensing operation to be carried out by improving an S/N ratio in a sensing method using a scattered light measurement.  <P>SOLUTION: In the sensing method for detecting an amount of a substance to be detected A, a labeling complex whose amount corresponds to the amount of the substance to be detected A is formed at a sensor part 14 on the surface of a transparent carrier 10 on which a first capture substance B1 for forming the labeling complex containing a scatterer F is immobilized, and the refractive index of the surface of the transparent carrier 10 containing at least the sensor part 14 is adjusted to be 1.35 or more, and less than the refractive index of the transparent carrier itself, and then the scattered light measurement is carried out.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Endoscope light source device, endoscope system, and operation method of endoscope light source device
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an endoscope light source device, an endoscope system, and an operation method of the endoscope light source device capable of adjusting a contrast of a blood vessel flexibly, according to depth and thickness under a mucosa.SOLUTION: An endoscope light source device comprises: a first light source 20a for emitting V-light having a depth resolution with respect to blood vessels under a mucosa which are observation targets; a second light source 20b for emitting a white light having a continuous spectrum with a wider band wider than that of the V-light; a Bs-light generation band restriction filter 25 for generating, from the white light, Bs-light having a thickness resolution with respect to the blood vessels under the mucosa which exist at a same depth; a light amount ratio setting part 23 for setting a light amount ratio of the V-light and Bs-light, and setting a blood vessel contrast to the mucosa to a target contrast according to depth and thickness of the blood vessels; and a light source control part 22 for controlling the first and second light sources, using the light amount ratio set by the light amount ratio setting part 23.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 16

title: Optical measurement device of eyeball
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an optical measurement device of an eyeball which improves accuracy of optical measurement as compared with a case where correction corresponding to an incident state on a light receiving surface receiving a light beam is not performed.SOLUTION: An optical measurement device 1 of an eyeball comprises: a light irradiation system 21 for irradiating an anterior chamber 13 of an eyeball 10 of a subject with a light beam 28; a light reception system 22 having a light receiving surface 35a of a light receiver 35 for receiving the light beam 28 having passed through the anterior chamber 13 of the eyeball 10; and an incident state measurement system 23 which is provided between the eyeball 10 and the light irradiation system 21 so as to be able to receive at least a part of the light beam 28 having passed through the anterior chamber 13 of the eyeball 10 and has a light receiving surface 51a of a light receiver 51 capable of measuring an incident position of the light beam 28.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Document preparing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To execute flexible document preparation without being influenced by the fixed relation of nodes or links in a document preparing device for converting data stored by hierarchical structure such as a hyper text into a document. CONSTITUTION:A hierarchical data managing part 1 manages nodes and links constituting hierarchical structure together with plural link types. A formation format setting part 4 sets up conversion information for document preparation in each of plural link types. In the case of converting nodes extracted by the managing part 1 into a document, a document preparing part 5 refers to the conversion information set up by the setting part 4 and executes document preparation corresponding to each link type.

title: Facsimile equipment
abstract: PURPOSE:To allow a sender side to easily specify a return sheet. CONSTITUTION:A received document is stored in a picture information memory 2 and its attribute is stored in a memory management section 16. An ID number indicating a sender of a stored document and an ID entered from an operation section 6 are compared at an ID comparator section 18. When the both are coincident, the stored document is read by a return sheet generating section 20 by using the ID as a retrieval key. The return sheet generating section generates a return sheet including a reduced picture of the stored document and stores it to a picture information memory 2. The return document read by a read section 1 and the return sheet are sent to a destination according to a transmission command entered from an operation section 6. The destination receiving the return document easily specify a document of a return object based on the reduced picture of the return sheet.

title: Document processor
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a document processor capable of recognizing a document image expressed by common allocation structure prior to the practical allocation of an individual document. CONSTITUTION:A designating means 112 designates a node in the common allocation structure stored in a common allocation information storing means 11. A position display means 113 outputs the node designated by the means 112 and a node relating to the node concerned. A slave element formation rule display means 114 outputs a salve element formation rule relating to at least a part of a node group displayed by the means 113. A page image display means 115 outputs a plane position relation in a rectangular area held by the slave node of a page node corresponding to the node designated by the means 112. Output information from these means 113, 114, 115 is inputted and displayed to/on a display device 103 through an I/O control part 104.

title: Output device
abstract: PURPOSE: To output each page of image data to a desired page depending on designation information by deciding to which page each page of the image data is composited by an output decision means. CONSTITUTION: An output page decision means 16 places priority on designation information received by a host interface (I/F) 11a from designation information received by a designation information input means 15. When a host device 20 sends image data comprising plural pages and designation information corresponding to each page of the image data, an output device 10 uses the host I/F 11a to store the data tentatively to a storage means such as a hard disk. When reduced information is received by a designation information input means 15, the information is stored in a register in an output page decision means 16. A display page designation means 18 stores display information to a storage means by the user.  Then an image processing means 12 extracts the data from the 1st page sequentially, the data are processed by an image expansion section 12a and recognized by a recognition means 14 and the result is outputted.

title: Document processor and form register device therefor
abstract: PURPOSE:To easily efficiently prepare a document having a form for presentation in accordance with contents of general document which is without preliminarily determining the position, the number of stages, and the number of characters. CONSTITUTION:This device is provided with an area dividing means 2 which divides the document picture held in a document picture holding means 11 into meaningful areas as document elements, an identifier giving means 3 which gives identifiers to divided areas respectively, a form data holding means 4 which holds form data including layout information of the document to be prepared and a form frame picture, a document constituting element converting means 5 which converts picture elements in each area in accordance with the identifier based on the form data, and a picture synthesizing means 6 which successively synthesizes converted elements into a form picture.

title: Document preparation supporting device
abstract: PURPOSE:To easily prepare a document excellent in outward appearance even in the case an implementor has no editorial design knowledge by inferring with document information such as the contents of the document or the attribute and document design knowledge information, and deciding an optimum design. CONSTITUTION:This document preparation supporting device is composed of a display part 1, document storage part 2, knowledge data base 3 and document design decision part 4. The document storage part 2 stores code data or graphic data prepared by a word processor, etc., generally electronized document such as the kind of the document, the data of preparation and the usage, and data expressing additional information as the document information. The knowledge data base 3 stores knowledge specifying evaluation words and mutual relation between document design elements and document attributes as the document design knowledge information. The document design decision part 4 decides the document design according to forward inference or backward inference based on the document information.

title: Data processor
abstract: PURPOSE:To attain the listing which is excellent in appearance and high in expressive power as a table by providing an accumulating and displaying means to accumulate and display the displayed squares and an input means to select the sequence of the squares accumulated and displayed. CONSTITUTION:An input means 1 is constituted of a matrix position input means 10 and a command input means 11, the instruction to accumulate and display respective squares is inputted by a command input means 11, the matrix position of respective squares is inputted from a matrix position input means 10 in accordance with the desired accumulation sequence, and then, an accumulation control means 20 to constitute a control means 2 forms the accumulation image of the squares in accordance with the designated accumulated sequence and displays it on the displaying picture of a displaying means 3. Thus, by accumulating and displaying the squares to constitute the table in the designated sequence, the table, which is excellent in appearance and abundant in expressive power, can be displayed.

title: Document preparation support device
abstract: PURPOSE: To provide a document preparation support device which supports document preparation by deciding a category during the document preparation by using a cooccurrence dictionary and indicating cooccurrence words specified in the decided category. CONSTITUTION: The document preparation support device is equipped with a document editing means which specifies a word in a document during document editing, a cooccurrence relation holding means 12 which classifies the cooccurrence relation of the words by plural categories and holds them, an example data holding means 15 which classifies and holds example data by plural categories, a category decision means 14 which decides the category of a prepared document according to a word set obtained by morpheme analytic processing and the cooccurrence relation held in the cooccurrence relation holding means 12, an example data retrieval means which retrieves examples containing both the words specified by the document editing means and the words in cooccurrence relation with the words in the category specified by the category decision means 14,  and example data display means 16 which displays the example retrieval result to a user.

title: Document editing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To facilitate a layout work at the time of preparing a document by executing a layout processing by designating a layout name as one of attributes of the document at the time of preparing the document. CONSTITUTION:The device is constituted of a keyboard 15 being a layout name setting means, a layout information defining part 14 being a layout information storage means, a layout determining part 13 being a layout determining means, a layout processing part 12 being a layout processing means, etc. By the layout name setting means 15, a layout name is set as an attribute of a document, and in the layout information storage means 14, the layout name and its layout information are related and stored. The layout determining means 13 fetches and determines the layout information, based on the layout name, and allows the layout processing means 12 to execute a layout processing of a document, based on the layout information. In this case, instead of the layout determining means 13, it is also possible that a layout inference mechanism infers the layout information in accordance with knowledge determined in advance, for example, a rule.

title: Document preparing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a document preparing device which can access only the part which each person in charge is in charge in one document. CONSTITUTION:A document storing means to store a document, a protection field setting means to set protection fields 67-69 to the desired area of the document stored in the document storing means and an access mode setting means to set the mode of the access for the set protection fields 67-69 to the mode different from the mode of the access for the document before setting the protection field are equipped to a document preparing control system.

title: Kana/kanji converting device
abstract: PURPOSE:To perform the KANA (Japanese syllabary)/KANJI (Chinese character) conversion at a high speed by copying a word dictionary of an external memory like a hard disk, etc., to a main memory like a RAM, etc. CONSTITUTION:When a document is produced by a word processor, a keyboard menu 71 displayed on the screen of a CRT 7 is clicked by a mouse 3a for selection of 'dictionary memory' of a keyboard menu 72. In this case, a CPU 1 checks the memory capacity of a RAM disk 10 and copies a word dictionary for KANA/KANJI conversion stored in a hard disk 6 to the disk 10 when the memory capacity of the disk 10 has its margin. As a result, the KANA/KANJI conversion processing is possible with an access given to the disk 10. Thus the access time is omitted to the disk 6 and therefore the KANA/KANJI conversion processing time is extremely reduced.

title: Dictionary retrieving device
abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate the checking such as the wastefull connection testing and to make the memory to hold an intermediate results into the necessary minimum limit by selecting with plural features of the word of the retrieving result in the case that plural retrieving results when the dictionary content of a heading coincident from the head of the retrieving object character string is retrieved exist. CONSTITUTION:For example, at the time of a retrieving object character string, that is to say, a high income (KOU SHO TOKU), the dictionary content of the heading coincident from the head becomes ('KOU'(high) prefix) ('TAKA'(high) adjective) and ('KOUSHO' noun). Next, since ('KOU'(high) prefix) is obtained when the content for which the speech part is the prefix or the adverb is searched, out of the shortest and coincident dictionary content this is stored. Continuously, when the shortest and coincident dictionary content is removed from the first dictionary content and ('KOU'(high) prefix) stored now is combined, ('KOU'(high) prefix) ('KOU SHO' noun) are obtained, and this is outputted as a primary result. Then, the retrieving leak of ('KOU'(high) prefix) caused by the longest coincident system is prevented and the extra retrieving result, that is to say, ('TAKA'(high) adjective) is not outputted.

title: Kana to kanji converter
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the efficiency of a conversion work by deciding a composite word intended by an operator from a result of conversion of KANA (Japanese syllabary) to KANJI (Chinese character) and registering it automatically in a dictionary. CONSTITUTION:The converter is provided with a CPU (central processing unit) 21, a disk controller 23, a display control part 24, a RAM 25, a keyboard/mouse control part 26, a disk 27 being an external storage device, and a display part 28. In such a state, whether an unconverted character is contained in a converted character-string or not is detected, and in the case the unconverted character is contained, whether the character converted in the next time is that which is obtained by further converting the unconverted character or not is decided. Simultaneously, whether an inputted KANA character-string is divided into plural KANA character-strings and converted separately or not is decided. Subsequently, at the time point when it is detected that the unconverted character is eliminated, a composite word obtained by synthesizing the divided and converted words and reading corresponding thereto are registered in a dictionary, respectively. In such a way, the work efficiency of a conversion processing can be improved remarkably.

title: Japanese word processor
abstract: PURPOSE:To attain a sorting job, the production of a list based on KANJI (Chinese characters) by using a KANJI/KANA (Japanese syllabary) conversion dictionary. CONSTITUTION:When a sentence of only KANJI or a sentence containing HIRAGANA (Japanese syllabary), KATAKANA (square forms of Japanese syllabary), etc. is supplied through a KANJI input part 1, these sentences are stored in a sentence memory part 2 in the form of the corresponding KANJI and character codes. When a sorting job, the production of a list, etc. are needed for the stored KANJI, a KANJI/KANA conversion key 11 is operated to read successively the KANJI codes out of a KANJI buffer 3. Then the corresponding KANA codes are detected through a conversion table of a KANJI/KANA conversion dictionary 4 and sent to a KANA buffer 5. These KANA codes are read out of the buffer 5 in a sorting or list production mode. The result of the sorting job or the result of production of a list is outputted to an output part 6.

title: Japanese word processor
abstract: PURPOSE:To attain list processing with KANJI (Chinese characters) by storing KANA (Japanese syllabary) and its converted KANJI, adding a code to each character of a sentence based on those stored KANA and KANJI and adding the reading start and end codes to KANJI reading. CONSTITUTION:A sentence containing HIRAGANA (Japanese syllabary) and KANJI is supplied from a KANA input part 1 in the form of a KANA sentence. For the KANJI part, a KANJI conversion key 11 is operated after the Japanese reading of the KANJI is supplied in HIRAGANA. Then the corresponding KANJI is detected through a KANA/KANJI conversion dictionary 3. The HIRAGANA supplied through the part 1 are stored succeedingly to a HIRAGANA buffer 2. While the converted KANJI is stored in a KANJI buffer 4. When the reference is desired to the reading of the input KANJI, both the reading start and codes are used to convert the KANJI into the KANA. Thus the KANJI can be applied to a sorting job, the production of a list, etc.

title: Kana and kanji converting device
abstract: PURPOSE:To execute KANA (Japanese syllabary)-KANJI (Chinese character) conversion at a high speed by retrieving the stored contents of a dictionary to correspond to a specified filed to be designated and executing the KANA- KANJI conversion from inputted character information to a desired character string when there is no homonym to correspond to the inputted character information in the stored contents of a basic vocabulary KANJI dictionary. CONSTITUTION:When the KANA-KANJI conversion is executed from the inputted character information to the desired character string, the storing contents of a basic vocabulary KANJI dictionary 15C are retrieved at first. When there is no homonym to correspond to the inputted character information in the stored contents of this basic vocabulary KANJI dictionary 15C, the stored contents of dictionaries 15A (technique) and 15B (commerce), which are correspond to the specified field to be designated, are retrieved and the KANA- KANJI conversion is executed from the inputted character information to the desired character string. Thus, by designating the field of a document to be prepared by an operator, a processing speed can be improved in the case of the KANA-KANJI conversion and efficient document preparation can be executed.

title: Document processor
abstract: PURPOSE:To define a desired KANJI(Chinese character) inscription by inputting first several characters of reading when the reading corresponding to a prescribed character inscription is so long, displaying a KANJI inscription containing the reading as a candidate by issuing an estimate conversion instruction, and selecting a desired KANJI out of the KANJI inscriptions. CONSTITUTION:A conversion controller 5, in the case of receiving the KANJI inscription group of a conversion candidate from an inclusion word retriever 7, holds the KANJI inscription group once in a buffer, then, sends it to a display device 3. The conversion controller 5 defines a selected KANJI inscription and holds it in the buffer by selecting the desired KANJI inscription out of the KANJI inscription group of the conversion candidate displayed on the display device 3 by a user. A defined KANJI inscription is fetched in a document replying to, for example, a defined character string request from a document editing device not shown in figure which edits a converted character string according to a format set in advance to the conversion controller 5. In such a manner, the selected KANJI inscription can be defined.

title: Document processor
abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce burden for a user to register relation information in the case of Japanese syllabary (KANA)/Chinese character (KANJI) conversion at the document processor provided with a function to utilize the information of relation between words for selecting the candidate of homonyms. CONSTITUTION:A character string fixed by KANA/KANJI conversion is sent to a morpheme analyzer 13, and morpheme analysis is performed. The morpheme analyzer 13 extracts a pair of words in modification relation from the character string of the analyzed result and stores them through a modification information controller 16 into a modification information storage part 17. The modification information controller 16 checks whether the use frequency of stored paired words exceeds a prescribed threshold value or not and when the use frequency of those paired words exceeds the threshold value, the paired words are extracted from the modification information storage part 17 and registered through a modification information dictionary controller 19 to a relation information dictionary 18.

title: Kana conversion method
abstract: PURPOSE:To attain the KANA (Japanese syllabary) conversion without using a large scale dictionary by converting successively the chained words like a composite word, etc. at and after the tip part. CONSTITUTION:A processor 11 is connected to disks 12 and 13, a keyboard 14, a display part 15, etc. via a bus 16. Then a KANA/KANJI(Chinese character) converting job according to the program stored in the disk 13. While the disk 12 stores a dictionary. The part 15 contains a display driving circuit and a CRT and displays the input KANA information, the converted words, etc. Then the processor 11 converts the chained words like a composite word, etc. and after the tip part.

title: Kana/kanji converter
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the operability of KANA (Japanese syllabary)/KANJI (Chinese character) converter by providing a dictionary part in which a reading KANA is stored, and providing a candidate display means for displaying in the lump candidates, in the case plural pieces of candidates of the same sound word exist in said dictionary part. CONSTITUTION:In a reading KANA storage part 15, a reading KANA dictionary is stored. When a key input is a reading KANA conversion key, the reading KANA dictionary is refered to by an input character-string, and the number of reading KANAs is derived. When the number of reading KANAs is one, its reading KANA is inserted into a character-string in a text. When two or more reading KANAs exist, candidates of the reading KANAs are displayed in the lump. Subsequently, the reading KANA selected by a user is inserted into the character-string in the text. For instance, a KANJI notation of 'KANNO' is registered in the reading KANA dictionary by three reading KANAs of 'SUGANO', 'SUGENO' and 'KANNO'. Thereafter, the KANJI notation of 'KANNO' is selected, and when the reading KANA key is depressed, the above mentioned three reading candidates are displayed altogether.

title: Kana/kanji converter
abstract: PURPOSE:To make effective use of memory resources by referring the storage information of a converted word storage means storing a defined Chinese character(KANJI) expression and its reading, and executing a Chinese character(KANJI)/Japanese syllabary(KANA) conversion by a reading converting means. CONSTITUTION:The KANJI expression and the reading information KANA/ KANJI-converted and defined are corresponded and stored in a converted word storage means 4. And when a reconverting instruction is requested to the specified character string to be a conversion object in a defined document, a reading converting means 23 refers the storage contents of the converted word storing means 4, retrieves the reading character string of the requiring KANJI expression, and reconverts the reading character string as the part of or the all of the input character string in the case the KANJI expression is included in the character string to be the conversion object. Therefore, regarding the defined KANJI expression, the KANJI expression and the reading are registered, and are not registered overlappingly. Thus, it is possible to reduce the storage area storing the reading information of the KANJI expression for processing the KANJI/KANA conversion, and to make effective use of the memory resources.

title: Japanese processing system
abstract: PURPOSE:To take off a word composed of normal-use KANJI (Chinese character) and non-normal-use KANJI in a form mixed with normal-use KANJI and KANA (Japanese syllabary) at high speed, and to express the word consisting of only non- normal-use KANJI with only KANA without expressing them in the form of the mixture of normal-use KANJI and KANA when the expression of 'the word consists of normal-use KANJI' is set in a KANJI/KANA conversion. CONSTITUTION:When an operator starts the operation of a Japanese processor, first, an initial menu is displayed, and among them, the information setting option sheet of a used dictionary is displayed. Next, a character converter 2 judges what the set expression is. At such a time, the expression of 'the word consists of normal-use KANJI' is selected, both a first dictionary 5a, which is used for a general word and expressed by normal-use KANJI, and a third dictionary 5c, which is used for the general word and expressed by non-normal-use KANJI, are selected. On the contrary, at the time of the expression of 'the word consists of non-normal KANJI', a second dictionary 5b, which is used for general word and expressed by by the non-normal-use KANJI, is adopted. The inputted character code is searched by a dictionary searching means 14.

title: Document editing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the operability of processing operation for 'KANA' (Japanese syllabary)/'KANJI' (Chinese character) conversion and its working efficiency by reflecting corresponding character attributes to a 'KANA'/'KANJI' mixed character string to execute 'KANA'/'KANJI' conversion. CONSTITUTION:A word to be registered by a registering means 31 is registered in storage means 33, 34 such as a dictionary correspondingly to a reading character string, a 'KANA'/'KANJI' mixed character string and a character attribute specified by a character attribute specifying means 32. At the time of 'KANA'/'KANJI' conversion, the 'KANA'/'KANJI' mixed character string corresponding to the reading character string is retrieved from the means 33, 34 and the retrieved 'KANA'/'KANJI' mixed character string is converted into a character string corresponding to the registered character attribute. Thereby, the 'KANA'/'KANJI' mixed character string having the required character attribute can quickly be obtained without changing the character attribute. Thus, the operability and working efficiency of processing operation such as document preparation and edition can be improved.

title: Kana to kanji converter
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the processing efficiency of a document generation processing and the operability to the correction of a document by selecting a desired sentence clause in an yet undetermined KANJI (Chinese character) mixed character-string and correcting the length of the selected sentence clause. CONSTITUTION:A pointing device such as a mouse 13, selects a desired sentence clause in an undetermined KANJI mixed character-string of KANA (Japanese syllabary) displayed on a display means 18, resets length of the selected sentence clause and corrects length of the sentence clause. Subsequently, a converting means 19 redetermines the sentence clause of the undefined KANJI mixed character-string in accordance with length of the corrected sentence clause, and reconverts the character-string in the redetermined sentence clause to the corresponding KANJI mixed character-string. In such a way, the processing efficiency of generation/editing, etc., of the document and the operability to the correction of the document can be improved.

title: Telephone number informing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To dial assuredly by informing in voices the bar codes recorded on a card like a visiting card, etc. CONSTITUTION:A changeover switch 18 is set to a record mode to record the bar codes corresponding to a telephone number on a card 7. Then the switch 18 is set at the report side, and the card 7 is put into a main body 1 through a slit 4 of an inserting part 1D. Then the bar codes are read by an optical reader 17, and the telephone number corresponding to those codes is displayed at a display part 1B. At the same time, the telephone number is announced through a speaker 6. Thus a telephone dialing operation is possible while listening to the telephone number delivered through the speaker 6. This eliminates a dialing error with telephone numbers.

title: Facsimile connection controller
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve management properties, and to prevent the disappearance of an original by not receiving an incoming call whose designation absence is discriminated by a designation discriminating means, or by receiving it and transferring the original data to a designated host. CONSTITUTION:Facsimile equipments 2-4 detect the incoming call, and transmit an information to a facsimile connection controller 1. The facsimile connection controller 1 accepts the information, and checks whether or not address information (host name) is designated. When the incoming call whose address is not clear is not received, the reception processing is ended, and when the incoming call is received, a receiving job is executed, the original data are received from the facsimiles 2-4, and stored in a memory in the facsimile connection controller 1. Next, the transfer destination host is checked, and the stored original data are transferred. Also, even when the instruction of print or delete is transmitted from the host, the processing is executed according to the instruction.

title: Facsimile equipment
abstract: PURPOSE:To allow the operator of a slave set to visit a master set as required and to obtain a hard copy with high picture quality outputted from the master set even when the picture quality of the copy obtained at the slave set is not excellent. CONSTITUTION:When communication indicating transmission of picture information to a specific slave set is made to a master set 1 from another facsimile equipment connecting to a line in a master-slave facsimile system comprising the master set 1 and plural slave sets 2-1 to 2-N whose communication capability is deteriorated than that of the master set 1, at first a transmission station capability discrimination means 61 discriminates the communication capability of a transmission station. The communication capability of the transmission station is compared with the communication capability of the slave set stored in a slave set capability storage means 62 at a comparator means 63. When the communication capability of the transmission station is in excess of the communication capability of the slave set, the picture information sent from the transmission station is converted in response to the capability of the slave set and transferred to the slave set and a hard copy 70 is obtained from an output means 69 by the communication capability of the master set.

title: Facsimile equipment
abstract: PURPOSE:To allow the facsimile equipment to confirm whether or not transmis sion documents are all printed out. CONSTITUTION:A sender side A generates communication management information when number of communication results to a same destination reaches a predetermined number or over and the generated communication management information is sent to a receiver side B. The receiver side B stores the received picture information to a picture information memory 2b.
