When the stored reception information is a usual reception document, a print section 11 prints out the document. On the other hand, the picture information stored in the picture information memory 2b is the communication management information fed from the sender side A, a bar code indicating the content of the communication management information is decoded. The decoded communication management information is fed to a comparator section 21. The communication management information of its own station is fed from a communication management information storage section 19 to the comparator section 21. When there is any reception picture information not printed out yet, a message to inform it is displayed on a display section 7.

title: Information transmission system, facsimile equipment used for the system and facsimile connection controller
abstract: PURPOSE:To control the system such that plural facsimile equipments are effectively used by a host computer. CONSTITUTION:A capability command reception section 8 receives a capability command from host devices 1-3. A maximum capability detection section 9 reads each capability of facsimile equipments (FAX) 5-7 under the control of the system and detects the maximum capability and stores it. The capability among those stored in the command reception section 8 and the maximum capability detection section 9 and selected by the setting of a selection means 10 is read by a declaration capability setting section 11 and sent to the facsimile equipments 5-7. The capability fed from a declaration capability setting section 11 of a facsimile server 4 is stored in each system control section of the facsimile equipments 5-7, which add these capability to a protocol command and transmit at the time of communication.

title: Message proessing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a new selection mechanism selecting the function to be operated from the object and message. CONSTITUTION:When a message is sent to the object, a first table 41 expanding messages with high utilizing frequency prepared for every class and a second table 42 expanding message with low utilizing frequency covering the whole system are prepared. The funtions to be operated for the messages with high utilizing frequency and for the messages with low utilizing frequency are decided by the first table and the second table, respectively. The futile use of the memory resource in the message communication device can be eliminated and required function address can be transmitted to the object at a high speed as the constitution that the index system and cash system are used with distinction according to the utilizing frequency of the message.

title: Facsimile communication system
abstract: PURPOSE:To facilitate network and users managements without providing a facsimile equipment with a large capacity memory. CONSTITUTION:When various instruction, commands such as a preparation instruction of various lists and specification for a list output destination are inputted from a panel 34 in a facsimile equipment 30 by an operator, a main control part 32 in the equipment 30 transfers these commands to a host 10. At the time of receiving the transferred list preparation instructing command and output destination specifying command, a main control part 12 in the host 10 prepares list information of a sort specified for an information processor (network terminal) specified by the 1st preparation instructing command based upon the command and transfers the prepared list information to an output destination indicated based upon the output destination indicating command. Thus a list is outputted from the indicated output destination.

title: Facsimile equipment
abstract: PURPOSE:To allow the sender side to use an instruction using a DTMF signal independently of a content such as NSS by allowing a receiver side facsimile equipment to use an instruction of predetermined priority when both of function setting commands by a multiplex frequency signal and by a conventional procedure are received. CONSTITUTION:An instruction by a multiplex frequency is received. predetermined priority is stored. When both of function setting commands by a multiplex frequency signal and by a conventional procedure are received, the instruction with higher priority is adopted. As a result, when the priority placed on the DTMF signal is known by a sender facsimile equipment, the sender side uses instructions using the DTMF signal independently of a content such as NSS. Furthermore, a non-standard function is used even from a facsimile equipment manufactured by other manufacturer even with the provision of a DTMF signal transmission function.

title: Facsimile equipment
abstract: PURPOSE:To increase the opportunity of reception by devising the facsimile equipment such that it can receive a call in place of a unreceptible terminal equipment. CONSTITUTION:Upon the detection of an incoming call, an LAPD/system controller 10 discriminates whether an incoming terminal equipment is busy or receptible, and when busy, a B channel is connected to a main facsimile equipment 5 to allow it to receive the call in deputy. When the main facsimile equipment 5 is busy, an idle terminal equipment is retrieved from other terminal equipments and the controller 10 allows the idle terminal equipment to receive the call in deputy. After the substitute reception, the presence of a document received in deputy is informed to a called terminal equipment and after the busy state of the called terminal equipment is released, the document received in deputy is transferred as required. Or the main facsimile equipment 5 may use its own recording section to print out the document received in deputy or may store the document in its memory.

title: Facsimile equipment
abstract: PURPOSE:To make dialing with a simple operation having only to depress a designation key corresponding to destination information to be displayed by registering a dial number of a destination automatically with a normal dialing operation. CONSTITUTION:When a transmission start command is entered from a start key 15, a call section 16 sends a dial number (a) to a line via a transmission reception control section 18 to call a destination. Station identification information (b) sent from the destination in response to the call is inputted to a buffer 17. The dial number (a) and the station identification information (b) stored in the buffer 17 are inputted to a destination information storage section 9 when a gate G is set. A selection signal (d) inputted from an abbreviation function selection key 13 is inputted also to a telephone directory 9 and the storage content is outputted to a display section 11. One of destination information stored in the telephone directory 9 is designated by the designation key 12 and the dial number of the designated destination information is outputted to a call section 16.

title: Facsimile equipment
abstract: PURPOSE:To easily identify an original and overlay information attached to the original at a receiving station while economizing paper sheets at the receiving station by transmitting the picture signals of the emphasized overlay information together with the transmitting original. CONSTITUTION:A system control part 1, control panel 2, data storage part 3 and line control part 4 are connected to a system bus 6. The facsimile equipment having the above-mentioned configuration is connected to a telephone line network 5, and desired picture information transmission/reception is executed. When transmitting the picture signal so as to be printed while synthesizing the picture signal of the read transmitting original and that of the overlay information, the picture signal of the overlay information is emphasized and transmitted together with the transmitting original. Thus, paper sheets can be prevented from being wasted at the receiving station side, and the attached overlay information and the transmitting original can be clearly distinguished.

title: Facsimile equipment
abstract: PURPOSE:To select and execute plural functions by using the same command by setting one or more pieces of information out of plural pieces of information sequentially on a facsimile information field(FIF) by a decided rule. CONSTITUTION:An execution discrimination part 20 discriminates the function to be executed such as the one for confidential transmission, confidential polling, relay multiple addressing, remote multi-copying, etc., by an instruction from, for example, a panel or a host, and outputs the code of the function. A preset value storage part 21 inputs the information required for the execution of the function, for example, a confidential box number and a password when it is the confidential transmission from the panel, or outputs a value inputted in advance by reading out from memory. Thence, a command generating part 23 generates plural commands by setting one or more pieces of information sequentially on the FIFs of one or plural commands by the decided rule based on the code from the execution function discrimination part 20 and the information from the preset value storage part 21.

title: Facsimile equipment
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the facsimile equipment providing an output of a communication management recording by which a communication state of each of terminal equipments such as computers connected by a LAN or an interface such as SCSI is easily discriminated. CONSTITUTION:After communication is executed in the step 102, communication management information obtained by adding a terminal equipment number to the information of the communication result is stopped in a communication management information storage area of each terminal equipment in a RAM in the step 104. When an output command of a communication management report is received in the step 106, communication management information in each communication management information storage area is extracted to edit the communication management recording foreach terminal equipment (steps 108-112). Then the communication management recording after edit is printed out on recording paper by a printer in the step 114 and the result is outputted as the communication management report. Thus, the communication status for each terminal equipment is grasped at a glance.

title: Facsimile equipment
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain facsimile equipment capable of acquiring a cover letter by a reception side on all occasions. CONSTITUTION:A control part 12 analyzes and edits information obtained from a communication protocol when a document is received from an opponent by a transmission/reception part 22, and stores edit result information and reception result information representing whether or not the image information of a received document can be accumulated in image information memory 26 in manaing information memory 24. A cover letter generating part 28 generates cover letter information based on the information stored in the managing information memory 24, and generated cover letter information is transferred to an output part 20 by the control part 12, and the cover letter is outputted from the output part 20. Therefore, it is possible to acquire the cover letter by the reception side on a 11 occasions.

title: Communication control system
abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate the need for a file describing information representing the propriety of communication corresponding to the user by adding information representing the propriety of communication to an external network to existing user information relating to the user and referencing the user information so as to control external communication. CONSTITUTION:A network manager registers in advance information representing the propriety of communication reaching a LAN system 20 as one item of user information relating to the user in a LAN system 10 to a clearing house service(CHS) 13A. When external communication from a W/S 11 (client) to the LAN system 20 takes place, a gateway 12 converts a format of a packet or the like into a protocol suitable on the LAN system 20 and transfers the result to a router 14. The router 14 inquires of the CHS 13A about whether or not the communication to the LAN system 20 is available of the user requesting communication and returns the result to the W/S 11. When the communication is allowed, the W/S 11 continues the packet transmission and when not allowed, the W/S 11 stops the transmission.

title: Communication equipment
abstract: PURPOSE: To provide the communication equipment with which the next block or page is transmitted even without getting a response showing the normal reception of a block or page and image information is outputted in the order of transmission on the reception side even without receiving the image information in that order. CONSTITUTION: A control part 1 controls a facsimile based on the procedure of a G3C protocol and a storage part 2 stores a transmitting command. Corresponding to a responding command, a retrieval part 3 retrieves whether the transmitting command is stored in the storage part 2 or not. A transmitting command information storage part 5 stores information added to the transmitting command and transmission information. A transmission information change part 6 changes this transmission information. A separation control part 7 separates the transmitting command in the storage part 2 from list structure, and an image information storage part 9 stores the received image information. Even when the image information is not received in the proper order, an image information output control part 10 properly outputs that information.  Thus, the transmission/reception of image information can be efficiently controlled.

title: Multi-functional facsimile equipment
abstract: PURPOSE: To execute the number of line counting operation of a received document in parallel with other operations by decoding stored document data and counting the number of lines if a decoding/counting means is in its free state. CONSTITUTION: When the input from a control panel 8 exists, whether prescribed time passes after the input or not is monitored and whether an operator uses this device or not is judged. When it is judged that a decoding/counting part 10 is not in use, the document control table 7a stored in a RAM 7 is referred and the retrieval of the document in which the number of lines is not fixed is performed. At this stage, a decoding is performed while a reception is performed in a line control part 6 in a normal G 3 mode reception and the number of error lines is confirmed. In a G 4 mode reception, data is stored in a storage memory 11 without counting the number of lines. As a result of the retrieval, the document in which the number of lines is not fixed is read from the memory 11, the document is transferred to the decoding/counting part 10, and the number of lines is counted, decoding the document. This work can be performed by using the free time of the decoding/counting means 10.

title: Method for manufacturing polyimide film composition, polyimide film composition, endless belt, fixing belt and dpc photosensitive body
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for manufacturing a polyimide film composition enhancing the adhesion of a metal layer. SOLUTION: The polyimide film composition is manufactured by a method wherein a polyimide precursor-containing solution is applied to the surface of a substrate and the coated substrate is dried to form a precursor resin layer and the metal layer is formed on the surface of the precursor resin layer to cure the precursor resin layer under heating or by a method wherein the polyimide precursor-containing solution is applied to the surface of the substrate and the coated substrate is dried to form the precursor resin layer and a catalyst metal layer is formed on the surface of the precursor resin layer to cure the precursor resin layer under heating,  and electroless plating and electroplating are successively applied to the surface of the catalyst metal layer to form an electroless plating layer and an electroplating layer or by a method wherein the polyimide precursor-containing solution is applied to the surface of the substrate and the coated substrate is dried to form the precursor resin layer and the catalyst metal layer is formed on the surface of the precursor resin layer and electroless plating is applied to the catalyst metal layer to form the electroless plating layer on the catalyst metal layer and, after the whole is cured under heating, electroplating is applied to form an electroplating layer on the electroless plating layer.

title: Method for manufacturing polymer optical waveguide

title: Conductive pattern forming method
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a high-resolution conductive pattern material which is excellent in production suitability and in durability and conduction stability and to provide a conductive pattern forming method with which the high-resolution conductive pattern which is excellent in durability and conduction stability is manufactured with a simple process excellent in production suitability.  <P>SOLUTION: The conductive pattern material is formed by carrying out pattern exposure on a substrate to which a compound having a polymerization initiating site to initiate radical polymerization with photo-cleavage and a substrate bonding site is bonded, deactivating the polymerization initiating site on the exposure region, subsequently bringing an unsaturated compound capable of radical polymerization into contact with the substrate, exposing an entire surface of the substrate, generating the photo-cleavage on the polymerization initiating site remaining on the unexposed region in the pattern exposure and generating a graft polymer by initiating the radical polymerization and subsequently adhering a conductive material to the graft polymer.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&amp;NCIPI

title: Manufacturing method of polymer optical waveguide, mold used therefor, and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a manufacturing method of a polymer optical waveguide of a good core shape by a extremely simplified manufacturing step at low cost, and to provide a mold used for the manufacturing method, and to provide a manufacturing method thereof.  <P>SOLUTION: The manufacturing method of the polymer optical waveguide comprises; (1) a step for preparing the mold in which ultraviolet ray shielding masks are formed on recess unforming parts on a substrate surface of a recess forming side of an ultraviolet ray transmissive substrate with the recesses corresponding to the cores of the polymer optical waveguide; (2) a step for forming an ultraviolet curing resin layer for forming the cores between the recess forming faces of the mold and a lower clad substrate; (3) a step for filling the recesses of the mold with the ultraviolet curing resin for forming the cores; (4) a step for irradiation with ultraviolet rays from the ultraviolet ray shielding mask unforming side of the mold; (5) a step for detaching the mold and the lower clad base material, (6) a step for removing non-hard spots of the ultraviolet curing resin; and (7) a step for forming the upper clad on the core forming faces of the lower clad substrate, comprising the mold used for the manufacturing method, and the manufacturing method of the mold for forming the recesses corresponding to the polymer optical waveguide cores on the surface where the ultraviolet shielding layer is formed, after forming the ultraviolet shielding layer on the ultraviolet ray transmissive substrate.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Method of forming metal pattern and conductive film
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a metal pattern forming method and a conductive film forming method capable of forming a metal pattern and a metal film having excellent adhesion to a board when less irregularities are present on a board interface.  <P>SOLUTION: The method of forming a metal pattern comprises a first process (a) of forming a polymerization initiating layer which is formed by fixing a polymer equipped with a functional group having polymerization initiating power and a crosslinking group at side chains by a crosslinking reaction on a smooth board whose surface roughness is preferably 500 nm or less, a second process (b) of forming a region where a polymer formed with functional groups which interact with an electroless plating catalyst or its precursor is chemically and directly bonded together in patterns on the polymerization initiating layer, a third process (c) of providing the electroless plating catalyst or its precursor to the region, and a fourth process (d) of forming a patterned metal film by performing electroless plating.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Metallic pattern forming method, metallic pattern, printed wiring board using the same, and tft wiring circuit
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a metallic pattern forming method capable of forming a minute metallic pattern without performing an etching process, the metallic pattern which is excellent in bonding properties with a substrate, has sufficient conductivity, and has small unevenness on an interface with the substrate.  <P>SOLUTION: The method successively has (a) a process of providing a polymer having a functional group interacting with a non-electrolytic plating catalyst or its precursor like a pattern on the substrate; (b) a process of causing the pattern to absorb the non-electrolytic plating catalyst or its precursor; and (c-1) a process of applying non-electrolytic plating processing to the substrate having the polymer layer by using a non-electrolytic plating liquid containing plating catalyst poison of 1&times;10<SP>-10</SP>to 1&times;10<SP>-4</SP>mmol/l, and forming a metallic film like a pattern; or (c-2) a process of applying non-electrolytic plating processing to the substrate having the polymer layer while adding the plating catalyst poison into a non-electrolytic plating liquid, so that the concentration of the plating catalyst poison is in a range of 1&times;10<SP>-10</SP>to 1&times;10<SP>-4</SP>mmol/l and forming a metallic film like a pattern.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&amp;NCIPI

title: Method for forming conductive pattern
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for forming a conductive pattern that can form a fine metal pattern without carrying out roughening and etching processes for a substrate surface and maintain stable adhesion properties against abrupt temperature variation, and to provide a method for forming a conductive pattern which is suitable to metal wiring with superior high frequency characteristics.  <P>SOLUTION: The method for forming the conductive pattern includes a process of generating a graft polymer which is bonded directly to the substrate surface and has a hydrophilic group on the substrate in a pattern shape, a process of imparting an electroless plating catalyst or its precursor to the graft polymer, a process of performing electroless plating, and a process of converting the hydrophilic group into a hydrophobic group in this order.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Structure for forming functional film pattern and method of manufacturing functional film
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method of manufacturing a functional film capable of forming a fine pattern, and withstanding a high-temperature process.  <P>SOLUTION: The method of manufacturing the functional film includes a process (a) for preparing a substrate on which a prescribed pattern is formed; a process (b) for using an inorganic material to form a separation layer on the substrate directly or indirectly; a process (c) for forming a layer to be peeled including the functional film by using a functional material on the separation layer; and a process (d) for peeling off the layer to be peeled from the substrate, or for decreasing the junction strength between the layer to be peeled and the substrate by heating the separation layer, applying electromagnetic waves toward the separation layer, or applying external force to the separation layer.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Method of manufacturing phosphor sheet
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method of manufacturing a phosphor sheet generating few structural defects.  <P>SOLUTION: The method of manufacturing a phosphor sheet for forming a prescribed phosphor film by deposition of a film-forming material onto a substrate is characterized as follows: the substrate is retreated from the upside of an evaporation source of the film-forming material; evaporation of the film-forming material is started in the state where an openable/closable shutter provided between the substrate and the evaporation source of the film-forming material is closed; the shutter is opened after elapse of a fixed time; then, conveyance of the substrate is started; and the phosphor film is formed on the substrate.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Method of manufacturing polymer optical waveguide module
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To facilitate manufacture of a low-optical-loss polymer optical waveguide through a simple production step, and to make multi-cavity-mold mass production possible for the purpose of reducing manufacturing cost.  <P>SOLUTION: The manufacturing method includes: a step of preparing a rubber mold 6 having a plurality of recesses 5 corresponding to an optical waveguide core; a step of sticking a clad layer base material 7 closely to the rubber mold; a step of setting a plurality of tapered needle-shaped injecting heads 27 for feeding core-forming hardenable resin to a core-liquid injecting port 23 that communicates with the plurality of recesses 5 of the rubber mold, setting a vacuum suction head 28 at the core-liquid discharging port 24 that communicates with the plurality of recesses 5, and filling the core-forming hardenable resin 9 to the plurality of the recesses 5; a step of forming an optical waveguide core 10 by hardening the hardenable resin so filled; a step of separating the rubber mold 6 from the clad layer base material 7; and a step of forming the clad layer 11 on the optical waveguide core 10.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Process for producing metal-film-coated substrate, metal-film-coated substrate, process for producing metallic-pattern material, and metallic-pattern material
abstract: The present invention discloses a metal-film-coated substrate in which the metal film has excellent adhesion to the substrate and which has a small dependence on temperature and humidity; and a process for producing the substrate. Also provided are: a metallic-pattern material which comprises a substrate and a metallic pattern having excellent adhesion to the substrate, has a small dependence on temperature and humidity, and has excellent insulation reliability in the regions not covered by the metallic pattern; and a process for producing the material. The process for producing a metal-film-coated substrate is characterized by comprising: a step (a1) in which a polymer layer is formed on a substrate, the polymer layer being made of a polymer which has a non-dissociable functional group interacting with a plating catalyst or a precursor therefor and capable of multidentate coordination and which is directly and chemically bonded to the substrate; a step (a2) in which a plating catalyst or precursor therefor capable of multidentate coordination is imparted to the polymer layer; and a step (a4) in which the plating catalyst or precursor therefor capable of multidentate coordination is plated. It may be characterized by further including, after the step (a2), the following step (a3). Step (a3) in which a metal different from the plating catalyst or precursor therefor capable of multidentate coordination is incorporated into the polymer layer.

title: Method of manufacturing substrate having metal film
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method of manufacturing a substrate having a metal film that allows the formation of a highly precise metal wiring having excellent adhesion to a substrate or an interlayer insulating resin film.  <P>SOLUTION: The method of manufacturing a substrate having a metal film comprises the steps of: (a) forming, on the surface of the substrate or an interlayer insulating resin film, a polymer layer that is composed of a polymer which has a functional group that interacts with a metal ion or metal salt, and which is directly and chemically combined with the substrate or interlayer insulating resin film; (b) adding a metal ion or metal salt to the polymer layer; (c) reducing the metal ion or metal salt added to the polymer layer using a reducing agent to generate a metal; (d) forming a plating film on the polymer layer using an electroless plating solution; and (f) performing a thermal process at a temperature from 100 to 200°C subsequent to the step (d) of forming the plating film.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title: Method for forming metal film, method for forming metal pattern, metal film, metal pattern, new copolymer and composition for forming polymer layer
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for forming a metal film having excellent adhesion to a substrate.  <P>SOLUTION: The method for forming the metal film comprises: a stage (a1) where, on a substrate, a polymer layer composed of a polymer having a partial structure having two or more adsorbable groups forming an interaction with a plating catalyst or the precursor thereof and chemically bonded directly with the substrate is formed; a stage (a2) where a plating catalyst or the precursor thereof is applied to the polymer layer; and a stage (a3) where the plating catalyst or the precursor thereof is plated.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title: Method for producing material of surface metal film, and material of surface metal film obtained thereby
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a material of a surface metal film which shows superior adhesiveness to a substrate, has little fluctuation of the adhesion due to humidity change and is superior in thermal shock resistance, and to provide a production method therefor.  <P>SOLUTION: The method for producing the material of the surface metal film comprises the steps of: (a1) forming a polymer layer made of a polymer on the substrate, which has such a functional group as to interact with a catalyst for plating or a precursor thereof and is directly chemically bonded to the substrate; (a2) imparting energy to the polymer layer to control a rate of remaining polymerizable groups to 5 to 60%; and (a3) giving the catalyst for plating or the precursor thereof to the polymer layer and plating the catalyst for plating or the precursor thereof to form the metal film thereon. The polymer layer having the metal film formed thereon has a coefficient of thermal expansion (α) of 120 ppm or less.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Thermoplastic film, method of manufacturing the same, polarizing plate, and liquid crystal display
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a thermoplastic film having an inclined structure of large phase difference, improving a thermal dimensional change rate and causing no display unevenness in diagonal line shape when used for a liquid crystal display, and to provide a method of manufacturing the same.  <P>SOLUTION: The method of manufacturing the thermoplastic film includes: a process of melt-extruding a composition containing thermoplastic resin, from a die; a process of allowing a melt-extruded molten material to pass through between a chill roll and a touch roll whose peripheral speeds differ from each other, to form the molten material in film shape; and a process of conveying the molten material formed in film shape with a tension of 0.5-15 kgf/m at a temperature of Tg-15°C to Tg+30°C, wherein Tg represents a glass transition temperature of the thermoplastic resin.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Film, method for manufacturing the same, polarizing plate, and liquid crystal display
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a film which is capable of achieving sufficient optical compensation when used in liquid crystal displays, has a long-run film formation property and less unevenness of the thickness and surface faults, and to provide a method of manufacturing the film.  <P>SOLUTION: A method of manufacturing a film includes the process of melt-extruding a composition containing a thermoplastic resin in a band shape from the discharge outlet of a die, the process of passing the melt-extruded strip of melt vertically downward in a casing device having an evacuating means to feed to a sandwiching and pressing apparatus, and the process of sandwiching and pressing the strip of melt passing through the casing device continuously between the first and second sandwiching-and-pressing faces of the sandwiching and pressing apparatus to form the melt into a film. The casing device has an evacuating outlet opened in a direction between the normal line with respect to the strip of melt and the upward vertical line or in a direction between the normal line with respect to the strip of melt and the downward vertical line.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Method for producing double-sided evaporation film, double sided evaporation film intermediate, double-sided evaporation film and magnetic recording medium support
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a technique for forming high-quality metal-containing evaporation films on both surfaces of a plastic substrate film.  <P>SOLUTION: A method for producing a double-sided evaporation film is provided, which includes forming metal-containing evaporation films on both surfaces of a non-magnetic plastic substrate film 16 by an evaporation device 1a having an evaporation drum 11. The method is characterized by: forming a metal-containing evaporation film on one surface (A surface) of the substrate film; forming an organic substance film on the metal-containing evaporation film; and forming a metal-containing evaporation film on the other surface (B surface) of the substrate film.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title: Method of manufacturing wafer level lens array, wafer lens array, lens module and imaging unit
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method of manufacturing a wafer level lens array, having good optical performance and superior productivity.  <P>SOLUTION: This manufacturing method includes a process of holding a base plate and a lens material supplied to a plurality of through-holes between a pair of mold members, and applying energy thereto to mold and cure the lens material. At least one of the pair of mold members is provided with a projecting part, the tip surface of which is shaped to transfer one surface of the lens, and the outside diameter of which is smaller than the inside diameter of the through-hole, whereby when the projecting part is inserted in the through-hole to deform the lens material, some of the lens material is controlled to enter a gap between the inner surface of the through-hole and the outside surface of the projecting part and not to reach the surface of the base plate outside the through-hole.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Method for manufacturing patterned metal material and patterned metal material
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for manufacturing a patterned metal material, which is superior in productivity and industrial production suitability, and also can form patterned metal wiring on the surface of the patterned metal material, which are superior in insulation reliability between themselves and temporal stability.SOLUTION: The method for manufacturing the patterned metal material provided with a patterned metal film on the surface comprises: a resin layer forming step of forming a resin layer 12a containing a copolymer that includes a unit having a predetermined functional group, on a substrate 10; a catalyst imparting step of imparting a plating catalyst or a precursor thereof to the resin layer 12a; a plating step of plating the plating catalyst or the precursor thereof; and a pattern forming step of forming the patterned metal film by using an etchant having a pH of 6.5 or less after the plating step.

title: Production method for laminate having patterned metal films, and plating layer-forming composition
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a production method for a laminate having patterned metal films, capable of readily plasma etching a plating layer and of obtaining a laminate having excellent insulating properties between the patterned metal films.SOLUTION: The production method for the laminate having patterned metal films includes: a plating layer-forming step in which a plating layer is formed on top of a substrate, using a plating layer-forming composition including a polymer having a prescribed unit; a catalyst application step in which a plating catalyst or a precursor thereof is applied to the plating layer; a plating step in which plating is performed and a metal film is formed on top of the plating layer; a pattern-forming step in which an etching fluid is used to form the patterned metal film; an acidic solution contacting step in which the substrate having the patterned metal film and an acidic solution are brought in contact with each other; and a plating layer-removal step in which the plating layer in an area in which no patterned metal film is formed, is removed by plasma etching.

title: Method for manufacturing laminate with metallic film
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for manufacturing a laminate with a metallic film having excellent adhesiveness to a substrate, and to provide the laminate obtained by the manufacturing method.SOLUTION: The method for manufacturing the laminate with the metallic film includes: a surface treatment step of bringing an insulating layer in a substrate with the insulating layer, which includes a substrate and the insulating layer formed by using an epoxy resin to be disposed on the substrate, into contact with a predetermined alkaline aqueous solution to subject the insulating layer to a surface treatment; a layer to be plated forming step of forming a layer to be plated on the insulating layer; a catalyst imparting step of imparting a plating catalyst or the precursor thereof to the layer to be plated; and a plating step of subjecting the layer to be plated to a plating treatment to form the metallic film on the layer to be plated.

title: Peelable laminated film, peelable laminated film roll, method of manufacturing them, film, polarizing plate, method of manufacturing polarizing plate, and liquid crystal display device
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for relatively easily and efficiently manufacturing a film being a thin film and having superior surface conditions and retardation uniformity.SOLUTION: The method of manufacturing a peelable laminated film includes a step of forming a laminate by simultaneously or sequentially casting a dope A which contains cellulose ester and a solvent and a dope B for forming a B layer containing a solvent and a resin different from the cellulose ester and allowing solution deposition and which is prepared so that adhesion of the A layer and a B layer to be ≤5N/cm on a casting support; a step of peeling the laminate from the casting support; and a step of drying the peeled laminate.

title: Method for producing laminated film, laminated film; transparent conductive film, phase difference film and organic electroluminescent element
abstract: To provide a production method capable of producing a laminated film having excellent adhesion between a cyclic olefin film and a coating layer even when a coating film is formed on a cyclic olefin film using an aqueous coating material.SOLUTION: There are provided: a method for producing a laminated film having a substrate film and a coating layer laminated on at least one surface of the substrate film, in which the main binder of the substrate film is a cyclic olefin polymer or the like, which comprises: an inline coating step of coating an aqueous coating liquid for forming a coating layer on an unstretched substrate film; a stretching step of stretching the unstretched substrate film during transporting by maintaining the inline state; and a thermal fixing step of subjecting the film to heat treatment while holding both ends of the substrate film at a thermal fixing temperature higher than the stretching temperature and higher than a glass transition temperature Tg of the substrate film; a laminated film; a transparent conductive film; a phase difference film; and an organic electroluminescent element.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Medium material for electrophoresis
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a material consisting of a biological high molecular constituent, suitable for electrophoretic analysis and of which a sheet and an electrophoretic gel layer of an aq. gel are not peeled off in operation, by forming a medium layer of the aq. gel on a polymer sheet treated with glow discharge. CONSTITUTION:The surface of a polyethylene terephthalate sheet, etc. is treated with glow discharge and made hydrophilic. A gel medium layer obtained by polymerizing an acrylamidic compd. and a crosslinking agent in the presence of water is formed on the surface. A water-soluble polymer such as polyacrylamide and polyethylene glycol and agarose may be added to the gel medium layer to improve its plasticity. Besides, an anionic surfactant such as alkyl sulfate and a denaturing agent are preferably added to improve the separation of protein, especially compound protein. In addition, a cover sheet made of the same material as a support may be provided and cross-linked. In this way, the excellent electrophoretic medium material without causing any peeling-off, etc. due to electrophoresis and dyeing operation can be obtained.

title: Medium material for electrophoresis
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a medium material for electrophoresis especially suitable for determining the basic configuration of DNA by providing a medium layer of polyacrylamidic aq. gel contg. a compd. having a carbamoyl group as a denaturing agent on a polymer sheet treated with glow discharge. CONSTITUTION:The surface of a polymer sheet such as polyethylene terephtalate is treated with glow discharge, and a layer of polyacrylamidic aq. gel, which is obtained by cross-linking and polymerizing a acrylamidic compd. contg. a carbamoyl group such as urea or formamide as a denaturing agent with a cross-linking agent in the presence of water, is formed on the surface. A water- soluble polymer and agrose are preferably incorporated into the aq. gel layer. In this way, the electrophoretic membrane, having strong adherence to the polymer sheet and which does not peel off while used for electrophoresis or further after drying and is especially suitable for determining the basic configuration of DNA, is obtained.

title: Medium material for electrophoresis
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a polyacrylamide gel film-based electrophoretic medium material using a resin film as the support with the resolution equal to or more than that of the electrophoretic medium material produced using a glass plate as the support, by providing a resin intermediate layer made of a resin material having the oxygen transmission coefficient lower than the support material between a medium layer for electrophoresis and a support layer. CONSTITUTION:A medium material for electrophoresis which includes a medium layer for electrophoresis made of a polyacrylamide-based water gel produced by crosslinked polymerization of an acrylamide-based compound and a cross linking agent in the presence of water and a resin support is provided with a resin intermediate layer made of a resin material with the oxygen transmission coefficient lower than the support material between the medium layer for electrophoresis and the support layer. The resin intermediate layer is preferably made of a resin material with the oxygen transmission of below 15cc/m<2>.atm per day in the form of a film made at a thickness of 20mum. The resin material herein applicable is a vinylidene-vinylchloride copolymer, polyvinyl alcohol or the like.

title: Medium material for electrophoresis
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a polyacrylamide gel film-based electrophoretic medium material using a resin film as the support with the resolution equal to or more than that of the electrophoretic medium material produced using a glass plate as support, by providing an oxygen transmission preventing layer made of an oxide or a sulfide of a specified metal element between a medium layer for electrophoresis and a support layer. CONSTITUTION:A medium material for electrophoresis which includes a medium layer for electrophoresis made of a polyacrylamide-based water gel produced by crosslinked polymerization of an acrylamide-based compound and a cross linking agent in the presence of water, and a resin support is provided with an oxygen transmission preventing layer made of an oxide or a sulfide of a metal element as selected from a group of V, Cr, Ni, Cu, Ga, In, Ge and Sn between the medium layer for electrophoresis and the support layer. Oxygen transmission of a laminate body made of the oxygen transmission preventing layer and the support is preferably below 10cc/m<2>.atm per day.

title: Medium material for electrophoresis and manufacture thereof
abstract: PURPOSE:To strengthen the bonding of materials and to facilitate handling, by using a three-layer structure, wherein a plastic supporting body and an acrylamide water gel are bonded by a derivative of methylmethacrylate macro-monomer, as a medium material for electrophoresis. CONSTITUTION:On a plastic supporting body, e.g., polyethylene terephthalate, a derivative of methylmethacrylate macro-monomer, e.g., the compound shown by the formula, is applied as a bonding agent layer. Then, modified polyacrylamide water gel, wherein acrylamide compound, e.g., acrylamide, a bridging agent, e.g., N,N'-methl bisacrylamide, and a compound having at least one carbamoyl group as a modifying agent, e.g. urea and the like are bridged and polymerized, is bonded. Then the obtained three-layer structure is used as an electrophoresis medium material. Since bonding is performed by the compound shown by the formula, the three-layer structure has high adhesion property. Electrophoresis and dyeing can be performed with a polyacrylamide gel film (medium layer) being mounted on the supporting body.

title: Medium material for electrophoresis
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve a practicable handling characteristic and the adhesiveness between a medium layer for electrophoresis and base in a wet state by using a material consisting of a polyacrylamide gel film formed on a plastic base and the plastic base. CONSTITUTION:This material is formed by joining the medium layer for electrophoresis and the one plastic base layer by an adhesive layer contg. gelatin. Then the gel film and the base are hardly separable even if the material is subjected to various operations in the laminated state of the base and the medium layer for electrophoresis after the electrophoresis. The medium layer for electrophoresis is, therefore, not ruptured and permits easy handling. Further, the adhesive layer contg. the gelatin is preliminarily formed on the base and the polyacrylamide gel film is formed on the adhesive layer. The other plastic base is placed on the gel film to obtain the above-mentioned material. The adhesiveness between the medium layer for electrophoresis and the base in the wet state is thus improved.

title: Medium material for electrophoresis
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the adhesiveness between a plastic base layer and a medium layer for electrophoresis contg. a compd. having a polyacrylamide aq. gel and one carbamoyl group as a modifier and cover film. CONSTITUTION:The adhesive layer contg. an inorg. compd. such as silicon dioxide and a binder consisting of polymer having a layer-forming effect such as cellulose deriv. at about (1:3)-(10:1) ratio by weight is laminated to about 0.2-15mum thickness on the base layer which is formed of a hydrophilic polymer such as polyethylene terephthalate and has about 70-300mum thickness. The medium layer for electrophoresis contg. the polyacrylamide aq. gel crosslinked and polymerized with an acrylamide compd. and a crosslinking agent such as bifunctional compd. in the presence of water and the compd. such as urea having at least one carbamoyl group as the modifier is laminated thereon. The plastic cover film layer is further laminated thereon.

title: Medium material for electrophoresis
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve resolving power and a handling property from a practical aspect, by constituting an electrophoretic medium layer of a predetermined polyacrylamide aqueous gel containing a specific surfactant and a modifier. CONSTITUTION:A polyacrylamide gel membrane is formed on a plastic sheet comprising a hydrophilic polymer or a sheet of which the surface is made hydrophilic as an electrophoretic medium layer. Said membrane is obtained by forming an aqueous solution or dispersion containing an acrylamide compound and a crosslinking agent into an aqueous gel membrane by crosslinking polymerization. A surfactant and a compound having at least one carbamoyl group being a modifier are contained in said gel membrane. The content of the surfactant is 1X10<-4>-5X10<-1>w/v%, pref., 1X10<-2>-5X10<-2>w/v% per a volume of an electrophoretic layer. A water-soluble polymer can be contained in the polyacrylamide gel membrane in a range of 2-about 100wt% of the monomer and the crosslinking agent.

title: Medium material for electrophoresis
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve resolving power and a handling property from a practical aspect, by constituting an electrophoretic medium layer by containing alkyl sulfate and other surfactant in a predetermined acrylamide aqueous gel. CONSTITUTION:A polyacrylamide gel membrane is formed on a plastic sheet comprising a hydrophilic polymer or a sheet of which the surface is made hydrophilic as an electrophoretic medium layer. Said gel membrane is obtained by forming an aqueous solution or dispersion containing an acrylamide compound and a crosslinking agent into an aqueous gel membrane by crosslinking polymerization. Alkyl sulfate ion surfactant and other surfactant are contained in said gel membrane. The content of the alkyl sulfate ion surfactant as a modifier is set to about 0.05-2.0w/v%, pref., about 0.1-1.5w/v% to the gel forming liquid. The content of the other surfactant is 1X10<-4>-5X10<-1>w/v%, pref., 1X10<-3>-5X10<-2>w/v% per a volume of the electrophoretic medium layer.

title: Medium material for electrophoresis
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the generation of a failure in a medium layer for electrophoresis by joining a base layer and the medium layer for electrophoresis by a specific adhesive layer, thereby constituting a titled medium material into three-layered structure. CONSTITUTION:The base layer, the adhesive layer which contains the polymer having the constitutional repeating unit expressed by the formula and further, the medium layer for electrophoresis which contains an aq. polyacrylamide gel formed by crosslinking polymn. of an acrylamide compd. and crosslinking agent in the presence of water and compd. having at least one kind of carbamoyl group as a modifying agent are successively laminated, by which the medium material for electrophoresis having the three-layered structure is formed. The generation of the failure in the medium layer for electrophoresis is thereby substantially obviated and the need for using filter paper or the like is eliminated.

title: Manufacture of semiconductor device
abstract: PURPOSE:To enable a patterned Cu wiring film to be formed without directly dry-etching Cu in a semiconductor device. CONSTITUTION:A polycrystalline silicon film 3 is patterned on an Si oxide film 2 formed on the surface of a semiconductor substrate 1, Cu is made to grow through a CVD method using, for instance, copper acetylacetonate complex as source, then the polycrystalline silicon film 3 is removed, and a Cu wiring film 5 is formed. By this setup, etching failure and corrosion attendant on a conventional method when Cu is etched hardly occur. As Cu is used as metal wiring material, a wiring is lower in electric resistance than that of Al or Al alloy, and a semiconductor device of this design can be enhanced in reliability to electromigration and stress migration.

title: Manufacture of semiconductor device
abstract: PURPOSE:To realize enhanced integration by a simplified manufacturing process by a method wherein unmasked portions on the surface of a polycrystalline substrate are removed by etching and the portion just under the mask is etched from the sides and then impurity ions are implanted into the polycrystalline semiconductor substrate from both sides with the intermediary of an insulating film. CONSTITUTION:An oxide film 12 is formed on a p-type Si semiconductor substrate 11. A polycrystalline silicon layer 13 is formed, whereinto impurity, for example phosphorus, is driven. A photoresist 14 is so patterned as to retain a region for a gate electrode. Etching is accomplished for the selective removal of the polycrystalline layer 13 for the formation of a gate region layer 13A. Both upper sides of the gate region layer 13A are etched horizontally in spite of the presence of the photoresist 14. With the gate region layer 13 serving as a mask, arsenic is drivin into the Si semiconductor substrate 11 through the intermediary of the oxide film 12, for the formation on the Si semiconductor substrate 11 by self-alignment of a source region 16 and drain region 17 composed of an n<+> diffusion layer.

title: Manufacture of thin film semiconductor device
abstract: PURPOSE:To form an insulating film which has an excellent boundary characteristic by keeping a glass substrate at a specific temperature or lower and at the same time depositing an insulating newer thereon and then applying heat treatment thereto in a specific range of temperature. CONSTITUTION:An a-Si film is formed on a glass substrate 1 and then is crystallized by annealing using a excimer laser to obtain a Poly-Si film, and then the Poly-Si film is patterned in land-like form by a photolithographic method to obtain a semiconductor active layer 2 having an inclination of 30 deg. or less at the end thereof. A silicon oxide film is deposited at a substrate temperature of 23 deg.C with the use of an ECR plasma CVD method, and then is heated at 500 deg.C in the atmosphere of nitrogen for an hour to deposit Ta, and patterning is applied thereto to form a gate electrode 5, and phosphorus is injected thereinto to form a source region 3a and a drain region 3b which are self-aligned. Therefore, the boundary level of a gate insulating film is lowered to improve the boundary characteristic, so that a thin films semiconductor device with high reliability may be realized.

title: Manufacture of thin film transistor
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide the manufacturing method of thin film transistor in even offset length between a gate electrode and a drain electrode as well as between the gate electrode and a source electrode within the thin film transistor in offset structure. CONSTITUTION:The deposition thickness on both sides of a gate electrode 6 can be equalized as well as equalizing the offset length on both sides of the same 6 by a method wherein metallic films (metallic oxide films) 8 capable of easily controlling the film thickness thereof by setting up the deposition requirements of a gate electrode 6 so as to decide the offset length of offset regions 12, 13 of an insular semiconductor layer 3 using metallic films 8 (metallic oxide films) 8 as masks.

title: Manufacture of thin film transistor
abstract: PURPOSE:To enable a source ohmic layer and a drain ohmic layer to be easily formed so as not to overlap a gate electrode by a method wherein an electron cyclotron resonance plasma CVD method and a lift-off method are employed. CONSTITUTION:A gate electrode 12 is formed on an insulating board 11, and then a gate insulating film 13, a semiconductor film 14, and a surface protective 15 are successively laminated. Thereafter, a resist film 16 is formed on the upside of the surface protective film 15, and the surface protective film 15 is etched into a pattern using the resist film 16 as a mask. Then, an N<+>-a-Si semiconductor film 17 is formed on the semiconductor film 14 and the resist film 16 at a room temperature through an electron cyclotron resonance plasma CVD method. Furthermore, the board 11 is dipped into solvent such as acetone or the like to remove the resist film 16 and the semiconductor film 17 together by dissolution. By this setup, a source ohmic layer and a drain ohmic layer are formed of the semiconductor film 17 so as not to overlap the gate electrode 12.

title: Thin film transistor and manufacture thereof
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a TFT device which is excellent in operational characteristics by making the inner fringes of a source electrode and a drain electrode equal at ends by limiting insulation film. CONSTITUTION:Amorphous Si2 and SiO24 are provided on a glass substrate 1 by plasma CVD and a Cr thin film 6 is piled. A gate electrode 6 and a gate insulation film 4 are made, using a resist mask 8. P-added amorphous Si 7 is made by plasma CVD, a Cr evaporation film 3' is piled and a source electrode 4 and a drain electrode 5 are made by removing the resist 8. At last, a TFT is completed by separating element, using an appropriate photo mask. No parastic capacity exists since source and drain layers and the gate electrode are not overlapped, the response speed is high and the operational characteristic are not overlapped, the response speed is high and the operational characteristics are excellent. The high precision mask alignment is not required and the process is also easy.

title: Manufacture of amorphous semiconductor device
abstract: PURPOSE:To form an amorphous semiconductor device on a thick-film IC substrate without exfoliating a thick film by forming an amorphous semiconductor layer by previously protecting a thick-film circuit by a metallic film on the formation of the amorphous semiconductor layer and removing the metallic film after the layer is attached. CONSTITUTION:Au layers 2, an insulating glass layer 3 and an Au layer 4 are printed and baked selectively onto a seramic substrate 1, thus forming a thick- film control circuit. A lower electrode 5 by a Cr evaporated film and a protective film 9 for the thick-film control circuit are formed, and the lower electrode 5 is connected to the thick-film control circuit. A metallic plate 6 is placed, and a hydrogenated amorphous Si layer 7 is deposited selectively through a plasma CVD method. When the metallic plate 6 is removed, the protective film 9 is taken away through etching and an ITO electrode 8 is formed selectively, a device consisting of a solid-state image pick-up element section 7 and a thick-film control section is obtained. In such constitution, the thick-film circuit has very excellent adhesive properties with the substrate and is stabilized secularly, a thick- film is not exfoliated even on a bonding operation on the circuit, and yield on mounting is improved.

title: Manufacture of semiconductor device
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the accumulation of ion on gate electrodes at the time of ion implantation as well as to avoid contamination of the surface of a substrate and the knock-on of oxygen element by a method wherein parts of the substrate surface other than a region, in which ion implantation is to be performed, are coated with an insulating film and the upper part of this insulating film is coated with a poly Si film. CONSTITUTION:A P-type well 2, N-type channel cut regions 1', P-type channel cut regions 2' and a field oxide film 3 are formed in an N-type Si substrate 1 and thereafter, gate oxide films 4 and 4' are formed and after a phosphorus- doped poly Si layer is deposited by an LPCVD method, gate electrodes 5 and 5' are formed by patterning. Then, a photo etching is performed in a state that a P-type channel region is coated with a photo resist 6 to remove the oxide film other than the gate oxide film 4 and opening parts 7a and 7b are formed. Subsequently, the photo resist 6 is removed, a non-doped poly Si layer 8 is deposited on the whole surface by an LPCVD method and arsenic ions are implanted. Then, a heat treatment is performed in an atmosphere of oxygen, the poly Si layer is all converted into an Si oxide layer 9 and the arsenic ions are diffused to form source and drain regins 10a and 10b.

title: Manufacture of semiconductor device
abstract: PURPOSE:To enable an interlayer insulating film to be formed thick enough to protect resist against damages while keeping the flatness of the surface of the interlayer insulating film, by applying, baking and then plasma oxidizing a siloxane S.O.G. film used as the interlayer insulating film to be provided between interconnection layers. CONSTITUTION:First aluminum interconnections 3 are formed on a substrate 1 and an insulating film 2. Then, ethanol solution of monomethyl silanol represented by CH3Si(OH)3 as siloxane S.O.G.-(spin on glass) is applied on the spinning substrate 1 having the first aluminum interconnections 3 to form an S.O.G. film 4 and then it is baked. The substrate 1 having the S.O.G. film 4 is introduced into an oxygen plasma treating apparatus, where it is plasma oxidized. Then, resist is deposited thereon and etched. The residual resist is removed and a via hole 6 is made on each of the first aluminum interconnection 3. Subsequently, second aluminum interconnections 7 are deposited on the interlayer insulating film 5. In this manner, the interlayer insulating film is allowed to have a large thickness and the flattened surface, whereby the resist is effectively protected against damages in the etching process.

title: Manufacture of semiconductor device
abstract: PURPOSE:To form gate oxide films composed of silicon oxide film layers having different thicknesses which are applied to a charge coupled device and CMOS device respectively by a method wherein a specific silicon oxide film layer is built up on a semiconductor substrate surface and then the gate oxide film layer on a region on which the CMOS device is formed is removed and the gate oxide film layer having a thickness applied to the CMOS device is built up. CONSTITUTION:By oxidizing the whole surface of a semiconductor substrate 2, a silicon oxide film layer 2 which has a thickness smaller than the thickness of a gate oxide film layer which is applied to a charge coupling device by the thickness of a gate oxide film layer which is applied to a CMOS device is built up. After a photoresist layer 24 is applied to a region B in which a charge coupled device is to be formed, the silicon oxide film layer 22 in a region A in which a CMOS device is to be formed is removed by etching. Then the photoresist layer 24 is removed. Then a gate oxide film layer having a thickness applied to the CMOS device is built up over the whole surface of the semiconductor substrate.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate an overhang of the wall of a contact hole and to improve adherence of aluminum wiring to a silicon substrate by forming an interlayer insulating film formed on the substrate of a plurality of layers, and increasing the concentration of an impurity to be added toward a layer disposed farther from the substrate. CONSTITUTION:An NSG film is a (non-doped) silicon oxide film in which no impurity is added, and an interlayer insulating film is, for example, formed of two layers of an NSG film 7 and a PSG film 1. If the thickness of the film 7 is T1, the interlayer insulating film to 0 - T1 is the film 7. Accordingly, its impurity concentration is '0'. If the thickness is larger than the T1, e.g., in the case of the part of the film 1, its impurity concentration becomes an impurity concentration K1 of the film 1. A semiconductor device is coated with resist to form a pattern. A contact hole 4 is opened by an RIE method (Reactive Ion Etchion method). The hole 4 has a large diameter near the upper part of the film 1 having large impurity concentration and a small diameter near the lower part of the film 7 having small impurity concentration. Resist 3 is removed.

title: Thin film semiconductor device
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve operation characteristics and reliability of a thin film transistor, by preventing the exfoliation of a gate electrode from a glass substrate and the disconnection of a source electrode and a drain electrode which are arranged on the upper side and constituted of aluminum. CONSTITUTION:A substrate side wiring layer 23 of tantalum and a laminated wiring layer 24 of molybdenum are continuously formed on a glass substrate 1, with an inline type sputtering system; a photo resist film is uniformly spread and formed on the surface; then pattern exposure and developing process are performed, thereby forming a resist film (r) corresponding with a gate electrode. The substrate wiring layer 23 of tantalum and the wiring layer 24 are subjected to plasma etching, under the conditions of CF4: 45SCCM, O2: 5SCCM, and RF power: 500W. Thereby a gate electrode 2 whose section is nearly trapezoidal is formed.

title: Manufacture of thin-film semiconductor device
abstract: PURPOSE:To form a highly reliable thin-film semiconductor device at a low cost even when forming it on a substrate having a large area. CONSTITUTION:In the manufacturing method of a thin-film semiconductor device, a film forming process and an ion implantation process are included. In the film forming process, on the surface of an insulation substrate 1, a semiconductor layer 2 to be changed into an active layer, a gate insulation film 3, and a gate electrode 4 are formed respectively. In the ion implantation process, by the implantation of non-mass-separative ions, in a self-aligned way, source and drain regions 6 are formed using the gate electrode 4 as a mask. In this manufacturing method of a thin-film semiconductor device, first, the gate electrode 4 is so formed that its film thickness exceeds 350nm, and thereafter, in the ion implantation process, the ions are implanted into the source and drain regions 6 while the gate electrode 4 is used as a mask.

title: Manufacture of mos-type semiconductor device
abstract: PURPOSE:To easily obtain a semiconductor device with fast operation speed by a method wherein in manufacturing a MOS-type semiconductor device in lightly doped drain structure for preventing hot carrier from occurring, an etching preventing coat and an injection preventing film are used in etching process. CONSTITUTION:A thick field oxide film 2 for separating between elements is formed in the periphery of a P-type Si substrate 1 while a thin gate oxide film 3 is adhered to a region surrounded by the film 2 to provide a gate electrode 4 at the center of the surface. Then, with the electrode 4 used as a mask, a source region S' and a drain region D' comprising an N<->-type region communicating with the film 3 from a side of the electrode 4 and an N<+>-type region positioned under the film 3 and coupled with the N<->-type region are formed on both sides of the electrode 4 by ion implantation or the like. When these are molded by etching at this time, an etching preventing film 5 made of aluminum oxide, titanium oxide, etc., is provided on the side of the electrode 4 while an injection preventing film 6 made of silicon oxide, silicon nitride, etc., is provided on upper end sides of the film 5 to prevent deformation of the molding.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: PURPOSE:To enable a highly reliable semiconductor device to be formed by forming slits in the wiring pattern positioned in the lower layer when forming a multilayer wiring pattern, thereby eliminating the occurrence of hillock even if a high-temperature treatment is involved in the subsequent process. CONSTITUTION:On a silicon substrate in which a predetermined element region is formed, a silicon doped aluminium layer of a 0.8-1mum thickness is formed by means of the DC magnetron sputter method with the substrate temperature of 250 deg.C. Subsequently patterning is performed by means of the photolithography method, forming the first-layer line wherein three rows of slits having a width W1=2mum and a length W2=30mum are alternately disposed in a power supply line having a line width L=50mum, and a silicon oxide film as an inter-layer insulating film is formed. Then, after punching a contact hole in the inter-layer insulating film by means of the photolithography method, patterning of the second-layer wiring line is performed. A multilayer wiring substrate formed in this way has no occurrence of hillock, and therefore is highly reliable.

title: Manufacture of thin-film transistor
abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce leakage current by applying an energy beam to a gate electrode by reducing the plane shape of a gate electrode thereby obtaining a uniform offset gate length. CONSTITUTION:An a-Si film is formed on an insulating substrate 1 and then is crystallized by annealing in an atmosphere of N2, and after an island 2' is formed, a gate insulating film 3 of SiO2 is formed. The a-Si film is formed thereon as a gate electrode film to form a gate electrode 4, and then by using it as a mask, a source electrode part 2s and a drain electrode part 2d are formed by the implantation of phosphor ions, and an island-like electrode formation semiconductor layer 2 composed of a channel region 2c is formed. The gate electrode 4 are formed above the channel region 2c. When an energy beam L is applied to the gate electrode 4, the gate electrode 4 melts and the gate electrode is contracted because of the balance of surface tension and gravity, so that the offset gate length of 0.5mum is formed between the electrode parts 2s, 2d and the gate electrode 4, respectively.

title: Thin film semiconductor device and manufacture thereof
abstract: PURPOSE:To manufacture a thin film semiconductor device in excellent controllability characteristics by a method wherein, the title manufacture is provided with the film formation process to laminate a thin film amorphous silicon layer on an impurity holding film and the photoenergy irradiating process to thermal-diffuse the conductivity type impurity of the impurity holding film in the amorphous silicon layer to be simultaneously crystallized into a polysilicon layer with the low concentration conductivity type impurities led- therein. CONSTITUTION:An amorphous silicon layer 22 is pulse-irradiated using an excimer laser to instantaneously melt down the layer 22 and then phosphorus atoms are thermal-diffused in the layer 22 from an impurity holding film 21 to evenly form a low concentration led-in region while the amorphous silicon layer 22 is crystallized to form a polysilicon layer 2 doped with the low concentration phosphorus atoms. On the other hand, the polysilicon layer 2 is pulse- irradiated using the excimer laser and a gate electrode G as a mask so as to form a source electrode S and a drain electrode D. Through these procedures, the title thin film semiconductor device in excellent controllability characteristics can be manufactured easily and without fail.

title: Manufacture of thin film transistor
abstract: PURPOSE: To improve the withstand voltage of a gate insulating film and to manufacture a thin film transistor with high yield by forming a structure in which an islandlike semiconductor layer and a gate electrode are scarcely short- circuited at the peripheral step of the semiconductor layer. CONSTITUTION: The method for manufacturing the thin film transistor comprises the steps of forming a poly-Si film on a glass board 11, adhering an oxidation- resistant film on the poly-Si film, forming an islandlike oxidation-resistant film 22 by patterning the resistant film in an island state, oxidizing all the poly-Si film of the region not covered with the layer 22 to form an islandlike semiconductor layer 12 disposed under the layer 22 and an oxide layer 23 disposed on the periphery, and removing the layer 22. Thus, the layer 12 can be formed without patterning the poly-Si film.

title: Manufacture of thin film transistor
abstract: PURPOSE: To shorten a manufacturing process and make the lengths of the lightly-doped regions of source/drain regions constant. CONSTITUTION: An insulating film 12 and a gate electrode film 4 are formed on a polycrystalline silicon film 2 formed on an insulating substrate 1 and a resist film 6 is formed on them. After the gate electrode film 4 is subjected to isotropic etching with the resist film 6 as a mask and a gate electrode 5 which has a smaller width than the resist film 6 is formed, the insulating film 12 is subjected to anisotropic etching to form a gate insulating film 3 which has a larger width than the gate electrode 5. After that, impurities such as phosphorus P are introduced into the polycrystalline silicon film 2 with the gate electrode 5 and the gate insulating film 3 as masks to form lightly-doped regions 8 in the parts which are masked by the gate insulating film 3 only and form heavily-doped regions 7 in the outside parts which are not masked.  The number of times of photolithography is reduced to 4 and the number of times of impurity introduction is reduced to 1 and, further, the position relations between the gate electrode 5 and the heavily-doped region 7 and between the gate electrode 5 and the heavily-doped region 8 can be always constant.

title: Thin-film semiconductor device and manufacture thereof
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a thin-film semiconductor device having a uniform and sufficient offset length and small parasitic capacitance. CONSTITUTION:A gate electrode 2 is formed onto an insulating substrate 1, and a gate insulating film 3 is formed so as to cover the gate electrode 2. SiNx films 4 are shaped onto the gate insulating film 3 so that a groove 5 is formed to a section oppositely faced to the gate electrode 2 while holding the gate insulating film 3. An active layer 6 is formed to a section positioned on the bottom of the groove 5 and offset regions 7a, 7b to the sidewall sections of the SiNx films 4 respectively, and source-drain regions 8a, 8b are shaped onto the SiNx films 4 while an inter-layer insulating film 9 and a passivation film 10 are laminated successively so as to cover the source-drain regions 8a, 8b and the above-mentioned active layer 6.

title: Thin film semiconductor device
abstract: PURPOSE:To form a structure in which semiconductor serving as a channel is not deteriorated, to reduce the OFF current and to decrease the parasitic capacitance by so providing a first gate electrode as to be interposed between second gate electrodes and disposing the first and second gate electrodes together on a channel region. CONSTITUTION:First and second gate electrodes 7, 5a, 5b are so formed on a channel region 2 as to be substantially in parallel and not to form a step on the region 2 thereby to eliminate a part where its dielectric strength is not locally reduced partly in the region 2 different from prior art, and hence its reliability is improved. The step of the region 2 is eliminated and the thermal conductivity of its base is not different like the prior art, and hence a crystal growth becomes uniform in the case of crystallization by annealing, thereby obtaining a thin film semiconductor having small variation in characteristics.

title: Semiconductor device and manufacture thereof
abstract: PURPOSE:To enhance the reliability of a semiconductor device having a multilayer interconnection structure using a coat-baked silicon oxide film, etc. CONSTITUTION:The multilayer interconnection structured semiconductor device contains a layer insulating film 11 having an insulting film comprising a nitrogen containing silicon oxide film having either the refractive index exceeding 1.503 and the nitrogen content exceeding 2.4 atomic% or the half-value width of Si-O coupling measured by FTIR exceeding 167cm<-1> as well as an insulating film (coat-baked silicon oxide film) 12 for flattening the insulating layer surface on a wiring. Manufacturing methods for the device are presented.

title: Manufacture of thin film transistor array
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve reliability by preventing deterioration of characteristics of a TFT while using a shower doping method in which a large-area of a board can be ion implanted. CONSTITUTION:A mask material which covers an insular polysilicon layer 2, a gate insulating film 3 and a gate electrode 4 laminated on a board 1 are formed of an etching stopper layer 5 and mask layers 6b, 7 having different etching rates from those of an etching stopper layer 5 and for preventing doping of ions. Sufficient heat resistance can be obtained in the layers 6b, 7 when an impurity is doped in the layer 2 by an ion doping method, and the electrode 4 and the film 3 disposed at a lower part of the layer 5 are protected when the layers 6b, 7 are removed.

title: Manufacture of mos type semiconductor device
abstract: PURPOSE:To enable the surface of a semiconductor layer to be hardly contaminated even during a manufacturing process and to prevent diffused atoms from being introduced and diffused into a gate insulating layer by a method wherein a gate insulating film and a diffused atom containing film are formed on the opposed faces of a semiconductor layer respectively. CONSTITUTION:A gate insulating film 4' and a doped film 2 are formed on the opposed faces of a polysilicon layer 3' used for the formation of a semiconductor layer, and phosphorus atoms are diffused into the polysilicon layer 3' from the underside, so that the film 4' is not required to be removed when a source and a drain electrode are formed. Therefore, the surface of the polysilicon film 3' is not exposed during a manufacturing process and prevented from being contaminated by an etching agent and the like, so that the film 3' can be prevented from deteriorating in characteristics As the doped film 2 and the gate insulating film 4' are not in contact with each other and phosphorus atoms are prevented from being introducing and diffusing into the gate insulating film 4', a MOS type semiconductor device of this design can be prevented from deteriorating in characteristic attendant on the reduction of the gate insulating film 4' in breakdown strength.

title: Manufacture of thin film semiconductor device of ldd structure
abstract: PURPOSE:To increase operating speed by forming aperture parts at a part positions corresponding with the high concentration region of a drain electrode and a part position corresponding with a source electrode, stacking an impurity retaining film on the surfaces of the apertures, projecting light energy, diffusing conductivity type impurities from the impurity retaining film to a semiconductor layer, and forming the source electrode and a drain electrode. CONSTITUTION:A coating film 3' for an insulating film exposed from a resist film is etched, and the resist film is eliminated, thereby forming an insulating film 3 in which aperture parts 31, 32 are opened. The aperture part 31 on the drain electrode forming region side corresponds with the high concentration region of the drain electrode.
