The aperture part 32 on the source electrode forming region side corresponds with the source electrode. A dope layer 5 made of amorphous silicon containing phosphorus is stuck on the surface. By projecting excimer laser from the gate electrode 4 side under the condition of 1J/cm<2>, a dope film 5 and a semiconductor layer 2 are fused, and phosphorus in the dope film 5 is subjected to liquid phase diffusion, thereby forming a drain electrode 6 and a source electrode 7.

title: Film transistor
abstract: PURPOSE:To make a barrier layer highly corrosion-resistant to water by making the barrier layer of the chromium mixed with metals nobler than chromium. CONSTITUTION:This is a film transistor where barrier layer 8 and 9 are provided between a source electrode 6 and a wiring metal 11 and between a drain electrode 7 and a wiring metal 12, and the barrier layers 8 and 9 are made of the chromium mixed with metals nobler than chromium. Such barrier layers can be made by using a planer type magnetron RF sputtering device. That is, the metal of compound that the barrier layer should have is targeted to be sputtered and accumulated in the specified position of a film transistor, and this is made a barrier layer. Hereby, the corrosion resistance to water improves remarkably, and even if water infiltrates due to insufficiency of passivation, it can prevent the corrosion of the barrier layer.

title: Film transistor and its producing method
abstract: A semiconductor film into which p-type impurities have been introduced is formed on a substrate. Subsequently, a resist film is formed on the semiconductor film, and dry etching is performed to the semiconductor film using the resist film as a mask. Due to the dry etching, the edge portion of the semiconductor film protrudes from the resist film. Next, the p-type impurities are introduced into the edge portion of the semiconductor film using the resist film as a mask. The volume density of the p-type impurities in a channel edge portion of the semiconductor film is two to five times the volume density of the p-type impurities in a channel center section. Subsequently, the resist film is removed to form a gate insulating film and a gate electrode.

title: Method for manufacturing electrode substrate
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To allow the overlapping width of an electrode with an insulating film to be the designed width, when manufacturing the electrode substrate with a structure where the edge portion of the electrode is covered with the insulating film.  <P>SOLUTION: On a layer comprising an electrode material 141, there is formed an insulating film pattern 151 comprising a region with a small film thickness, a region with a large film thickness adjacent to the region, and a region without a film (E). With the insulating film pattern 151 as an etching mask, an electrode material 141 is etched, and electrodes 14a and 14b are formed (F). After that, only the insulating material 152 at the edge portion is left, and the insulating film pattern 151 is removed (G). By deforming the remaining insulating material 152 by melting, the insulating film 15 covering the edge portions of the electrodes 14a and 14b is formed.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Piezoelectric element,method for manufacturing the same, and liquid discharge head
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a piezoelectric element that promotes adhesion of films to each other in a laminate formed by lamination of a plurality of piezoelectric films so as to prevent delamination of the films and improves displacement efficiency(drive efficiency) while enhancing durability and reliability.SOLUTION: A first electrode 32 is formed on a substrate 30, and a first piezoelectric film 34 is formed on the first electrode 32. Further, a metal oxide film 36 that functions as a diffusion blocking layer is laminated on the first piezoelectric film 74, and a metal film 38 is laminated and formed on the metal oxide film 36. A second piezoelectric film 76 is formed on the metal film 38, and a second electrode 46 is laminated and formed on the second piezoelectric film 76. The first piezoelectric film 34 and the second piezoelectric film 44 are different in polarization direction from each other. The first electrode 32 and the second electrode 46 are set at a ground potential, and an intermediate electrode 40 including the metal film 38 is rendered as a drive electrode. The piezoelectric films in the respective layers are allowed to be formed with different compositions. It is preferable that the product of the thickness and stress value of the intermediate electrode 40 is smaller than 100 N/m.

title: Automatic focusing camera by zone focusing
abstract: PURPOSE:To perform excellent photography with proper exposure by inhibiting stroboscopic light emission and placing a stop device from the full aperture state once an automatic focusing device detects a subject being beyond an effective stroboscope distance. CONSTITUTION:An automatic focusing circuit AF10 generates an H-level output when detecting the subject being beyond the specific effective stroboscope distance. A shutter control circuit 12 generates an H-level output when a shutter release button enters closing operation. Both outputs are inputted to the set terminal S and reset terminal R of an FF14. The Q terminal of the FF14 is connected to the base of an NPN type TR16. When the shutter release button is pressed to an intermediate position and the H output of the AF10 is sent out and inputted to the FF14, the FF14 outputs H to turn on TR16, and a stroboscope stop magnet 20 and an additional stop turn-on magnet 18 are excited. Consequently, a miss of photography is prevented and excellent photography with proper exposure is performed.

title: Autofocusing control method for video camera
abstract: PURPOSE: To perform speedy and smooth autofocusing control even when the lightness of an object is rapidly changed. CONSTITUTION: An image formed through lenses 1 and 5 and an iris 3 is inputted to an imaging device 7 and an image pickup signal S is provided. By processing the image pickup signal S, a luminance signal Y is provided. A photometric value is calculated from a luminance integrated value IY, for which the luminance signal Y is integrated, and the aperture of the iris 3 is controlled so that this photometric value can be equal with a target value. Besides, a focusing evaluated value F(x) is calculated by integrating a high frequency component provided by passing the luminance signal Y through a band pass filter. Then, a value dividing a reference photometric value (b) with successively provided photometric value (a) is multiplied to the focusing evaluated value F(x) and a corrected focusing evaluated value is calculated.  The position of a focus lens 5 is controlled in the direction where this corrected focusing evaluated value is enlarged.

title: Photographic lens driving device for camera
abstract: PURPOSE:To securely stop a motor at a specific position under simple control without overrunning when the motor needs to be stopped by moving a photographic lens at a relatively fast speed up to near by a position of specific focal length, driving the motor at a slow speed from the position to the specific position, and thus moving the photographic lens. CONSTITUTION:An encoder 6 detects the movement of the photographic lens and the contact of this encoder 6 for detecting the specific position where the photographic lens is stopped from moving consists of a position detection main contact Ed corresponding to the specific focal length position of the photographic lens and a position detection subordinate contact Ea which is positioned deviating slightly from the position detection main contact Ed and used to detect a position deviating slightly from the specific focal length position. Then when a changeover switch 4 is operated and the photographic lens is moved, the motor 12 is driven fast until the position detection subordinate contact Ea is detected and then driven at the slow speed from the position detection subordinate contact Ea to the position detection main contact Ed. Consequently, a control means for driving the lens can be made simple and the photographic lens can securely be stopped at the specific position.

title: Auto focus camera
abstract: PURPOSE:To reduce a blur amount of an image by providing at least two positioning mechanisms whose lens set position in different from each other, and selecting one positioning mechanism in accordance with a photographing condition. CONSTITUTION:In case of an EE photographing by a program shutter device, when the focus of a photographing distance lens 9 measured by a distance measuring device 37 is matched, the electric conduction of an electromagnet 34 is stopped, a detaining pawl 23 is rotated counterclockwise by an energizing force of a spring 33, and it is engaged to the pawl of a ratchet gear 22. As a result, the rotation of a gear 16 stops, and the movement of a movable lens barrel 10 stops. When photographing by a stroboscope, a solenoid 24 is electrified, therefore, a plunger 25 moves in the left direction, and a ratchet gear 21 faces the detaining pawl 23. In this case, as for the ratchet gear 21 and 22, the position of the pawl is different, therefore, in the EE photographing and the stroboscope photographing, a photographic lens 9 can be positioned by a different step.

title: Auto-focus camera
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain a low-cost auto-focus camera by operating an electromechanical converting part with a signal obtained by combining distance information and luminance information and controlling the lens set position, the aperture value, and the shutter speed value in accordance with a displacement quantity by which a control member is displaced. CONSTITUTION:Power supply to a magnet 36 is controlled with the signal obtained by combining luminance information and distance information, and a control ring 21 is rotated to the position determined by these information, and the magnet 36 is turned off. When the magnet 36 is turned off, a positioning lever 33 is turned counterclockwise and is engaged with one of eight hooking teeth 32 to stop the rotation of the control ring 21. When the control ring 21 is stopped, the turning quantity of aperture blades 26 is controlled by an aperture driving lever 50 brought into contact with a cam 53 for aperture, and aperture blades 26 are set to a prescribed aperture value. A shutter blade stop lever 100 is turned by a shutter speed switching lever 61 brought into contact with a cam 60 for shutter speed and is displaced between the position, where the stop lever 100 catches a projection 27b of a shutter blade 27, and the position where it does not catch it.

title: Automatic focusing camera
abstract: PURPOSE:To securely photograph in case of light quantity of picture which can be of practical use by executing focusing when a photometric value is larger than a second reference value which is the lower limited value of the light quantity of picture by which the picture quality of practical use can be obtained even if the photometric value is less than a first reference value at which a flashlight is automatically emitted. CONSTITUTION:In the case of solving the shortage of exposure with all the light quantity of picture, a photographing optical system is driven in state where a focus setting limiter function is used by a focusing circuit 20 so as to execute automatic focusing and then a shutter is actuated by a shutter driving circuit 18. In case of deciding that the photometric value obtained from the detected output of a photometry sensor 12 is larger than a second reference value Lev which is the lower limited value of the light quantity of picture by which the picture quality of practical use can be obtained, the focus setting limiter function is released and the distance to an object is measured by a distance measuring circuit 22 so as to execute the focusing by the focusing circuit 20. Thus, photographing can be possible in case of obtaining the light quantity of picture by which the picture quality of practical use can be obtained.

title: Zoom lens device
abstract: PURPOSE:To accurately switch focusing in a normal zoom area and focusing in super-wide-angle mode by performing focusing operation by rotating a zoom ring in a macrophotography area in response to the ON signal of a switch when a wide converter lens is inserted into an optical system. CONSTITUTION:When the insertion of the wide converter lens 35 into the optical system is detected by the signal from a microswitch 50, the focusing is performed by the rotation of the zoom ring, but the rotation range of the zoom ring is limited to only the macrophotography area. Therefore, when the microswitch 50 is turned on while the zoom ring is in the normal zoom area, a focus controller 47 puts a zoom motor driving circuit 48 to rotate the zoom ring forcibly to the macrophotography area. Consequently, zoom ring forcibly to the macrophotography area. Consequently, the focusing mechanism for the macrophotography area can be utilized for the focusing in super-wide-angle mode and the focusing is automated even at this time.

title: Camera with automatic exposing function
abstract: PURPOSE:To take pictures of a night view and fire work by providing a means which sets a shutter speed set by an exposure quantity determining means, a shutter speed predetermined beyond the range of a diaphragm value, and the diaphragm value when a slow photographing mode is set. CONSTITUTION:The title camera is provided with the exposure quantity determining means which determines the shutter speed and the diaphragm value to attain an appropriate exposure quantity when a measuring illuminance is within a range where normal photographing is possible. Moreover, the camera has the means setting with the shutter speed predetermined beyond the range of normal values when the slow photographing mode is set and the diaphragm value. With the slow photographing mode 13 set, the shutter speed set by a popular exposure quantity determining means, the shutter speed predetermined beyond the range of the diaphragm value, and the diaphragm value are set to allow photographing. As a result, photographing becomes possible even in a low illuminance range where photographing is impossible in a normal photographing mode 12, thereby taking pictures of a night view and fire work.

title: Electronic camera
abstract: PURPOSE:To set the best exposure state by measuring the light of a subject with an analog video signal read out of picture elements in a specific range. CONSTITUTION:When a shutter release button is pressed, a switching means 15 is switched to a contact (b) and a driving circuit 20 generate a driving signal for scanning only plural picture elements in the center area of an image sensor 13 vertically and horizontally. Then an exposure quantity detecting circuit 14 detects the mean value or peak value of the analog video signal read out of the center area and supplies it to a shutter control circuit 19 through an A/D converter 16 to set the operation timing of a mechanical shutter 12 for the best exposure quantity, thereby taking a picture. Thus, the best exposure state can be set and the accuracy of digital signal processing is improved by the shutter control means 19.

title: Camera with zoom device
abstract: PURPOSE:To eliminate confirmation when shifting a photographing lens to a telephoto edge and a wide-angle edge by directly shifting the photographing lens to the telephoto edge and the wide-angle edge for advancing and retreating the lens in an optical axis direction by not only zoom drive but without stopping the lens on the way. CONSTITUTION:When a TW direct operating part 12 is operated, the present position of the photographing lens is detected by an encoder 16 and the detected position is compared with the prescribed position. When the photographing lens is on the telephoto side than the prescribed position, the photographing lens is shifted to the wide-angle edge position without stopping on the way by the rotation of a motor 20, and when the lens is on the wide-angle side than the prescribed position, the photographing lens is shifted to the telephoto edge position without stopping on the way. When a TW zoom operating part 12 is operated, the photographing lens is zoom-driven by the rotation of the motor 20 and is stopped at the desired position. Thus, a photographer is prevented from being irritated and from missing a shutter chance.

title: Camera with built-in stroboscope
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent over-exposure in a counter light state and take a picture with more appropriate exposure by making the stroboscopic device emit light in daylight synchronized flash mode before the aperture diameter of a programmed shutter is reached. CONSTITUTION:When a person is photographed in a bright background, a photo- graphy preparation state is entered with a main switch 16 ON and then a shut ter release button 18 is half-pressed to start measuring light by a light measuring instrument 26 while the focus is locked to the subject. When detecting the differ ence in light measured value between an averaged overall light measuring element 28 and a partial light measuring element 30 being larger than a constant level, a CPU 24 judges the daylight synchronized flash mode. The CPU 24 one judging this photographic mode controls the stroboscopic device 40 so that light is emitted before the aperture diameter of the programmed shutter 34 determined by a flashmatic mechanism is reached.

title: Electronic still camera
abstract: PURPOSE:To carry out white balance properly without using an exclusively used stroboscopic device by adjusting the white balance by deciding that a light emission operation of the stroboscopic device is performed when an exposure value decided based on an output signal from a photometric means during a photographing operation is largely changed toward a direction in which a shutter speed is higher than the exposure value decided before the photographing. CONSTITUTION:During the photographing operation of an electronic still camera, reflected light 100 from an object actually incident to the surface of a solid-state image pickup element 20 is fetched to a photodetecting element 28 through a master lens 14 and a condenser lens 26 and an automatic exposure control circuit 34 calculates the shutter speed so as to have the proper exposure based on the output signal of the photodetecting element 28. When the shutter speed changes to a higher one by one step before the photographing, it is decided that the stroboscopic device a mounted on the camera main body performs the light emission operation, the adjustment of the white balance is changed over to a daylight mode, and when there is hardly difference therebetween, the white balance is adjusted based on an arithmetic output 132 of an R/B arithmetic circuit 124.

title: Film unit with waterproof type lens
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a film unit with a waterproof type lens in which the watertightness of a waterproof case is enhanced. SOLUTION: The film unit with a lens 3 is housed from the aperture 17 of a case main body 13 in the film unit with the waterproof type lens 2, and a case back cover 14 is coupled so as to close the aperture 17 from back. A rectangular frame-like projected line is formed on the outer periphery of the aperture 17, and a rectangular frame-like recessed groove 19 is formed at the peripheral edge of a case back cover 14 at the case main body 13. When the case main body 13 and the case back cover 14 are coupled, an O ring 15 is force-fitted to the recessed groove 19 and also the projected line of the case main body 13 is fitted. The cross-sectional area of the recessed groove 19 at a rectangular frame-like corner part is made narrower so as to conform with deformation at the time of force-fitting the O ring 15.

title: Film unit with lens and its assembling method
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To make protruding parts around first and second lenses whose focal distances are different compact. SOLUTION: A lens aperture for exposing a photographing lens is provided on a unit main body 12. A package label 11 is stuck to the main body 12. A protecting cover 23 covering the lens aperture is attached to the main body 12. The cover 23 is attached after the label 11 is stuck to the main body 12, so that the label 11 need not be stuck to cover the cover 23. The cover 23 need not be formed of a quadradic surface by which wrinkle does not occur on the label 11. The cover 23 can be formed of a free curved surface, so that the protruding part around the lens can be compact.

title: Film unit with lens
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To appropriately photograph a main object and background at stroboscopic photography. SOLUTION: When a strobe selection member 8 is at a lower off position, a small diaphragm aperture is arranged on a photographing optical axis by a diaphragm plate 1 with the pressure of a diaphragm spring. When the strobe selection member 8 is slid to the upper on position, the diaphragm plate is energized against the pressure of the diaphragm spring. A large diaphragm aperture is arranged on the photographing optical axis at stroboscopic photography, then the main object and the background are appropriately photographed. An automatic strobe circuit is installed in a stroboscopic device 18. When a shutter button 10 is depressed, light is emitted from a strobe light-emitting part 7. The strobe light reflected by the object is received by a photometry element 34.  When the charge voltage of a current flowing from the photometry element 34 reaches a reference voltage, the strobe light emission is stopped by the automatic strobe circuit, so that then overexposure of the main object is prevented.

title: Film unit with lens
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reduce the waste part of material for packing a unit main body. SOLUTION: Film is loaded in a film unit 2 in advance, and the unit main body 3 is provided with a photographic lens 8 and a finder 9 required for photographing. Transparent covers 4 and 5 with which one part of the main body 3 is covered are fit on the respective side faces of the main body 3. A packing sheet 6 made of the belt-shaped one is stuck to the center part of the main body 3 so as to extend over the transparent covers 4 and 5 on both sides and hermetically seals the main body 3. At the time of photographing, one part 6a of the sheet 6 is cut off and the lens 8 and the finder 9 are exposed to the outside, whereby photographing is performed. Since only one part 6a of the sheet 6 is discarded, the waste of the packing material is restrained.

title: Photographing mode selecting device
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a photographing mode selecting device with which a photographing mode is hardly erroneously selected.  <P>SOLUTION: A film unit with a lens 2 is provided with a daylight photographing mode, a daylight synchro photographing mode and a night synchro photographing mode. The photographing modes are switched by moving an operation member 15 arranged on the front of the unit 2 inside an aperture 14. In the daylight photographing mode, the member 15 exists at the lower part in the aperture 14. By operating the member 15 to slide upward, the unit 2 is set to the daylight synchro photographing mode. When the member 15 is turned rightward in figure from the daylight synchro photographing mode, the unit 2 is set to the night synchro photographing mode. In the case of hesitating over which photographing mode to select, the mode is selected by sliding operation in the same manner as the selecting operation of the daylight photographing mode, and the daylight synchro photographing mode taking the middle position of three kinds of photographing modes is selected, whereby overexposure is not caused.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO

title: Lens-fitted photographic film unit
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To lower efficiency of repacking work of photo film performed by detaching a front cover.  <P>SOLUTION: Steps 35 are formed on an inner face of a lens-barrel part 15 in which a taking lens 2 is fitted. When the taking lens 2 is fitted in the lens-barrel part 15, stands 36 of the lens 2 are engaged with faces of the steps 35 having the same height to position the lens 2. A front cover 14 is provided with a lens presser foot 39 and a hooking pawl 40. When the front cover 14 is attached, a front surface of the taking lens 2 is pressed down by the lens presser foot 39 and the hooking pawl 40 enters the back of the taking lens 2 from a notch 41. When the front cover 14 is detached, the taking lens 2 falls from the lens-barrel part 15 and a third person who detaches the front cover and repacks film is required to reattach the taking lens 2.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO&NCIPI

title: Photographing equipment and lens barrel
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To effectively implement further thinness by causing a portion of photographic lenses to retreat into an appropriate position at the time of the collapse relating to photographing equipment and the like for creating an image signal by catching subject light with an imager.  <P>SOLUTION: The rear group lens 112 among three groups; the front group lens, rear group lens and focusing lens sequentially lining up from the front of an optical axis direction is revolved between a position on the optical axis and a retracting position coming into a hollow portion 104 beside the CCD imager 120, so that the rear group lens 112 comes into the hollow portion 104 at the time of the collapse.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

title: Photographing device
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a photographing device where a blurring correction part is arranged in a lens barrel without making the lens barrel larger.  <P>SOLUTION: A blurring correction element 1010 is arranged in a photographic optical system. The blurring correction element has: a container equipped with an electrode; two kinds of liquids 1010A and 1010B which are enclosed in the container and spread in a direction crossing with an optical axis 101b, and at least one kind of which is attracted to the electrode or kept away from the electrode according to the application of voltage to the electrode, and which have different refractive indexes; and a partition wall 1010C partitioning the two kinds of liquids from each other and freely tilted in accordance with the movement of the liquids. By controlling the voltage to the electrode with which the container 10101 is equipped, the partition wall 1010C is tilted, whereby the blurring correction element performs the correction of the blurring.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Model change and recycle method for lens-fitted photo film unit
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To make a lens-fitted photo film unit for standard photographing only by subjecting a recovered lens-fitted photo film unit for a high shutter speed to simple additional process.  <P>SOLUTION: A stopper 51, a diaphragm aperture 52, a lens receiving portion 53a and a lens cover locking claw 54 are formed on a lens base 50 in one. The diaphragm aperture 52 controls the quantity of light which passes through a taking lens 80. The lens receiving portion 53a positions the taking lens 80 in an optical axis direction. A lens barrel 53 which houses the taking lens 80 and the lens cover locking claw 54 lock a lens cover 85 which is attached to the anterior end of the lens barrel 53 to hold the taking lens 80 between the lens cover and the lens receiving portion 53a. The stopper 51 comes in contact with a shutter blade 40 immediately after the shutter blade 40 opens the diaphragm aperture 52, thereby controlling the maximum turn amount of the shutter blade 40. A stopper 51 of a recovered lens base 50 is cut off in a predetermined position and a diaphragm aperture 52 is enlarged by processing.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title: Lens barrel
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a lens barrel having impact absorption capacity, in the utilization state of a camera.  <P>SOLUTION: In the lens barrel 20, when power in the direction of arrow A is applied from an object side to a front moving frame 100 in a drawn out state, a reseating spring 124 contracts against pressing force, to absorb the force. Accordingly, the impact applied to the lens barrel 20 in the using condition of a digital camera 10 can be absorbed and the trouble where cam follower pins 98,104 drop out of cam slots 96, 102 can be dissolved. Furthermore, when the lens barrel 20 begins to collapse, a cam 126 of a driving cylinder 92 pushes the lens barrel 20 as a whole to a collapsed position against the pressing force of the reseating spring 124. Thereby, since the camera body 12 can be made thinner by the amount of the lens barrel 20 pushed-in, portability of the digital camera 10 is improved.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title: Radiation imaging device
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To acquire a present image suitable for subtraction with time in which arrangement of structure of an object on an image is similar to one of the past image in a radiation imaging device.  <P>SOLUTION: A control unit 17 controls an imaging system which comprises an X-ray tube 2 and an X-ray detector 3, an object 1 is preliminary imaged from a plurality of different imaging angles, an optimal imaging angle calculator 16 calculates the optimal imaging angle La having less arrangement deviation of structure of the object due to an error of posture of the object 1 between a present image Pa obtained by the present imaging and a past image Pr of the object 1 based on the feature reflecting posture deviation of the object 1 in the preliminary image Ppi obtained by the preliminary imaging, and the control unit 17 controls the imaging system in order to photograph by the imaging angle La.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Radiation image capturing system
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reduce processing burdens on a controller which controls an image capturing apparatus and to efficiently confirm radiation image information acquired from a plurality of image capturing apparatuses.  <P>SOLUTION: The radiation image capturing system includes: the plurality of image capturing apparatuses 20, 22, 134, and 136 for acquiring the radiation image information of a subject 36 by controlling radiation sources 24 and 26 according to predetermined image capturing conditions; the controller 18 for controlling the respective image capturing apparatuses 20, 22, 134, and 136 according to the image capturing conditions set therein; and a plurality of display devices 28, 30, 148, and 150 associated respectively with the image capturing apparatuses 20, 22, 134 and 136, for displaying the radiation image information acquired from the respective image capturing apparatuses 20, 22, 134, and 136.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Radiographic apparatus
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a radiographic apparatus capable of executing appropriate afterimage correction of a radiation image according to the state of an afterimage based on the charge accumulation time in a FPD at each pixel position.  <P>SOLUTION: The radiographic apparatus includes an image acquisition part which acquires afterimage data of the previous radiation image when radiation is not applied before the next radiography and acquires data of the next radiation image after the next radiography; an offset correction part which offset-corrects the afterimage data of the previous radiation image and data of the next radiation image; an afterimage correcting image generating part which computes the quantity of afterimages at each reading position of the offset-corrected afterimage data with a correction coefficient in a one-dimensional look-up table; an afterimage correcting part which executes the afterimage correction by subtracting afterimage data after the correction of the quantity of afterimages from the offset-corrected, next radiation image data; and a control part for controlling the operation of the radiographic apparatus.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title: Radiation image diagnosing system
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a radiation image diagnosing system which allows for efficient diagnoses.  <P>SOLUTION: Data of a plurality of tomosynthetic sectional images obtained by a tomosynthesis image capturing unit 32 are processed to reconstruct a shift-and-add image by a shift-and-add processor 54. The data of the plurality of tomosynthetic sectional images are reconstructed to create an FBP (Filtered Back Projection) image by an FBP processor 58. The shift-and-add image and the FBP image are displayed parallel to each other on a display unit 24. Therefore, a doctor 70 can view both the shift-and-add image and the FBP image at one time, and hence can diagnose efficiently.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Radiation image capturing system
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a radiation image capturing system allowing an operator to treat a subject while simultaneously observing the subject and a radiation image and capable of reducing the exposed dose of radiation to be applied to the operator.  <P>SOLUTION: The capturing system 10 includes: an electric cassette 20 which has a radiation detector 36, and a display 28 disposed in the opposite side of the irradiation face 36A of the radiation detector 36 so as to face the display face in the opposite direction of the irradiation face of the radiation detector 36, and displaying the radiation image based on image information output from the radiation detector 36, on the display face; and a console 26 acquiring coordinate information indicating the position of the distal end of a catheter in the patient's body and controlling motors 146, 148, 150 and 152 so as to irradiate the interior of the irradiation area including a position indicated by the coordinate information and a partial area of the irradiation area of the radiation detector 36 including the position with the radiation.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Tomographic image capturing apparatus
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a tomographic image capturing apparatus shortening a time required for imaging and forming a high-resolution tomographic image.  <P>SOLUTION: This tomographic image capturing apparatus includes: a plurality of radiation sources (14 and 16) moving along predetermined paths and applying radiation to a subject (18) from different angles and at different times; a dose adjusting section (30) for making adjustment for equal doses of the radiation output from the respective radiation sources (14 and 16); a radiation detector (20) for detecting the radiation transmitted through the subject (18) and converting the detected radiation into radiographic image information; and a tomographic image formation section (42) for forming a tomographic image of the subject (18) based on the radiographic image information detected by moving the radiation sources (14 and 16).  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Tomographic image capturing apparatus
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a tomographic image capturing apparatus forming a high-quality tomographic image without shading.  <P>SOLUTION: This tomographic image capturing apparatus includes: radiation sources (14 and 16) moving along predetermined paths and applying radiation to a subject (18) from different angles; a dose adjusting section (30) for making adjustment for constant doses of the radiation emitted from the radiation sources (14 and 16) independently of irradiation angles of the radiation with respect to the subject (18); a radiation detector (20) for detecting the radiation transmitted through the subject (18) and converting the detected radiation into radiographic image information; and a tomographic image formation section (42) for forming a tomographic image of the subject (18) based on the radiographic image information detected by moving the radiation sources (14 and 16).  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Device and system for radiation imaging
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain a device and a system for photographing a radiation image, where it is both possible to restrict the quantity of radiation a subject is exposed to, and to observe the radiation images of areas around the subject photographing spot.  <P>SOLUTION: At least either the form or position of the aperture 51 of a throttle 44 for narrowing down the radiant rays X irradiated to a patient is made variable. Also the throttle 44 is controlled so that radiant rays X can directly be radiated to a predetermined physical part of a patient, while the throttle 44 is constructed in the way that the more it is separated away from the circumference of the aperture 51, the less the transit dose of radiant rays X becomes.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title: Method and apparatus for photographing radiation image
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a reconstructed image more suitable for a diagnosis by appropriately suppressing an influence of an artifact generated by the vibration of a radiation image detector and a radiation source.SOLUTION: The method and apparatus for photographing radiation image comprises: detecting information indicating the vibration of at least one of the radiation source and a radiation image detector when irradiating each photographing direction with radiation; and setting a voxel resolution of the reconstructed image based on the information indicating the detected vibration.

title: Radiographic imaging system, image processing apparatus, control method for radiographic imaging system, and control program for radiographic imaging system
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a radiographic imaging system, an image processing apparatus, a control method for radiographic imaging system, and a control program for radiographic imaging system capable of appropriately correcting level-difference components that have occurred in a captured image even when there is a change in an incident direction of radiation between an image for correction and the captured image.SOLUTION: An electronic cassette 12 includes three radiographic imaging devices 14. A controller 30 preacquires a gain calibration image from each radiographic imaging device 14, and has a storage part 50 store it. The controller 30 detects locations of a scintillation level-difference component and a glass level-difference component from a captured image of a lower radiographic imaging device 14and the gain calibration image. The controller 30 performs coordinate transformation on the scintillation level-difference component and the glass level-difference component of the predetected gain calibration image for mapping to the locations of the scintillation level-difference component and the glass level-difference component of the captured image. The controller 30 performs gain correction for the captured image based on the modified gain calibration image.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title: Image processing system, radial ray imaging system, image processing method, and image processing program
abstract: To provide an image processing system, a radial ray imaging system, an image processing method, and an image processing program which can improve the image quality of a radiation image.SOLUTION: A CPU 60A acquires a radial ray image 45 of an imaging region SA in which a patient P is present, taken by a radial ray fluoroscopic apparatus 10 with radial ray R emitted from a radiation source 30 on an irradiation field IF adjusted by a collimator 31. The CPU 60A specifies a structure image 47B included in the radiation image 45 and representing a structure of specific shape having a transmissivity of radial ray R less than that of the patient P, on the basis of the specific shape. The CPU 60A carries out image processing according to the structure image 47B, for a patient image area 49A taken by the radial ray fluoroscopic apparatus 10 as if the irradiation field IF of an area on the radial ray image 45 were made into the irradiation field IF in which a position of the structure is eliminated.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title: Recording disk cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording disk cartridge which surely moves a rotary shutter to an opening position without making its size larger in a structure which interlocks a rotary shutter with a swing shutter.  <P>SOLUTION: An engaging projection part 42c, which projects downward, is formed on a rotary shutter 40, and an engaging pore part 52, which engages with the engaging projection part 42c, is formed on a swing shutter 50. The engaging pore part 52 is a nearly long-pore shaped pore having a first side edge part 52a and a second side edge part 52b, which are pressed by the engaging projection part 42c when a shutter is opened or closed, and is formed so that its one end part 52c may agree with the outer circumference of the engaging projection part 42c when at a closing position. Further, the engaging pore part 52 is also formed to include a gently curved shape which is formed by the connection of the outer circumference face of the engaging projection part 42c at a closing position to one end part 52c of the engaging pore part 52 by the second side edge part 52b.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Cartridge for photosensitive recording medium
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a cartridge for photosensitive recording medium such as a hologram recording medium having high light shielding and dust guarding effect.  <P>SOLUTION: This cartridge for photosensitive recording medium is provided with a cartridge main body housing freely rotatably the photosensitive recording medium of a disk type so as to insert, an opening provided at the cartridge main body and exposing the photosensitive recording medium to the outside, and a shutter attached to the cartridge main body so as to move freely between a close position at which this opening is closed and an open position at which it is opened, the shutter has a bent part formed by being bent to the cartridge main body side at an outer peripheral end part of the shutter, the cartridge main body has a projection part formed at a position corresponding to the outer peripheral end part.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Cartridge for photosensitive recording medium and method for manufacturing the same
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reduce the number of components by reducing screwed parts of a cartridge main body and a gobo and to reduce assembly man-hour.  <P>SOLUTION: A cartridge 2 which rotatably stores a photosensitive recording medium 4 has the cartridge main body 11 on which an aperture is formed on the side 11c in the inserting direction C of the cartridge 2 and on the outer surface of which a shutter slide surface and a gobo attachment surface are formed by being offset to the inside, a cover 21 which is fixed to the side 11c of the cartridge main body 11 and closes the aperture, the shutter 13 and the gobo 12 which are attached to the shutter slide surface and the gobo attachment surface, respectively and the shutter 13 and the gobo 12 are sandwiched at a step part between the cover 21 and the shutter slide surface and a step between the cover 21 and the gobo attachment surface while the shutter 13 and the gobo 12 are inserted and engaged into the cartridge main body 11 from the side 11c on the aperture side, the cover 21 is fixed to the side 11c of the cartridge main body 11 and attached to the aperture.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Cartridge for photosensitive recording medium
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a cartridge for photosensitive recording medium in which it is obstructed that the cartridge is loaded erroneously to a recording and reproducing apparatus for recording medium being a different kind, thereby, damage given to recorded data and the recording and reproducing apparatus is prevented.  <P>SOLUTION: The cartridge is provided with a groove part 29 in which a plane part 20c is formed at a front plane 20a of a loading direction C of a cartridge 20 housing a photosensitive recording medium 21 freely rotatably over whole length of the width direction and the plane part 20c is extended to a direction being orthogonal to the loading direction C, a shutter opening member 43 of a normal recording and reproducing apparatus presses a shutter 24 and opens an opening 25 by engaging to the groove part 29 and moving, on the contrary, when it is inserted to a recording and reproducing apparatus 10 to which the cartridge 20 is not yet correspondent, the plane part 20c of the front plane 20a interferes to a shutter opening and closing pin 11 and obstructs insertion, and erroneous loading of the cartridge 20 is prevented.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a cartridge in which light shielding effect of a photosensitive recording medium such as a hologram recording medium can be improved.  <P>SOLUTION: The cartridge is provided with a first shell 12 formed in an almost plate shape, a second shell 13 of an almost plate shape jointed so as to superpose on the first shell, and a shutter 20 opening and closing openings provided at the first shell 12 and the second shell 13, and a photosensitive recording medium 40 of a disk type is housed freely rotatably in a cartridge main body 11 formed by combining the first shell 12 and the second shell 13, the shutter 20 is provided with an outside shielding plate part 22 and inside light shielding plate parts 24, 25 shielding an opening 17 respectively at the inside of the first shell 12, the inside of the second shell 13, the outside of the first shell 12, and the outside of the second shell 13.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Cartridge for photosensitive recording medium and driving device
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a cartridge for a photosensitive recording medium and a driving device with high reliability capable of preventing exposure of the photosensitive recording medium by surely locking a shutter in a closed state.  <P>SOLUTION: The cartridge for the photosensitive recording medium has: a cartridge main body 11 which stores the disk-like photosensitive recording medium 4 and has apertures 18, 19 for exposing a part of the photosensitive recording medium 4 to the outside; the shutter 13 which is incorporated into the outside of the cartridge main body 11 and opens/closes the apertures 18, 19; and a lock member 63 which locks the shutter 13 at a closed position, wherein a hook part 63f which is an inclined plane formed so as to incline in the closing direction of the shutter 13 is formed in the lock member 63 and an engagement inclined plane 56f formed approximately in parallel with the hook part 63f and fitted to the hook part 63f while the shutter 13 is at the closed position is formed in the shutter 13.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Cartridge for photosensitive recording medium
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a cartridge for a photosensitive recording medium for securing moisture preventing properties of the photosensitive recording medium and preventing deterioration of performance of the photosensitive recording medium.  <P>SOLUTION: The cartridge 10 is provided with a first shell 25 formed in a nearly plate shape, a second shell 26 joined to the first shell 25 so as to be superposed on the first shell 25 and a shutter 15 opening and closing apertures 21 and 22 provided at at least one of the first and the second shells 25 and 26. At least one part of a cartridge main body 11 is formed of a plastics material which has moisture absorbing properties and is derivative from a plant, or a pulp mold material.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Cartridge for photosensitive recording medium
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a photosensitive recording medium cartridge capable of preventing a photosensitive recording medium from exposure and dust by suitably performing light shielding and dust prevention between a cartridge body and a light shielding plate.  <P>SOLUTION: The cartridge 2 for storing a photosensitive recording disk 4 is provided with a cartridge body 11 having inner apertures 18, 19 for exposing a part of the recording disk 4, a light shielding plate 12 having external aperture 14, 15 opposed to the inner aperture, and a shutter 13 arranged between the cartridge body 11 and the light shielding plate 12. Projection pieces 55h are formed on the end edges 55f of first and second shutter plates 55a, 55b of the shutter 13 which is the moving side in a closing direction and slits 25k, 26k into which the projection pieces 55h are inserted are formed on step parts 25j, 26j formed on the cartridge body 11 on which the end edges 55f are abutted.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Cartridge for photosensitive recording medium
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve reliability and operability by reliably opening a shutter of a cartridge for a photosensitive recording medium.  <P>SOLUTION: The cartridge for the photosensitive recording medium comprises a lock mechanism for locking the shutter at a closing position by engaging with the shutter. A rectangular operation hole 63b for releasing the lock by engaging with a lock releasing arm is formed at a lock member 63 of the lock mechanism. The lock releasing arm is inserted through openings 72, 73 provided in a cartridge body for exposing the rectangular operation hole to engage with the rectangular operation hole. Outwardly expanding chamfered sections 25k, 26k are formed at the peripheries of side walls 25m, 26m for defining an opening and outer surface 25n, 26n. Relative positional shift between the lock releasing arm and the opening is corrected by the lock releasing arm to be guided by the chamfered section. Thus, the lock releasing arm is smoothly inserted into the opening.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Cartridge for photosensitive recording medium
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a cartridge for a photosensitive recording medium for improving light shielding performance and reliability and being easily manufactured.  <P>SOLUTION: The cartridge 2 for the photosensitive recording medium comprises an inner case 11 having a disk storage part 3 for freely rotatably storing a disk-like photosensitive recording medium 4 and first openings 18 and 19 for exposing a part of the photosensitive recording medium 4 to the outside, an outer case 12 provided with second openings for exposing a part of the photosensitive recording medium 4 to the outside and positioned on the outer side of the inner case for storing the inner case 11, and a shutter 13 incorporated between the inner case 11 and the outer case 12 and disposed so as to be freely moved between a closing position for closing the first opening 18 and an opening position for opening the first opening 18. The inner case 11, the outer case 12 and the shutter 13 are formed of a synthetic resin.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Cartridge for photosensitive recording medium
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a cartridge for a photosensitive recording medium for improving light shielding performance and reliability and being easily manufactured.  <P>SOLUTION: The cartridge 2 for the photosensitive recording medium comprises a disk-like photosensitive recording medium 4, an inner case 11 having a disk storage part 3 for freely rotatably storing the photosensitive recording medium 4 and first openings for exposing the center part 4a and recording surface 4b of the photosensitive recording medium 4 to the outside, an outer case 12 with second openings for exposing the center part 4a and recording surface 4b of the photosensitive recording medium 4 for storing the inner case 11, and a shutter 13 incorporated between the inner case 11 and the outer case 12 for opening and closing the first openings 18 and 19.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Magnetic disk cartridge and recording/reproducing method thereof
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To secure the sure function by constituting a shutter member and its opening/closing mechanism to be thin as much as mountable to a PC card slot together with a disk drive device. SOLUTION: The shutter member 3 is provided for opening/closing a head inserting opening 21 arranged on a case 2 wherein magnetic disk media 6 are rotatably housed, and also a working piece 7 moving linked with the inserting/ ejecting operation is provided on the case 2, and a connecting member 4 is arranged for connecting the working piece 7 and the shutter member 3. This connecting member 4 comprises a linear flexible member 41 wherein one end part is connected to the shutter member 3 and another end part is connected to the working piece 7, and an elastic member 42 for biasing the shutter member 3 in the closing direction through one end part of this flexible member 41.

title: Recording tape cartridge
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain a recording tape cartridge, whose recording tape is drawn out surely by a draw out member of a drive device, without damaging its leader tape. SOLUTION: In the recording tape cartridge, the leader tape 50, having a leader hole 58 that a take-up leader of the drive device enters, is connected to the tip part of a magnetic tape 14 wound around a single reel which is put rotatably in a case. A leader-protecting member 60 is fitted around the leader hole 58 of the leader tape 50, and when the magnetic tape 14 is drawn out, the leader protecting member 60 engages the take-up leader. Namely, the edge part of the leader hole 58 is protected by the leader-protecting member 60.

title: Recording tape cartridge
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain a recording tape cartridge, for which the number of components for connecting a leader block to a free end of a recording tape is decreased. SOLUTION: In the recording tape cartridge 10, the leader block 18 is connected to the free end of the magnetic tape, wound around a single reel 14 to be rotatably loaded in a case 16. The leader block 18 closes an opening 26 while held by a leader block holding part 28 of the case 16 and is operated, when the magnetic tape 12 is drawn out of the case 16. This leader block 18 is constituted as a single component which is connected directly to the magnetic tape 12, so that while the magnetic tape 12 is clamped between a couple of holding pieces 50 and 52 coupled via a hinge member 54, the holding pieces 50 and 52 are welded to the magnetic tape 12.

title: Recording tape cartridge
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording tape cartridge which can open and close an opening constituted to minimize the drawing route of a recording tape in which a shielding member capable of miniaturizing a housing space in a drive unit does not interfere a reel and a leader member. SOLUTION: In the recording tape cartridge 10, the opening 20 is formed by notching a corner at a loading side to the drive unit, and slanting in the direction of an arrow A. A leader pin 22 and a magnetic tape 14 are drawn in the shortest route from the opening 20 facing both the direction of the arrow A and the direction of an arrow B. A door 50 having a shape curved in a circular arc in a plane view is guided (wobbling regulation) by the screw boss 36 of the case 12, projected parts 42, 44 and 46 and a guide surface 48A. The door 50 is turned so as to round around the pin base 24 and the outside of the reel 14 without going out from a moving locus along the curvature shape, thereby the opening 20 is opened and closed.

title: Recording tape cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain a recording tape cartridge which can prevent a case from inclining with a loading direction when a door is moved to a direction where an opening is held open by a loading action to a driver.  <P>SOLUTION: The opening 20 of the recording tape cartridge 10, which opening is disposed at the corner of a front wall 12A and right wall 12B of a case 12 and is closed by a door 50, is opened while an engaging projection 62 fixed to the driver is engaged with an operating projection 52 of the door 50 by the loading action in an arrow A direction to the driver. At this time, an engaging member 60 disposed at a bucket moving to the arrow A direction together with the case 12 engages an engaging surface 58A of a cell retention notch 58 disposed at the left end of the case 12 and negates the moment of rotation acting on the case 12 as the opening 20 is opened.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2003,JPO

title: Recording tape cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain a recording tape cartridge which can relieve the impact force acting on the front end of a recording tape.  <P>SOLUTION: The recording tape cartridge is rotatably housed with a reel 16 wound with a magnetic tape 14 within a case 12 and is provided with a buffer spring 98 which is a spiral spring disposed within a recessed part 92 for housing of a leader block 18 between the front end of the magnetic tape 14 and the leader block 18. When a reel 16 rotates in a take-up direction (tensing direction) of the magnetic tape 14 in the state that the locking of the reel 16 by locking means is released while the leader block 18 is held in the case 12 and is kept blocked from moving inward of the case 12, the impact force in the tensing direction is absorbed by the elastic elongation of the buffer spring 98.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO

title: Recording medium cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To suppress increase in the cost of a shutter of a recording medium cartridge having a shutter provided with a shutter knob and to eliminate a possibility of disengagement of the shutter knob.  <P>SOLUTION: The recording medium cartridge 1 is formed by freely rotatably housing a magnetic disk 17 fastened and held to a center core into a housing consisting of an upper shell half 11, a lower shell half 12, a resin section including a push-in section, a shutter member 14 consisting of upper and lower parts 14a and 14b, a locking member for locking the shutter member 14 to a closed position, and an energizing member, not shown in Figure, for energizing the shutter member 14 to the closed position, etc., in which the shutter knob 14c is molded integrally with the lower part 14b of the shutter member 14 by press molding to the lower part 14b of the shutter member 14.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO

title: Reel
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a reel which can highly precisely maintain a shape of a hub irrespective of a change of an environment.  <P>SOLUTION: In a recording tape cartridge in one reel type or two reel type, which is stored in a single case, a metallic ring-like member 74 is disposed in the hub 56 by insertion molding in the reel 50 having the cylindrical hub 56 which is formed of a resin material and to which the recording tape is wound and flanges 52 and 54, which are disposed at end parts of the hub 56 and hold an end part of a width direction of the recording tape.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO

title: Recording tape cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording tape cartridge which can enhance an incorporating nature of a shielding member and an energizing member into a case.  <P>SOLUTION: The recording tape cartridge 10 is provided with a nearly rectangular case 12 which rotatably accommodates a single reel 14 wound and loaded with a recording tape T; an aperture 20 formed in the case 12 for pulling out a leader member 22 mounted on an edge section of the recording tape T; a shielding member 50 which opens and closes the aperture 20 by sliding; and an energizing member 56 which energizes the shielding member 50 in a blocked direction of the aperture 20.A support means 54A which supports the energizing member 56 in a cantilever state at a section to be mounted 54 of the energized member 56 set in the shielding member 50.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO

title: Registration tape cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording tape cartridge by which miniaturization of a drive unit can be attained.  <P>SOLUTION: This recording tape cartridge is equipped with a nearly rectangular case 12 in which an upper case 16 and a lower case 18 are joined by connecting respective peripheral walls 16A, 18A and which accommodates rotatably a single tape reel 14 on which a recording tape T is wound and loaded; an aperture 20 formed by notching a loading side corner section to a drive unit of the case 12 for pulling out a leader member 22 attached to an edge section of the recording tape T; a shielding member 50 which opens and closes the aperture 20 by sliding movement; an operation unit 52 which is provided protrusively in the shielding member 50 and engaged to an engagement member 59A of the drive unit; a slit 40 formed by notching the peripheral wall 16A of the upper case 16 for exposing the operation unit 52; a protrusion section 36A formed in the peripheral wall 18A of the lower case 18 by the side of aperture 20 rather than the operation unit 52 exposed from the slit 40 and protruding in a plane view from the peripheral wall 18A by a prescribed length.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO

title: Recording tape cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording tape cartridge wherein it is not necessary to dispose a pressing means for pressing a reel or a locking member to a case.  <P>SOLUTION: In the recording tape cartridge 10, the rotation of a reel 28 against a case 12 in the engaged state of a reel locking member 62 with its inner-tooth shape engaging gear 50 is prevented. When a clutch member 88 is pushed up, a cam part 90 tilted based on a reel axis moves the reel locking member 62 to a rotation permission position in a reel diameter direction inner side while sliding with the follower cam part 70 of the reel locking member 62. On the other hand, when the clutch member 88 is pressed down, the cam part 90 moves the reel locking member 62 to a rotation locking position in a reel diameter direction outer side. Thus, the pressing means for pressing the reel locking member 62 to the rotation locking position side is made unnecessary.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2005,JPO&NCIPI

title: Recording tape cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording tape cartridge capable of preventing a leader tape from falling down from a slot part by a simple structure without increasing the number of components.  <P>SOLUTION: The recording tape cartridge 10 is equipped with a case 12 in which a single reel 18 with a recording tape T wound thereon is rotatably housed, the leader tape 22 which is attached to the end of the recording tape T and has a hole part 24 engaged by the drawing out member of a drive unit, and an overhanging part 26 overhanging in the width direction of the recording tape T, the slot part 50 which is formed in the case 12 and houses and holds the overhanging part 26, wherein rugged parts 56 to 62 are formed on the inside of the slot part 50.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Recording disk cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide constitution for efficiently removing dust in a recording cartridge accommodating a plurality of flexible recording disk media so that the fault due to the dust is eliminated.  <P>SOLUTION: The recording disk cartridge 10 is provided with: a plurality of magnetic disks 1; a rotating body 2 in which exhaust holes 21a, 22a, 23a, and 24a for blowing air toward each surface of the magnetic disks 1 and a suction hole 24b for sucking the air from the bottom part are formed and which is integrally connected with the magnetic disks 1; and a case 3 for accommodating the magnetic disks 1 and the rotating body 2.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Recording tape cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording tape cartridge which is prevented from occurrence of fault even if an impact such as falling is imparted, and which is excellent in shock resistance.  <P>SOLUTION: The recording tape cartridge 10 comprising; a case 12 for housing rotatably a single reel 18 on which a recording tape T is wound; an opening 20 which is formed in a front surface 12A and a side surface 12B adjacent to a corner part 12C of the case 12, and which pulls out a leader member 22 attached to an end part of the recording tape T; and a door 30 for opening/closing the opening 20 by turning, the door 30 is structured so as to be able to cover the corner part 12C of the case 12 including a a top surface 14A and/or a bottom surface 16A when the door closes the opening 20.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Recording disk cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To prevent dust from entering the recording disk cartridge.  <P>SOLUTION: This disk cartridge has a base frame 10 which encloses a magnetic disk medium DM radially and has an access opening C2 on the side to expose it to the outside, a lower plate 20 which composes the lower wall of the cartridge case C and has a center hole C3 for the chuck to engage the spindle SP of the disk drive D with the magnetic disk medium DM, an upper plate 30 which composes the upper wall of the cartridge case C, a rotary shutter 40 which opens and closes the side opening, and a swing shutter 50 which, being disposed between the magnetic disk medium DM and the lower plate 20 and connected to the rotary shutter 40, rocks following the turning of the rotary shutter 40 to open or close the center chuck hole C3. The base frame 10 has ribs 14 facing the sides 28, 38 of the lower plate 20 and the upper plate 30 respectively.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Recording disk cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording disk cartridge in which reduction of quality of a signal recorded in a recording disk medium can be prevented by preventing contact between the recording disk medium and other members at when the recording disk cartridge is not used.  <P>SOLUTION: A magnetic disk cartridge 1 is provided with a center core 61 supporting a flexible disk FD, a center hole C3 for chuck formed at the lower plate 20 and making the center core 61 face the outside, a rotary shutter 40 opening and closing a side opening of a cartridge case C, and a swing shutter 50 opening and closing the center hole C3 for chuck. And the center core 61 has a flange part 61b supporting the flexible disk FD in a separated state from its upper and lower ends, while when the swing shutter 50 is closed, the upper and lower ends are supported by the upper plate 30 and the swing shutter 50.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Recording disk cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording disk cartridge which prevents taint damage of a recording disk medium as much as possible, has high rigidity, and in which access of magnetic head is performed exactly.  <P>SOLUTION: The recording disk cartridge is equipped with; a base frame 10 having at the side part, an aperture C2 for access which nearly circles around outside of a magnetic disk medium DM in a radial direction to make the magnetic disk medium DM facing the outside; a lower plate 20 which constitutes a lower wall of a cartridge case C, and on which a center hole C3 for slide fastener for combining a spindle SP of a disk drive D with the magnetic disk medium DM is formed; an upper plate 30 which constitutes an upper wall of the cartridge case C; a rotary shutter 40 which opens and closes the side aperture; a swing shutter 50 which rocks according to rotation operation of the rotary shutter 40 and opens and closes the center hole C3 for slide fastener; and a ramp member R which sends a magnetic head which advances from the side aperture toward the magnetic disk medium DM.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Recording disk cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording disk cartridge which prevents a recording disk medium from being taint-damaged as much as possible, is excellent in rigidity, and is ejected from a disk drive even if a shutter is not urged.  <P>SOLUTION: The recording disk cartridge is provided with; a base frame 10 having, at its side part, an aperture part C2 for accessing which nearly surrounds the outer side in the radius direction of a magnetic disk medium DM to make the magnetic disk medium DM face the outside; a lower plate 20 in which a center pore C3 for a chuck for connecting the spindle SP of a disk drive D with the magnetic disk medium DM is formed; a rotary shutter 40 which opens and closes the aperture at the side part; and a swing shutter 50 which is arranged between the magnetic recording medium DM and the lower plate 20 and swings in response to the rotational operation of the rotary shutter 40 to open and close the center pore C3 for the chuck. In this case, a leaf spring 72 is provided at the front of the base frame 10 in the inserting direction.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Recording disk cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording disk cartridge in a simplified structure, which prevents contamination to a recording disk medium to the utmost, and has high stiffness, and excellent assembling performance and productivity.  <P>SOLUTION: A recording disk cartridge has: a base frame 10; a lower plate 20 configuring a lower wall of a cartridge case C and having a chucking center hole C3 formed therein; an upper plate 30; a rotary shutter 40 for opening and closing a side opening; and a swing shutter 50 that has a bearing 51 fit onto a spindle 21, engages with the rotary shutter 40, and opens and closes the chucking center hole C3 by swinging depending on rotational operation of the rotary shutter 40, wherein a lock spring 70 for locking or unlocking the rotary shutter 40, which is formed by forming a sheet of plate, has a bearing part 71, lock leg part 72, unlock leg part 73, and spring leg part 74.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Reel and recording tape cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a reel and a recording tape cartridge capable of stably pulling out a recording tape without damaging the edge portion of the recording tape.  <P>SOLUTION: A flange part 60 is formed in the upper end of a hub 40, an annular rib 64 is drooped from an upper flange 48, an elastically deformable engaging part 66 is disposed in the annular rib 64, the flange part 60 is held between the upper flange 48 and the engaging part 66, and the upper flange 48 is fixed to the hub 40. Thus, the upper flange 48 is positioned with respect to the lower flange 46, and the edge part of the magnetic tape T is surely held by the upper and lower flanges 48 and 46. As the upper flange 48 is movable in the axial direction of the hub 40, with the lower flange 46 set as a reference, when an abutting force of a predetermined value or more is applied to the upper flange 48 by the magnetic tape T, the upper flange 48 is moved in the axial direction of the hub 40 to release the abutting force. Accordingly, the magnetic tape T is stably traveled without damaging the edge of the traveling magnetic tape T.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Recording disk cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording disk cartridge in which dust hardly enters into a drive device and which can be used appropriately.  <P>SOLUTION: The recording disk cartridge 1 is provided with: a recording disk medium 30; a cartridge case 10 housing the recording disk medium 30, while having an opening part 101 for access facing the recording disk medium 30 to the outside; and a rotary shutter 20 opening and closing the opening part 101 for access by rotating between the recording disk medium 30 and the cartridge case 10. The recording disk cartridge 1 is used while inserted into the drive device D, wherein the cartridge case 10 has an air stream path 132f at the insertion side (front side) and the opposite side (rear side) of the drive device D, in which air absorbed in the drive device D by the rotating recording disk medium 30 is passed through, and the case 10 is provided with a filter 80 removing dust in air passing through the air stream path 132f.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Recording disk cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording disk cartridge which can prevent stuck of dust to a recording disk medium when set in a drive unit.  <P>SOLUTION: The recording disk cartridge 1 comprises a recording disk medium 30, and a cartridge case 10 which accommodates the recording disk medium 30 and also has an aperture 101 for access in order to make this recording disk media 30 face outside. The recording disk cartridge is constituted so that in the cartridge case 10, grooves 111a and 121a are set up along a peripheral part of the aperture 101 for access.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: Recording tape cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording tape cartridge in which a leader pin can be made not to be slipped out from a holding part during non-use and reduction of a manufacturing cost can be attained.  <P>SOLUTION: The recording tape cartridge has a leader pin 30 which is attached to an end part of a recording tape T and in which flange parts 36 are formed at both ends, holding parts 40 formed at an upper case 14 and a lower case 16 and holding the flange parts 36 of the leader pin 30 in the vicinity of an opening 18, an overhang part 44 formed at the holding part 40 and overlapping on the flange parts 36 at an inner plane 36B side of the flange part 36 and a claw part 44B formed at the overhang part 44 and making the leader pin 30 going-in and going-out by its elastic deformation.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title: Recording tape cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording tape cartridge preventing a leader member from seprating from holding sections without causing problems, such as a cost increase and difficulty in processing even if a shock or the like is applied to a case due to falling etc.  <P>SOLUTION: The recording tape cartridge 10 is provided with a leader member 30 which is attached to the end of a recording tape T, and is formed with flanges 36 at both ends, and holding sections 40 which are formed in an upper case and lower case and hold the leader member 30 near the opening 18, in which a shock absorbing means 70 to absorb the shock applied to the case 12 by deformation is formed within the holding sections 40 or near the holding sections 40.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title: Reel and recording tape cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a reel which ensures dimensional accuracy of a flange when a reinforcement ring is mounted to a reel hub, and to provide a recording tape cartridge which favorably protects a recording tape by applying the reel.  <P>SOLUTION: The reel 28 includes: the reel hub 45 made of a resin material and having a cylindrical shape, an upper flange 50 made of a resin material and extended integrally outward in a radial direction from one end portion in an axial direction of the reel hub 45, and a reinforcement ring 68 integrally arranged radially inside a tape take-up surface 46A of the reel hub 45 by insert molding and reinforcing the reel hub 45 in the radial direction. An upper end 68A of the reinforcement ring 68 is aligned with an upper end of the tape take-up surface 46A in the axial direction of the reel hub 45.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title: Recording tape cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording tape cartridge preventing rotational locking between a reel and a case from being released due to fall.  <P>SOLUTION: The recording tape cartridge 10 includes a reel 40 on which a recording tape T is wound, a case 12 for housing the reel 40 so as to move in an axial direction, a locking member 90 entering between the case 12 and the reel 40 to regulate the axial movement of the reel 40 when the recording tape T is not in use, and a reel locking mechanism 110 having an engaged gear 54 disposed in the bottom plate 16A of the case 12 and an engaging gear 82 disposed in the reel 40. The reel locking mechanism 110 is configured in such a manner that the engaging gear 82 and the engaged gear 54 are engaged/disengaged by contact/separation between the reel 40 and the bottom plate 16A, while when the locking member 90 is located between the case 12 and the reel 40, engagement between the engaging gear 82 and the engaged gear 54 is maintained.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title: Recording tape cartridge
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recording tape cartridge which is excellent in a property of incorporating a security tag in a case.  <P>SOLUTION: A tape cartridge 10 includes: a case 12 composed of an upper case 14 and a lower case 16 and configured to house a reel 20 having a recording tape T wound thereon; a cylindrical security tag 110 held between a top plate 14A of the upper case 14 and a bottom plate 16A of the lower case 16 and communicable with the outside; and a holding part 120 formed at least at one of the top plate 14A and the bottom plate 16A and having a pressing surface 126 for pressing an edge 116 of the security tag 110 from a vertical direction and a direction orthogonal to the vertical direction.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title: Liquid developer for electrostaticphotography
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the developer having excellent dispersion stability and fixability by constituting dispersing resin particles of a block A contg. a monofunctional monomer and the polymer component expressed by specific formula and a block B consisting of a polymer component selected from a carboxyl group, sulfo group, etc. CONSTITUTION:The block A contains the monofunctional monomer (A) which is soluble in a nonaq. solvent but is insolubilized therein when polymerized and the polymer component expressed by the formula I. The block B consists of the polymer component contg. at least one kind of the polar group selected from a carboxyl group, sulfo group, hydroxyl group, formyl group, etc., and/or the polymer component corresponding to the monofunctional monomer (A). The resin particles are the polymer resin particles which are constituted of the blocks A, B and are obtd. by bringing a soln. contg. respectively one kind of the resins for stabilizing dispersion consisting of the A-B type block copolymers having 1X10<4> to 1X10<5> weight average mol. wt. and the solubility in the nonaq. solvent into a polymn. reaction. Distinct image quality is obtd. by this developing soln.

title: Liquid developer for electrostatic photography
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve dispersion stability, redispersibility and fixability by bringing an oligomer (B) having <=10<4> number average mol. wt. into polymn. reaction with a specific polymer in the presence of a resin for stabilizing dispersion which is soluble in nonaq. solvents.
