title: Endoscope system and operation method thereof
abstract: To obtain an endoscope system, which is capable of accurately detecting an insertion state including at least one of a position and shape of an insertion part of an endoscope, and an operation method thereof.SOLUTION: An endoscope system acquires a value concerning an output impedance of a magnetic field detection element, which detects a magnetic field, and a value concerning an input impedance of a reception circuit, which receives a signal outputted from the magnetic field detection element. The endoscope system derives a frequency characteristic of a pair of the magnetic field detection element and the reception circuit using the value concerning the output impedance and the value concerning the input impedance. The endoscope system corrects an output signal of the reception circuit in accordance with the frequency characteristic, and detects an insertion state of an insertion part of an endoscope inserted into a subject using the corrected output signal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: プリント処理装置およびそのウォームアップ処理方法
abstract: 【課題】プリント要求時にただちにプリントを実行することが可能なプリント処理装置およびそのウォームアップ処理方法を提供することを目的とする。 【解決手段】入力指示部によりユーザから「普通紙プリント機能」の選択が入力された場合、制御部のトリガー検出手段は「普通紙プリント機能」の選択が入力されたことを検出し、プリント処理部に対して普通紙用フューザーのウォームアップ処理の開始を指示し、入力指示部によりユーザからプリント処理要求が入力されると、制御部はプリント処理部に対してプリント処理の開始を指示する。 【選択図】図１

title: Photosensitive composition and planographic printing plate using the same
abstract: The present invention provides a photosensitive composition comprising an infrared absorbing agent represented by the following formula (I) and a polymer compound which is insoluble in water and soluble in an aqueous alkali solution and becoming soluble in an aqueous alkali solution by radiation of an infrared laser. In the formula described below, R<1> and R<2> independently represent an alkyl group having 1 to 18 carbon atoms or an alkyl group having 9 to 30 carbon atoms and Z represents a heptamethine group which may have a substituent. The definitions of other substituents are shown in the specification. According to the present invention, a photosensitive composition having high development latitude and storage stability, together with a positive type planographic printing plate for direct plate-making which can form an image with high sensitivity by using an infrared laser, are provided. <CHEM>

title: Color picture converting device
abstract: PURPOSE:To convert a color picture into another color picture having a designated psychological image without deteriorating the quality of the color picture by executing a color conversion for the picture according to a psychological image conversion request from an operator. CONSTITUTION:When the instruction of the color conversion from the operator in a psychology display language is received, a psychological language selecting means 10 retrieves a psychological language coordinate memory 92 and reads out the coordinate value of the psychology display language corresponding to the instruction of the operator. An optimum histogram calculating means 11 calculates the optimum histogram most adaptive to the coordinate value of the psychological language. A color conversion means 12 successively makes areas in the histogram of an input picture correspond to areas in the optimum histogram obtained in the optimum histogram calculating means 11 according to a sequence from the area having the highest frequency, converts color data in a picture memory, and writes the color-converted data in a converted picture memory 22. Further, a picture display means 13 displays the respective contents of the picture memory before and after the color conversion. Thus, the color conversion for the input picture can be automatically executed only by instructing the psychology display language of an image level.

title: Integral type video camera
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve a portable and holding property, by deviating a rotary head drum to a supplying or a take-up side, and housing a lens in a cavity generated by arranging a tape loading mechanism so that a tape can bypass the mechanism. CONSTITUTION:The rotary head drum 26 is arranged by deviating to the take-up reel 24 side. Also, the tape loading mechanism is arranged so that a video tape 30 can bypass (especially, among a tension pole 36, a guide pole 42, an impedance roller 40, and a loading pole 34) and travel, and it can be wound on the rotary head drum. An almost rectangular cavity 44 is formed at the left lower part of a cabinet 20. A zoom lens 59 and a CCD52 are housed in the cavity 44.

title: Manufacture of magnetic recording medium
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a flexible thin film type magnetic recording medium preventing the occurrence of a crack in a substrate layer and having high recording density and a low noise characteristic. SOLUTION: In this method, the manufacture of the magnetic recording medium formed by spatter film forming a magnetic layer on a non-magnetic substrate layer after sputter film forming the transferred and supported nonmagnetic substrate layer on continuous web W of thickness 10μm-200μm is performed. In such a case, the temp. (Ts) of of the web W when the substrate layer is sputter film formed is set so as to become 0.5×T1<=Ts<=T1 (where, T1 is usable temp. of non-magnetic supporting body), and sputter gas pressure (Ps) when the substrate layer is sputter film formed is set in Ps<3.0×10<-3> Torr.

title: Transparent toner and toner image using the same, electrostatic latent image developer, toner cartridge, process cartridge, image forming apparatus, and image forming method
abstract: PURPOSE: Transparent toner, a toner image using the same, an electrostatic latent image developer, a toner cartridge, a process cartridge, an image formation apparatus, and an image formation method are provided to produce the transparent toner for forming the image having excellent transparency in the environment in which the color temperature is greater than 5,000 K. CONSTITUTION: Transparent toner for electrostatic latent image development includes a toner particle containing a binding resin, and an external additive agent containing cerium oxide. The concentration of cerium for the toner is 0.05-0.20 mass%, and the concentration of neodymium is 0.001-0.015 mass%. An electrostatic latent image developer contains the transparent toner for electrostatic latent image development. A toner cartridge has a toner storage chamber, and contains the transparent toner for electrostatic latent image development. A process cartridge for an image formation apparatus uses a phase retainer and a developer for developing an electrostatic latent image formed on the surface of the phase retainer.

title: Printer device
abstract: PURPOSE:To properly select an optimum illuminating lamp in accordance with a used photosensitive sheet by constituting a latent image writing means with the illuminating lamp and a liquid crystal shutter. CONSTITUTION:A latent image writing part 5 consists of a housing 12 arranged in the lengthwise direction of a scroll drum 4, a fluorescent lamp 13 which is provided in the lengthwise direction of the housing 12 in the housing 12 and has 540n'm optical characteristic, and a liquid crystal shutter 17 which is provided in the lengthwise direction of the housing 12 on the scroll drum 4 side of the housing 12 and consists of a liquid crystal panel 14 and upper and lower electrode groups 15 and 16 on both sides of this panel 14. Electrode groups 15 and 16 are connected to a picture reading part 19 arranged under a platen 18, and electrode groups 15 and 16 are turned on and off based on the electric signal outputted from the reading part 19, and a liquid crystal in the liquid crystal panel 14 is allowed to develop or extinguish colors to transmit through or intercept the light from the fluorescent lamp.

title: 磁気ディスクカートリッジ
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  ライナーの非固定部分の自由端を磁気ディス クメディアに接触させてクリーニングを行うについて、 メディアの変形を防止して磁気記録再生性能の信頼性を 高める。
【解決手段】  上シェル１と下シェル２との接合による ケースＣ内に円盤状の磁気ディスクメディア４を回転可 能に収容し、磁気ディスクメディア４に対向する上シェ ル１及び下シェル２の内面にライナー5,6 を固定するに ついて、このライナー5,6 の一部である非固定部分5a,6 a を上下シェル1,2 の内面に非固定で、その自由端をシ ェル内面から離れて磁気ディスクメディア４の表面に接 触させると共に、磁気ディスクメディア４の回転方向Ｄ に対する非固定部分5a,6a の外周側と内周側の長さh1,h 2 をほぼ等しく設けてなる。

title: Selenium vapor depositing apparatus
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a selenium vapor depositing apparatus which can deposit a uniform amorphous selenium film free from defects on a material to be vapor-deposited.  <P>SOLUTION: The selenium vapor depositing apparatus includes: a vacuum chamber; a holding mechanism which is installed in the vacuum chamber and holds a material to be vapor-deposited; an evaporation source which is arranged at a lower part of the holding mechanism and evaporates an evaporation material containing selenium as a main component; at least one of an evaporation source cover for covering at least one portion of the outer periphery of the evaporation source, a shutter which is arranged opposite to the evaporation source and shields vapor of the evaporation material going to the material to be vapor-deposited from the evaporation source, and a deposition preventing cover for covering an area between the material to be vapor-deposited, held by the holding mechanism, and the evaporation source, through which area the evaporation material passes; and a temperature regulation mechanism for keeping at least one of the evaporation source cover, the shutter, and the deposition preventing cover at a temperature of ≤60°C or ≥100°C.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title: 画像形成装置及びプロセスカートリッジ
abstract: 【課題】  現像剤として球形トナーを用いる場合であっても、良好な画質を長期にわたって安定的に得ることができ、高画質化及び環境に対する負荷の低減を高水準で達成することが可能な画像形成装置及びプロセスカートリッジを提供すること。 【解決手段】  本発明の画像形成装置は、電子写真感光体、帯電装置、露光装置、現像装置及び転写装置を備える画像形成装置であって、電子写真感光体が、導電性支持体、及び該導電性支持体上に設けられており、６００〜９００ｎｍの波長域での分光吸収スペクトルにおいて８１０〜８３９ｎｍの範囲に最大ピーク波長を有するヒドロキシガリウムフタロシアニンを含有する感光層を有するものであり、現像装置が平均形状係数１００〜１４０のトナーを電子写真感光体に供給し、静電潜像を現像して電子写真感光体上にトナー像を形成するものである。 【選択図】  図５

title: Image display medium, device and method
abstract: An image display medium provided with a pair of substrates both of which are substantially transparent, and a gas enclosed in space defined between them. Each of the pair of the substrates is provided with transparent electrodes (ITO). The space defined between the substrates encloses two types of particle groups having colors different from one another, have a negative charge polarity, and have different adhesiveness from each other with respect to the substrates. A white particle group having a positive polarity is further enclosed in the space. A voltage is applied to the electrodes  28  and  30  so as to apply an electric field determined in response to the types of particles to be transferred. Thus, a plurality of colors are selectively developed via the particle groups enclosed in the space for displaying different colors.

title: 時計内蔵型装置及び撮像装置
abstract: 【課題】  ユーザーに対して内蔵時計の時刻に誤りがあったことを認識させることの可能な時計内蔵型装置、撮像装置、及び、時刻の誤りが生じていた時の不都合を解消することの可能な撮像装置を提供する。 【解決手段】  パーソナルコンピュータ５０の時計５２から時刻データを取得すると共に、デジタルカメラ１０の内蔵時計３０から時刻データを取得する。そして、デジタルカメラ１０の内蔵時計３０の時刻データとが同時刻かどうかを判断し、同時刻であった場合には、ＬＣＤ１８へ、時刻に信頼性がある旨の表示を行なう。一方、同時刻でなかった場合には、ＬＣＤ１８へ、時刻が不正確である旨の表示を行なう。 【選択図】  図３

title: 紙送り装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  前記用紙出力装置の排出速度および用紙排出 間隔に関係なく、任意の速度で紙折り部に用紙を送出で きる紙送り装置を提供することにある。
【構成】  用紙搬入時に、用紙検出手段２および速度検 出手段３等から構成される用紙サイズ検出手段で用紙の サイズを検出し、搬入された用紙を一旦用紙収容トレイ ４に収容してから紙折り部１２へ送出する。この際、所 定のタイミングで、フィードベルト７が駆動され、該用 紙の下側の一枚を紙折り部１２への方へ送出する。この ため、用紙搬入口１から紙折り部１２までの用紙搬送路 １１を短くすることができ、用紙出力装置の用紙排出速 度、および用紙排出間隔に影響されずに、任意の速さで 紙折り部１２へ一枚づつ用紙を送ることができるように なる。また、本装置内で用紙のサイズが分かるため、用 紙出力装置との通信が不要になる。

title: 层叠膜
abstract: 本发明提供一种层叠膜，其具有量子点层等光学功能层，能够防止由于氧气等从端面渗透而引起显现量子点的光学功能的部件劣化。本发明的层叠膜具有功能层层叠体及端面密封层，所述功能层层叠体具有光学功能层及层叠于光学功能层的至少一个主表面的阻气层，所述端面密封层覆盖功能层层叠体的端面中的至少一部分而形成，端面密封层从功能层层叠体的端面侧起依次包括端面树脂层、金属层，金属层覆盖端面树脂层的除了与功能层层叠体的端面接触的面以外的整个面。

title: 文書構造作成装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  文書全体の構造から不足部分を判断して補完 処理を行い、希望の文書クラスに従った文書構造を作成 する。
【解決手段】  補完指定記憶手段１は、文書構造に対す る補完の指定を記憶する。補完手段２は被補完文書構造 に補完処理を施す。対応規則記憶手段３は異なる文書ク ラス間の構成要素の対応規則を記憶している。文書構造 変換手段４は特定の文書クラスの構造制約を満たした原 文書を、対応規則に従って別の文書クラスに従った構造 になるように変換する。原文書は、まず文書構造変換手 段４において特定の文書クラスに従った構造から希望の 文書クラスにほぼ従った構造に変換される。ここで変換 に必要な対応規則は対応規則記憶手段３に記憶されてい る。その後、補完指定記憶手段１に記憶された補完指定 に基づいた補完処理を補完手段２において施され、希望 の文書クラスに従った文書構造が作成される。

title: 放射線撮影装置
abstract: 【課題】本発明は、天板と放射線検出パネルとを剥離させる必要が生じたときは容易に剥離できる放射線撮影装置の提供。 【解決手段】放射線検出パネル１２と、放射線検出パネル１２を制御する制御基板１３と、放射線検出パネル１２および制御基板１３が互いに重なるように内蔵され、放射線検出パネル１２が接着、固定され、放射線検出パネル１２の撮影領域１９Ａが天馬６４に画成されている筐体１８と、を備え、天板６４と放射線検出パネル１２とを剥離するためのピアノ線７１を挿入する溝６５が、天板６４の放射線検出パネル１２が接着、固定される側の面に天板６４の一の辺から、前記一の辺に隣接するかまたは天板６４の面を挟んで相対向する他の辺に向かって少なくとも１本形成されている放射線撮影装置。 【選択図】図６

title: Production of aqueous dispersion of polyisothianaphthene and electroconductive polymeric material
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the title aqueous dispersion which gives conductive polymer material of high conductivity and clarity by oxidatively polymerizing isothianaphthene in the presence of anionic polymer or the like. CONSTITUTION:In the presence of an anionic polymer such as a compound of formula I and/or an anionic surface active agent such as C12H25COONa, isothianaphthene, preferably a compound of formula II (R<1> to R<4> are H, halogen, alkyl, aryl, hydroxyl or amino) such as isothianaphthene is oxidatively polymerized to give the subject aqueous dispersion.

title: Head device for printing
abstract: PURPOSE: To provide a head device for printing which efficiently records a uniform latent image on a photosensitive material and is suitable for miniaturization. CONSTITUTION: This head device 12 is provided with a light source 42, lenses 44a and 44b and light guides 46a and 46b. Five each LEDs 48a and LEDs 48b constituting the light source 42 project light to the lenses 44a and 44b respectively through five each optical fibers 52a and 52b. The optical fibers 52a and 52b all have the same curvature and the same length with each other, so that the exposure of the film F is uniformized.

title: 像保持体及びこれを用いた画像形成装置
abstract: 【課題】画素単位で縦横に配列された画素電極を有しトナーを保持可能な像保持体にて、環境適応性を向上し、高湿環境下においてもコントラストの低下等の画質劣化を防ぐ。 【解決手段】潜像が形成され且つこの潜像に基づいたトナー像を保持可能な像保持体１であって、移動可能な支持体１ａと、この支持体１ａ上に形成され、画素単位で縦横に配列されて画像信号に基づいた潜像電圧が画素単位に印加されることで潜像が形成される多数の画素電極１ｂと、この画素電極１ｂ表面及び画素電極１ｂ間を保護する保護層６とを備え、保護層６は、画素電極１ｂ間に最大潜像電圧に相当する電圧が作用したときに画素電極１ｂ間の絶縁性が維持される程度に高耐圧で、酸化シリコン、窒化シリコン、酸化タンタルのいずれかからなる絶縁層７と、この絶縁層７の表面に形成され且つ水の接触角が８０度以上となる疎水性表面層８とを有するものとなっている。 【選択図】図１

title: Post-processing device and image forming device
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To curve and fold a plurality of media.  <P>SOLUTION: This post-processing device (U4) includes a medium curving member (9) arranged on the upstream side of a bending member (11) in a medium carrying-in direction, and adapted to be moved between a leaving position of leaving the media (S) and a curving position of contacting the media (S) to be carried to the side of a storage part (6) and curving the media (S) whose downstream ends contact an alignment part (7), to the side of the bending member (11), and a control means (C4G) for moving the medium curving member (9) to the leaving position when the preset number of media (S) are not stored in the storage part (6), and for moving the medium curving member (9) to the curving position when the preset number of media (S) are stored in the storage part (6).  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title: Hand-written servicing unit
abstract: The problem of the present invention is to provide a kind of hand-written servicing unit for not producing the decline of miscellaneous function caused by the shadow of writer and realizing hand-written auxiliary.The hand-written servicing unit of the present invention possesses：Support member (40), so that the plane picture display face (32) of the mirror image of the picture of display is located at the mode of the top of the writing surface (12) of the writing medium (10) with plane writing surface (12), image-carrier (30) of the support with its picture display face (32) in display writing surface (12)；And half-reflecting mirror (20), it is configured between writing surface (12) and picture display face (32), reflect at least a portion of the light come from above, and making a part of transmission, plane minute surface (22) of the picture display face (32) with writing surface (12) across half-reflecting mirror (20) is configured with equal optical distance.

title: Silver halide emulsion
abstract: PURPOSE:To provide a silver halide emulsion having high sensitivity and inhibiting fog. CONSTITUTION:This silver halide emulsion contains silver halide particles obtd. by disposing silver halide made practically of silver bromide as a guest by epitaxial growth on flat platy silver halide particles having dislocation in the particles as host particles.

title: Image processing system for generating, storing, and transmitting image datafiles associated with enciphered identification information
abstract: A picture image processing system for performing picture image processing operations in a picture image processing unit on picture input data from an input unit on the basis of corresponding job parameters to produce picture image datafiles for output by a picture image output unit. The system comprises an enciphered identification key input unit provided in the input unit for the selective entry of an enciphered identification key associated with one of the picture image datafiles, memory for storing the picture image datafiles, the corresponding job parameters, and enciphered identification key codes associated with the picture image datafiles, a cipher deciding unit for determining whether the enciphered identification key inputted by the input unit corresponds to an enciphered identification key code associated with one of the picture image datafiles, and a control unit responsive to the cipher deciding means determining that the enciphered identification key inputted by the input unit corresponds to an enciphered identification key code associated with one of the picture image datafiles for controlling the picture image output unit to output the one picture image datafile.

title: Magnetic disk
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a magnetic recording disk for high-density recording having high traveling durability. SOLUTION: This magnetic disk device for a magnetic recording system is formed with a magnetic film consisting of a metallic thin film and executes recording and reproducing at a number of revolutions of >=1000 rpm. In such a case, the magnetic film or the protective film formed on the magnetic film has a lubricating agent having at least a fluoroalkyl chain and alkyl chain within the molecule or a lubricating agent having at least two fluoroalkyl chains within the molecule or a lubricating gent contg, further alkylamine in these lubricating agents.

title: Optical element
abstract: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a novel optical element which can be used for various purposes. The problem is solved by the optical element having a liquid crystal layer in which the alignment of a liquid crystal compound is fixed, and which has a film thickness distribution of 1.1< (in-plane maximum value /in-plane minimum value) <100.

title: 判別器生成装置および方法並びにプログラム
abstract: 【課題】マルチクラス、マルチビューの判別を行う判別器を生成するに際し、判別器における木構造の問題点を解決して、判別精度および判別速度を両立させる高性能の判別器を生成する。 【解決手段】検出対象画像から抽出した特徴量を用いて、検出対象画像に含まれるオブジェクトを判別する、複数の弱判別器が組み合わされてなる判別器であって、オブジェクトについて判別するクラスが複数あるマルチクラスの判別を行う判別器を生成する。その際に、複数のクラス間の弱判別器の分岐位置および分岐構造を、各クラスにおける弱判別器の学習結果に応じて決定する。 【選択図】図１

title: Selling method for grab bag, and method, system, device, and program for grab bag retrieval
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a grab bag selling method, and a method, a system, a device, and a program for grab bag retrieval which retrieve articles according to desired article information obtained from a user and sell a grab bag containing an article close to the user's desire. SOLUTION: A server 90 of a grab bag seller includes a process of making a display means 468 of a terminal of the user 10 display prepared questionnaires and making the user input personal information on the user 10 and desired article information on an article classification, the price, etc., of a grab bag that the user desires according to the questionnaires, a process of retrieving two or more grab bags matching the desired article information from a plurality of grab bags according to the inputted desired article information, a process of displaying the retrieved grab bags on the display means 468 of the terminal so that the contents of the grab bags can not be seen, and a process of making the user select an arbitrary grab bags out of the grab bags displayed by the display means 468, so a grab bag containing an article closes to an article that the user desires can be sold.

title: Information processing unit
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an improved technique to increase data transfer efficiency in an information processing unit.  <P>SOLUTION: By means of communication control using a common control signal line (common line), a module control unit 10 transfers data to a read module 20 via a communication signal line (RX). The read module 20 performs write processing of the transferred data into a flash memory. The module control unit 10 transfers data to a print module 30 via the communication signal line (RX), in parallel to the write processing by the read module 20. By this, a data transfer time to a plurality of functional modules is reduced as compared to the time of data transfer to the print module 30 after completion of the write processing by the read module 20.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title: Image coder and method
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image coder that prevents image quality from fluctuating even when the resolution of a received image is changed in the case of conducting irreversible coding through frequency conversion and quantization. SOLUTION: A DCT section 20 applies DC transform to an image received by an image input section 10, a quantization section 40 quantizes the result of transform, and an entropy coding section 50 applies entropy coding to the output of the quantization section 40 and provides the output of the entropy coding. A quantization table calculation section 30 stores each normalized quantization step with respect to a reference resolution, receives resolution data of the received image, calculates each quantization step matching the input image according to an expression of (quantization step)=(reference quantization step)/(reference resolution)×(resolution of received image) to prepare a quantization table.

title: Color photographic material
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent storage deterioration of image quality, change of hues, and occurrence of fog by forming a layer containing at least one kind of compound represented by a specified formula on a support to form a color photographic material. CONSTITUTION:The compound represented by formula (each of R1, R2 is H, an aliphatic, aromatic, or heterocyclic group, or the like, each of R3, R4 is halogen, an aliphatic group, or the like; and each of R5, R6 is H, an aliphatic or aromatic group or the like) is dispersed into a silver halide emulsion together with a magenta coupler and the like by the oil in water dispersion process or the like. The color photographic material is obtained by coating the support with this dispersion and drying it to form the photographic emulsion layer, thus permitting the obtained color photographic material to prevent fading of the color image to be finally obtained and discoloration of its color nondeveloped areas.

title: Gas separation membrane, gas separation module, gas separator and gas separation method
abstract:
A gas separation membrane which is provided with a gas separation layer that contains a polymer having gas separation ability, and wherein the gas separation layer contains a nonionic compound represented by one of general formulae (a-1)-(a-4) and having a molecular weight of 300-5,000 and the content of the nonionic compound in the gas separation layer is 0.01-30% by mass; and a gas separation module, a gas separator and a gas separation method, each of which uses this gas separation membrane.
In formula (a-1), X represents an n-valent group and n represents an integer of 1 or more.
In formulae (a-2)-(a-4), each of L 21 , L 22 , L 31 , L 41  and L 42  represents a substituent other than a fluorine atom.

title: 画像形成装置
abstract: 【課題】単色画像の形成動作と複数色画像の形成動作が種々の比率で切り替えて行われることがあっても、複数の作像装置（特に単色画像形成時に現像剤像を形成しない作像装置）における各像保持体の帯電を安定して行うことができる画像形成装置を提供する。 【解決手段】単色画像の形成時に現像剤像を形成しない作像装置の帯電装置に印加する帯電用電圧について、その初期設定値から、計測手段で計測された単色画像形成時における像保持体の回転量の累積値に基づいて定められる第１補正値と計測手段で計測された複数色画像形成時における像保持体の回転量の累積値に基づいて定められる第２補正値とから得られる値に変更する制御手段とを有する。 【選択図】図５

title: Muffling device
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a muffling device which can attain a large noise reducing effect by using an inexpensive arithmetic unit and causes no size increase. SOLUTION: A duct-shaped structure 11 propagating noise from a noise source as a plane wave is constituted of a first duct-shaped part 12a and a second duct-shaped part 12b having different cross-sectional areas at an installation position of a sound detecting means 13 for detecting noise. The transmitivity and reflectivity of a sound wave at a position where the cross-sectional areas discontinuously change are respectively made to be 0.5 by making ratio of these cross-sectional areas to be 1:3. Thereby a transmitted component of a traveling wave transmitting the installation position of the sound detecting means 13 and a reflected component of a retreating wave reflected at the installation position respectively are the same magnitude for the signal detected by the sound detecting means 13. Thereby the reflected component of the retreating wave is also muffled by the same principle as the transmitted component of the noise from the noise source is muffled by interference with sound from an electro-acoustic converting means 15.

title: 进纸装置
abstract: 根据基于打印数量计算得到的记录纸的总进纸量来驱动马达。当逆时针方向旋转齿轮时，螺旋弹簧的一个端部会向上移动，并且保持臂也随之旋转。固定在保持臂上的分离板尖端移动到能够与纸卷的外圆周表面接触的接触位置上。分离板通过螺旋弹簧以恒定压制力压在纸卷的外圆周表面上。当纸卷旋转时，分离板能够使纸张的端部分离。此后，沿顺时针旋转齿轮，使螺旋弹簧的端部向下移动，从而分离板移动到远离纸卷的外圆周表面的缩回位置上。在打印时，该分离板处于缩回位置上。

title: 画像記録方法およびインクジェットプリンタ
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】被写体表面の光沢感や繊維織りの細かなテクス チャー等の被写体の質感を十分に表示することのできる 画像記録方法、および、この画像記録方法を行うインク ジェットプリンタを提供する。
【解決手段】平面状の基台に載置されて照明された被写 体の拡散反射光を読み取って得られた静止被写体の拡散 反射画像信号と、この拡散反射画像信号を用いて求めら れた静止被写体の光沢度を表す光沢信号とを用いて、静 止被写体の読取画像を被記録媒体に形成して記録する 際、拡散反射画像信号に基づいて静止被写体の拡散反射 画像を被記録媒体に形成し、この被記録媒体に形成され た拡散反射画像の画素単位の領域毎に、前記光沢信号に 基づいて透明な光沢調整材からなる光沢調整層を形成す る。

title: Thin film of optically active polypeptide
abstract: PURPOSE:To prepare the subject film excellent in the biocompatibility and molecular orientation properties by polymerizing a monolayer or a built-up film thereof comprising amphoteric long-chain alkyl derivs. of optically active alpha-amino acid esters having the same stereochemical structure. CONSTITUTION:A monolayer of amphoteric long-chain alkyl derivs. (e.g. formulas I and II) of optically active alpha-amino acid esters having the same stereochemical structure is developed with a suitable org. solvent on the surface of water in a trough for preparing a monolayer, and is allowed to stand on the water surface for a length of time necessary for the monolayer to polymerize, thus giving a thin film of an optically active long-chain alkylated polypeptide. A built-up film obtd. by laminating a plurality of said monolayers may be polymerized to produce the thin film. The resulting thin film, being excellent in the biocompatibility, is usable in living tissues as, e.g. a permeation-controlling film of a drug.

title: Manufacture at high temperature for high electrically- conductive tin oxide powder and its apparatus
abstract: PURPOSE:To control the viscosity of high electrically-conductive SnO2 to be produced whose grain size is micron or less by burning tin compounds while introducing an incombustible gas functioning as a diluent or a reaction moderator into the combustion flame of an oxidizing agent contg. oxygen and a combustible gas contg. hydrogen. CONSTITUTION:The high electrically-conductive SnO2 powder is produced by burning tin compounds (e.g. SnCl4) in the flame formed by the combustion of an oxidizing agent consisting of air or oxygen and a combustible gas contg. H2 as a simple substance or H which is present in the form of a volatile hydrocarbon (e.g. C3H8). In this case, a diluent and/or incombustible gas flow consisting of N2 or air acting so as to make the reaction temp. adjustable are thrown in or brought into contact with the flame. Thereby, the grain size of SnO2 to be produced is controlled and the high electrically-conductive SnO2 powder whose grain size is micron or less is obtained.

title: Electrophotographic receptor
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain an electrophotographic receptor high in light response gain, by adding 2 kinds of specified azo dyes as a charge generating material and a specified 4,4'-biphenyl-diphenylamine as a charge transfer material to a photoconductive layer. CONSTITUTION:A compound used as a charge generating material is one or 2 kinds of azo dyes represented by the formulaIor II in which Y is OCH3 or Cl. A compound used as a charge transfer material is a biphenyl compound represented by the formula III in which X is CH3 or Cl. Said charge generating material is contained in a charge generating layer and said charge transfer material is contained in a charge transfer layer to form a laminate photoconductive layer on a conductive substrate, or both the materials are contained in a single photoconductive layer, thus permitting charge generating and transferring efficiencies to be enhanced and a high-photosensitivity electrophotographic receptor to be obtained.

title: Processing distribution control device, distributed processing system, processing distribution control program and processing distribution control method
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To shorten the processing time of an image including the transfer time of the image in a plurality of processors.  <P>SOLUTION: A processing distribution control device determines, for each of a plurality of processors for performing the same processing to a plurality of data to be processed in order to process the data, the processing to be performed by the processor concerned. This control device comprises a processing power examination part for examining the respective processing powers of the plurality of processors in the generation of a processing, and a distribution ratio determination part for determining the distribution ratio of processing load for the plurality of data to be processed for each of the plurality of processors.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2003,JPO

title: 立体視画像表示装置およびその動作方法
abstract: 【課題】立体視画像表示装置において、複数の立体視画像を順次観察する際、簡単な装置構成および処理によって観察者の疲労を検出して疲労増加を抑制する。 【解決手段】   入力部４２が、立体視画像Ｇの表示中に、次の立体視画像Ｇの表示を行う旨のユーザ指示を受け付けると、表示制御部４３３がユーザ指示に基づいて、次の立体視画像Ｇを表示する。表示時間判別部４３５が立体視画像Ｇ毎に表示時間を測定し、表示時間判別部４３５が。表示時間が所定時間以内であるか否かを判別する。警告部４３６が、表示時間が所定時間を越えた場合、画面表示および／または音声による警告を発する。 【選択図】図３

title: 感光性平版印刷版刷版作成装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  感光性平版印刷版を露光する描画装置を確実 に遮光する。
【構成】  描画装置が備えられた描画部１８は、ケーシ ング１８Ａによって区画されて遮光されている。描画部 に隣接して給版部１２と排版部１４とはケーシング１６ Ａによって区画されている。ケーシング１６Ａの連結部 ６００には、エアーシリンダ６２６によって作動して給 版口６１６を開放するシャッタ６１８と、エアーシリン ダ６４２によって作動して排版口６３２を開放するシャ ッタ６３６によって遮光されている。これらのシャッタ は、図示しない印刷版が通過される際に開放されるよう になっており、通常、閉止状態とされ描画部内が遮光さ れる。

title: インクジェット記録装置及びインク吐出面清掃方法並びに清掃装置
abstract: 【課題】液滴吐出面に付着した液類および付着部を確実に除去できるとともに、液滴吐出面表面及び清掃部材の耐久寿命を低下させないインクジェット記録装置及びインク吐出面清掃方法並びに清掃装置を提供する。 【解決手段】印字ヘッド５０のノズル面５１Ａに付着している汚れを清掃するノズル面清掃手段６６は、印字ヘッド５１に当接しながら往復移動してノズル面５１Ａの清掃を実行する。往路では、インク吸収ローラ６６Ａを従動回転させ、液類を吸液除去し、復路では、インク吸収ローラをスリップさせながら固着物を払拭除去する。従動回転と非従動回転とはワンウエイクラッチにより切り換える。液類を吸液除去する部材と固着物を拭き取る部材とを別部材構成にすると、往路移動のみで液類の吸液除去と固着物の払拭除去とを行うことができ、構成を簡素化するとともにメンテナンス時間を縮減できる。 【選択図】  図８

title: 色素画像形成方法
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  簡易に色素画像を得る。しかも現像液の再生 使用が可能となる。
【構成】  色像形成剤を含有するハロゲン化銀写真感光 材料を、露光後、酸化還元反応を可逆的に行う化合物で あって、ハロゲン化銀と反応して酸化体となり電子が供 与されることにより還元体に戻る化合物の還元体の存在 下に現像し、ハロゲン化銀が銀に還元される反応に応じ て前記色像形成剤から色素を得、この色素により色素画 像を形成する。

title: Coating device
abstract: PURPOSE:To contrive the formation of a high quality coating layer by selecting the numerical values for the inside diameter of a liq. reservoir, the amt. of the gap of a slit, the depth of the slit, the discharge width thereof, the viscosity of a coating liq. in the liq. reservoir, the viscosity thereof in the slit, the supply amt. of the coating liq. and the discharge amt. thereof, in order to satisfy a specific inequality. CONSTITUTION:A coating liq. 3 supplied into a liq. reservoir 10 is discharged partially from one end thereof and the coating liq. is also continuously discharged from the end of a slit 2 positioned opposite to the surface of a continuously moving flexible strip-like supporting body 4, whereby a coating liq. film is formed on the surface thereof. Given that the inside diameter of the liq. reservoir 10 is D, the gap of the slit 2 is (d), the depth of the slit from the liq. reservoir 10 to the end of the slit 2 at the coating liq. supply end is L1, the depth thereof from the liq. reservoir 10 to the end of the slit 2 at the coating liq. discharge end is L2, the discharge width of the slit 2 is W, the viscosity of the coating liq. in the liq. reservoir 10 is mup, the viscosity thereof in the silt 2 is mus, the supply amt. of the coating liq. is Q1 and the discharge amt. thereof is Q2, the numerical values therefor are selected to satisfy the inequality I.

title: 纤维素酯胶片的干燥方法
abstract: 一种纤维素酯胶片的干燥方法是在干燥箱(31)内边传送胶片(1)边经干燥风排气管(33)及干燥风供给管(34)循环干燥风干燥胶片(1)。这时，与干燥箱(31)内的干燥风接触部分的温度比在干燥风中所含低分子量物质的饱和温度高5℃以上。另外，在新鲜风导入口(36)导入新鲜风，同时在干燥风排气口(37)排出部分干燥风。该方法在溶液制膜法中传送胶片至干燥箱使之干燥时，能抑制低分子量物质气化物附着在干燥箱内壁面并能防止低分子量物质附着在胶片上。

title: Electrophotographic film to be transferred, color toner and color image forming method
abstract: PURPOSE: To provide an electrophotographic film to be transferred with which transfer latitude is wide, the occurrence of discharge marks is preventable, the transfer rate is high, the color developability of projected images is good and the occurrence of an offset is obviated and which is used for a full-color electrophotographic device of an indirect dry process using an intermediate transfer medium, a color toner, and a method for forming multicolor images. CONSTITUTION: A transparent layer of a polyester resin is formed on the surface of a transparent plastic film. The film has the relation -50Pa<=Ep-≠t<=2500Pa between the storage modulus of elasticity Ep of the resin and the storage modulus of elasticity ET of the binder resin of the toners. The inclination angle of the molten toner of the resin is specified to γ50 deg.. The thickness of the transparent resin layer is specified to be in a range of l to 8μm. The surface electric resistance value of the surface which comes into contact with an elastic transfer roll is 5×10<8> to 3.2×l0<10> Ω/cm<2> and the surface electric resistance value of the transparent resin layer is 10<10> to 10<13> Ω/cm<2> .

title: 画像データ修復装置、撮像装置、画像データ修復方法、及び画像データ修復プログラム
abstract: 【課題】ぶれの発生している画像データからぶれのない画像データを安価で高速に復元する。 【解決手段】画像データ修復部は、撮像時における撮像素子のＹ方向へのぶれに関するぶれ情報を内部メモリから取得し、ぶれ情報に基づいて、ぶれ情報に基づくぶれがない状態で被写体を撮像したときに得られる理想的な画像データを、内部メモリに記録されている静止画像データから復元するための復元行列であって、該理想的な画像データのＹ方向への広がりを表すぶれ伝達関数の行列表現であるぶれ行列の擬似逆行列である復元行列を生成し、この復元行列と静止画像データとにより、理想的な画像データを復元する。ここで、復元行列は、静止画像データのＹ方向の総画素データ数ｎと同じ数のデータからなるｎ個の行ベクトルＤｔで構成される。 【選択図】図６

title: 画像形成装置
abstract: 【課題】  外力の作用による画質の低下を抑えること。 【解決手段】  前記画像形成装置（Ｕ）を設置する設置面（５６）に支持される下部フレーム（３１）と、前記下部フレーム（３１）の上部に支持され、記録用紙（Ｓ）に記録する画像を形成する画像形成部材（ＲＯＳ）を支持する上部フレーム（１１）と、前記下部フレーム（３１）に支持され且つ、前記上部フレーム（１１）の外面を被覆する外装カバー（Ｕ２，Ｕ３）と、を備えた画像形成装置（Ｕ）。 【選択図】  図４

title: 画像処理装置及びプログラム
abstract: 【課題】画像の画質に影響を与える特定の成分を強調する際に、画像の画質を指定された画質に近付ける。 【解決手段】画像処理装置１０では、予測再現部１１が、画質予測パラメータ値が設定された再現パラメータに基づいて、原画像から画像強調が施された予測再現画像を生成し、画質量算出部１２ａが、予測再現画像の画質量を算出し、画質量算出部１２ｂが、原画像の画質量を算出し、画質特性予測部１３が、これらの画質量と画質予測パラメータ値とに基づいて、再現パラメータと画質量とを対応付けた画質特性を予測し、画質制御パラメータ値算出部１４が、画質特性に基づいて、再現画像の画質量が指定画質量となるために再現パラメータに設定すべき画質制御パラメータ値を算出し、画像再現部１５が、画質制御パラメータ値が設定された再現パラメータに基づいて、原画像から画像強調が施された再現画像を生成する。 【選択図】図１

title: Image carrier, process cartridge, and image forming apparatus
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image carrier and a process cartridge hardly causing a grounding failure and an image forming apparatus hardly causing an image quality defect caused by the grounding failure.SOLUTION: The image carrier includes a conductive rotating shaft 14, a cylindrical tube 11 through which the rotating shaft 14 passes and whose inner wall surface 110 has conductivity, a cover part which is provided at the end of the tube 11 and in which a through-hole through which the rotating shaft 14 passes is formed, and a conductive plate 15 which is fixed to the cover part and through which the rotating shaft passes. The conductive plate 15 includes a first contact piece 150 formed in a part of the peripheral edge of the conductive plate 15 and coming into contact with the inner wall surface 110 and a second contact piece 151 formed at the center of the conductive plate and coming into contact with the rotating shaft 14. The second contact piece 151 is formed so that the direction of connecting the second contact piece 151 and a rotation center is different from the direction of connecting the first contact piece 150 and the rotation center.

title: Connection processing method of radiation picture and radiation picture processor
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To clearly identify an area, where density correction different from that of the other area is given since the picture of a sheet terminal end part is omitted in a read radiation picture in the radiation pictures recorded in accumulative fluorescent sheets, from the other area. SOLUTION: This image processor is provided with a different processing range display means 17 for displaying a non-readable area Sp clearly in the case of performing density correction different from that of the other area in an area corresponding to the part Sp in the case of reconstituting a single radiation picture P recorded across two sheets of accumulative fluorescent sheets 31 and 32 superposed so that each part of them are overlapped with each other based on the radiation pictures P1 and P2 obtained by respectively recording from the sheets 31 and 32.

title: Plate material for lithography printing not requiring dampening water
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain the plate material for the dry lithography printing good in stickiness to a base material and ink repellence and efficient in plate water, without greasing which can be easily reproduced by electrophotograpy, by forming an ink repellence layer by vapor phase polymerization method. CONSTITUTION:In the plate material for the dry lithography printing having an ink repellence layer on the base material, the ink repellence layer is formed by the vapor phase polymerization method of silicon compound. As a base material, various kinds of substance such as paper, plastic film, or metallic plate of aluminum or the like, and various kinds of composite materials of paper laminated with aluminum foil and paper one or both sides of which are laminated with the polymer layer of polyethylene or the like are used. The electrophotographic photosensitive layer consisting of zinc oxide, inorganic photoconductive layer may be provided on the base material. As a monomer used for polymerization, silicon compound or the like are used. As to the organic silicone film produced by plasma polymerization method, the radical generated in gas phase reacts on the surface of the substrate and is accumulated to form a film. Therefore, the said organic silicone film has good stickiness to the surface of the base material.

title: Cleaning device for electronic copying machine
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the generation of a trouble caused by toner pollution and simplify maintenance by preventing toner from leaking outside of a cleaning device so as to eliminate the pollution of a charger, an optical system and a driving system. CONSTITUTION:The housing 400 of a cleaning device is provided with a brush roller 43, side walls 410 for rotatably supporting a toner conveying auger 45, and a scrape-off part 47 formed by projecting the upper face of the housing 400. The longitudinal dimension L2 of the scrape-off part 47 is shorter than the dimension L1 between the side walls 410 and equal to or longer than the axial length dimension L3 of the brush roller 43 so as to form clearances 100 to the side walls 410 of the housing 400. These clearances 100 serve as air passages for making air flow, generated by the rotation of the brush 43, flow out to the rear part in the housing and making air at the rear part flow in to circulate air.

title: Imaging apparatus
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an imaging apparatus for enabling even a person who is not familiar with any operation to photograph a satisfactory image without any mistake.  <P>SOLUTION: When the half depression of a release button is performed, photographing is prepared. Then, when the photographing preparation is completed, preliminary photographing is performed, and an acquired image is temporarily recorded in a memory as a preliminary photographic image. When the half depression of the release button is released prior to the full depression of the release button, the preliminary photographic image recorded in the memory is recorded in the memory card. Thus, it is possible to prevent such a mistake that the half depression of the release button is mistaken for having been photographed, and that a shutter chance is missed as a result.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title: Method for making printing plate and apparatus for making printing plate
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for making a printing plate and an apparatus for making a printing plate by which the printing plate for flexographic printing plates with various hardness can be easily made.  <P>SOLUTION: The discharging ratio of the droplets of multiple kinds of photocurable materials is adjusted such that the printing plate for flexographic printing having targeted hardness or targeted hardness distribution is made when making the printing plate for flexographic printing formed by laminating two or more layers of two dimensional images by repeating discharging the liquid droplets of the photocurable materials from a liquid droplet discharge means capable of discharging the droplets of the multiple kinds of photocurable materials having different hardness after solidified and solidifying the same by irradiating light to the same.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&amp;INPIT

title: Improvements in or relating to the stabilisation of dyes

title: A method of printing
abstract: The present invention provides a method of inkjet printing comprising the following steps, in order: (i) providing an inkjet ink comprising a radiation-curable material and a photoinitiator; (ii) inkjet printing the inkjet ink from a printing head on to a substrate; (iii) exposing the inkjet ink to a first dose of radiation from an LED source to partially cure the ink; (iv) exposing the inkjet ink to a second dose of radiation from a mercury lamp to fully cure the ink; wherein the printing head moves relative to the substrate at a speed of 60 m/min or more. The radiation-curable material may comprise a radiation-curable monomer which may be a difunctional, multifunctional (meth)acrylate monomer or 3-methyl-1,5-pentanediol diacrylate. The photoinitiator may be phenylbis(2,4,6-trimethylbenzoyl) phosphine oxide. The method may be a method of single-pass inkjet printing. The first dose of radiation from each LED source to partially cure the ink is from 10 to 80 mJ/cm2. The second dose of radiation from each mercury lamp to fully cure the ink is from 50 to 250 mJ/cm2.

title: Flow control method for liquid
abstract: PURPOSE:To make to control flow with good precision for various conditions of applicating liquid by using a flow control valve which has small rate of change in flow and still linear quality to valve lift. CONSTITUTION:Finished emulsion for application is detected flow rate by a flow detector in a feed pipe, and thereby a servomotor 6 is ordered to control a flow control valve 7, and flow control is performed so as to get a required flow rate. The flow control valve 7 is lifted and lowered through a valve stem 10, on the top of which a valve head 13, abut ting to a valve seat 11 and in conical or cylindrical shape, is provided. The valve head 13 is treated to conical or cylindrical shape in slender and so as to be small and still linear in rate of change of flow rate to lift of the valve stem.

title: 具有高透射率和无光泽特性的薄膜
abstract: 本发明公开了一种具有高透射率和无光泽特性的薄膜，在透明基底(1)上，有一个硬涂层(8)，其中结合了颗粒尺寸在1.0到10μm的颗粒，所述的颗粒尺寸大于硬涂层的厚度，还包括低折射指数层(3)，其折射指数是1.45或者更小，覆盖在所述硬涂层上面，该薄膜的浊度是1.0%或者更大，总的透光率是93.5%或者更大。该具有高透射率的薄膜能够防止由于调光薄膜的热膨胀而导致的显示不均匀，并防止调光薄膜出现亮度不均匀。

title: 画像形成装置及びプログラム
abstract: 【課題】形成される画像の品質低下を抑えつつ、吐出を停止させる不良ノズルの数を抑制することができる画像形成装置、及びプログラムを提供する。 【解決手段】液滴吐出が正常な正常ノズル及び液滴吐出が異常な異常ノズルを含む複数のノズルと、異なる複数の条件の各々に対応させて画像形成時に液滴を不吐出とする不吐出ノズルを定めることが可能なノズル情報を記憶した記憶手段と、を備え、画像形成に関連する少なくとも１つの条件に対応するノズル情報に基づいて定めた不吐出ノズルから液滴が吐出されないように制御すると共に、画像情報に基づいて複数のノズルより不吐出ノズルを除外した吐出ノズルから液滴が吐出されるように制御する。 【選択図】図４

title: Electrostatic charge image developer, process cartridge, image forming apparatus, and image forming method
abstract: An electrostatic charge image developer contains toner particles, silica particles that are added to an exterior of the toner particles and contain a nitrogen element-containing compound, and a carrier that has a core material and a nitrogen element-containing coating resin layer, in which a content of the nitrogen element-containing compound with respect to the silica particles is 0.005% by mass or more and 0.5% by mass or less in terms of a nitrogen element, and in a case where A represents a pore volume of pores that the silica particles include and have a diameter of 1 nm or more and 50 nm or less, which is determined from a pore size distribution curve obtained by a nitrogen adsorption method before baking of the silica particles at 350° C., and B represents a pore volume of pores that the silica particles include and have a diameter of 1 nm or more and 50 nm or less, which is determined from a pore size distribution curve obtained by a nitrogen adsorption method after baking of the silica particles at 350° C., B/A is 1.2 or more and 5 or less and B is 0.2 cm 3 /g or more and 3 cm 3 /g or less.

title: Color conversion method for image
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain visibility of the same color as that of an image of a hard copy to a soft copy image on a display device. SOLUTION: A physiological primary color corresponding to three stimulus values of each pixel of am image on a hard copy is obtained, a parameter representing a degree of an incomplete adaptation corresponding to a correlation color temperature of a white color point on a display device (CRT) displaying an image is decided, temporary three stimulus values to be reproduced on the display device are introduced based on the parameter, metric brightness, metric chroma and a metric hue angle in the LAB color system are obtained by making the while color point on the display device as an observation light source from the three stimulus values, the three stimulus values of the image are converted into three stimulus values on the display device and a soft copy image on the display device is prepared based on the converted three stimulus values.  As a function of the color temperature of the white color on the display device, especially as for as a white color correlation color temperature is higher than 6000K or lower than 5500K, by setting an adaptation white color point to a point different from a white color point itself on the display device an ideal color is obtained to the widespread display device.

title: 光硬化性組成物及び液晶表示装置用フォトスペーサー
abstract: 【課題】高感度で高溶解性で現像残渣を抑えると共に、画像太りを軽減して所期の画像パターンの再現を可能とする。 【解決手段】アルカリ可溶性樹脂と光重合性化合物とトリハロメタントリアジン系化合物とクマリン系紫外線吸収剤とを含み、アルカリ可溶性樹脂及び光重合性化合物の少なくとも一方がアルキレンオキサイド鎖を有している。 【選択図】なし

title: Optical waveguide element
abstract: PURPOSE:To converge a light beam which is projected from an optical waveguide into a small spot by setting the grating height of a diffraction grating formed on the surface of the optical waveguide so as to have a mountain-shaped distribution in the traveling direction of waveguide light. CONSTITUTION:The grating height of the diffraction grating 21 is varies in the mountain shape in the traveling direction of the waveguide light 13' so that when waveguide light 13' is projected from the optical waveguide 11 by the diffraction grating 21, the intensity distribution of the projection light 13'' is nearly a Gaussian distribution in the traveling direction. Therefore, the light beam 13'' projected from the optical waveguide element 10 is converted into the small beam spot Q through a scanning lens 26 to scan (main scan) on a photosensitive body 23 as shown by an arrow (u). Simultaneously, the photosensitive body 23 moves by a conveying means 22 almost at right angles to the main scanning direction as shown by an arrow (v) to make a subscan, so the photosensitive body 23 is scanned with the light beam 13'' in two dimensions. Consequently, the beam spot Q is converted sufficiently and a fine image can be recorded.

title: Image forming apparatus
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain images without a density irregularity by effectively avoiding the trouble of adhesion of an external additive of toner to the non-image forming region of an image holding body even when toner images of different sizes are formed on the image holding body.SOLUTION: An image forming control means 7 includes: a first toner image forming control part 11 which forms a first toner image TBon the outside of an image forming region M of an image holding body 1 through a preset gap region U under the condition that density information on an image TG formed in a region through which a recording medium 5 passes is higher than a threshold value preset; and a second toner image forming control part 12 which forms a second toner image TBfor the gap region U under the condition that formation history information on the first toner image TBby the first toner image forming control part 11 exceeds a threshold value preset.

title: マーカー消去装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  編集準備処理のために原稿上にマーカーペン で書いたマーカーを、編集実行のために原稿を読み取る 際に消去するマーカー消去装置において、プレスキャン 時とコピースキャン時での原稿セットの位置ずれに基づ くマーカーの消し残りをなくすこと。
【構成】  プレスキャン時に、マーカー認識回路１によ りマーカー部分を認識してマーカーデータ記憶部２−１ に記憶しておく。コピースキャン時には、プレスキャン 時に読みとったマーカー部分より、主走査方向および副 走査方向に予め指定した幅だけ拡張した領域に対して は、あたかもマーカー部分であるかのような出力をマー カー太め回路８が出す。そうすると、コピースキャン時 にセットした原稿がプレスキャン時の位置より多少ずれ ても、コピースキャン時に読みとられるマーカー部分 は、前記の拡張した領域内には入る。入った場合、選択 回路３は、マーカーを消去するための置換レベル設定部 ４のデータを選択する。

title: プリンタ装置およびその制御方法
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【目的】  プリントが終了したことをユーザに知らせ る。
【構成】  店頭プリント装置には，Bluetooth インター フェイス２およびBluetooth 用アンテナ１ならびに携帯 電話インターフェイス４および電話回線用アンテナ３が 設けられている。店頭プリント装置においてプリントが 終了すると，Bluetooth による近距離通信が可能な場合 には，Bluetooth による近距離通信を用いてユーザにプ リント終了を知らせる。近距離通信が不可能な場合に は，ユーザの携帯電話に電子メールでプリント終了を知 らせる。

title: Close up photographing controller for variable focus camera
abstract: PURPOSE:To make it possible to perform close up photographing in either state of standard photographing and telephotographing by controlling a lens barrel so that it may be positioned at a 1st close up photographing position in the case of the standard photographing and controlling the lens barrel so that it may be positioned at a 2nd close up photographing position in the case of the telephotographing. CONSTITUTION:In the case that an object distance is shorter than a close range capable of photographing in the case of the standard photographing and the telephotographing, the lens barrel 1 is extended, and in the case of the standard photographing, the lens barrel 1 is controlled so as to be positioned at the 1st close up photographing position where the performed based on the detection of the 1st adjacent photographing pattern which is obtained by sliding a contact member 8. Meanwhile, in the case of the telephotographing, the lens barrel 1 is controlled so as to be positioned at the 2nd close up photographing position where the adjacent photographing by the telephotographing can be performed based on the detection of the 2nd close up photographing pattern which is obtained by sliding the contact member 8. Thus, the close up photographing can be performed in either state of standard photographing or telephotographing.

title: Analysis data accumulating system for recording device managing system
abstract: PURPOSE:To minutely analyze a use form for every department and every machine by accumulating recording information as the elemental data for every job in a managing device. CONSTITUTION:The managing device 10 monitors a job finish signal transmitted from an interface 20 by using the control part 11 of the device 10 and accumulates the recording information in job units as the elemental data. Name ly, the information is recorded as the elemental data showing what time and how copying is performed for every job. By storing the data in an external memory 13, the information is specially analyzed by a personal computer, etc., and the characteristic of the use of every department and every copying machine is grasped so as to be used as business supporting data. Thus, the characteristic of the use form of the recording device is minutely grasped.

title: Control method for optical device
abstract: PURPOSE:To considerably shorten the time required for control of the exposure by storing a rough driving frequency corresponding to the correct exposure of an image sensor for each interchangeable lens and driving the image sensor with the driving frequency corresponding to a selected lens at the time of replacing a lens. CONSTITUTION:A correction curve for the illuminance variance of each lens is preliminarily stored in a memory 86, and a CPU 52 corrects a contrast C and an output signal d' or slice levels Sn and Sp for a turning position theta of a line sensor 40. The driving frequency of the line sensor 40 corresponding to an approximately correct exposure for lens power is preliminarily stored in a memory 88 for each interchangeable lens; and since this frequency determines the rough exposure of the line sensor 40 for each interchangeable lens and a comparator 68 has a blooming preventing function, such driving frequency is stored in the memory that the exposure is rather on the blooming side. Thus, the exposure of the image sensor is certainly entered in the correct range and the operation time when the driving frequency in this range is obtained is very shortened at the time of lens replacement.

title: Cleaning sheet for electrophotographic copiers - comprising substrate with fluorine-contg. resin coating, for removing electroscopic powder from photosensitive matl.
abstract: The cleaning sheet comprises a substrate with tensile elastic modulus 0.01-10 kg/mm2 (i.e. rubber-elastic) and a surface coating layer of F-contg. resin. Cleaning effect is better than with resin or elastomer alone, so that the photosensitive matt can be reused. Powder can also be reused since it is not contaminated with bristles etc. as when a brush is used. Resin is e.g. polyvinyl(idene) fluoride or PTFE.

title: シェーディング補正装置および方法並びにプログラム
abstract: 【課題】放射線検出器を用いて放射線画像の撮影を行うに際し、適切にシェーディング補正を行うことができるようにする。 【解決手段】シェーディング補正データ取得部４２が、あらかじめ放射線源１４に起因する第１のシェーディング補正データＨ１およびカセッテ２０Ａ，２０ＢのＦＰＤ２２Ａ，２２Ｂに起因する第２のシェーディング補正データＨ２Ａ，Ｈ２Ｂを取得し、記憶部３８に記憶しておく。例えばカセッテ２０Ａを用いての撮影時には、ＦＰＤ２２Ａの向きを検出部４０が検出し、これに基づいて、画像処理部３４が、第１のシェーディング補正データＨ１を第２のシェーディング補正データに対して回転して、最終的なシェーディング補正データＨ０を生成する。そして、撮影により取得した放射線画像データを最終的なシェーディング補正データＨ０によりシェーディング補正する。 【選択図】図１

title: 積層体フイルムのハーフカット方法及び装置
abstract: 【課題】簡単な工程及び構成で、積層体フイルムを高品質にハーフカットすることを可能にする。 【解決手段】ハーフカット装置３６は、感光性ウエブ２２のハーフカット部位３４を、回転丸刃６８又は固定丸刃８０に応じて予め設定された所定温度に加熱する加熱機構５２と、前記所定温度に加熱されるハーフカット部位３４に沿って回転丸刃６８又は固定丸刃８０を移動させることにより、前記感光性ウエブ２２をハーフカットするカッタ機構５４とを備える。加熱機構５２は、カット受台７０に設けられるシート型ヒータ７６を備え、前記カット受台７０は、感光性ウエブ２２に接触してハーフカット部位３４を加熱する。 【選択図】図４

title: 積層体の製造方法
abstract: 【課題】表示装置の表示精度を向上させる。 【解決手段】搬送されている支持体の反応膜に露光装置による紫外線の連続照射し、これに保護フィルム７０を付与してＦＰＦ１２と保護膜１３とを備える複層フィルム１４を得る。この複層フィルム１４をシート状に切断して、液晶パネル１１と貼り合わせる。複層フィルム１４を、支持体の搬送方向に対応するＡ方向に、目的とする張力で引っ張る。目的とする張力は、露光装置により紫外線が照射されている間の支持体の搬送方向における張力に基づいて求める。この引張工程により引っ張られた状態で、複層フィルム１４を液晶パネル１１と貼り合わせる。 【選択図】図６

title: Photosensitive microcapsule and photosensitive material
abstract: PURPOSE:To obtain microcapsules capable of providing a picture image having satisfactory contrast by constituting the microcapsules of external shells comprising a resin generated from a raw material contg. isocyanate having a isocyanurate ring structure, around a core material. CONSTITUTION:External shells comprising a resin generated from a raw material contg. isocyanate having an isocyanurate ring structure are formed around a core material contg. silver halide and a polymerizable compd. When the shell is prepd. from a raw material contg. isocyanate having an isocyanurate ring structure (a product modified with isocyanurate ring), heat resistance is given to the shell by the trimerization of isocyanate monomer, and, as a result, resin walls having high glass transition point is obtd. Thus, oozing of the monomer in the capsule is retarded even if heat development is performed at high temp., and a distinct picture image is obtd. by the development for a short time.

title: Silver halide photographic sensitive material
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve graininess of a silver halide photographic sensitive material without reducing its sensitivity by incorporating at least one kind of liquid paraffin into an outermost layer, and regulating an amt. of a matting agent to be contained in the outer-most layer to <=15mg/m<2>. CONSTITUTION:At least one kind of liquid paraffin is incorporated into the outermost layer of the silver halide photographic sensitive material, and content of the matting agent in one of the outermost layer is regulated to <=15mg/m<2>. The kind of the liquid paraffin is not restricted particularly by a mol.wt. etc., and any kind of liquid paraffin may be useful so far as it reduces a coefft. of static friction and a degree of adhesion when it is present on the surface of a body as compared to that when it is absent. Preferred amt. of the matting agent to be used is <=50mg/m<2> when a mean particle size of the matting agent is <=2mum, and an improving effect for graininess is obtd. when it is <=30mg/m<2>, particularly, <=15mg/m<2> in the case of >=2mum particle size. Thus, graininess and sharpness of the silver halide photographic sensitive material are improved without reducing its sensitivity.

title: 転写装置及び画像形成装置
abstract: 【課題】転写ベルトに転写ロールを圧接する方向にばね力を発生させる場合と比べて小さいばね力でニップ荷重を得ることができる転写装置及び画像形成装置を提供する。 【解決手段】転写装置７は、感光体２０のトナー像を転移させて保持する中間転写ベルト７０と、中間転写ベルト上のトナー像を用紙Ｐに転写する二次転写ロール７１と、二次転写ロールを回転可能に保持する第１の保持部材７２と、第１の保持部材を介して中間転写ベルト７０に二次転写ロール７１を圧接する圧接部材７３と、圧接部材及び第１の保持部材７２を介して中間転写ベルト７０に二次転写ロール７１を圧接し、かつ第１の保持部材７２を揺動かつ移動可能に保持する第２の保持部材７４と、第２の保持部材に対して第１の保持部材７２を傾斜させた状態において、第１の保持部材７２及び第２の保持部材７４に圧接部材７３を圧接するためのばね力ｆを付与するばね力付与部材７５とを備えた。 【選択図】図５

title: Method for removing high density lipoprotein in blood
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for selectively and quickly removing high density lipoprotein (HDL) from a blood sample.SOLUTION: This method for removing the high density lipoprotein from the blood sample is provided by comprising the formation of a complex comprising pore silica and the high density lipoprotein by bringing the pore silica in contact with the blood sample under the condition of pH 3.0-6.5 and the separation of the complex from the blood sample. The method for measuring low density lipoprotein is provided by comprising the measurement of the low density lipoprotein in the blood sample after removing the high density lipoprotein by using (a) cholesterol esterase and (b) cholesterol oxidase or cholesterol dehydrogenase.

title: Failure detector for electrostatic potentiometer of copying machine or the like
abstract: PURPOSE:To simply detect the failure of an electrostatic potentiometer without using a measuing instrument by impressing a voltage with a proper waveform to an electrostatic latent image recording member, detecting the potential by the electrostatic potentiometer and detecting the failure of the potentiometer from the potential and a delay. CONSTITUTION:At the time of setting up an operation mode to a failure detecting mode in order to detect a failure in the electrostatic potentiometer 7, a square waveform signal (c) is outputted from a control device 9 to a high voltage amplifier 10. The signal (c) is impressed to the electrostatic latent image recording member 4 through a current collecting brush 12 and sent from the potentiometer 7 to the control device 9. The control device 9 reads out voltage V1 obtained after t1sec from the trailing edge of a signal (b) inputted from the potentiometer 7 and displays the value V1 on a display device 13. The potential V1 obtained after t1sed and displayed on the display device 13 is compared with a regulated value, and when the displayed value is <= the regulated value, the normality of the potentiometer is decided, and in case of exceeding the regulated value, its failure can be easily decided.

title: Print control device and program
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To shorten time till the start of printing without generating a case in which the transfer of print data to a printer is not in time when re-printing of the printer data having been transmitted to the printer is performed in a constitution in which print data developed by performing drawing processing is stored in a storage device, is temporarily recorded in volatile storage means, and then is transmitted to the printer.SOLUTION: When transferring developed print data stored in an HDD 33 to a memory 36, executing necessary image processing on the data, and then transmitting it from a transmittance part 37 to a printer 10, a control part 34 leaves the print data having been transmitted to the printer 10 in the memory 36 in a re-printing available state. When transferring new print data from the HDD 33 to the memory 36, the control part 34 partially deletes print data having been transmitted to secure a recording capacity for transferring the print data among print data recorded in the memory 36 when the recording capacity of the memory 36 is insufficient.

title: Manufacture of semiconductor device
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the decrease of concentration caused by diffusion of phosphorus by providing an ion mixing process after a silicide layer is formed and crystallized by heat treatment. CONSTITUTION:On a P-type silicon substrate 1 wherein trivalent boron B<+> is mixed into silicon crystal, a field oxide film 2 is formed, and element isolation is performed. The surface of the substrate 1 is oxidized in a dry oxygen atmosphere, thereby forming a gate oxide film 3, on which a photo resist film (r) is selectively formed. Next the substrate is exposed to an atmosphere of boron B gas being P-type impurity, and the boron gas is diffused and mixed into the substrate 1 from the exposed part position. After the layer (r) is eliminated, washed with suitable acid and inorganic solvent, and dried, silicide 6 is formed on the surface. After that, the substrate is heated in a high temperature atmosphere, thereby crystallizing the layer 5. Since boron gas B is mixed into the substrate 1, the decrease of concentration caused by the diffusion of mixed-in atom can be prevented.

title: Automatic original feeder
abstract: PURPOSE:To bring a conveyed original into contact automatically by starting taking a copy without projecting a register gate which stops the original on platen glass in contact with the platen glass. CONSTITUTION:A CPU21 is connected to ROM23, RAM24, a belt running motor driving circuit 25, a plunger solenoid driving circuit 26, and a copy control circuit 27. The register gate 7 is normally in a projection state, and stops the original which is sent automatically and then lowers the projection part below the platen glass 2 before a copy is taken. Therefore, the automatically sent original is brought into contact with on the glas 2 excellently.

title: 光変調素子の駆動方法及び光変調素子並びにそれを用いた露光装置、平面表示装置
abstract:
(57)【要約】
【課題】  高速変調やアレイ化の不要な安価な光源が使 用可能になり、しかも、構造が簡素で、高精度な位置合 わせが不要になる光変調素子の駆動方法及び光変調素子 並びにそれを用いた露光装置、平面表示装置を提供す る。
【解決手段】  光源２３からの光を伝搬させる導光体２ ７と、この導光体２７の境界面に対面して設けられる主 可撓薄膜３３と、主可撓薄膜３３より光伝搬方向下流側 で導光体２７の境界面に対面して設けられる副可撓薄膜 ３５とを備え、電気機械動作により主可撓薄膜３３と境 界面との距離を変化させて導光体２７を伝搬する光の透 過率を変化させるとともに、電気機械動作により副可撓 薄膜３５と境界面との距離を変化させ、導光体２７を伝 搬する透過光の光路を偏向させて導光体２７から外部へ 出射される光を制御する。

title: 組成物、密着膜、積層体、硬化物パターンの製造方法および回路基板の製造方法
abstract: 密着性および濡れ性に優れた組成物、密着膜、積層体、硬化物パターンの製造方法および回路基板の製造方法の提供。化合物１又は化合物群２と溶剤を含むインプリント用密着膜形成用組成物であって、化合物１等は、極性変換基が処理されると、２種以上の化合物に分解されることが可能な化合物であり、少なくとも１種の分子量が３０〜４００であり、少なくとも１種の分子量が１,０００以上である、組成物；化合物１：重合性基と極性変換基とを有する樹脂であり、樹脂は極性変換基を主鎖に有するか側鎖に有するかの少なくともいずれかであり、極性変換基を側鎖に有する場合の極性変換基は、樹脂の主鎖に連結基を介して結合しており、連結基の鎖を構成する原子の数が８以上である化合物、化合物群２：重合性基を有し極性変換基を有さない化合物および重合性基を有さず極性変換基を有する化合物。

abstract: 【課題】  塗布法により成膜する際の成膜性と得られる膜の電気特性との双方を高水準で達成することが可能である新規な電荷輸送性化合物を提供すること。 【解決手段】  下記一般式（Ｉ）で表わされる電荷輸送性化合物。   【化１】       ［式中、Ｘ １ 、Ｘ ２ 及びＸ ３ は各々独立にハロゲン原子、炭素数１〜１０のアルキル基、炭素数１〜１０のアルコキシル基、置換もしくは未置換のアリール基、炭素数７〜１０のアラルキル基、置換もしくは未置換のスチリル基、置換もしくは未置換のブタジエン基、又は、置換もしくは未置換のヒドラゾン基を、Ｒ １ 、Ｒ ２ 及びＲ ３ は各々独立に炭素数１〜１８の１価の有機基を、Ｌ １ 、Ｌ ２ 及びＬ ３ は各々独立にアルキレン基を、ｐ１、ｐ２及びｐ３は各々独立に０〜２の整数を、ｑ１、ｑ２及びｑ３は０又は１を示し、（ｑ１＋ｑ２＋ｑ３）≧１の条件を満たす。］ 【選択図】  なし

title: Citryl methacrylate monomers, polymers, dispersions, and inks
abstract: A compound according to Formula (1) or a salt thereof, where R is H, methyl, or ethyl. A method for preparing compounds according to Formula (1) comprising: protecting carboxylic acid groups in citric acid with a protecting agent; esterifying the free hydroxyl group to yield a citryl acrylate; deprotecting the carboxylate groups. A polymer obtained by polymerisation of a compound according to Formula (1). The polymer may be a copolymer, and may comprise one or more compounds according to Formula (1), one or more hydrophobic ethylenically unsaturated monomers, and one or more hydrophilic ethylenically unsaturated monomers. Also specified is the use of the polymer for preparing an ink jet printing ink comprising a pigment, liquid medium, and the polymer.

title: Light wavelength conversion device
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent the deterioration of an element by providing a filter cutting off the light included in the absorption wavelength region of an organic nonlinear optical material constituting the conversion element within the external light fed to a transparent window and transmitting the wavelength conversion wave. CONSTITUTION:A light wavelength conversion element 10 stored in a sealed container 20 filled with dry nitrogen gas 50, a semiconductor laser 16 emitting the fundamental wave 15, and a collimator lens 17 and an objective lens 18 serving as an incidence optical system are provided. Transparent windows 27, 28 of the sealed container 20 are formed with a filter cutting off the light in the absorption wavelength region of the material of the core 11 of the conversion element 10, the external light included in this region is absorbed by the transparent windows 27, 28 and does not infiltrate into the sealed container 20, thus the core 11 is surely prevented from being denatured by the photochemical reaction.

title: Radiographic apparatus and operation method of the same
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To radiograph stereoscopic vision images having an appropriate depth feel corresponding to a subject, in a radiographic apparatus.SOLUTION: Radiation is emitted to a subject from a first radiographing direction and the radiation transmitted through the subject is detected by a radiation detector 131. A reaching dose T which has reached the radiation detector 131 is measured, and a convergence angle Δθ is set on the basis of the reaching dose T. The radiation is emitted to the subject from a second radiographing direction and the radiation transmitted through the subject is detected by the radiation detector 131. Radiation image data for the respective first and second radiographing directions is generated on the basis of detection signals from the radiation detector 131.

title: Image forming device

title: Sheet material supply device
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To certainly avoid overlapped delivery of sheet materials in simple constitution. SOLUTION: A high friction coefficient part 82 and a low friction coefficient part 80 are provided on an outer peripheral surface of a separation roller 72, and a paper feeding roller 64 to rotate by a motor and a guide roller 66 smaller in radius than the paper feeding roller 64 and free to rotate are provided so as to face against this separation roller 72. When a second sheet P is carried by being dragged by a first sheet P to be carried by the paper feeding roller 64, the second sheet P makes contact with the high friction coefficient part 82 on its head end, and further carriage is avoided. Additionally, the second sheet P is pushed back to the side of a pressure plate 37 by the separation roller 72 which is energized by a coil spring 88 immediately after the first sheet P is separated from the separation roller 72.

title: Information input device
abstract: PURPOSE:To prevent a titled device from becoming large in size by providing a keyboard on the upper face of a device main frame, providing an original read part of a facsimile on its lower part, and forming them as one body. CONSTITUTION:When code information is inputted to a keyboard 2, various functions of preparation, editing, etc. of a document are attained by a control part 20, and it is transmitted between each device through a communication circuit 23. On the other hand, as for image information, when an original 3 is sent into an original read part A from an inlet part 15 of a device main frame 1, an LED array 5 irradiates the original 3, and it is condensed on a close contact type long image sensor 7, stored, compressed and encoded, modulated, and sent out to the circuit 23. On the other hand, said information can be handled in the same way as the code information by applying a read signal to the control part 20 and encoding it.

title: Image data compressing device
abstract: PURPOSE:To compress even an original where characters and half-tones are mixed together without spoiling the picture quality by converting respective picture elements in a block into binary data and replacing them with a specific bit pattern when the picture elements are in a character area, or replacing them with the mean value in the block when the picture elements are in a half-tone area. CONSTITUTION:When image data is outputted actually, the area decision flag of the head bit of the image data is detected when the flag indicates '0', the same image data is read out three times repeatedly in a main-scanning and a subscanning direction and stored in a three-line buffer. The image data is compared with the threshold pattern of a dither matrix for binary coding and output binary data obtained by the comparison is generated in a three-line buffer for output. Further, when the area decision flag indicates '1', on the other hand, the data is character data, so bit patterns corresponding to picture elements A-D, and F-I are read out to the three-line buffer for output and they are restored according to the states of the picture elements A-D, and F-I and then stored.

title: Image search device, image search program, and storage medium for image search program
